Within two years it held the densest data in the niche.

C-MT-006E.title_en: Read Institutions and Physics on One Map
C-MT-006E.description_en: A manufacturer fought data leaks without success. Security overlaid the permission regime (who may see) onto system topology (where data flows) and immediately found three gaps 'permitted on paper yet unblockable in the plumbing'. Governance shifted from firewall thinking to structural thinking.

C-MT-007E.title_en: Go Where Rivals Will Not, for the Data
C-MT-007E.description_en: An industry team noticed homogenized research: all data came from 'easy-to-visit' headline firms. Inverse siting: interview hidden champions and shuttered plants — the chair-inaccessible ones. A year later they owned the sector's only 'decline sample library', and valuation models sharpened markedly.

C-MT-008E.title_en: Write Reports a Third Party Can Re-Walk
C-MT-008E.description_en: A due-diligence firm was asked to make reports third-party verifiable. The team rewrote the genre: body organized by investigation path, eyewitness / hearsay / inference anchored by distinct verbs, obstructions and retreats recorded as fact. New reports were admitted directly as evidence in arbitration.

C-MT-009E.title_en: Write 'Not Yet Resolved' Into the Deliverable
C-MT-009E.description_en: A consultancy had been burned by vague 'basically certain' phrasing. New rules require a preserved-doubt zone: unresolved questions, each with evidence status and next-round verification advice, plus the cause of suspension (cannot judge vs never reached judging). Clients raised renewal rates precisely for this honesty.

C-MT-010E.title_en: Take the Money, Never the Agenda
C-MT-010E.description_en: An independent research institute was offered full funding by a single patron — with a veto over topics. It declined the single-source structure: own floor plus many small donors, reciprocity limited to information and credit, routes and publication never traded, exit rights written into terms. Three years on: agenda intact, sources plural.

C-CC-001E.title_en: A Full-Time Opposition Seat for Every Conclusion
C-CC-001E.description_en: An investment committee kept reversing decisions after the meeting — no objections in the room, holes everywhere in execution. The new partner added a 'strongest opposition' seat: no conclusion passes until a dedicated cross-examination round fails to break it. Two quarters later reversals fell 70% — weak conclusions now die in the room, not in the market.

C-CC-002E.description_en: Two teams read 'feature complete' differently; rework and blame ran in circles. The PM opened a definition round: each side gives a definition and three borderline counterexamples to attack the other's. Two rounds yielded a three-part acceptance bar (merged code, test coverage, docs). 'Done' became a contract instead of a feeling; scheduling disputes halved.

C-CC-003E.title_en: The Retrospective Looks at Us First
C-CC-003E.description_en: After an outage, teams traded blame and the retro became a tribunal. The new CTO's rule: hour one covers only 'which of our steps could improve'; external factors wait for hour two, plus a fixed three-question weekly self-check. Six months on, repeat incidents fell 40% — with the noise of blame gone, the signal of improvement surfaced.

C-CC-004E.description_en: One-size-fits-all training bored veterans and lost newcomers. The L&D lead pre-diagnosed by deficiency and re-cut the same principles per group: the hesitant practiced speaking first, the aggressive practiced risk first. Pass rates rose from 60% to 90% — content unchanged, dosage changed.

C-CC-005E.title_en: No Key Knowledge May Live in One Head
C-CC-005E.description_en: When the core engineer left, nobody dared touch the system three months later. The CTO instituted person-as-text: every critical module staffed by two trained owners and one designated successor, with rotation exams as the transfer gate. A year later every key role had a backup; the next wave of departures caused no gaps.

C-CC-006E.title_en: Fines and Honor for Late Meetings
C-CC-006E.description_en: Fining latecomers changed nothing — the fine had become a 'lateness tax'. Management added a second rail: fines stayed, plus monthly punctuality credit postings and a team honor board; three clean months won resource priority. Within a quarter, lateness nearly vanished — penalty governs behavior, shame and honor govern motive.

C-CC-007E.description_en: Shop-floor safety violations kept rising; fines did nothing. The safety director inverted the process: every violation opens with a cognitive interview — 'what do you think the harness stops? what actually happens in a fall?' Most workers simply did not grasp the real magnitude. After cognitive training, repeat violations dropped 60%: most 'knowing violations' were not knowing.

C-CC-008E.title_en: Minutes Record Speeches; Handbooks Get Rebuilt
C-CC-008E.description_en: Meeting minutes had been 'distilled for spirit' until the original words vanished and accountability blurred. The new dual-track rule: minutes are low-intervention — speeches and attendees only — while methodology lives in a separate reconstructed handbook signed by its rebuilder. Disputes dropped within six months: 'who said it' and 'who translated it' now sign separately.

C-CC-009E.title_en: No Paper Enters the Library Without a Rebuttal
C-CC-009E.description_en: The team forwarded paper summaries; the knowledge base filled with undigested input. The architect's rule: every entry ships with one rebuttal or one reconstruction attempt — 'no three corners returned, no entry'. A year later the library was two-thirds thinner and citation rates doubled — what remained had been thought through.

C-CC-010E.description_en: In fundraising, investors doubted the team's commitment. On the spot the founders announced a 30% pay cut for all until retention targets held, CEO resuming last — turning 'we believe in the product' from slogan into collateral. The next round priced 40% higher: when claimants pay first, credit becomes priceable.

C-CC-011E.title_en: Dark-Baseline Stress Test — Modern Application of The Dark-Baseline Method
C-CC-011E.description_en: A modern scenario applying The Dark-Baseline Method (M-CC-011): Corporate governance: independent directors, auditor separation, and non-compete clauses are all dark-baseline engineering that trusts structure, not goodwill Cautionary note: Cautionary: Qin Er Shi ruled by Han-Fei-style severity, yet the handles of reward and punishment slipped to Zhao Gao (th...

C-CC-012E.title_en: Structural-Power Redesign — Modern Application of The Structural-Power Method
C-CC-012E.description_en: A modern scenario applying The Structural-Power Method (M-CC-012): Platform strategy and moat theory: assess a firm by structural position (network effects, switching costs, scale leverage), not founder talent — Han Fei's 'position before virtue' in modern dress Cautionary note: Cautionary: Qin's institutionalized 'law plus position' conquered all under heaven, then died in two reigns: when positi...

C-CC-013E.title_en: Core-Process Privacy — Modern Application of The Privatized-Art Method
C-CC-013E.description_en: A modern scenario applying The Privatized-Art Method (M-CC-013): Information discipline in leadership: executives reveal no leanings during uncertainty (neutral language in earnings calls and all-hands letters) so the organization stops guessing and starts working — institutionalized 'strip away likes and dislikes' Cautionary note: Cautionary: an executive who ran 'vision-sell' as management art, with a public persona long divorced from internal layo...

C-CC-014E.title_en: Single-Efficacy Audit — Modern Application of The Single-Test-of-Results Method
C-CC-014E.description_en: A modern scenario applying The Single-Test-of-Results Method (M-CC-014): OKRs and results-based performance management: only delivered outcomes count, never effort in the abstract — Han Fei's 'demand his achievement' institutionalized; the key companion is periodic re-estimation of the metrics themselves Cautionary note: Cautionary: Qin's single-test system of merit ranks and annual audits topped the world's power table, yet the metric car...

C-CC-015E.title_en: Times-Change Rule Refresh — Modern Application of The Time-Contingency Method
C-CC-015E.description_en: A modern scenario applying The Time-Contingency Method (M-CC-015): Strategic inflection-point management (Grove): set tripwires to detect when the environment has crossed the bend, and force transformation debates in good times — 'law moving with the times' in contemporary form Cautionary note: Cautionary: Nokia re-invented itself time and again on exactly this logic (paper to rubber to phones), yet in the smartp...

C-CC-016E.title_en: Full-Rule Publication — Modern Application of The Published-Code and Rule-Primacy Method
C-CC-016E.description_en: A modern scenario applying The Published-Code and Rule-Primacy Method (M-CC-016): Auditing 'public rules, private discretion' in corporate governance: shareholder agreements and handbooks are published while promotion and dismissal decisions run in the dark room — measure the real gold content of published rules by their deviation band Cautionary note: Cautionary: Qin's fall in the second generation — 'nothing more visible than law' degenerated into 'nothing heavier than...

C-CC-017E.title_en: Two-Faced Rhetoric Control — Modern Application of The Two-Faced Rhetoric Method
C-CC-017E.description_en: A modern scenario applying The Two-Faced Rhetoric Method (M-CC-017): Core-shell separation in managing upward: when bad news goes to the decision layer, the core (facts and risk) is never decorated, while the shell (timing, framing, attachment to initiatives already funded) is re-fitted to the decision-maker's mood Cautionary note: Cautionary: Han Fei himself is the failed case study of 'Shuo Nan' — his counsel so penetrating that fellow-student Li S...

C-CC-018E.title_en: Dual-Draft Writing — Modern Application of The Two-Draft Method
C-CC-018E.description_en: A modern scenario applying The Two-Draft Method (M-CC-018): Two-track audit of corporate charters and crisis playbooks: normal-times governance documents and war-room emergency-authority documents must share deep operators (a transparency floor, say), and the emergency segment's trigger, term, and exit audit must be written down Cautionary note: Cautionary: readers who take sides with one draft of Machiavelli double the distortion — 'Machiavellianism' keeps the Pr...

C-CC-019E.title_en: Lone-Minister Community — Modern Application of The Lone-Minister Community Method
C-CC-019E.description_en: A modern scenario applying The Lone-Minister Community Method (M-CC-019): Managing revolving-door distance between researchers and regulators: officials moving into think tanks should set cooling-off periods and data-access boundaries, keeping domain knowledge without renting out their stance Cautionary note: Cautionary: two-way failures of the distance band — Han Fei drifted too near (retained in Qin) and died of Li Si's frame...

C-CC-020E.title_en: Legacy-Cost Audit — Modern Application of The Legacy-Cost Audit Method
C-CC-020E.description_en: A modern scenario applying The Legacy-Cost Audit Method (M-CC-020): Legacy-cost audits for founders and their inventions: when assessing a foundational technology (encryption, nuclear power, social media), account separately for the inventor's personal fate and the deployment outcomes — sympathy for the founder must not discount deployment risk Cautionary note: Cautionary: single-ledger reading of the two legacies produced twin mis-accountings — reading ledger one alone canonizes...

C-CC-021E.description_en: A research team facing a huge technical survey kept aiming for one grand answer and producing nothing. The new lead sliced the problem into two hundred exhaustible items, each person 'ge-ing' only their few each day, plus a monthly 'coherence review' turning investigated items into one synthesis. Six months later the synthesis wrote itself — gradual accumulation had reached its breakthrough point.

C-CC-022E.title_en: The Review Board with a Signed Ruling
C-CC-022E.description_en: An architecture board kept ending 'rich discussion, merit on both sides,' then re-arguing the same points three months later. The CTO imposed a scholastic agenda: opposition states its strongest case first, each side lists its authorities, the chair must issue a signed ruling, and unanswered objections enter a carried-forward list. Debate stopped cycling — every objection now had a home.

C-CC-023E.description_en: A law firm's junior associates cited blogs, cases, and statutes as if equal, muddying their briefs' persuasiveness. The firm built a force-tier table: statutes tier one, cases tier two, scholarship tier three, blogs inadmissible — with the conflict rule fixed in advance (higher overrides lower). Brief quality and win rates rose together.

C-CC-024E.description_en: A platform's permission system had grown so many proxy layers that no one could say where a given grant originally came from. The new architect ran a no-infinite-regress audit: every dependency chain must terminate in a non-derivative anchor; what could not was filed as an architectural defect. The audit found seventeen ghost permissions with 'no first cause' and sealed them all.

C-CC-025E.title_en: Tiering Desires Instead of Banning Them
C-CC-025E.description_en: A product director tried total phone abstinence, failed repeatedly, and blamed herself. A coach proposed Zhu Xi's tiering: necessary (work messages), moderate (thirty minutes of social browsing), excessive (late-night short videos). Governance targeted only the 'excessive' tier's concrete triggers. Night scrolling vanished in three months — she had stopped fighting desire and started pruning its excess.

C-CC-026E.title_en: State the Common Good Before the Budget
C-CC-026E.description_en: A city's data-center budget hearings drowned in procedural detail. A new rule required every public-project filing to declare on page one: what common good it serves and where the benefits flow. A procedurally impeccable project whose benefits concentrated among connected firms was flagged on the spot — the purpose clause became the revealing mirror.

C-CC-027E.description_en: A popular open-source library lived entirely in its founder's private repository and oral tradition; when the founder burned out, the project nearly died. The community rebuilt it as an institution: charter, module curriculum, reviewer certification, regular releases. Two years later the founder left and the project ran on — the doctrine had been written into institutions, not texts and persons.

C-CC-028E.title_en: Master Outline First in Doc Rebuilding
C-CC-028E.description_en: A company's knowledge base held eight thousand contradictory, unusable documents. Instead of patching piece by piece, the lead wrote a one-page master outline first, tagged the stock as take/discard/transform, gave each major rival approach a load-bearing chapter, and published an unfinished list. Three months later the new base was usable — old documents became the system's evidence layer, not its noise.

C-CC-029E.title_en: Post-Mortems by Department, Not by Blame
C-CC-029E.description_en: A firm's failure reviews always concluded 'insufficient ownership' and the same errors recurred. A new process required attribution by department — information lapse, judgment usurpation, execution absence — with remedies matched to the disorder: cooling-off design for emotional usurpation, handover checklists for execution absence. Similar incidents halved within six months.

C-CC-030E.title_en: Ledger Entries at the Orthodoxization Moment
C-CC-030E.description_en: A community-driven technical standard was adopted by a big-vendor consortium and the community celebrated its 'victory.' One veteran launched a cost audit: recording which community voices the adoption clauses excluded, keeping a list of suppressed alternatives, reviewed quarterly. Two years later when the consortium tried to lock the standard, the community quickly reorganized a viable fork — because the costs had been booked all along.

C-HZX-001E.category: 政治合法性理论/民本主义
C-HZX-001E.title_en: Tianxia as Principal, Ruler as Guest: Resetting Political Legitimacy in 'Origin of the Ruler'
C-HZX-001E.description_en: After the Ming's fall, Huang's 'Origin of the Ruler' traces rulership to a contracted role—cultivating public good and removing public harm—and condemns rulers who keep the realm as private estate as 'the great harm of Tianxia,' transferring the court of legitimacy from heaven's mandate to the lived welfare of all under heaven.

C-HZX-002E.category: 制度设计理论/治理方法论
C-HZX-002E.title_en: Good Law Before Good Men: The Institutional-Priority Manifesto of 'Origin of Law'
C-HZX-002E.description_en: 'Origin of Law' distinguishes the Three Dynasties' 'law of Tianxia' from the post-Qin 'law of one family,' arguing that 'non-law law' manacles the realm so even a worthy ruler cannot govern well—the order must invert: first establish public law, then seek the men.

C-HZX-003E.category: 公共领域理论/协商民主
C-HZX-003E.title_en: Public Right-and-Wrong Decided in Schools: The Grand Director's Vermilion-Inking
C-HZX-003E.description_en: The 'Schools' chapter designs an academic estate independent of the executive: the Grand Learning director ranks with the chancellor, decrees take effect only after public school deliberation and vermilion inking, and county schools review local governance each term—public reason given a statutory veto point.

C-HZX-004E.title_en: Li Is the Li of Qi: An Philosophical Audit Against 'Li Before Qi'
C-HZX-004E.description_en: Against Zhu Xi's 'li before qi,' Huang objects that a prior principle would be 'a separate thing'—the cosmos is one qi in flux and li is qi's own regularity. His calendrical science substantiates it: heaven's way is not an entity aloft but a computable process.

C-HZX-005E.title_en: One Essence, Many Manifestations: The Pluralist Academic History of the Ming Ru Xue An
C-HZX-005E.description_en: Compiling the 'Ming Ru Xue An,' Huang ruled that 'partial views and opposing arguments deserve a scholar's closest attention at their differences,' condemning the homogenization of 'pouring water into water'—schools stand side by side, and divergence itself becomes the information.

C-HZX-006E.title_en: Rooted in the Classics, Verified in the Histories: The Statecraft Pipeline of Learning
C-HZX-006E.description_en: 'Learning must be rooted in the classics to avoid treading on emptiness and verified in the histories to manage affairs'—Huang grounds scholarship in canonical norms, tests it against the historical record, and drags learning from late-Ming mind-nature talk back to the real battlefields of institutions, taxation, and defense.

C-HZX-007E.title_en: Astronomical Audit of the Classics: Recomputing the Spring-Autumn Eclipses
C-HZX-007E.description_en: Huang recomputed the thirty-six eclipses of the Spring and Autumn Annals with Han and Yuan calendar systems against the text, and his calendrical expertise fed the unmasking of the forged Old Text Documents—turning 'seeking truth from facts' into a falsification procedure with independent instruments.

C-HZX-008E.title_en: The Ratchet of Accumulated Harm: Huang Zongxi's Law of Fiscal Rebound
C-HZX-008E.description_en: The 'Land Tax' chapter tracks reform from the two-tax law to the Single Whip: each consolidation briefly lightens burdens, then new surcharges regrow beyond former levels—'accumulated harm cannot return,' the institutional logic by which tax merger without an anti-accretion lock guarantees rebound.

C-HZX-009E.category: 文化认同理论/民族政治学
C-HZX-009E.title_en: Distinguishing Yi and Xia by Civilization: The Leftover Subject's Standard
C-HZX-009E.description_en: After the Ming's fall Huang refused Qing office for life, grounding resistance in the Yi-Xia distinction—yet what he defended was culture, not blood: he accepted Western astronomy's precision and urged converging the two learnings, holding the civilizational standard above the political boundary while refusing to bless armed conquest.

C-HZX-010E.title_en: Synthesizing the Many into One: From Valley to River to Sea
C-HZX-010E.description_en: 'A scholar a thousand years on, unable to synthesize the many into one—from valley to river, river to sea—can this be called mastering the classics?' The 'Ming Ru Xue An' distills each school from its complete works, states each aim unreconciled, and lets the convergent structure of the many emerge from the material itself.

tags_en: Tai Xu as Qi Method (Cosmic Qi Ontology)
C-ZZ-001E.title_en: Tai Xu as Qi: Ending "Being Born from Non-Being" in the Zhengmeng
C-ZZ-001E.description_en: Opening the Zhengmeng, Zhang Zai pronounces: everything describable exists, everything existing has form, everything formed is qi — the void is not nothingness but the clear, formless state of qi. The whole inquiry of "being born from non-being" is redirected: not being arising from nothing, but the illusion of being and nothing explained by qi's two phases, condensation and dispersal.

C-ZZ-002E.title_en: Enmity Resolves in Harmony: The Terminus of Contradiction in Supreme Harmony
C-ZZ-002E.description_en: In the Zhengmeng, four clauses set the dialectical charter: Supreme Harmony is not a conflictless mush but a dynamic unity that contains opposition and reconciles it. Zhang refuses to read "harmony" as absence of conflict, and refuses to read "enmity" as a war that must end with one side annihilated — the terminus of contradiction is reconciliation.

tags_en: Universal Kinship Method (All People as Siblings, All Things as Companions)
C-ZZ-003E.title_en: All People as Siblings: The Cosmic Family Ethics of the Western Inscription
C-ZZ-003E.description_en: The Western Inscription opens with "Heaven is my father, Earth is my mother," translating cosmology directly into ethics: since what fills the universe is my body, all humans are siblings and all things companions. Concrete virtues — loyalty, filiality, benevolence — are rehoused in the narrative of serving Heaven as one serves parents, giving everyday ethics ontological weight.

tags_en: Great-Mind Method (Expanding the Mind to Embody All Things)
C-ZZ-004E.title_en: Greaten the Mind to Embody All Things: A Geometry of Cognitive Boundaries
C-ZZ-004E.description_en: The Zhengmeng's "Great Mind" chapter defines cognitive deficit as "the mind still has an outside": if a thing remains un-emodied, the mind has not yet enclosed the world. The ordinary mind stops at the narrowness of the senses, while the sage "sees no thing in the world as not himself" — to greaten the mind is not to know more facts but to abolish the self-limitation of cognition, folding the whole world into realization.

tags_en: Moral-Knowledge Method (De Xing Zhi — Transcending Sensory Knowledge)
C-ZZ-005E.title_en: Moral Knowledge Does Not Sprout from the Senses: Drawing the Is–Ought Line
C-ZZ-005E.description_en: The "Great Mind" chapter distinguishes sensory knowledge from moral knowledge: the former is knowledge from contact with things, the latter does not sprout from the senses. No abundance of sensory experience yields a moral ought — this epistemic boundary was drawn in the eleventh century, echoing Hume's is–ought gap nine hundred years before Hume.

tags_en: Endowment-Transformation Method (From Qi Zhi to Heavenly Nature)
C-ZZ-006E.title_en: The Learner Must First Transform His Endowment: Endowment Is Not a Verdict
C-ZZ-006E.description_en: The "Sincerity and Illumination" chapter proposes a two-story theory of human nature: the biases wrought by one's qi endowment are real, yet "if one turns back well, the nature of Heaven and Earth is preserved within." Learning and ritual are the operating levers of change — the bias of endowment is a construction plan, not a verdict, and self-transformation is the prior engineering of all inquiry.

tags_en: One-Thing-Two-Bodies Method (The Dialectic of Integral Opposites)
C-ZZ-007E.title_en: One Thing, Two Bodies: The Systemic Structure of the Supreme Polarity
C-ZZ-007E.description_en: The "Parity and Duality" chapter defines Tai Ji as "one thing with two bodies": every unity contains two opposed aspects moving in contrary directions, and "if the two do not stand, the one cannot be seen" — remove either side and the whole ceases to hold. Zhang internalizes the opposites within one thing, rejecting external-cause theories at the ontological level.

tags_en: Statecraft-for-the-People Method (Learning in the Service of Order)
C-ZZ-008E.category: 政治哲学 / 治理实践
C-ZZ-008E.title_en: Buying Land to Test the Well-Field: Master Hengqu's Policy Experiment
C-ZZ-008E.description_en: Retiring to Hengqu in his late years, Zhang Zai bought a plot of land and planned to divide it into sections, preparing to trial the well-field system by "buying and tilling together" — he went beyond arguing the ideal of the Three Dynasties' methods to fund an institutional MVP with real silver. The well-field and enfeoffment discussions of the Classic of Learning Textual Repos carry this undertone: the value of thought is settled by whether it can be landed to settle the people.

C-ZZ-009E.title_en: Finding Doubt Where There Was None: Questioning as the Engine of Learning
C-ZZ-009E.description_en: The Recorded Sayings of Master Zhang set the charter "learning values the mind's awakening; clinging to the old achieves nothing," and the yardstick "to find doubt where there was none — that is progress": raising questions outranks reciting answers. "Where principle has doubt, wash away the old view to admit the new meaning" adds the operative procedure — rinse the old to admit the new.

tags_en: Ritual-to-Nature Method (Li as the Perfection of Human Nature)
C-ZZ-010E.title_en: Knowing Ritual to Perfect Nature: Ritual as the Medium in Which Nature Grows
C-ZZ-010E.description_en: The "Centrality and Correctness" chapter holds that "only the virtuous can truly know ritual," and ritual is "what principle demands": through practice, external norms are internalized as nature, and freedom is thereby redefined — not release from norms but norms digested, arriving at "following the heart's desire without overstepping the line." The Guan School's "teaching through ritual" changed the folkways of Guanzhong.

C-BV-001E.title_en: Map Constraints Before Speaking of Choice
C-BV-001E.description_en: A company's promotion reviews kept drawing unfairness complaints. The new chair replaced attitude training with a situational audit: every case first lists the candidate's actual given conditions — resources, information, room for trial and error, visibility — before judging performance. Within two rounds, disputes fell sharply: most 'capability gaps' resolved into situational gaps, and the firm rebuilt its rotation and resource-allocation rules on the evidence.

C-BV-002E.description_en: A product team's 'typical user' persona was a young man; complaints from women and older users clustered on the same interaction barriers. Applying the othering-engine method, the team asked: who drew this category, whose habits does it serve? They replaced the 'default user' with a spectrum of situated users, designing by stratum. Retention among premium users rose after the redesign — particular needs hid universal improvements.

C-BV-003E.title_en: The Installation History of 'Just Not Built for It'
C-BV-003E.description_en: An engineer was convinced he was 'just not built to manage' and repeatedly declined team leads. A coach stage-tracked the narrative: one public shooting-down in college, each subsequent avoidance, and the industry script that 'techies don't manage' installing it link by link. Three intervention points surfaced; he took a three-month small-team stint — by the second retrospective, nobody mentioned 'natural inclination' anymore.

C-BV-004E.title_en: What Future Is This Role Allowed
C-BV-004E.description_en: A department's senior roles paid well yet churned constantly. Diagnosis started not with pay but with the right to project: what were these roles allowed to initiate? Answer: only maintenance and repetition. Management rebuilt the roles with a proposal budget — every position got a pool of resources it could autonomously project with. Within a year the highest-churn roles went to zero, and people who had left began returning.

C-BV-005E.description_en: In a dispute over whether women fit heavy-duty roles, HR introduced a three-level distinction: admit the inventory of physiological facts (strength distribution) → argue item by item under which equipment and process arrangements each fact becomes an obstacle → set 'what the adapted body can still do' as the acceptance criterion. Most roles passed via tooling changes; only two categories truly failed. The debate turned from a clash of stances into an engineering problem.

C-BV-006E.description_en: A firm launched a huge but uncertain new venture. The project file added a 'no-guarantee declaration': unguaranteeable premises, existing business lines it might harm, and named owners for monitoring undesired consequences. Two years later the venture failed; the retrospective went straight to the four declared decision points, item by item. No 'we were all too optimistic' talk — and the team volunteered for the next bet.

C-BV-007E.description_en: Operations found long-time users 'cooperating' with a bad legacy flow and first proposed forced migration. Analysts built the situational ledger first: exit costs, migration learning costs, and a history of ignored protests. The ledger showed strategic acceptance, not endorsement. The team designed feedback-based phased migration that cut the price of revolt to zero — migration completed in three months with no concentrated complaints.

C-BV-008E.title_en: Three Questions Instead of a Satisfaction Survey
C-BV-008E.description_en: A consultancy's annual survey showed high satisfaction — yet top talent kept leaving. The new partner replaced the satisfaction scale with three questions: who may define the project's direction? who may initiate change? who waits for permission? The answers were sharply asymmetric. The firm wrote 'who may initiate change' clauses into every charter and published dissent logs. Attrition fell the next year, and exit interviews, for the first time, carried specific, non-personal suggestions.

C-BV-009E.title_en: A Sample Is Not a Model
C-BV-009E.description_en: A research report framed an entrepreneur as a 'self-made model.' The editor demanded situated-memoir standards: declare sample status (inherited education, networks, the era's window), dissect both ways (what shaped him, what he used), juxtapose records with retrospective narrative. The rewritten story was less 'legendary' — and more cited. Readers trust an analysis that doesn't hide privilege more than a smoothed model.

C-BV-010E.title_en: Policy and Slogan Filed as One Project
C-BV-010E.description_en: A nonprofit advocacy launched two moves at once: an institutional track revising industry standards and a symbolic track of public storytelling to rewrite the narrative — separate ledgers, quarterly weight comparison. Opponents first rebutted only in the press; once the standard text visibly advanced too, they joined the revision. Eighteen months later the standard passed. The retrospective's conclusion: any single-track victory gets bounced back by the other track.

C-AR-001E.description_en: During a corporate 'workforce optimization,' management recast employees as replaceable cost items: cuts were made by 'role redundancy' rather than individual contribution, and no reasons were explained. A consultant flagged the moment organizational language begins calling people 'superfluous' rather than merely 'unsuitable' as an early sign of dehumanization, and proposed reason-giving and an appeals channel be written into the process. Not soft management — a floor against treating people as pure material.

C-AR-002E.description_en: A bank's support team strictly followed 'answer only from script': a customer was double-billed for three months due to a system error, and every agent 'compliantly' replied 'please wait,' no one escalating. In review, one question arose: everyone did their job — where was the failure? The answer: the process permitted everyone not to think. The bank added an 'anomaly escalates' clause, turning 'not my problem' into 'someone must own this to the end.'

C-AR-003E.description_en: An urban renewal plan was twice voted down — residents opposed not redevelopment but 'being represented.' For the third round, instead of a briefing, the planners let each group — elderly residents, tenants, shop owners — state what the plan meant for their lives, then wove the statements into a shared text. The plan passed without unanimity: the decision was no longer a majority acting for the silent, but formed in speech where all appeared to one another.

C-AR-004E.description_en: A content platform put all creators under output KPIs: volume, read-through rate, update frequency. Top writers left — their writing was 'action' (taking a stance, shaping public discussion) being managed as 'labor' (measurable repetitive expenditure). The platform exempted core creators from volume metrics and evaluated them on influence and the quality of dialogue their work generated. Distinguishing activity types is not ranking; it is choosing the right form of evaluation.

C-AR-005E.title_en: Why Public Space Cannot Be Privatized
C-AR-005E.description_en: A city converted its street discussion areas into 'brand pop-up spaces' to boost 'urban vitality.' Citizens found they could consume there but not deliberate on public matters. The municipal research office then designated non-commercial 'public-issue corners' — not for footfall, but so that any issue could be spoken there. A city's vitality lies not in crowds but in spaces where public speech can appear.

C-AR-006E.title_en: Unpredictability as the Power of Action
C-AR-006E.description_en: Pitching investors, a founder was repeatedly asked to 'prove certainty.' Her reply: if the outcome were fully predictable, it would not be a beginning — she showed not guarantees but the team's ability to revise quickly on new information. She got the funding with staged milestones instead of a hard bet. Natality is not irresponsibility; it is honestly treating the new as new.

C-AR-007E.title_en: Forgiveness and Promise to Repair Cooperation
C-AR-007E.description_en: Two companies whose first merger failed reopened talks by doing something unusual: each listed the 'irreversible damage' of the last round — leaks, poaching, press attacks — stating which they would own and which they asked be forgiven, then locked future conduct in written commitments. The second merger closed — not because trust returned, but because the irreversible past was settled and the future bound by promise.

C-AR-008E.description_en: A hospital's post-incident review of a medication error traced execution to a system prompt built on a template three months stale. Management noticed a pattern: every incident sat where 'no one was expected to think' — prompt means execute, execute means compliant. The hospital added mandatory independent recalculation by a second checker on high-risk workflows. Thoughtlessness is not a personal flaw; it can be designed in or out of an organization.

C-AR-009E.title_en: Evaluating Policy with Narrative, Not Metrics
C-AR-009E.description_en: A poverty-alleviation program's evaluation was full of target-achievement rates yet silent on how change happened. The team switched to interviews: participants narrated 'a day in my life before and after.' The narratives showed the turning point was not funding but a village official handing deliberation power to a women's group — absent from every metric. The report was redesigned, and the transferable elements of the policy became visible for the first time.

C-AR-010E.description_en: A city's waste-sorting policy stalled in government-citizen standoff. The deliberation forum added a design: before stating their own side, each speaker first had to present 'the other side's strongest reason,' confirmed by that side. A consensus draft emerged — not from compromised interests but from each side, for the first time, seeing the policy's real constraints from the other's position. Judgment is not a gesture of empathy; it is a way of thinking that can be institutionalized.

C-CUR-001E.title_en: Tracking an Anomaly to the End
C-CUR-001E.description_en: A SaaS firm's monitoring team noticed a fixed 200 ms latency jump at an edge node at 3 a.m. daily — below alert threshold, never gone. Most suggested raising the threshold; one engineer insisted on explaining it first: ruling out batch jobs one by one, they found a departed team's orphan task still writing to the database. The company then made 'unexplained constant anomalies' a mandatory investigation item. An anomaly is not noise; it is a fact not yet read.

C-CUR-002E.description_en: A hospital knew 'post-op experience was poor' but had no lever. Instead of debating which stage was worst, the quality team first set measures: pain scores, time-to-first-mobility, night-time decibel levels, recorded weekly. Three months of data pointed to a single significant factor — night-time alarm tones. Set the metric first, improve second; debate without measurement is only a collision of preferences.

C-CUR-003E.description_en: Yield on a production line fell 3 points with no obvious cause. The team refused 'full inspection' and eliminated by variable groups: new resin batch — no change; shift crews — no change; one aging injection molder — yield restored. Attribution in four steps cost two afternoons instead of two months. The discipline of elimination: write down every ruled-out suspect so it never returns.

C-CUR-004E.title_en: Purifying a Core from a Slag Heap
C-CUR-004E.description_en: A research group sat on mountains of lab notes but could not write the paper. A newcomer proposed Curie's method with pitchblende: don't spread effort — define the purification target (which finding deserves publication), then run a stepwise crystallization: bucket the records by how strongly they support the conclusion, recycle weak evidence, refine strong evidence. Six months later the lead paper was submitted. A breakthrough campaign is not more effort; it is effort concentrated into one purification.

C-CUR-005E.description_en: A materials startup lost competing on 'the best-performing material.' A dual-axis review followed: horizontal = physical performance (conductivity), vertical = the chemical properties customers actually buy (corrosion resistance, workability). They ranked second on conductivity but were unique in the vertical combination — customers never wanted a single-axis champion. The pitch was rewritten: not the best conductor, but the only high-conductivity material that can be welded.

C-CUR-006E.title_en: Opening Core Technology to Build an Ecosystem
C-CUR-006E.description_en: A battery startup gave up patent monopoly on its core formulation, switching to open patents plus certification fees. The board objected; the CEO quoted Curie on radium: 'Radium belongs to all people.' Competitors adopted their standard, and the company's testing method became the de facto industry standard — certification revenue exceeded what monopoly pricing could have earned. Openness is not surrender; it turns a technology into the gravity center of an ecosystem.

C-CUR-007E.description_en: A husband-wife founding team was burning out on 'who decides.' They rewrote governance on the Pierre and Marie Curie model: divide by workflow, not power — one outward (funding, clients), one inward (technical direction), a shared lab notebook, authorship rules fixed in advance (whoever leads is first author), and data — not volume — as the escalation path. Partnerships survive not on affection but on pre-agreed workflow and credit institutions.

C-CUR-008E.description_en: Sanctions cut a company off from a critical component. The team neither dissolved nor idled: with procurement severed, they built the line themselves; locked out of export markets, they went deep into domestic use cases. Two years later their in-house part outperformed the original supplier. Adversity is not a period to endure but a converter that turns 'forced' into 'focused' — provided energy is not spent complaining.

C-CUR-009E.title_en: Converting Basic Research into Rescue Capacity
C-CUR-009E.description_en: After a major earthquake, a robotics lab combed its results shelf: no new robots — instead its existing SLAM and vision algorithms were urgently integrated into a rubble-search prototype, deployed within 72 hours. Critics called it a distraction; the lead quoted Curie's WWI X-ray vans: basic research is not devalued by emergency use — only real basics convert at all. Emergency is the acceptance test of basic research, not its opposite.

C-CUR-010E.title_en: Building a Niche Direction into a Discipline
C-CUR-010E.description_en: Five people ran an 'obscure' direction (explainable AI) inside a large firm. Rather than wait for attention, they institutionalized: internal standards and evaluation benchmarks, quarterly symposia, open training, a glossary in every new hire's handbook. Three years later the direction became a mandatory review gate for all model launches, and the team grew to sixty. A field's survival depends not on geniuses but on whether it is institutionalized — repeatable, teachable, auditable.

C-WZT-001E.title_en: Change the Grading, Not the Slogan
C-WZT-001E.description_en: A retail chain's regional performance relied on two veteran brokers; a new CEO's reform kept getting hollowed out. Instead of pushing the plan, he first changed who scores regional managers — moving promotion-grading power from veteran brokers to HQ and cross-region panels. Within six months the plan landed on its own. He persuaded no one; he changed the authorization structure.

C-WZT-002E.title_en: Change the Pool, Not the Plan
C-WZT-002E.description_en: At a legacy manufacturer, digitization stalled: every mid-level manager rose through the old system and every project died 'for prudence'. The new CTO stopped persuading them; he spun up a digital division staffed with outsiders and fast-tracked juniors carrying no old-system baggage, reporting straight to the CEO. Within two years the new pool forced the old departments to follow. When reform stalls, check whose people run the execution layer before rewriting the plan.

C-WZT-003E.description_en: A big company's executives long reported only good news; every risk report read rosy. The CEO set up an anonymous channel straight to the audit committee, bypassing all management, and publicly promised protection for anyone using it. Nobody knew who was using it — managers began assuming bad news was already reported, and concealment dropped sharply. The channel's real output was not tips but the expectation of being watched.

C-WZT-004E.description_en: A firm hired an aggressive outside debt-collection agency, with contract clauses: no access to core client relationships; installments with the final payment contingent on 'zero complaints'. When collections ended, the company publicly terminated the engagement and published complaint outcomes, client relations intact. When using morally contested tools, design the exit and severance mechanism in advance — far cheaper than cleaning up afterwards.

C-WZT-005E.title_en: Switch the Frame, Not the Verdict
C-WZT-005E.description_en: An automaker's EV program, framed as a 'cost center', bled losses and faced repeated budget cuts. The new lead reframed it as the entry point for data and software capability: metrics shifted from gross margin to battery-data capture and software iteration speed, reporting straight to the board's strategy committee. Once the frame changed, the same team turned from a money pit into the moat's source. Legitimacy contests are, at bottom, contests over frame selection.

C-WZT-006E.title_en: Move the Battle to Your Home Ground
C-WZT-006E.description_en: In a standards war, one company kept losing inside a forum dominated by its rival. It instead co-launched a new open working group with downstream users, hosting discussion, tooling and test benchmarks in a field it anchored. Within two years major vendors joined the new group and the old forum was marginalized. Space is never a neutral container but the carrier of loyalty, supply and information networks — before competing, ask whose arena it is.

C-WZT-007E.description_en: A founder faced an exit dilemma: hand the firm to her children and professionalization stalls; hand it to professional managers and family capital decouples from reputation. She chose the 'who is closer' kind of answer — passing the baton to the family member most aligned with long-termism, while hedging with independent-director veto rights, a family trust, and an open contest for professional managers. In dilemma decisions, the standard is not today's satisfaction but your position at the five-year reckoning.

C-WZT-008E.title_en: Designing the Exit from Wartime Mode
C-WZT-008E.description_en: After a data-fabrication scandal, a company entered 'wartime governance': frozen promotions, layered approvals, hard accountability — the turnaround took a year. From day one the CEO had published exit criteria and a timetable; on the due date he personally lifted the controls, pardoned non-malicious wartime violations, and publicly disciplined two managers who had abused wartime powers. One system, two rule regimes — the pivot must be executed by the one who started it, with the narrative attached.

C-WZT-009E.description_en: When the instant-retail category emerged, rival platforms coined competing labels: '30-minute delivery', 'local-life e-commerce'. The platform whose coinage, 'hourly delivery', stuck went on to own the discursive gateway in media, investor decks and even regulatory papers. Coining a new word beats wrestling in the semantic mud of a rival's old one — whoever controls what a thing is called controls what it is.

C-WZT-010E.description_en: A retiring fund founder refused to write a retrospective of his tenure, leaving instead two institutional arrangements: annual independent attribution review, and traceable records of successor decisions. Challenged on the missing 'conclusion', he replied that any self-authored verdict becomes a fixed target. A decade on, the external review records became a stronger defense than any memoir. When self-justification pays negative, structural silence plus institutional backup beats words.

C-FYJ-001E.title_en: Ask What to Learn Before Enrolling
C-FYJ-001E.description_en: An engineer aiming to move into data science was told to chase hot certificates and trendy frameworks. Instead of following the crowd, he first listed the problems his target role actually solves daily: SQL, statistical fundamentals, business communication. In three months he learned only those three and shipped one small demo project for each — and landed the offer on projects, not certificates. The value of learning lies in solving real problems, not in popularity.

C-FYJ-002E.description_en: An analyst at a consultancy was repeatedly asked to soften reports 'for client feelings'. She quit to become an independent researcher with revenue from many subscribers — no one above twenty percent. She then dared to downgrade her biggest sponsor, losing clients short-term; two years on, 'willing to tell the truth' became her strongest brand. Independence is not a posture; it is a revenue-structure question.

C-FYJ-003E.title_en: Adopt the Mechanism, Not the Aesthetics
C-FYJ-003E.description_en: An expanding company copied Silicon Valley's open offices and free snacks; productivity fell. The new lead traced the 'internal spirit' behind those surface traits: flexible goal-setting and information transparency. He made all operating data and OKRs public, kept private offices — and productivity recovered within six months. When importing best practice, first separate the external decoration from the internal mechanism.

C-FYJ-004E.description_en: A county imported a big city's 'smart city' package; sensors everywhere, nobody used them — the basics of data entry did not exist yet. The next lead re-assessed the actual stage, digitized manual ledgers and trained staff first, and deployed the system two years later. It ran smoothly. Reforms are not right or wrong in themselves; they fit or miss the stage you are actually at.

C-FYJ-005E.title_en: Culture Starts with One Who Goes First
C-FYJ-005E.description_en: A law firm mandated written case opinions; no partner complied and the rule sat idle. Instead of adding enforcement, the managing partner began publishing his own written analyses of every case he handled on the intranet, week after week. Within three months partners followed voluntarily; within a year it became firm custom. Rules do not change culture — the example of one who goes first does.

C-FYJ-006E.title_en: Borrow the Mechanism, Not the Business
C-FYJ-006E.description_en: A restaurant-chain founder, stuck for a profit model at home, studied Japanese convenience-store food supply chains: freshness management, small-batch high-frequency delivery, waste-rate accounting. He did not copy the format — he transplanted three mechanisms and localized them, and single-store margins improved markedly. Learning from another civilization is not about resemblance; it is about whether the mechanism transfers.

C-FYJ-007E.title_en: Turn the Passion into a Business
C-FYJ-007E.description_en: A science writer posted free content for five years and was burning out. On a friend's advice he set up a studio with three revenue lines — a paid column, commissioned explainers, book publishing — and hired an editor. With stable income his output increased and quality rose. Turning discourse into an industry is what lets passion survive without being carried on sentiment alone.

C-FYJ-008E.description_en: An online-education firm's premium courses sold well, yet the founder carved out a free public tier: full chapters free, certificates and coaching paid. Revenue dipped at first, but the user base grew tenfold, and within two years paid conversions out-earned the old model. Democratizing knowledge is not charity — it is lowering the gate to the widest audience and charging at the point where value is realized.

C-FYJ-009E.title_en: The Monitor Stays Outside the Cabinet
C-FYJ-009E.description_en: A veteran journalist was invited to join a government ministry. He declined, staying an independent commentator. His subsequent criticism of that very ministry made headlines, and his reporting drove two policy revisions. His explanation: once inside, you lose the position from which to watch. The 'man of the hour' serves as guide and monitor, not as an office-seeker.

C-FYJ-010E.description_en: A consumer-goods firm was squeezed by the single legacy channel it depended on. Management decided to 'cut loose': over three years it built its own e-commerce and membership system while maintaining the channel relationship — but signed no new exclusivity terms. When the severance was complete, dependence on the old channel had fallen from seventy percent to twenty. Strategic severance is not a declaration of rupture; it is a sequencing job — build the alternative first, then lower the dependence.

C-SBRY-001E.title_en: Put a Steering Wheel on Profit
C-SBRY-001E.description_en: A startup's sales team hid product defects to hit quotas; revenue spiked. The founder went beyond moral lecturing: he wrote 'no hiding defects' into the commission rules — one hidden defect voids the whole commission. Six months later renewal rates beat the industry average. Ethics cannot rely on exhortation; it must be built into the abacus. The abacus needs the Analects; the Analects needs the abacus to cash out.

C-SBRY-002E.title_en: The Organization That Pools Money Beats Money Itself
C-SBRY-002E.description_en: An agri-entrepreneur wanted to build a cold-chain warehouse but her own funds fell far short and banks balked at farming's long cycles. She switched to a cooperative structure: downstream supermarkets and upstream farmers each put in equity, shared the facility, and took dividends by usage. Three supermarkets and twenty-plus farm households joined; the warehouse was built in half a year. What she lacked was never capital — it was the organization that pools dispersed capital.

C-SBRY-003E.title_en: Back the People Before the Project
C-SBRY-003E.description_en: An investor received two nearly identical business plans: one with a mediocre team in a hot sector, one with a first-class team in a cold sector. He funded the latter and helped the team plug industry-resource gaps. Three years on, the hot sector was crowded with copycats, while the first-class team had built a unique moat in the cold one. Success is seven parts people, three parts money — establish the people first, and the money will come.

C-SBRY-004E.title_en: Lose One Deal to Compound a Decade of Credit
C-SBRY-004E.description_en: A small supplier's client demanded a thirty percent price cut or it would switch vendors. The owner accepted the loss-making order — on the condition of a three-year framework agreement with on-time payment. When industry overcapacity later hit and suppliers everywhere chased unpaid invoices, this client not only kept his prices but prepaid to fund his expansion. The thin margin conceded today is the compound-interest principal withdrawn tomorrow.

C-SBRY-005E.title_en: Translate Institutions from Afar to Home
C-SBRY-005E.description_en: A health-IT engineer found that a foreign country's medical-record interoperability system was fully documented publicly — and that the real blocker between domestic hospitals was precisely the missing mechanism. Instead of inventing new technology, he translated and localized the mutual-recognition protocols, liability rules, and privacy provisions item by item, piloting them in two hospitals. The gap between systems is itself the opportunity — those who translate find industry gaps faster than those who invent.

C-SBRY-006E.description_en: An industry veteran convened a trade alliance; member firms feared he would use it to swallow them. He pledged publicly: the alliance company holds only small stakes with no veto rights, and the secretariat is funded by shared, openly audited dues. With suspicion gone, twenty-plus firms joined, and the alliance became the de facto setter of industry standards. A group of firms bound by credit travels farther than one bound by equity.

C-SBRY-007E.description_en: A civil servant excelled at policy research but climbed slowly among a crowd of equally able peers. He resigned and entered consulting, selling his policy-reading skill to companies and local governments — the same ability, with almost no comparable supply on the market. Five years later his firm leads its niche. In the old system he was one of many; in the new system he was the sole provider of a scarce perspective. Exiting is arbitrage.

C-SBRY-008E.description_en: A manufacturer faced chronic skilled-labor churn. Instead of bidding wages up in a talent war, management joined four neighboring factories in a shared technician pool: co-funded training, interchangeable scheduling of spare capacity, and a park-wide skills certification. Within a year turnover fell at all five firms and training costs dropped thirty percent each. Rewriting the zero-sum poaching game into a shared risk table is the lasting answer for labor and peers alike.

C-SBRY-009E.title_en: Declare the Old Debt, Bank the Credit
C-SBRY-009E.description_en: A founder owed an ex-partner an old, ill-defined debt from years ago, and the matter had quietly faded. When the ex-partner's firm later became a potential key client, he did not avoid it — he visited, openly acknowledged the debt, and proposed compensation. The client ultimately awarded him the contract — not for the amount, but because openly owning an old debt is itself the hardest currency. To receive a favor and stay silent about it is the biggest bad entry on any ledger.

C-SBRY-010E.description_en: An executive lived through her company's acquisition, her own demotion, and finally a leap into entrepreneurship. Each transition upended her role and interests, but her principles never moved: let the data speak, never claim others' credit, honor every promise. Old colleagues and new partners alike kept steering opportunities her way — people trusted not the roles she had held, but the axis that had never shifted. Change roles as you must; never change the axis.

C-SYS-001E.title: Sun Yat-sen's 'Knowing-is-Hard-Doing-is-Easy Reset Method' applied today
C-SYS-001E.description:
Prototype case: In the Sun Wen Doctrine he used 'eating' as proof: everyone eats daily yet no one fully understands nutrition—doing does not wait for true knowledge; 'spending money': all spend, few grasp monetary theory—the threshold of doing is far below that of knowing
Modern drill: Startup execution paralysis: check whether perfect analysis is demanded before acting; explain the philosophical basis of the MVP before sprints Method core: If my heart believes a thing can be done, then even the difficulty of moving mountains and filling seas will one day be overcome; if my heart believes it cannot be done, then even the ease of turning over a palm or breaking a twig will yield nothing.
C-SYS-001E.title_zh: 孙中山「知难行易重置法」现代应用

C-SYS-002E.title: Sun Yat-sen's 'Revolutionary-Stage Sequencing Method' applied today
C-SYS-002E.description:
Prototype case: The Fundamentals of National Reconstruction set a county self-government acceptance checklist (census, land survey, policing, roads, training in the four powers, duties fulfilled) before officials could be elected—turning 'tutelage' from slogan into engineering acceptance
Modern drill: Phased transformation governance: write exit clauses per stage so transition committees do not become permanent bodies Method core: The day the constitution is promulgated is the day constitutional government is complete... and three months after the election, the National Government shall resign, handing power to the elected government—therein the great work of nation-building is done.
C-SYS-002E.title_zh: 孙中山「革命程序分期法」现代应用

C-SYS-003E.title: Sun Yat-sen's 'Land-Value-Capture Closed-Loop Method' applied today
C-SYS-003E.description:
Prototype case: The 1905 Tongmenghui oath placed 'equalizing land rights' alongside 'expelling the Tartars'—distribution entered top-level design on day one, not as an afterthought
Modern drill: Urban land-value tax / TOD development-right capture: recycle infrastructure-driven appreciation back into transit Method core: Since the owner sets the price himself, declaring low or high both hurt him: low brings heavy tax, high invites purchase—so the declared value cannot stray far from the true one.
C-SYS-003E.title_zh: 孙中山「涨价归公地价闭环法」现代应用

C-SYS-004E.title: Sun Yat-sen's 'Surplus-Capital Import Arbitrage Method' applied today
C-SYS-004E.description:
Prototype case: The Plan's ten railway systems and the Northern Great Port: wiring the northwestern interior into global trade via the Bohai approaches—reframing 'underdeveloped' as 'not yet connected'
Modern drill: Belt-and-Road style infrastructure export: coupling surplus capacity to unconnected markets—the national-scale version of the same method Method core: The development of China's industry must proceed at all costs. But shall it follow the old road of Western civilization? ...like Columbus's first voyage from Europe to America... take the direct route and the distance shrinks manyfold.
C-SYS-004E.title_zh: 孙中山「剩余资本引进套利法」现代应用

C-SYS-005E.title: Sun Yat-sen's 'Powers-Split Five-Branch Flaw-Patching Method' applied today
C-SYS-005E.description:
Prototype case: Distilling supervisory power from the censorial system and examination power from the imperial examination—two 'imperial legacies' negated by revolutionary discourse, reversed into constitutional assets: a textbook case of cross-civilizational transplant
Modern drill: Corporate-governance patching: independent audit and nomination committees beside the board—the five-branch idea in modern corporate form Method core: We must now gather the essence of China and the West and guard against every abuse... adopt the foreign executive, legislative, and judicial powers, add China's examination and supervisory powers, and join them into one perfect whole.
C-SYS-005E.title_zh: 孙中山「权能区分五权补漏法」现代应用

C-SYS-006E.title: Sun Yat-sen's 'Parliamentary-Practice Drill Method' applied today
C-SYS-006E.description:
Prototype case: The Manual teaches clause by clause how to second, how to interrupt, how to quell disorder—a book on 'how to hold a meeting' ranked first in the nation-building program, the extreme form of 'democracy learned through meetings'
Modern drill: Agile teams: write standups and reviews as procedures judgeable in thirty seconds for compliance, and drill them periodically Method core: By what does civil rights develop? It begins with binding hearts and combining forces. To bind hearts and combine forces, nothing serves but assembling—and the assembly is truly the first step of civil rights.
C-SYS-006E.title_zh: 孙中山「民权初步会议操演法」现代应用

C-SYS-007E.title: Sun Yat-sen's 'Oath-and-Pledge Ritual Method' applied today
C-SYS-007E.description:
Prototype case: The 1894 Xingzhonghui covenant still bore the traditional 'witnessed by the gods'; the 1905 Tongmenghui oath already read 'let the assembly punish me'—in five years the shift from swearing to gods to answering to the assembly, the text itself recording a leap in political philosophy
Modern drill: Open source: contributing pledges plus a public code of conduct with publicized breach procedures Method core: Faithful and true, from beginning to end; should I break my word, let the assembly punish me.
C-SYS-007E.title_zh: 孙中山「宣誓承诺仪式法」现代应用

C-SYS-008E.title: Sun Yat-sen's 'Repeated-Defeat Reboot Leverage Method' applied today
C-SYS-008E.description:
Prototype case: After the Huanghuang uprising nearly wiped out the cadre, Sun did not retrench; he shifted subversion toward the new army and Wuchang—next year Wuchang rose, the post-mortems of ten defeats feeding the eleventh victory
Modern drill: Repeated startup pivots: nail the mission; swap product, channel, and segment with each failure Method core: Neither lose heart in failure nor shrink at difficulty; pour in spirit and press forward mightily, riding the world's current of progress... and the day of final success shall surely come.
C-SYS-008E.title_zh: 孙中山「屡败重启信念杠杆法」现代应用

C-SYS-009E.title: Sun Yat-sen's 'Party-Governs-the-Doctrine Transition Method' applied today
C-SYS-009E.description:
Prototype case: Sun defined the party's tutelage task as sending 'trained and examined personnel' to the counties to teach the people the four powers—the party's KPI is its pupils' graduation, not regime consolidation
Modern drill: Founder succession: codify values and governance as text—what is inherited at departure is the charter, not the person Method core: Governing the state through the party means not governing through party members but governing through the party's doctrine.
C-SYS-009E.title_zh: 孙中山「以党治义过渡法」现代应用

C-SYS-010E.title: Sun Yat-sen's 'Three-Track Blueprint Method' applied today
C-SYS-010E.description:
Prototype case: One book, three projects: writing philosophy (knowing-is-hard-doing-is-easy), drawing railways and ports, teaching meeting rules—the author counts all three as 'construction,' itself a demonstration that blueprints must be drawn in three dimensions at once
Modern drill: Three-dimensional diagnosis for organizational transformation: audit short planks in culture-narrative (mind), systems and capital (matter), process and meetings (group) simultaneously Method core: What is construction? Psychological, material, and social construction advanced together—none can be spared.
C-SYS-010E.title_zh: 孙中山「三维建设总蓝图法」现代应用

C-HS-001E.title: Hu Shih's 'Bold-Hypothesis-Careful-Verification Method' applied today
C-HS-001E.description:
Prototype case: Boldly hypothesizing that Dream of the Red Chamber was Cao Xueqin's autobiographical novel, then carefully combing the sources, he founded New Redology and routed the allegorical school
Modern drill: Research training: write a mentor's tacit intuition into two assessable metrics—hypothesis boldness and disconfirmation rigor Method core: Bold hypotheses, careful verification—without bold hypotheses no new discoveries; without sufficient evidence, no conviction.
C-HS-001E.title_zh: 胡适「假设求证十字法」现代应用

C-HS-002E.title: Hu Shih's 'Historical-Evolutionary Attitude Method' applied today
C-HS-002E.description:
Prototype case: His History of Vernacular Literature rewrote vernacular writing as the orthodox mainstream of Chinese letters, collapsing 'classical Chinese as orthodoxy' from within and legitimizing the vernacular revolution
Modern drill: Organizational change: write the evolutionary history of an old process—what problem did each rule originally solve, and does it still exist? Method core: Studying a problem takes a historical vision—every institution is a product of history; once you know where it came from, it no longer seems too sacred to touch.
C-HS-002E.title_zh: 胡适「历史演化态度法」现代应用

C-HS-003E.title: Hu Shih's 'Problem-over-Ism Filtering Method' applied today
C-HS-003E.description:
Prototype case: 'Study More Problems, Talk Less of Isms' lists a dozen concrete problems in one breath—rickshaw pullers' livelihood, the president's powers, prostitution—modeling isms as inventories of problems
Modern drill: Meeting governance: a rule—no proposal reaches the agenda without 'what is the first step?' Method core: Isms arise from problems... To prate of a pleasing 'ism' is the easiest thing in the world—any cat or dog can do it; studying problems is what is truly hard.
C-HS-003E.title_zh: 胡适「问题主义过滤法」现代应用

C-HS-004E.title: Hu Shih's 'Vernacular-Tool Revolution Method' applied today
C-HS-004E.description:
Prototype case: 'Modest Proposals for Literary Reform' set the Eight Don'ts—'have substance, do not imitate the ancients, do not moan without illness'—replacing slogan revolution as the formal constitution of new literature
Modern drill: Knowledge productization: sink expertise from PDF/paper format into tutorials, videos, templates—cutting the cost of the medium Method core: For living literature you first need a living language; the vernacular is the true vein of literature—the living literature written by living people in living language for millennia.
C-HS-004E.title_zh: 胡适「白话工具革命法」现代应用

C-HS-005E.title: Hu Shih's 'Suspension-of-Judgment-by-Evidence Method' applied today
C-HS-005E.description:
Prototype case: His Red Chamber textual study went through two drafts: the first, on Yuan Mei's testimony, made Cao Xueqin Cao Yin's son; new evidence led him to correct it publicly to grandson, admitting his earlier reliance on a lone source
Modern drill: Research-report norms: every conclusion carries a confidence grade and refutation conditions; readers discount at will Method core: With one measure of evidence, say one measure; with three measures, say three—in studying the heritage, everywhere hold the purpose of hunting evidence.
C-HS-005E.title_zh: 胡适「证据悬判法」现代应用

C-HS-006E.title: Hu Shih's 'Recreating-Civilization Program Method' applied today
C-HS-006E.description:
Prototype case: The heritage-reorganizing movement he led enrolled classical fiction and pre-Qin philosophy into modern scholarly procedure; his Water Margin studies and Philosophy Outline were its demonstration pieces
Modern drill: Corporate transformation: problems (business pain), theories (new methodology imports), reorganizing (re-registering legacy assets), recreating (new product lines)—run in parallel Method core: The sole aim of the new intellectual current is to recreate civilization—civilization is not made wholesale, but drop by drop.
C-HS-006E.title_zh: 胡适「再造文明纲领法」现代应用

C-HS-007E.title: Hu Shih's 'Tolerance-as-Condition-of-Liberty Method' applied today
C-HS-007E.description:
Prototype case: 'Tolerance and Liberty' rests on Reformation history: Calvin, in the name of pure faith, burned the heretic Servetus—those who deem themselves absolutely right persecute once in power
Modern drill: Platform governance: the sole test of content rules is whether the power-holder (the platform itself) is bound by the same rules Method core: Tolerance is the root of all freedom—without tolerance there is no freedom.
C-HS-007E.title_zh: 胡适「容忍自由互生法」现代应用

C-HS-008E.title: Hu Shih's 'Drop-by-Drop Incremental Reform Method' applied today
C-HS-008E.description:
Prototype case: His concrete reform list: unified national language, phonetic literacy, ending foot-binding, marriage reform, school reform—each independently verifiable
Modern drill: Large projects: a checkable problem list over a master-plan narrative; each item ships and reviews independently Method core: Civilization evolves drop by drop, liberation comes drop by drop—and transformation must likewise be drop by drop.
C-HS-008E.title_zh: 胡适「点滴改良渐进法」现代应用

C-HS-009E.title: Hu Shih's 'No-Effort-Ever-Wasted Long-Termism Method' applied today
C-HS-009E.description:
Prototype case: His vernacular-literary-history research and textual studies, marginalized for decades of politics, became the first-hand foundation when mainland New Culture studies restarted
Modern drill: Career cold-season strategy: choose deepening vs. correcting by the ten-year test, not by chasing the next wave Method core: No effort is ever wholly wasted—no merit is ever lost in vain!
C-HS-009E.title_zh: 胡适「功不唐捐长期法」现代应用

C-HS-010E.title: Hu Shih's 'Lifelong-Apprentice Exemplification Method' applied today
C-HS-010E.description:
Prototype case: Changshi served as the revolution's first experimental data—vernacular poems even he admitted were flawed—its preface openly discussing which poems had failed
Modern drill: Tech evangelism: the advocate dogfoods first and publishes pitfall logs, replacing the flawless demo Method core: I write vernacular poems using myself as the test subject—my failures too can serve as reference for others.
C-HS-010E.title_zh: 胡适「终身学童示范法」现代应用

C-NEW-001E.title: Isaac Newton's 'Axiomatic-Deductive Reconstruction Method' applied today
C-NEW-001E.description:
Prototype case: In Principia Book I Newton deduces Propositions 1-69 from the three laws: Proposition 1 (the area law) follows directly from Laws 1-2, Proposition 4 (circular motion) traces back to Law 2—Kepler's second law emerges as a deduced theorem
Modern drill: Software refactoring: reorganize scattered if-else rules into a minimal state machine with type definitions so every behavior traces to the spec Method core: The whole burden of natural philosophy consists in this—to investigate the forces of nature from the phenomena of motions, and then to demonstrate the other phenomena from these forces.
C-NEW-001E.title_zh: 牛顿「公理化演绎重建法」现代应用

C-NEW-002E.title: Isaac Newton's 'Hypothesis-Suspension Verdict Method' applied today
C-NEW-002E.description:
Prototype case: The General Scholium admits the physical cause of gravity is unknown, yet the law suffices to compute the heavens—the Cartesians mocked 'not knowing the cause'; Newton answered with computational precision: Halley's comet's 1758 return was the verdict
Modern drill: Paper writing: put speculative explanations in a 'limitations and assumptions' section; main conclusions stand without them Method core: I feign no hypotheses—whatever is not deduced from the phenomena is to be called a hypothesis; and hypotheses have no place in experimental philosophy.
C-NEW-002E.title_zh: 牛顿「假说悬置裁决法」现代应用

C-NEW-003E.title: Isaac Newton's 'Fluxion Quantification of Continuity Method' applied today
C-NEW-003E.description:
Prototype case: Shut in during the plague of 1665-1666, Newton produced both fluxions and the dispersion experiments in the same period—two years at Woolsthorpe yielded his two greatest inventions
Modern drill: Data analysis: invent scripts and DSLs for repeatedly hand-processed reports, turning monthly ordeals into routine computation Method core: Consider mathematical quantities as fluents generated by continuous motion—the ratio of fluxions, that is, of generation speeds, is the key to everything.
C-NEW-003E.title_zh: 牛顿「流数量化连续法」现代应用

C-NEW-004E.title: Isaac Newton's 'Moon-Apple Unified Inference Method' applied today
C-NEW-004E.description:
Prototype case: The moon test: the first calculation was off by 15% (a wrong value for the earth's radius); after Picard's new measurement the deviation fell to 0.4%—unification confirmed after data calibration
Modern drill: Platform strategy: compute all business lines with one unit-economics model; do not force in lines the model cannot compute Method core: The force by which the moon is drawn toward the earth is one and the same with gravity—proved by the moon test: the moon's deviation from straight line connects to surface gravity exactly by the inverse square.
C-NEW-004E.title_zh: 牛顿「月球苹果统一推理法」现代应用

C-NEW-005E.title: Isaac Newton's 'Crucial-Experiment Verdict Method' applied today
C-NEW-005E.description:
Prototype case: The crucial experiment: monochromatic light does not decompose through the second prism—the modification thesis executed, color as the nature of light established
Modern drill: A/B testing: design experiments with discriminative power as the metric, forcing two candidate proposals to diverge on key indicators Method core: Experiment is the most certain mode of thought—by the crucial experiment I make rival hypotheses give different predictions themselves, then let phenomena execute the loser.
C-NEW-005E.title_zh: 牛顿「关键实验裁决法」现代应用

C-NEW-006E.title: Isaac Newton's 'Book-I Deduction of the Heavens Method' applied today
C-NEW-006E.description:
Prototype case: Book I Propositions 10-11: deducing elliptical orbits under inverse-square from the laws—Kepler's first law becomes a theorem, not an empirical rule
Modern drill: Algorithm engineering: derive algorithmic complexity under ideal conditions first, then align with production data—never fit conclusions directly from data Method core: Only propositions deduced to fluency under ideal conditions without medium can align with the phenomena of Book III one by one—a theory not deduced to fluency has no power to align with observation.
C-NEW-006E.title_zh: 牛顿「第一编推演天体法」现代应用

C-NEW-007E.title: Isaac Newton's 'Numerical Perturbation Alignment Method' applied today
C-NEW-007E.description:
Prototype case: Moon test error 15%→0.4%: diagnosed as earth-radius data error, swapped for Picard's new measurement—theory untouched, data changed
Modern drill: Model deployment: decompose production-metric deviations into feature bias, data drift, and architecture error, attributing and treating class by class Method core: The moon's problem makes my head ache—but deviations must be decomposed into data error, method error, and theory error, treated class by class.
C-NEW-007E.title_zh: 牛顿「数值摄动对齐法」现代应用

C-NEW-008E.title: Isaac Newton's 'Two-Branched Comet Orbit Verification Method' applied today
C-NEW-008E.description:
Prototype case: The 1680 comet's dual-branch calculation: Newton computed the folded two branches of one comet's orbit under the inverse square—the 'two comets' and 'one comet' theses mutually exclusive in parameter structure
Modern drill: Technology selection: translate candidate architectures into mutually exclusive performance-parameter predictions, so launch data naturally adjudicates Method core: The two branches of one comet's orbit folded around the sun explain both appearances—whether the parameters are complementary, future observation naturally adjudicates.
C-NEW-008E.title_zh: 牛顿「两枝彗星轨道验证法」现代应用

C-NEW-009E.title: Isaac Newton's 'Particle-Wave Aligned-Suspension Method' applied today
C-NEW-009E.description:
Prototype case: Queries 29-31: Newton registered diffraction (the Grimaldi phenomenon) as unsolved by the corpuscular thesis—publicly showing his own weak side
Modern drill: Technology-route review: register both routes' explanatory coverage as open documents, stating each one's unsolved phenomena Method core: The corpuscular thesis explains refraction and dispersion but not yet diffraction; the wave thesis has difficulties with rectilinear propagation—both accounts lie open on the table; the verdict is left to the future.
C-NEW-009E.title_zh: 牛顿「光粒波悬判法」现代应用

C-NEW-010E.title: Isaac Newton's 'Power-Overreach Cost Audit Method' applied today
C-NEW-010E.description:
Prototype case: The Commercium Epistolicum: Newton drafted the Society committee's report accusing Leibniz of plagiarism—the investigator aligned with a party in the dispute, institutional power overreached
Modern drill: Open-source governance: written recusal rules (review, voting, merge power) for maintainers who are a party to the dispute Method core: Presidential power made the evidence accounts impossible to settle publicly—the settlement price of personal rivalry within institutions far exceeds the surface win or loss.
C-NEW-010E.title_zh: 牛顿「权力越界代价审计法」现代应用

C-WZ-001.description_zh: 王阳明被贬谪到贵州龙场，在艰苦的环境中顿悟'心即理'的道理，创立了阳明心学的核心思想。
C-WZ-001.description_en: Wang Yangming was exiled to Longchang, Guizhou, where he had an epiphany about 'mind is principle' in difficult circumstances, founding the core ideas of Yangming School of Mind Studies.

C-WZ-002.title_en: Suppressing the Prince of Ning's Rebellion
C-WZ-002.description_zh: 王阳明运用军事才能和智慧，迅速平定了宁王朱宸濠的叛乱，体现了'知行合一'的实践智慧。
C-WZ-002.description_en: Wang Yangming used military talent and wisdom to quickly suppress the rebellion of Prince Zhu Chenhao, embodying the practical wisdom of 'unity of knowledge and action'.

C-WZ-003.description_zh: 王阳明在各地讲学，传播'致良知'思想，培养了众多弟子，使阳明心学得以广泛传播。
C-WZ-003.description_en: Wang Yangming taught in various places, spreading the thought of 'cultivating conscience', cultivating many disciples and enabling the wide spread of Yangming School.

C-WZ-004.description_zh: 王阳明在担任地方官员期间，运用'事上磨练'的方法，处理各种政务，体现了心学在实践中的应用。
C-WZ-004.description_en: During his tenure as a local official, Wang Yangming used the method of 'practice through affairs' to handle various government affairs, embodying the application of mind studies in practice.

C-WZ-005.description_zh: 王阳明通过静坐冥想的方法，体认良知，达到内心的清明与觉悟，体现了'破心中贼'的修养方法。
C-WZ-005.description_en: Wang Yangming used meditation and introspection to experience conscience, achieving inner clarity and enlightenment, embodying the cultivation method of 'conquering the thief within'.

C-WZ-006.description_zh: 王阳明根据学生的不同资质和特点，采用不同的教学方法，体现了'因材施教'的教育理念。
C-WZ-006.description_en: According to students' different aptitudes and characteristics, Wang Yangming adopted different teaching methods, embodying the educational philosophy of 'teaching according to aptitude'.

C-WZ-007.description_zh: 王阳明在讲学和实践中，采用简单直接的方法，体现了'大道至简'的思想特点。
C-WZ-007.description_en: In his teaching and practice, Wang Yangming used simple and direct methods, embodying the characteristic thought of 'the great way is simple'.

C-WZ-008.description_zh: 王阳明在处理各种复杂情况时，能够灵活运用道德原则，做到'时中'，体现了权变的智慧。
C-WZ-008.description_en: When handling various complex situations, Wang Yangming could flexibly apply moral principles, achieving 'timely appropriateness', embodying the wisdom of adaptation.
