C-WZ-009.description_zh: 王阳明通过'致良知'认识到万物一体的道理，体现了'仁者与天地万物为一体'的哲学思想。
C-WZ-009.description_en: Through 'cultivating conscience', Wang Yangming realized the principle of unity of all things, embodying the philosophical thought of 'the benevolent person is one with heaven, earth, and all things'.

C-WZ-010.description_zh: 王阳明在日常生活中践行'知行合一'的理念，体现了理论与实践的统一。
C-WZ-010.description_en: In daily life, Wang Yangming practiced the concept of 'unity of knowledge and action', embodying the unity of theory and practice.

C-XFZ-001E-001.title_zh: 投机动荡——张国焘事件后的政治转向案例
C-XFZ-001E-001.description_zh: 1935年张国焘分裂主义失败后，谢富治主动向毛泽东提供红四方面军内部情报，完成政治忠诚的迅速转移，保全自身并赢得毛的信任。
C-XFZ-001E-001.title_en: Opportunistic Recalibration — Political Shift After Zhang Guotao Incident Case
C-XFZ-001E-001.description_en: After Zhang Guotao's separatist failure in 1935, Xie proactively provided Mao with Red Fourth Front Army internal intelligence, completing a rapid political loyalty transfer to preserve himself and win Mao's trust.

C-XFZ-001E-002.title_zh: 忠诚检验——公安部反修防修运动案例
C-XFZ-001E-002.description_zh: 谢富治取代罗瑞卿后，在公安部发起'反修防修'运动，以'忠于毛泽东思想'为标准清洗原罗瑞卿派系干部，完成权力再配置。
C-XFZ-001E-002.title_en: Loyalty Test — Anti-Revisionism Campaign in Ministry of Public Security Case
C-XFZ-001E-002.description_en: After replacing Luo Ruiqing, Xie launched an 'anti-revisionism' campaign in the Ministry of Public Security, purging Luo's faction using 'loyalty to Mao Zedong Thought' as the standard to complete power redistribution.

C-XFZ-001E-003.title_zh: 组织操控——通过程序推进'砸烂公检法'案例
C-XFZ-001E-003.description_zh: 作为公安部部长，谢富治通过公安部系统向下传达、组织落实'砸烂公检法'的政策，将个人政治意图转化为组织决策的合法形式。
C-XFZ-001E-003.title_en: Organizational Manipulation — Pushing 'Smash Public Security Organs' Through Procedures Case
C-XFZ-001E-003.description_en: As Minister of Public Security, Xie used the ministry's organizational channels to transmit and implement the 'smash the public security organs' policy, transforming personal political intent into legitimate organizational decisions.

C-XFZ-001E-004.title_zh: 混乱红利——文革初期利用秩序真空扩张权力案例
C-XFZ-001E-004.description_zh: 文革初期，谢富治利用秩序混乱之机，推动公安部向造反派提供武器，建立红色警卫力量，在旧秩序瓦解中获取超额政治资本。
C-XFZ-001E-004.title_en: Chaos Dividend — Power Expansion During Early Cultural Revolution Vacuum Case
C-XFZ-001E-004.description_en: In the early Cultural Revolution, Xie exploited the chaotic order to push the Ministry of Public Security to arm Rebel factions and establish a red guard force, acquiring excess political capital during the collapse of old order.

C-XFZ-001E-005.title_zh: 正面施压——陈毅追悼会事件中的公开批斗案例
C-XFZ-001E-005.description_zh: 在陈毅追悼会事件中，谢富治默许造反派进入会场炮轰陈毅，当面指责陈毅是'老右倾机会主义者'，通过公开施压摧毁对手权威。
C-XFZ-001E-005.title_en: Direct Pressure — Public Denunciation at Chen Yi's Memorial Service Case
C-XFZ-001E-005.description_en: At Chen Yi's memorial service, Xie tacitly allowed Rebel factions to enter and attack Chen Yi, publicly calling him an 'old right-deviationist,' destroying the opponent's authority through direct pressure.

C-XFZ-001E-006.title_zh: 底线突破——'砸烂公检法'击穿法治底线案例
C-XFZ-001E-006.description_zh: 1967年8月提出'砸烂公检法'，使公安机关瘫痪、司法体系崩溃，将文革暴力升级为'国家授权'的合法行为。
C-XFZ-001E-006.title_en: Bottom-Line Transgression — 'Smash Public Security Organs' Breaching Rule of Law Case
C-XFZ-001E-006.description_en: Proposing 'smash the public security, procuratorate, and courts' in August 1967, paralyzing public security organs and collapsing the judicial system, upgrading Cultural Revolution violence to 'state-authorized' legal behavior.

C-XFZ-001E-007.title_zh: 双重身份——革命将领与政治打手的并行身份案例
C-XFZ-001E-007.description_zh: 谢富治生前享有'无产阶级革命家'身份待遇（高级别追悼会、八宝山安葬），死后8年被开除党籍并移出八宝山，两种身份在不同时期被不同力量认可。
C-XFZ-001E-007.title_en: Dual Identity — Revolutionary General and Political Hitman Parallel Identity Case
C-XFZ-001E-007.description_en: During his lifetime, Xie enjoyed the identity of 'proletarian revolutionary' (high-level memorial, Babaoshan burial); 8 years after death, stripped of that identity (expelled from Party, removed from Babaoshan).

C-XFZ-001E-008.title_zh: 信息控制——红军肃反时期'怀疑一切'氛围营造案例
C-XFZ-001E-008.description_zh: 谢富治在红军肃反时期提出'要勇于怀疑一切'，通过制造普遍的怀疑氛围使人人自危、人人自证，从而巩固自己的审查权力。
C-XFZ-001E-008.title_en: Information Control — 'Dare to Doubt Everything' Atmosphere Creation in Red Army Purges Case
C-XFZ-001E-008.description_en: Xie proposed 'dare to doubt everything' during the Red Army purges, creating an atmosphere of universal suspicion where everyone was anxious and self-incriminating, thereby consolidating his review power.

C-XFZ-001E-009.title_zh: 实用效能——云南三年困难时期治理案例
C-XFZ-001E-009.description_zh: 在云南主政期间，三年困难时期云南未发生大规模饿死事件，体现了谢富治在行政治理能力上的实用主义取向——在政治安全红线内追求治理效能最大化。
C-XFZ-001E-009.title_en: Pragmatic Effectiveness — Yunnan Three Years of Difficulty Governance Case
C-XFZ-001E-009.description_en: During his tenure in Yunnan, no large-scale starvation occurred during the Three Years of Difficulty, demonstrating Xie's pragmatic orientation in administrative governance—maximizing governance effectiveness within political safety red lines.

C-XFZ-001E-010.title_zh: 制度重塑——北京市革命委员会成立案例
C-XFZ-001E-010.description_zh: 推动北京市革命委员会的成立并担任主任，在废墟上主导新制度的设计和建立，使新制度天然有利于自身权力位置的巩固。
C-XFZ-001E-010.title_en: Institutional Reshaping — Establishment of Beijing Municipal Revolutionary Committee Case
C-XFZ-001E-010.description_en: Pushing for the establishment of the Beijing Municipal Revolutionary Committee and serving as its chairman, leading the design and establishment of new institutions on the ruins to consolidate his own power position.

C-DZS-001E.title_zh: 天人感应法——汉代政治合法性论证案例
C-DZS-001E.description_en: Dong Zhongshu proposed the Heaven-Human Resonance theory in Three Strategies on Heaven and Man, arguing that Heaven is a willful sovereign expressing approval or warning through disasters and omens. Core proposition: The Way of Heaven and the Way of humanity are one.

C-DZS-002E.title_zh: 春秋大一统法——独尊儒术意识形态整合案例
C-DZS-002E.description_en: Dong argued that The Great Unity in Spring and Autumn is the constant principle of heaven and earth, demonstrating the necessity of political and ideological unity, providing theoretical basis for Emperor Wu exclusive Confucianism policy.

C-DZS-003E.title_zh: 三纲五常法——社会伦理秩序宇宙论论证案例
C-DZS-003E.description_en: Dong mapped ruler-minister, father-son, husband-wife relations onto yin-yang cosmic order, stating the three bonds of the royal way can be sought in Heaven, providing metaphysical foundation for traditional social ethics.

C-DZS-004E.title_zh: 性三品法——人性分类与教化理论基础案例
C-DZS-004E.description_en: Dong classified human nature into sages, common people, and incapable grades, arguing common people have goodness potential requiring education, bridging the gap between innate goodness and transformative education.

C-DZS-005E.title_zh: 德主刑辅法——汉代治国方略设计案例
C-DZS-005E.description_en: Dong mapped virtue and punishment onto yin-yang, proposing Yang is virtue yin is punishment, establishing教化-primacy governance principle with transcendent cosmic justification.

C-DZS-006E.title_zh: 屈君伸天法——权力制约机制设计案例
C-DZS-006E.description_en: In the hierarchy of subordinating people to ruler subordinating ruler to Heaven, Dong positioned Heaven above the ruler as ultimate arbiter, checking imperial authority through disaster warnings—the only transcendent power-checking mechanism in imperial China.

C-DZS-007E.title_zh: 阳尊阴卑法——社会等级秩序宇宙论论证案例
C-DZS-007E.description_en: Dong systematically mapped all social relations onto yin-yang framework: ruler as yang minister as yin, father as yang son as yin, husband as yang wife as yin, providing unquestionable metaphysical justification for social hierarchy.

C-DZS-008E.title_zh: 教化成性法——汉代太学建立与教化制度案例
C-DZS-008E.description_en: Dong held that innate disposition is nature but nature cannot become virtue without education, advocating ruler responsibility for educating the people, leading to establishment of Grand Academy and local school network.

C-DZS-009E.title_zh: 法天则古法——三统循环历史哲学案例
C-DZS-009E.description_en: Dong creatively combined Gongyang Three Ages theory with cyclical history, proposing Three Dynastic Cycles (Black White Red) as historical philosophy, providing legitimacy for new dynasties to institute reforms.

C-DZS-010E.title_zh: 原心定罪法——春秋决狱司法实践案例
C-DZS-010E.description_en: Dong proposed examining facts and tracing intent, using behavioral motive rather than external consequences as primary legal criterion, opening the way for Confucian classics to enter legal practice.

C-ISN-001E.title_zh: 存在本质区分法——「飞马」与本体论承诺的分离
C-ISN-001E.description_en: In the Metaphysics of the Shifa, Ibn Sina argued that a thing’s essence (what it is) and its existence (whether it is) can be thought separately: one can fully grasp the essence of a flying horse or of man without conceding any existing instance—essence becomes one only in an individual. This made “what it is” and “whether it is” two distinct questions, founding medieval ontology.

C-ISN-002E.title_zh: 必然存在者论证法——存在赋予链的终止点
C-ISN-002E.description_en: Starting from “whatever exists,” Ibn Sina argued that whatever can fail to exist receives existence from another; the chain can neither regress infinitely nor loop, so it must terminate in the Being necessarily existent through itself—whose essence is existence. Unlike Anselm’s purely conceptual proof, this starts from experience; Kant called it an unwitting synthesis of the ontological and cosmological proofs.

C-ISN-003E.title_zh: 悬浮人内省法——先于笛卡尔六百年的我思
C-ISN-003E.description_en: Ibn Sina imagined a person created suddenly in mid-air, senses severed, limbs not touching: he would still affirm his own existence. This proves self-awareness depends on neither senses nor body; the soul’s awareness of itself is primordial. It is the first systematic first-person argument in philosophy, anticipating Descartes’ cogito by over six centuries.

C-ISN-004E.title_zh: 流溢层级法——一者生一者的宇宙架构
C-ISN-004E.description_en: To “how does the absolutely One produce the many,” Ibn Sina answered with emanation: every perfect intellect overflows one successor; from the First Intellect flow ten intellects in sequence, the last, the Active Intellect, generating the sublunar world. The principle “from the One only one proceeds” resolves the overflow problem by hierarchy, welding Aristotle, Neoplatonism, and monotheistic creation into one system.

C-ISN-005E.title_zh: 五谓词定义法——概念树的系统定位
C-ISN-005E.description_en: Ibn Sina forged the Porphyrian five predicables (genus, differentia, species, property, accident) into an engine of knowledge organization: fix the most universal category, partition by differentiae down to indivisible species, so any unknown can be located on a determinate branch of the concept tree. “Avicennian definition” dominated European logic classrooms for four centuries via Latin translations.

C-ISN-006E.title_zh: 药物检验七则法——比随机对照试验早九百年
C-ISN-006E.description_en: Book I of the Canon of Medicine set seven rules for testing a drug’s true efficacy: simple cases, temporal sequence, excluding natural recovery, repetition, excluding novelty effects, distinguishing human from animal, excluding the disease’s own change. A systematic defense of “correlation is not causation” and history’s earliest embryo of controlled experimentation.

C-ISN-007E.title_zh: 内感官分层法——史上第一个认知加工流水线
C-ISN-007E.description_en: Beyond the external senses, Ibn Sina posited layered internal senses: common sense converges inputs, representation retains images, imagination combines them, estimation grasps non-imagistic meaning (the sheep “estimates” the wolf’s danger), memory stores the results. The first systematic cognitive-pipeline model, common ancestor of scholastic and modern psychology.

C-ISN-008E.title_zh: 灵魂非物质论证法——抽象与非物质性同构
C-ISN-008E.description_en: The soul grasps universal forms carrying no matter (the triangle as such), while material faculties receive only individual images; whatever grasps forms apart from matter cannot itself depend on matter—hence the intellect is immaterial. The principle “the more universal the abstraction, the further from matter” grounded medieval proofs of immortality and theories of abstraction.

C-ISN-009E.title_zh: 归谬二分反证法——穷尽分割与钢人反驳
C-ISN-009E.description_en: Ibn Sina’s argumentative method: exhaustively dichotomize a contested question into exclusive and exhaustive options, demolish each non-target branch by reductio, leaving the target as the sole survivor—while steelmanning the opponent first. “Exhaustive partition plus branch-by-branch reductio” made the Shifa among the most formidable argumentative texts of the Middle Ages.

C-ISN-010E.title_zh: 百科体系综合法——统一原理网的知识组织
C-ISN-010E.description_en: The Shifa organized philosophy under the fourfold logic-physics-mathematics-metaphysics; the Canon organized medicine as principles-drugs-diseases-therapies: each discipline placed under shared conceptual hierarchies and inference rules, contradictions adjudicated explicitly (Aristotle vs. Galen), gaps flagged with channels for empirical revision. This made the Canon Eurasia’s standard medical textbook for five hundred years.

C-IBR-001E.title_zh: 真理不相冲突法——哲学与启示的诠释层和解
C-IBR-001E.description_en: There is one truth: 'truth does not oppose truth but accords with it and bears witness to it.' When philosophical demonstration and scriptural text seem to clash, the fault lies in interpretation—either in the demonstration or the reading. Given two apparently conflicting authorities, presume each true and relocate the conflict to the level of expression.
C-IBR-001E.title_en: Truth Does Not Contradict Truth - Reconciling Philosophy and Revelation at the Interpretive Level

C-IBR-002E.title_zh: 三级论证分级法——演示/辩证/修辞的受众分层
C-IBR-002E.description_en: One truth must be expressed by three methods matched to cognitive capacity: demonstration (burhān) for philosophers, dialectic (jadal) for theologians, rhetoric (khiṭāba) for the multitude. Mismatch is disaster: demonstrative reasoning unsettles those who live by rhetorical certainty, and rhetorical speech blocks the road to necessity.
C-IBR-002E.title_en: Three-Tier Argument Grading - Matching Demonstration, Dialectic, and Rhetoric to the Audience

C-IBR-003E.title_zh: 因果必然论法——对偶因论的奠基性反驳
C-IBR-003E.description_en: Against al-Ghazālī's occasionalism (fire does not burn cotton; God creates the burning in it), Averroes reasserts: things have natures; cause and effect are essentially connected—fire burns by necessity. Denying intrinsic causality destroys knowledge, makes the world unintelligible, and cancels divine wisdom shown in the order of causes.
C-IBR-003E.title_en: Causal Necessitarianism - The Foundational Refutation of Occasionalism

C-IBR-004E.title_zh: 回到原典还原法——剥离注疏层，重建原作者论证
C-IBR-004E.description_en: Transmitted classics are polluted by interpretive strata: Neoplatonists made Aristotle an emanationist, commentators became the text. Doubt all second-hand accounts, return to the nearest source, reconstruct the original's own argumentative structure. Every field has its classics buried under commentary.
C-IBR-004E.title_en: Return to the Original Text - Strip the Commentary Strata, Rebuild the Author's Own Argument

C-IBR-005E.title_zh: 三级评注递进法——同一文本的三种分辨率
C-IBR-005E.description_en: His signature system—long commentary (verbatim lemma + exhaustive problems + adjudication of disputes), middle commentary (continuous paraphrase), short commentary (summary)—processes one text into three resolutions, forming a climbable ladder from primer to professional exhaustiveness.
C-IBR-005E.title_en: Three-Tier Commentary Ladder - One Text at Three Resolutions

C-IBR-006E.title_zh: 以子之矛驳斥法——不引入外部标准的内部批判
C-IBR-006E.description_en: To refute a system, import no external standard: enter it and derive the opponent's conclusions' failure from the opponent's own premises—as Averroes answered al-Ghazālī question by question and showed Ghazālī's own criterion would rebound on his own kalām theology.
tags_en: standards turning back on their users
C-IBR-006E.title_en: Refutation by the Opponent's Own Blade - Internal Critique Without External Standards

C-IBR-007E.title_zh: 本质存在二分法——"概念上可能"与"实际存在"的分界
C-IBR-007E.description_en: Distinguish what a thing is (essence, māhiyya) from that it is (existence, wujūd): in creatures the two are separable in thought; only in the Necessary Being are they identical. Refined from Ibn Sīnā, this distinction became the pivot of scholastic metaphysics via Aquinas. Every conflation of 'conceivable' with 'actual' breaks along this seam.
C-IBR-007E.title_en: Essence vs. Existence Distinction - Between Conceptual Possibility and Actual Existence

C-IBR-008E.title_zh: 物质理智统一法——知识是全人类的公共事业
C-IBR-008E.description_en: Intellect divides into individual imagination (perishing with each body) and one shared material intellect (receiving all intelligible forms in potency). Images are private; understood forms are universal and common to mankind—'the understood is one in the understander.' Knowledge is thus a collective unfolding of a single human intellect, not private accumulation.
C-IBR-008E.title_en: Unity of the Material Intellect - Knowledge as the Common Enterprise of Humankind

C-IBR-009E.title_zh: 哲人法官合一法——推理者与治理者的统一
C-IBR-009E.description_en: From a Mālikī legal dynasty and a lifetime qāḍī, Averroes holds that law and philosophy are two faces of the same excellence: law needs philosophical reasoning to apply analogy (qiyās) correctly; philosophy needs law's constraint to remain within the community. Institutions should make the reasoner and the governor the same kind of person.
C-IBR-009E.title_en: Philosopher-Judge Unity - The Union of the Reasoner and the Governor

C-IBR-010E.title_zh: 理想政体制度塑造法——评估制度先问它塑造什么人
C-IBR-010E.description_en: Following Plato's Republic (he prefers Plato over Aristotle's Politics as fitting his age): a regime is not merely an allocation of power but a school that shapes souls—each class acquires its virtue through institutions, and corruption begins with misplaced virtue (rulers without wisdom, guardians without courage). Ask of any institution: what kind of people does it form?
C-IBR-010E.title_en: Ideal-Regime Institutional Shaping - Evaluate an Institution by the Souls It Forms

C-GHZ-001E.title_zh: 彻底怀疑悬置法——对知识来源的全面审计
C-GHZ-001E.description_en: Systematically test each source of knowledge: sense data fall to dream and illusion, reason itself falls to the question of a higher judge. Suspend whatever can be doubted—not for doubt's sake, but as a stress test of foundations, until the proximate, undoubtable clarity is reached.
C-GHZ-001E.title_en: The 1095 Baghdad crisis: a source-level audit of knowledge

C-GHZ-002E.title_zh: 心之光确信法——论证清理道路，体验抵达目的地
C-GHZ-002E.description_en: The highest knowledge is not produced by argument but is a light God casts into the heart—direct, ineffable, firmer than any demonstration. Reason clears the road; only experience reaches the destination, as knowing the definition of honey differs from tasting its sweetness.
C-GHZ-002E.title_en: The honey metaphor: from conceptual knowledge to tasted certainty

C-GHZ-003E.title_zh: 偶因论解构法——把恒常伴随与必然联结分开
C-GHZ-003E.description_en: Interrogate necessity itself: we observe only constant conjunction between fire and burning, never necessity. God creates the burning in the cotton at each instant according to His custom (sunna); fire is the occasion, not the cause. Mistaking habituated conjunction for necessary connection is reason's overreach—Hume's problem, six centuries early.
tags_zh: 恒常伴随 vs 必然联结
C-GHZ-003E.title_en: Fire does not burn: the seventeenth discussion dismantles causal necessity

C-GHZ-004E.title_zh: 先转述后判教法——不经最强形式转述者无资格宣判
C-GHZ-004E.description_en: Before critique, restate the opponent's doctrine in its strongest form—al-Maqāṣid renders al-Fārābī and Ibn Sīnā neutrally, even better than they stated themselves, before Tahāfut adjudicates point by point. Critique without strongest-form restatement is strawmanning and carries no verdict weight.
tags_zh: 两书结构（转述书+裁决书）
C-GHZ-004E.title_en: Two books: first the Intentions, then the Incoherence

C-GHZ-005E.title_zh: 二十题分层裁决法——分歧枚举化与显式分级
C-GHZ-005E.description_en: Refuse wholesale labels ('philosophy = heresy'): decompose the rival system into a finite list of propositions (twenty), adjudicate each independently with explicit grades—sound, blameworthy innovation (bidʿa), or excommunication (takfīr). Only three of twenty cross the excommunication line.
tags_zh: 裁决分级（无争/异端/出教）
C-GHZ-005E.title_en: Twenty questions: three excommunications, seventeen disputable

C-GHZ-006E.title_zh: 知识体检分域法——宣称目标、交付机制、失效点
C-GHZ-006E.description_en: Audit every discipline with a uniform battery—what does it promise, by what mechanism does it deliver, where does it fail, how well does it match the goal? Theology, philosophy, Ismāʿīlism, and Sufism each receive the exam; the result is a demarcation of validity domains, not a generic good/bad verdict.
C-GHZ-006E.title_en: The four-way exam: theology, philosophy, Ismailism, Sufism

C-GHZ-007E.title_zh: 动机审判净化法——虚荣可使学术在外部全优而内在归零
C-GHZ-007E.description_en: The worth of an act is set by its motivational structure: the same sermon delivered for truth and for fame are different in value-layer. Learning tainted by vanity can score perfectly on external metrics while voiding itself within. Audit your motives on a schedule—contamination is gradual and self-masking.
C-GHZ-007E.title_en: What he resigned was not a chair but a motivational environment

C-GHZ-008E.title_zh: 知行断裂诊断法——当学习增长而行为不变
C-GHZ-008E.description_en: Two kinds of knowledge: 'knowledge of the sword' (concepts, arguments) and 'knowledge of the flash' (experience, capacity, conviction); accumulating the former yields nothing of the latter—an encyclopedia of health cures no one. When learning grows but behavior stands still, a knowledge-action rift has opened: verify knowledge by behavioral change.
tags_zh: 刀剑之知 vs 闪电之知
C-GHZ-008E.title_en: The Revival: knowledge re-organized by therapeutic yield

C-GHZ-009E.title_zh: 宗旨五护目的论法——规则的效力根源于其保护对象
C-GHZ-009E.description_en: The validity of norms is rooted in purpose: revelation's provisions protect five essential interests—religion, life, intellect, lineage, property. Test any rule by which purpose it protects and how well: literal compliance that voids the purpose is an empty shell; a better means to the same purpose deserves preference.
tags_zh: 字面遵从 vs 宗旨达成
C-GHZ-009E.title_en: The fire-precaution duty: protecting life without explicit text

C-GHZ-010E.title_zh: 阶梯净化修行法——深度转化是可工程化的阶梯而非顿悟
C-GHZ-010E.description_en: Deep transformation is not a lightning event but an engineerable ladder: knowledge → action → purification → stations (repentance, vigilance, trust, contentment…) → certainty. Each rung has entry conditions, typical obstacles, and test marks; no skipping, no stalling. Personal change re-defined as a plannable, verifiable, compounding project.
C-GHZ-010E.title_en: The decade as a ladder: resignation, austerities, seclusion, certainty

C-DKR-001E.title_zh: 普遍怀疑还原法——危机期的一次性来源审计
C-DKR-001E.description_en: Rather than patching beliefs one by one, Descartes suspends every source of knowledge at once—senses, custom, authority, even simple arithmetic—keeping only the indubitable residue as the foundation for rebuilding. Before major decisions, run one source-level stress test instead of endless item-by-item debate.

C-DKR-002E.title_zh: 我思基点确立法——从怀疑中锚定不可动摇的原点
C-DKR-002E.description_en: While doubting everything, Descartes finds that the act of doubting itself certifies thinking and the thinker—'I think, therefore I am.' The anchor is not an inferred conclusion but a performative self-verifying act. In any rebuild, find the signal that validates itself in every challenge and make it the audit origin.

C-DKR-003E.title_zh: 梦境恶魔极限测试法——用最强假想敌压测信念体系
C-DKR-003E.description_en: Descartes crushes sense belief with the dream hypothesis, then a priori knowledge with the evil-demon hypothesis (an omnipotent deceiver could make even 2+3=5 doubtful). Extreme hypotheses need not be true, only logically possible—whatever wobbles under the strongest assumption is not foundation. The prototype of red-teaming and worst-case testing.

C-DKR-004E.title_zh: 四规则程序法——把'想清楚'改写为可执行程序
C-DKR-004E.description_en: In the Discourse on Method Descartes gives four rules: evidence (accept only the clear and distinct), analysis (split until each subproblem depends only on solved ones), synthesis (proceed from simplest to complex in dependency order), enumeration (a closing checklist that no step was skipped). A universal solve program for complex tasks.

C-DKR-005E.title_zh: 普遍数学同构法——先证同构再迁移方法
C-DKR-005E.description_en: Descartes sees that arithmetic and geometry succeed for the same reason: their objects contain only order and measure—hence a 'universal mathematics'. Before migrating a proven method across domains, verify the target problem is isomorphic at the order-and-measure level; never force the fit.

C-DKR-006E.title_zh: 心物二元区分法——给每层问题配专属解释工具
C-DKR-006E.description_en: Descartes stratifies the world by each substance's unique essential attribute: mind's essence is thought (accessible by introspection), matter's is extension (solvable by geometry and mechanics)—neither may trespass on the other. Likewise in engineering diagnosis: attribute experience problems and performance problems separately, each with its own acceptance criteria.

C-DKR-007E.title_zh: 明证性担保法——为验收标准本身找非循环依据
C-DKR-007E.description_en: Descartes sets 'clear and distinct' as the acceptance criterion for truth, then guarantees the criterion's global reliability by a non-deceiving God—while warning that if the guarantor depends on what it guarantees, one falls into the Cartesian circle. Same for evaluation design: define the pass condition first, then check whether the eval set depends on the system under test.

C-DKR-008E.title_zh: 机械还原解释法——把伪解释翻译为可追问的机制
C-DKR-008E.description_en: Descartes banishes occult qualities and final causes from physical explanation, admitting only size, shape, and motion—treating even animals as automata. Any explanation containing uninterrogable words like 'instinct' or 'intuitively' must be replaced by a candidate mechanism (what shape, what motion); otherwise label it 'unsolved'.

C-DKR-009E.title_zh: 暂行道德准则法——根基悬置期的生活维持方案
C-DKR-009E.description_en: During his doubt-and-rebuild Descartes keeps living: follow the laws and customs of your country to lower friction; act decisively once decided, since hesitation costs more than a wrong turn; change your desires, not the world's order. The dual-track pattern of 'legacy system keeps running + small radical experiments' in organizational transformation is the same structure.

C-DKR-010E.title_zh: 坐标代数统一法——用翻译层让两个系统的工具互通
C-DKR-010E.description_en: Descartes introduces coordinates so geometric figures and algebraic equations translate both ways—and every existing tool of each system instantly works on the other. The prototype of cross-stack integration and heterogeneous data unification: build a normalized translation layer first, then verify lossless conversion in both directions.

C-KD-001E.description_zh: When 'how does knowledge conform to objects' deadlocks for centuries, invert the direction: objects, qua known, conform to the knower's a priori forms. As Copernicus swapped orbiter and center, Kant swapped the priority of object and mind—one stroke explaining the necessity of mathematics and physics. The silent decade of 1770-1781: after his chair, Kant re-sifted all inherited metaphysical problems. The breakthrough came in his 1772 letter to Marcus Herz: how representations relate to objects had never truly been answered. Instead of a corrective treatise he wrote a tribunal—and the inverted direction turned Hume's problem from a skeptical victory into proof of the understanding's a priori legislation.

C-KD-002E.title_zh: A Priori Form of Intuition Method
C-KD-002E.description_zh: Decompose all experience into matter (given sensation) and form (the a priori frame). Space and time are not properties of things but forms of intuition—we can only experience through them as through fixed lenses; hence geometry holds a priori for all possible experience. Kant's two-pronged argument for the a priority of space: geometry is synthetic yet a priori—possible only if space is the a priori form of intuition; and every outer experience is already given 'in space,' so space precedes experience. His incongruent-counterparts argument (left and right hands) shows orientation cannot be captured by concepts alone but requires intuition.
tags_en: A Priori Form of Intuition Method

C-KD-003E.description_zh: 'Deduction' here means a justification: proving that rules we actually use (causality) are entitled to apply to objects. The strategy: from the fact of use infer the conditions of use—categories are not learned from experience but make experience possible. The B-Deduction of 1787: the 'I think' must accompany all my representations; for the manifold to be unified into an object of one consciousness, the understanding must synthesize it through the categories. Hence causality is valid a priori for all possible objects of experience—not because the world is proven causal, but because without the presupposition nothing could count as experiencing an object.

C-KD-004E.description_zh: When both horns of an opposition can be rigorously proved, do not pick a side—diagnose: the contradiction may lie in transgressive use of a tool beyond its domain. Kant's four antinomies show thesis and antithesis both follow; the shared presupposition is what transgresses. The third antinomy (freedom vs. natural causality) is the keystone: both thesis and antithesis are provable. Kant's resolution is stratification—within appearances the antithesis holds without exception; at the level of things in themselves the thesis may hold, so freedom is not excluded but becomes a postulate of practical reason. He said the antinomies first 'aroused him from his dogmatic slumber.'

C-KD-005E.description_zh: Knowledge is confined to phenomena—what intuition and categories have structured; the thing in itself can be thought but not known. This is a double move: a wall for knowledge against dogmatic metaphysics, and room beyond it for practical postulates (freedom, God). The 1794 religious dispute: ordered by King Friedrich Wilhelm II to refrain from writing on religion, Kant promised silence 'as Your Majesty's loyal subject'—precisely 'during Your Majesty's lifetime.' After the king died in 1797 he promptly published The Conflict of the Faculties: a political two-track demarcation between publicly examinable knowledge and an inner realm unreachable by authority.

C-KD-006E.description_zh: The moral law must be a priori and unconditional—a categorical, not hypothetical, imperative. Test: conceive your maxim as universal law and ask whether its universalization is (1) self-contradictory (violates duty) or (2) universally resisted (violates duty). Morality lies in the form of the maxim, not the outcome. Four cases in Groundwork II: the false promise annihilates itself under universalization (if everyone lied, promising would vanish)—a perfect duty; suicide, neglected talents, and refusing aid illustrate the two tests. Kant deliberately used ordinary cases to show moral testing requires no situational intuition; even in the murderer-at-the-door case (1797) he refused the consequentialist exception, since one exception destroys the a priori character of the law.

C-KD-007E.description_zh: The second formula: treat humanity, in yourself and others, always as an end and never merely as a means. Persons have dignity (no equivalent, non-exchangeable); things have price. This sets a hard limit on aggregate welfare maximization. The kingdom-of-ends formula lifts contract theory from bargaining to co-legislation; it is the doctrinal source of the Universal Declaration's dignity clause, the Nuremberg Code's voluntary-consent requirement, and the autonomy principle of bioethics. Kant's own version: he refused to bend his curriculum to 'usefulness' and faced down royal interference over his theological lectures—the scholar's public use of reason is an end in itself.

C-KD-008E.description_zh: When two rigorously separated domains (nature and freedom) cannot be bridged from within either, construct a third term: judgment, governed by 'purposiveness without purpose,' legislates to neither yet mediates between them. Bridges are new functions, not new theorems. The third Critique was written to fill the 'immense gulf' the first two left between nature and freedom. Kant housed the homeless faculty of judgment, whose aesthetic judgment ('this flower is beautiful') demands universal assent without concepts or interest—demonstrating the possibility of universal validity without legislation, and symbolically joining nature and freedom.

C-KD-009E.description_zh: Enlightenment is not unlimited freedom but layered use of reason: the public use (addressing the whole reading public as a scholar) must always be free; the private use (within a civil post) may be restricted without harming enlightenment. Answering the Berlinische Monatsschrift's question in 1784, Kant offered operational wisdom: the officer obeys orders but as a scholar may debate the laws of war; the citizen pays taxes but as a scholar may criticize them. Rawls later recast this as 'public reason.' Kant's own practice: silenced by royal edict in 1794, he promised obedience 'during Your Majesty's lifetime'—confining the private constraint to the post and yielding nothing of the public use.

C-KD-010E.description_zh: Kant redefines peace from a mere interval between wars to a state to be established (status pacis). Three definitive articles: republican constitutions, a federation of free states (union without world government), and cosmopolitan right of hospitality—backed by a 'secret article' guaranteeing philosophers' public discussion of war and peace. Written as a 'philosophical sketch' after the Peace of Basel (1795), Kant parodied treaty form—hiding philosophers' right to public discussion in a 'secret article.' The兑现链 is legible: the League of Nations, the Kellogg-Briand Pact (1928), the UN Charter, the Universal Declaration, and the empirical 'democratic peace' finding all restate or test Kant's articles.

C-HEG-001E.description_zh: Every concept, position, or institution harbors internal contradiction: pushed to its limit, it negates itself and turns into its own other. Sublation (Aufhebung) means three things at once—cancel, preserve, and lift up: the contradiction is resolved not by choosing a side but by finding the higher concept within which both sides are moments. Being-nothing-becoming is the prototype: pure Being, devoid of all determination, proves indistinguishable from Nothing, hence negates itself; their truth is Becoming. Likewise the collapse of sense-certainty: the 'now' it claims turns out, in language, to be a universal—each standpoint refuted by its own words.

C-HEG-002E.description_zh: Re-understand every 'result' as a 'process': truth is not a picked fruit but the whole bud-bloom-wither chain. Against Spinoza's static substance, Hegel insists the real must be grasped not only as substance but as subject—self-moving, self-mediating. Hegel judged Spinoza's substance 'one-sided for lacking subjectivity': motion and freedom have no place in it. Restoring self-mediation, the Absolute must divide itself (nature, finite spirit) and return. His treatment of everyday concepts ('patriotism,' 'morality') likewise asks not for definitions but for the process that shaped them.

C-HEG-003E.description_zh: Self-consciousness cannot establish itself alone: the 'I' must be recognized by another free consciousness. The master wins the life-and-death struggle, yet depends on recognition from someone unfree—worthless; the slave, shaped by fear and by labor on the world, acquires independence. Domination is self-undermining; freedom is mutual recognition. The thought-experiment of chapter IV: two self-consciousnesses stake life itself for recognition. The victor's prize is hollow—recognition from the unfree—while the slave, disciplined by fear and formed by labor, gains a deeper self-certainty. Kojève read this as the engine of history; Marx, Honneth, and Fanon all begin here.

C-HEG-004E.description_zh: Refute a position not by external standards but by its own: let it experience the world per its own commitments until it fails from within. Each immanent failure forces consciousness to revise its notion of object and knowledge, climbing the ladder of the Phenomenology. The critique of sense-certainty is the template: Hegel introduces no external criterion, merely lets common sense repeat its own claim until language—the home of universals—betrays it. The 'now' written down survives only as a universal. Sense-certainty fails by its own standard and ascends voluntarily. The whole Phenomenology is this program run continuously.

C-HEG-005E.description_zh: Spirit (or a person, an organization) necessarily proceeds in three steps: externalization (self-investment into the object-world—works, institutions, products), alienation (the object gains independence and turns on its creator), return (reappropriating the object-world as one's own product at a higher level). Alienation is not an accident to avoid but the necessary route of development. In the Bildung chapter, power and wealth—spirit's own products—become alien powers the individual must serve; noble and base consciousness struggle through them to 'divided consciousness.' In labor, the artisan must submit to the material—precisely this submission forms skill and discipline. Marx's four-fold alienated labor in the 1844 Manuscripts inherits this frame.

C-HEG-006E.description_zh: No one designs the macro-outcome of history: it is the unintended aggregation of countless agents pursuing private passions—'the cunning of reason' uses ambition and greed to work its ends. Neither great-man history nor conspiracy theory explains it; the right question is: what aggregation mechanism fused self-interested acts into this unanticipated result? The world-historical individuals—Alexander, Caesar, Napoleon—sought personal glory yet were agents of their age's idea, falling 'like empty husks' once their mission was done. The modern analogue: no single firm wants platform monopoly, yet moat-building under profit motives plus network effects fuses into monopoly no one designed. Smith's invisible hand is the economic version; Hegel its philosophical statement.

C-HEG-007E.description_zh: Set the axis of history not at dynasties, economies, or technologies but at the expansion of the concept of freedom in consciousness: the Oriental world (one free), Greco-Roman (some free), Germanic-Christian (all free)—institutions and art at each stage are explained by that stage's level of freedom-consciousness. Hegel rewrites world history by freedom's level: China/India at 'substantiality' (individual undifferentiated from the ethical substance); Greece's 'beautiful freedom' (citizens only, slavery presupposed); Rome's abstract legal personhood; Christianity's break—all persons of infinite worth; the Germanic world's task of institutionalizing that principle. He concedes even his own world has realized the principle, not the reality.

C-HEG-008E.description_zh: Freedom is realized not in abstract rights or arbitrary choice but by concretizing through three ethical tiers: the family (love, immediate unity), civil society (needs and labor, a system of differences mediated by law and corporations), the state (concrete universality where personal freedom is realized in the universal). Each tier means freedom differently: belonging, exchange, membership. Civil society is the hinge: the system of needs releases individuals from family bonds yet throws them into atomized interdependence—liberation and pauperism share a root. Hegel's rabble (Pöbel) diagnosis: those stripped of all ethical bonds cannot be saved by charity (misapplied family bond) or the market (which produces them); they need corporate membership. His critique of 'arbitrary choice' as freedom echoes through Tocqueville's association and the communitarian-liberal debate.

C-HEG-009E.description_zh: Philosophical truth cannot be exhausted by the static subject-predicate proposition: in the speculative proposition the predicate swallows the subject—'God is Being' states not an attribute but the dissolution and reconstitution of the subject. The proposition form is used and then broken: its truth lies in the movement of reading, not the literal statement. The preface's example, 'God is Being': the understanding hears an attribute; speculation finds the predicate rewriting the subject as the sentence completes. Philosophy, Hegel warns, cannot be read as an inventory—the same sentence is not the same on the second pass. The modern analogue is the Gödelian self-reference ('this sentence is unprovable'), where the meta-level flips inside the system itself.

C-HEG-010E.description_zh: Philosophy—and any mature theoretical understanding—can grasp only a reality that has completed its formation: 'the owl of Minerva spreads its wings only with the falling of dusk.' Retrospective understanding necessarily lags practice; institutionalize the lag rather than fight it. The preface refuses recipes for the state: one cannot leap over one's epoch any more than over one's skin. After the French Revolution injected 'all are free' into actuality, philosophy's task was understanding the completed process, not drafting utopias. His History of Philosophy is dusk-flight throughout. The modern analogue: dissecting completed industry cycles (CRT→LCD, PC→mobile) calibrates the next cycle's assumptions more reliably than futurology.

C-TLY-001E.description_zh: When facing an unanswerable controversial question ('can machines think?'), first diagnose why it is unanswerable—usually an unobservable interior essence—then rewrite it as an equivalent question with an operational, testable criterion. Not evasion: the controversy lives in the formulation itself. Turing applied this thrice: computable numbers → what a Turing machine does; thinking → the imitation game; form → reaction-diffusion equations. The 1950 paper opens with the move: 'thinking' has no public criterion, so Turing replaces the two-thousand-year metaphysical dispute with the imitation game—a testable protocol. In 1936 he did the same for Hilbert's Entscheidungsproblem: rather than argue about 'algorithm', he defined it via the Turing machine and proved universal decidability impossible—one rewrite yielding the century's most important negative theorem.

C-TLY-002E.description_zh: To define a complex activity, strip the apparatus until removing one more part breaks it—the minimal sufficient apparatus is the essence. The Turing machine is just an infinite tape, a read-write head, and a finite state table; this spare structure is what makes 'all computing machines are equivalent' a theorem rather than an intuition. In 1936 Turing derived the machine from a human computing with pencil and paper: looking, writing, erasing, remembering finitely many 'states of mind'. Section 9 then proves the punchline—wider tapes, more heads, faster machines, parallelism—are all simulable by the minimal machine; 'more powerful' is an illusion at the level of principle. This is the founding argument of computer science and the direct template for the von Neumann architecture.

C-TLY-003E.description_zh: When every new task needs a new apparatus, seek the universal layer: encode each machine's behavior description as a symbol sequence the machine itself can read and execute. The universal Turing machine's revolution is 'program as data'—new capability drops from building new machines to writing new descriptions, at the cost of simulation overhead but with unbounded extensibility. Section 6 of the 1936 paper encodes each machine's rules as a description number and builds U, which reads any description and executes it—one machine, any computable sequence. Having felt the pain of special-purpose devices at Bletchley, Turing's 1945 ACE report made instructions numerically stored, indistinguishable from data; von Neumann's EDVAC report followed the same route. Every 'software update instead of hardware replacement' today is this method's dividend.

C-TLY-004E.description_zh: To prove some problems are in-principle unsolvable, construct an object pointing at the list itself: make the system process an input containing its own description, forcing contradiction or non-termination. Diagonalization gives structural refutation—not 'we haven't found the algorithm' but 'finding it entails contradiction'—while also mapping the boundary's shape. Section 8 executes the Entscheidungsproblem: enumerate all machines, build Machine H claiming to decide halting, then the diagonal machine D, which queries H about itself and does the opposite of H's verdict—H must err on this one question. Not an engineering obstacle but a structural impossibility. Gödel had just done the same in arithmetic; Turing's machine version made self-reference transparent to any engineer, and the construction spawned halting-problem theory, Rice's theorem, and complexity hierarchies.

C-TLY-005E.description_zh: Against an apparently impregnable adversary system, do not outspend it—find its irremovable structural weakness, ideally a deterministic flaw (Enigma's 'no letter ever encrypts to itself'), then mechanize the exploitation so codebreaking becomes a routine any operator can run. Sustainable advantage = unfixable constraint × mechanizable process × trainable team. 1939-42, heading naval Enigma at Bletchley: against ~1.59×10^20 settings, brute force was hopeless. Turing instead seized two certainties—the reflector's 'no letter enciphers to itself' (any crib with a same-letter clash, e.g. WETTER, is eliminated) and German procedural predictability. His Bombe simulated settings electrically and auto-eliminated contradictions, yielding a handful of candidates each morning for human verification, run as a shift-based factory of dozens of machines. The breach cut the Atlantic war by two years (Hinsley's estimate)—won by system, not nightly inspiration.

C-TLY-006E.description_zh: When a dispute centers on unobservable interior states (consciousness, understanding, sincerity), suspend the interiority question and demarcate by observable performance under protocol—whoever meets the protocol earns the relevant standing. Turing rejects the 'sentimental fallacy': whether machines are conscious is independent of what they can do. Section 6 of the 1950 paper answers Jefferson's strongest objection—'no machine could feel'. Turing's reply is coolly sharp: consciousness is unobservable, so by that standard we have no proof of each other's either; but passing the imitation game and having consciousness are independent propositions. The strategy shaped the field for decades—AI compliance, liability, and rating all proceed by performance while philosophy keeps the consciousness question—and Searle's 1980 Chinese Room was a frontal assault on exactly this suspension.

C-TLY-007E.description_zh: Rather than hard-coding adult-level knowledge into a machine, build a nearly blank 'child mind' with a basic learning mechanism and educate it—using reward/punishment signals (later: reinforcement) plus random variation to explore beyond instructions. When target capability is too complex to rule-ify, shift engineering from 'writing content' to designing initial mechanism, environment, and feedback. Section 5 of the 1950 paper—overshadowed by Section 6—is a stunning prophecy: the child machine, shaped by reward and punishment, trained on curricula, with random variation and teacher-imposed selection pressure; his 1948 'Organized Machines' sketch even describes neural-network-like structures with modifiable connection weights. Sutton and Barto later credited Turing as a forerunner of reinforcement learning, and deep RL (AlphaGo) realized the recipe: random variation + selection pressure + curriculum.

C-TLY-008E.description_zh: For the puzzle of how uniform origins yield regular structure (embryonic stripes, price clusters, opinion polarization), do not posit an external designer—look for local interaction rules, especially when two antagonistic processes with different diffusion rates coexist: the uniform state then destabilizes and spontaneously breaks into periodic patterns. Turing proved chemistry alone can 'compute' zebra stripes. The 1952 paper answered developmental biology's oldest puzzle: how does a nearly uniform egg know where to grow fingers and stripes? Against 'predetermined maps', Turing proposed morphogen A (self-activating, activating B) and B (inhibiting, fast-diffusing): small fluctuations amplify into periodic activation islands ringed by inhibition halos, with wavelength computable from four parameters. Confirmed chemically in the 1980s and biologically since (zebrafish stripes, palatal ridges), Turing patterns became a standard model of emergence—order without a designer.

C-TLY-009E.description_zh: Between 'possible in principle' and 'buildable in practice' lies a physical budget that must be itemized: speed, memory, energy, latency, cost, human throughput. Turing never stopped at existence proofs: the 1945 ACE report budgets delay-line words, gate delays, and multiply cycles; in 1950 he even estimates teacher-machine ratios for the child machine. The postwar ACE report is the method's specimen: 150+ pages itemizing 32-word delay lines, 200-line memory allocation, 1.5μs adds and 5μs multiplies, throughput under instruction mix—even the interface between programmers and circuit engineers. When NPL's bureaucracy starved the budget, the project shrank to Pilot ACE—proof the audit also reveals when the organization does not deserve the idea. In 1950 he even budgeted teacher-machine ratios for the child machine; System/360 performance models and LLM compute budgets are the same lineage.

C-TLY-010E.description_zh: When making a revolutionary claim, enumerate in advance every line of opposition—numbered, classified, and answered substantively; concede where objections 'have force', then show they miss the claim's core. The body of Turing's 1950 paper is not the imitation game but nine numbered objections, from theology and Gödel to consciousness and ESP—with the consciousness objection even conceded weight. The paper's real body is nine numbered objections: against theology, one should not limit omnipotence; against the mathematical objection, humans likewise fail each other's undecidable questions; the consciousness objection is conceded 'strong' yet leads only to solipsism and is irrelevant to the game's criterion; against Lady Lovelace's objection, machines can surprise (state histories incomputable for observers). He even numbers ESP—serious enough to lay every opponent's card on the table. That composure made the paper the field's obligatory reference for seventy years.

C-XN-001E.description_zh: When a field's basic object (information, risk, value) is endlessly contested, find its only publicly measurable functional facet—information's is 'how much receiver uncertainty it resolves'—and measure it on probability space: H = -Σ p·log₂ p. Measurement precedes theory: Shannon first set the unit (the bit), then the theory grew around the dimension. Axioms (continuity, monotonicity, additivity) make the definition unique and unarguable.

C-XN-002E.description_zh: When a compound problem (communication = transmission + meaning) stagnates, split it: explicitly declare which subproblem the theory addresses and strip the other as out of scope. Shannon's declaration that 'semantic aspects are irrelevant to the engineering problem' made the theory universal for English, telegraph, TV, and DNA alike. A stripping is honest only if independence, boundary, and ownership of the stripped part are all answered.

C-XN-003E.description_zh: Every signal source has statistical structure—predictable parts, i.e., redundancy. Redundancy is two-faced: a compressible margin (waste in transmission) and simultaneously capital for fighting noise (raw material of error correction). One statistical ledger serves both opposite goals: compress by stripping redundancy, protect by adding it back in controlled form. Where there is repetition, there is a redundancy account to audit.

C-XN-004E.description_zh: For 'can it be done' engineering questions, prove the limit before building: Shannon's theorem states that for any rate R below capacity C, codes exist with arbitrarily small error; above C, no code works. 'Existence without construction' freed four decades of coding research—it pursued the ceiling rather than chasing impossibility, until Turbo codes (1993) effectively reached it. A precise ceiling is the best roadmap: it shows where to stop and where to persist.

C-XN-005E.description_zh: When an engineering field runs on craft and trial-and-error, look for an isomorphism with a mature mathematical structure: if elements and operations map one-to-one, the engineering problem becomes algebra—simplification and correctness proofs included. Shannon (1937): relay open/closed ↔ Boolean true/false, series/parallel ↔ and/or. Wiring diagrams became mathematical objects with provable minimal forms.

C-XN-006E.description_zh: When noise is inevitable, don't chase 'never fails'—budget for error: add controlled redundancy (parity, checksums, copies) so receivers can detect and correct. Key ideas: structure decides power (Hamming distance fixes correctable errors); overhead-vs-reliability is an explicit trade to be plotted; and the converse matters—systems with zero redundancy collapse at first fault; resilience lives in seemingly wasteful duplication.

C-XN-007E.description_zh: When a field's security rests on cleverness, give it an information-theoretic criterion: security is provable—cipher and plaintext statistically independent (zero mutual information) means perfect secrecy, unbreakable by any compute; any leaked bit is a cumulative attack surface. Shannon (1949) proved one-time pad is uniquely perfect and requires key entropy ≥ plaintext entropy: insecurity is entropy deficit, not sloppiness.

C-XN-008E.description_zh: For an 'unspoken' human skill (chess, negotiation, diagnosis), don't imitate it wholesale—decompose into computable parts: a static evaluation function + forward search + pruning. Shannon's 1950 chess paper: positional evaluation (material, mobility) plus bounded search, with the Shannon number (~10^120) proving brute force hopeless and pruning necessary. The goal is not to copy mastery but to find the minimal computable skeleton supporting usable performance.

C-XN-009E.description_zh: When the environment cannot be pre-enumerated (mazes, markets, system limits), don't pre-program—build an explore-memorize-correct loop: the device explores, writes successful paths into memory, and reuses them. Shannon's 1950 mechanical mouse Theseus was the earliest physical demo: it bumbled, stored the found path in 75 relays, then ran it directly on every repeat. Intelligence lives in the loop's structure, not the initial program; exploration needs a budget; and the environment must hold stable regularities for memory to be signal, not noise.

C-XN-010E.description_zh: Before committing a big idea to a full system, build a toy: minimal in size and cost yet preserving the idea's full core mechanism—a minimum viable test of the concept and a universal demo language. Shannon mastered this: the maze-solving mouse (learning), juggling robots (motion control), a coin-returning 'no-coin' machine (automation). A toy is not a shrunken product but a mechanism distillery—strip everything until only the idea remains; its success criterion is instant comprehension, and its license to be absurd is what makes it memorable.

C-VNY-001E.description_zh: When a field's foundations self-contradict, don't patch the definition—rewrite the paradox as a boundary condition of a new axiom system. Von Neumann's treatment of Russell's paradox: split Class from Set, so 'too large' totalities can no longer enter construction. Paradoxes become illegal constructions, not mysteries.

C-VNY-002E.description_zh: When one object has multiple irreconcilable representations (Heisenberg matrices vs Schrödinger waves), first prove structural equivalence—a homomorphism preserving all operational relations—then switch freely by which representation simplifies the problem. Von Neumann housed both in Hilbert space: disputes about correctness became choices of coordinates.

C-VNY-003E.description_zh: When outcomes depend on a rational opponent's best response, rationality means maximizing your guaranteed worst-case payoff, not expected value. Von Neumann's 1928 Minimax Theorem: in two-person zero-sum games, defense-against-best-attack equals attack-against-weakest-defense—a stable rational value exists, generally in mixed strategies.

C-VNY-004E.description_zh: Operationalize 'rationality' by axiomatizing it: completeness, transitivity, independence, continuity—then prove an agent satisfies these iff it maximizes some expected utility function. Von Neumann & Morgenstern's representation theorem turns rationality from a moral claim into a checkable mathematical structure.

C-VNY-005E.description_zh: To make a machine general, demote control to data: store program and data in the same read-write memory so instructions become readable, modifiable objects—the machine becomes any machine by reading its description. Von Neumann's 1945 EDVAC five-unit decomposition made universality an architecture, not more hardware.

C-VNY-006E.description_zh: When problems admit no analytic solution (high-dimensional integrals, shock waves), design an experiment that computes: discretize or randomize, bound the error, iterate. Von Neumann and Ulam's Monte Carlo method is the extreme case—random sampling taming the curse of dimensionality, with probability as an algorithmic resource.

C-VNY-007E.description_zh: Decompose 'can machines reproduce' into logical parts: universal constructor + universal controller + description tape. Reproduction needs no vitalist extra—it requires a sufficiently general machine plus a copy of its own description, exactly the logical structure of heredity. Von Neumann's 1948 automaton prefigured DNA's mechanism by five years.

C-VNY-008E.description_zh: To predict a complex system's long-run behavior without tracking trajectories, prove (or assume within bounds) time average equals space average. Von Neumann's 1932 Mean Ergodic Theorem gave the first rigorous proof, upgrading statistical mechanics from physical intuition to theorem and grounding all ensemble methods.

C-VNY-009E.description_zh: Engineer conflict: write objectives as payoffs, actions as strategy spaces, uncertainty as probabilities and guarantees, then use game theory, optimization, and simulation to find stable structures—deterrence is arithmetic that makes first strikes unprofitable. Von Neumann fused game theory, Monte Carlo, and systems analysis into this operation.

C-VNY-010E.description_zh: When a new field's problem seems to demand learning from scratch, ask which existing tool's abstract form matches it. Von Neumann's six fields rested on a few repeatedly-drawn instruments: axiomatization, spectral decomposition, extremal principles, averaging, discretization—abstracted enough to be portable, matched by structure not vocabulary, and enriched by each transfer.

C-ONO-001E.description_zh: An online retailer replaces 'stock extra to be safe' with pull replenishment paced by real orders: cutting two weeks of stock to two days exposes both shortages and dead inventory, which reshapes assortment and supplier lead times—JIT recasts prudence as waste.

C-ONO-002E.title_zh: The Right to Stop the Line
C-ONO-002E.description_zh: A factory fits every assembler with an andon cord: an odd noise halts the line and the team leader arrives within a minute. Ten minutes of stoppage trades for a batch of latent defects—jidoka distributes quality to every pair of hands.

C-ONO-003E.title_zh: The Server That Died at Midnight
C-ONO-003E.description_zh: Ops refuses to settle for a reboot (replacing the fuse); 5 Whys traces the outage to 'no staged rollout or rollback in the release process'—revising the release standard kills the whole failure class.

C-ONO-004E.description_zh: An admin team audits by 'would the customer pay for this?': unread weekly reports (over-processing), approval waits, physical hand-carries—ranked and removed, meeting time drops by a third.

C-ONO-005E.title_zh: Kanban WIP Limits for a Dev Team
C-ONO-005E.description_zh: A software team swaps batch-and-crunch for kanban pull: WIP caps, tasks drawn as downstream capacity frees—lead time falls from months to weeks.

C-ONO-006E.description_zh: A support center stops staffing to the annual peak and instead levels shifts with rapid cross-skilling (SMED-style), absorbing holiday surges with the same headcount.

C-ONO-007E.description_zh: A new CEO drops the slide decks and stands weekly in stores and warehouses: shelf displays and picking paths that no report ever reveals—gemba puts first-hand fact back at the decision table.

C-ONO-008E.title_zh: From Checklists to the Kaizen Spiral
C-ONO-008E.description_zh: QC shifts from 'catch defects' to 'revise standards so defects cannot occur': every abnormality is written back into standard work with all-hands retraining—one station iterates 47 versions a year—standards are floors, not ceilings.

C-ONO-009E.description_zh: A supply chain team installs monitoring and rapid replenishment first, then peels safety stock layer by layer—each exposed stockout becomes a supplier improvement; inventory halves while fill rate rises.

C-ONO-010E.description_zh: A plant ties kaizen adoption to rotation and promotion: workers freed by improvement are retrained, not laid off—operators become researchers of their own process; respect for humanity is a productivity principle.
tags_en: Respect for Humanity: Empowering the Line

C-JBS-001E.title_zh: Executing Everything Outside the Four Quadrants
C-JBS-001E.description_zh: A new head maps forty-odd product lines onto a 2×2 grid of use × form: printers, accessory lines and clones outside the grid are executed, and the recovered cash and people are pressed into four quadrants—within two years the company returns from loss to the top of its industry. (Focus: Saying No to a Thousand Things)

C-JBS-002E.title_zh: One Button Left in the App
C-JBS-002E.description_zh: A product team interrogates each of seventeen settings switches with 'what is the user actually trying to do,' ending at one smart button and a default—uninstall rate and support tickets fall together as ratings double. (Subtractive Simplicity)

C-JBS-003E.title_zh: Announcing the Ship Date as Fact
C-JBS-003E.description_zh: A lead tells the team 'it has already shipped; we are only walking the path there': a locked deadline and no excuses force out the parallel solution hidden behind 'it normally takes three months'—delivered in forty days. (Reality Distortion Field)

C-JBS-004E.title_zh: Writing the User's Three Seconds First
C-JBS-004E.description_zh: The project brief may not contain a technical word: 'Half asleep at dawn, a thumb swipes and the world lights up'—display, battery and interaction are back-derived from those three seconds, killing two false requirements that parameter benchmarking had kept alive. (Design Back from Experience)

C-JBS-005E.title_zh: A Calligraphy Course Becomes a Font Library
C-JBS-005E.description_zh: A design team makes an unrelated aesthetic training—layout, kerning, whitespace—quarterly required reading for engineers; the next release's type hierarchy and spacing feel transformed: humanist input became product spec. (Technology × Liberal Arts Intersection)
tags_en: Focus: Saying No to a Thousand Things

C-JBS-006E.description_zh: In architecture review, each 'of course'—a config center, a new team, a daily report—is asked what constraint it originally solved; a third turn out to be fossils and are cancelled that quarter. (Beginner's Mind)

C-JBS-007E.title_zh: A Flag Rises over the New Project
C-JBS-007E.description_zh: A core innovation team is moved off the HQ floor with full exemption from routine reviews, given an irreverent codename and a flag on the roof; exemptions run beside martial law—iron deadline, iron secrecy—and a prototype ships in four months. (Pirate! Rebel Innovation Culture)

C-JBS-008E.title_zh: Name 101 Does Not Enter the List
C-JBS-008E.description_zh: As headcount nears the cap, hiring freezes: moves come from inside, new demand waits rather than standards drop, and the top decision-maker hand-interviews every decision behind each core hire's best work—density saved the delivery. (A-Player Small Teams)

C-JBS-009E.title_zh: Pulling the New Product from an Envelope
C-JBS-009E.description_zh: The launch stops reading spec sheets: one line ('unbelievably thin'), an enemy in the old heavy world, the product drawn from an envelope, a horizon at the close—every headline lands on the narrative line. (Narrative Keynote)

C-JBS-010E.description_zh: An experience map marks three broken seams—unboxing, service, account migration. The company reclaims ownership outright: in-house unboxing design, a first-party service desk, rewritten migration terms—the seams vanish and repurchase rises. (End-to-End Integration)

C-MKS-001E.description_zh: Quoted $65M for a rocket to Mars, Musk decomposed the vehicle into aerospace alloys, titanium, copper and carbon fiber—raw materials were ~2% of the price. He founded SpaceX to build from the floor up.

C-MKS-002E.title_zh: Model 3 Production Hell and the Five Steps
C-MKS-002E.description_zh: With Model 3 stuck at 2,000 cars a week, Musk slept on the Fremont floor, ripped out over-automated conveyors, and codified the five-step ordering: question, delete, simplify, accelerate, automate.

C-MKS-003E.description_zh: Musk ordered the Starship team into a deletion rampage: every questionable tube, sensor and manifold removed overnight, ~10% to be re-added. Deletion rate became the mass-reduction gauge.

C-MKS-004E.description_zh: An idiot-index-50 carbon fiber part triggered a full-material rewrite to 301 stainless steel ($3 vs $200 per kilogram)—one audit ignited Starship's cost revolution.

C-MKS-005E.description_zh: Nearly bankrupt after three failures, SpaceX's fourth launch reached orbit and won NASA's $1.6B contract—each failure had pinned a real cause: slosh, interstage resonance, engine soak.

C-MKS-006E.description_zh: On Starship IFT-5, the 71-meter Super Heavy booster was caught mid-air by the launch tower's arms—three years from first-flight explosion to chopsticks, flying-as-testing proven.

C-MKS-007E.description_zh: At 2 a.m. Musk found a battery-pack bottleneck and had engineers change tooling within two hours—communication by information chain, not command chain.

C-MKS-008E.description_zh: With both Tesla and SpaceX weeks from insolvency, Musk split his last $100M from PayPal between them and borrowed for rent—the mission validated in cash.

C-MKS-009E.description_zh: After the pad explosion destroyed the payload, telemetry pinned COPV failure; a public root-cause letter led to return-to-flight in four months with customers intact—blame frozen, honesty as credit.

C-MKS-010E.title_zh: Falcon Heavy Sends a Car to Mars
C-MKS-010E.description_zh: The slogan-grade deadline of launching a Tesla to Mars was met in February 2018—public mortgage forced an insane wish into an eighteen-month real task chain.

tags_zh: 销售最大化费用最小化
C-INM-001E.description_en: When JAL went bankrupt in 2010, Inamori's first move was neither layoffs nor financing but teaching operating accounting and building per-route P&L—numbers mapped one-to-one to things made every route's profit visible monthly, and record profits followed within two years.

C-INM-002E.description_en: Kyocera split the whole company into ~3,000 amoebas with handoffs priced as internal trades; the next process inspects the last like a customer, and unit-time added value posted weekly exposes waste and opportunity at once.

tags_en: What Is Right as a Human Being
C-INM-003E.title_en: Kyocera Refused Speculation in the Bubble
C-INM-003E.description_en: While rivals feasted on land and stock speculation in Japan's bubble, Inamori refused on principle—'windfalls beyond the fruits of labor are shameful'—and kept everything in the core business; when the bubble burst, Kyocera stood unharmed.

tags_zh: 付出不亚于任何人的努力
tags_en: The Success Equation (Way of Thinking × Enthusiasm × Ability)
C-INM-004E.title_en: Multiplicative Life in a Dying Factory
C-INM-004E.description_en: In the dying Shofu Industries, a mediocre-talented Inamori scaled the only fully controllable variable—effort beyond anyone—and slept in the lab until the forsterite breakthrough: mindset and enthusiasm won the multiplication.

C-INM-005E.title_en: Seiwajuku Daily Disciplines and the Mirror Ritual
C-INM-005E.description_en: Thousands of Seiwajuku entrepreneurs share the six daily verbs: nightly mirror reflection, time-boxed clearing of emotional churn, daily gratitude—character training broken into six executable small deeds.

C-INM-006E.title_en: Testing the Motive Before Founding DDI
C-INM-006E.description_en: Before founding DDI in 1984, Inamori asked himself nightly for half a year—'Is the motive good? Any self-interest?'—and entered only after the motive passed: reverence precedes the project, and an outsider dared challenge the telecom monopoly.

C-INM-007E.description_en: When the 1973 oil shock cut orders 90%, Kyocera ran company-wide selling with shared pay cuts and zero layoffs while pushing idle hours into new products—two years later demand returned and the company sprang like bamboo after rain.

tags_zh: 销售最大化费用最小化
C-INM-008E.description_en: Kyocera priced IC packages on customer value with its unique ceramics, refusing cost-plus; with price set, target costs were back-cast onto every process—pricing decides life or death, cost management decides success.

C-INM-009E.description_en: During the JAL rebuild, a 78-year-old unpaid chairman showed up weekly at Haneda and talked with employees face to face—the hen-guarding-chicks fighting spirit made visible: organizational temperature is set by the leader's flame.

tags_en: Optimistic Conceive, Pessimistic Plan, Optimistic Execute
C-INM-010E.title_en: Three-Stage Staging of the DDI Founding
C-INM-010E.description_en: DDI's founding staged three personas: wild conception (the rate revolution), months of pessimistic planning (failure contingencies and rate-war funding), then faithful execution—each stage staffed by the personality it needs.

C-SQIN-001E.description_en: Su Qin persuaded Yan, Zhao, Han, Wei, Qi and Chu to unite 'the many weak against the one strong,' wore six chancellor seals as coalition chief, and deterred Qin from Hangu Pass for fifteen years.

C-SQIN-002E.description_en: After failing with Qin and being mocked at home, Su Qin shut his door, drilled the Yinfu, stabbing his thigh to stay awake—blood to the feet—and emerged with the probing craft complete.

C-SQIN-003E.description_en: 'Better a chicken's beak than an ox's rear'—one line reframed serving Qin as servitude; the enraged King of Han offered his state to the alliance.

C-SQIN-004E.title_en: Five-Direction Parallelism Before the King of Qin
C-SQIN-004E.description_en: His opening inventory of Qin's wealth—Ba-Shu, Hu-Mo, Wushan, Yao-Han—marched in parallel clauses; Qin rejected the plan yet later followed the very route he outlined.

C-SQIN-005E.title_en: The Snob Filter: Contempt as Crucible
C-SQIN-005E.description_en: Returning in glory with six seals, Su Qin sighed that two qing of farmland would have kept him from greatness—utter poverty had forced the year of mastery.

C-SQIN-006E.title_en: Three Steps of Doom for the King of Zhao
C-SQIN-006E.description_en: Qin nibbles Han-Wei; Han-Wei submit; 'the calamity must land in Zhao's lap'—a three-step deduction put a twenty-year threat on today's decision table.

C-SQIN-007E.description_en: Mortally wounded in Qi, Su Qin prescribed his own posthumous disgrace as a public reward notice—the assassin came forward to claim credit and was executed.

C-SQIN-008E.title_en: The Trusted Counselor Who Bled Qi
C-SQIN-008E.description_en: As honored guest minister, Su Qin urged lavish burials, towering palaces and the conquest of Song—each flattering, each draining—paving the way for the five-state coalition against Qi.

C-SQIN-009E.title_en: Punished for Loyalty: The Court Defense
C-SQIN-009E.description_en: Slandered and out of favor, Su Qin asked whether a man as true as Weisheng could tramp a thousand li for Yan, then told the wine-spilling concubine parable—and was restored with greater honor.

C-SQIN-010E.description_en: Yan funded Su Qin's carriage-and-gold journey to Zhao; Zhao then bankrolled the rounds to the other courts—each win pledged to the next stop, ending in six seals.

C-SX-001.description_en: Su Xian traveled among the states, systematically collecting military and political intelligence, comparing strengths and interest patterns, and proposing 'determine strategy by observing circumstances, speak based on analysis of interests,' laying an accurate intelligence foundation for the vertical alliance strategy.

C-SX-002.title_en: Riding the Qi-Chu rivalry to build the alliance
C-SX-002.description_en: Su Xian exploited the interest conflicts between Qi and Chu, guiding both states toward a joint anti-Qin stance—'follow the momentum, never move against it'—so the vertical alliance grew naturally out of interstate rivalries.

C-SX-003.title_en: Persuading the King of Chu to join the vertical alliance
C-SX-003.description_en: With carefully crafted rhetoric and argument, Su Xian persuaded the King of Chu, laying out the peril of Qin's eastward expansion and the real benefits of alliance—'one word can raise a state'—bringing Chu into the vertical alliance.

C-SX-004.description_en: Facing different counterparts, Su Xian adjusted strategy in real time: stern warnings of the cost of expansion toward Qin, warm accounts of alliance benefits toward Chu—speak to the audience—achieving diplomatic aims by adapting to the adversary.

C-SX-005.title_en: Feint against Wei to relieve Zhao
C-SX-005.description_en: Su Xian designed a feint: an apparent attack on Wei whose real aim was relieving Zhao—'show the false as true and the true as false'—using information manipulation to scatter Qin's forces and lift the siege.

C-SX-006.title_en: Trading land for treaties: the interest calculus
C-SX-006.description_en: Su Xian precisely calculated each state's interests, advocating ceding border towns for key treaties—'where benefit lies, people gather; where benefit trends, states follow'—consolidating the alliance's core at minimal cost.

C-SX-007.description_en: Su Xian built a systematic international intelligence network tracking Qin's internal politics and military movements—'know the other and know yourself and you win'—using information asymmetry to anticipate counterparts' bottom lines and move first at the table.

C-SX-008.title_en: Seizing the initiative: launching the vertical alliance first
C-SX-008.description_en: Before Qin's horizontal-alliance offensive took shape, Su Xian launched the vertical alliance proposal and drafted the treaty framework himself—'the first voice commands, the first move prevails'—seizing control of the diplomatic agenda.

C-SX-009.title_en: Forging the six-state vertical alliance against Qin
C-SX-009.description_en: Guided by 'unite the weak to attack the strong,' Su Xian linked Yan, Zhao, Han, Wei, Qi, and Chu into a vertical alliance treaty, setting the alliance-strategy paradigm later practiced by Zhang Yi and Su Qin.

C-SX-010.title_en: Reading the grand pattern: union and division are impermanent
C-SX-010.description_en: Analyzing the international system from a macro perspective—'the momentum of the world alternates between union and division'—Su Xian accurately forecast Qin's rise and the alliance's eventual split, reserving room for strategic withdrawal and follow-on positioning.

C-ZY-001E.title_en: Severing the Qi-Chu Bond: Felling the Coalition's Load-Bearing Beam
C-ZY-001E.description_en: The Qi-Chu partnership was the eastern pillar of the vertical alliance. Baiting King Huai of Chu with the promised 600 li of Shang land, Zhang Yi made Chu break with Qi—the eastern wing collapsed, and the rest of the coalition loosened on its own.

C-ZY-002E.title_en: Chancellor of Wei, Agent of Qin: Re-Positioning Without Re-Aiming
C-ZY-002E.description_en: Resigning Qin's chancellorship to serve as Wei's chancellor for four years, Zhang Yi ostensibly served Wei while actually dismantling the five-state vertical alliance for Qin—position in Wei, direction toward Qin: adaptability in the service of a fixed objective.

C-ZY-003E.title_en: The 600-li Hook: Interest-Bait That Makes the Mark Sell Himself
C-ZY-003E.description_en: Offering King Huai of Chu 600 li of Shang land, Zhang Yi moved the delighted king to break with Qi. The bait's purpose was never to enrich Chu but to make Chu demolish its own alliance—the cleverest inducement leaves the target happy to sell himself out.

C-ZY-004E.title_en: Hollow Words, Real Arms: Drafting the Enemy's Imagination
C-ZY-004E.description_en: Chu's envoys waited three months in Qin for land that never came; misreading silence as a secret Qin-Qi pact, Chu furiously cut Qi a second time. Zhang Yi's time lag let Chu 'verify' the false intelligence itself—hollow words made credible by real armies behind them.

C-ZY-005E.title_en: An Auditable Ledger for Wei: Sizing Strength Before Speaking
C-ZY-005E.description_en: 'A thousand li square, no more than 300,000 troops, four-square plains, spokes to every state, no mountains or rivers for a rampart'—checkable geography and troop counts argued Wei could not hold, and the king ceded fifteen counties of Shangjun.

C-ZY-006E.title_en: Kindling the Crack: Riding Contradictions Qin Never Created
C-ZY-006E.description_en: The Qi-Chu pact was solid; Zhang Yi never attacked the alliance—he angled for its king. The land-hungry king broke with Qi and the coalition snapped from within, at zero casualties for Qin. The best lever is a crack the enemy already owns.

C-ZY-007E.title_en: Demolish, Then Refound: Pouring the New Order as You Break the Old
C-ZY-007E.description_en: While dismantling the five-state vertical pact, Zhang Yi signed each state into 'serve-Qin' treaties with hostages and cessions—every broken ring re-laid as a bilateral stone in a new order whose exit costs exceeded its maintenance costs.

C-ZY-008E.title_en: Six Li, Not Six Hundred: One Re-Worded Sentence Demolishes an Alliance
C-ZY-008E.description_en: 'I agreed on six li with your king, never six hundred.' One re-wording—yet the Qi-Chu pact was already self-severed; Chu lost at Danyang and Lantian and ceded 600 li of Hanzhong besides. Deception's compound interest accrued from every wrong move the target made.

C-ZY-009E.title_en: One Envoy, Five Courts: Information Arbitrage on an Itinerary
C-ZY-009E.description_en: Touring Chu, Han, Qi, Zhao and Yan, Zhang Yi planted country by country the news of 'what Qin has offered and what others have ceded'—flipping the six vertical-ally states one by one, none seeing another's cards. One man's itinerary outweighted an army's supply line.

C-ZY-010E.title_en: 600 li the Hook, 6 li the Price: Betting What You Don't Own
