C-ZY-010E.description_en: Zhang Yi never owned the Shang land—he held only the right to quote it. Betting resources not his own, he took what Chu truly possessed: the Qi-Chu alliance and, in the end, Hanzhong. No land left Qin, and territory came in.

C-ZZJ-001E.description_en: Rather than describing a case, Zhang Zhongjing defined the entry criteria of a state machine—'floating pulse, stiff painful head and nape, aversion to cold'; a thousand years of external-disease medicine ran on this map.

C-ZZJ-002E.description_en: A feverish patient craving more clothing—the conflicting readings of inspection and inquiry are not discarded but flagged as a 'yet'-clause leading to the true-cold/false-heat discrimination: contradiction is the diagnostic crux.

C-ZZJ-003E.title_en: The Post-Formula Protocol of Guizhi Tang
C-ZZJ-003E.description_en: 'Sip hot thin gruel, cover warmly for an hour; when sweating resolves the illness after one dose, stop'—administration, warming, observation, and stopping fully protocolized: history's earliest post-administration observation and feedback-stopping protocol.

C-ZZJ-004E.title_en: Edema Above the Waist Sweated, Below the Waist Drained
C-ZZJ-004E.description_en: One edema, split by the location coordinate into two opposite treatments—the same disease with symmetrically opposed therapies works because treatment targets the pattern coordinate, not the disease label.

C-ZZJ-005E.title_en: See the Liver Sick, Fortify the Spleen First
C-ZZJ-005E.description_en: The target is not the current lesion but the next state: foreseeing the liver disease's downstream transmission and reinforcing the spleen in advance—preventive intervention predicated on a progression model, the earliest explicit 'downstream reinforcement' clause.

C-ZZJ-006E.title_en: One More Liang of Cinnamon, A New Formula
C-ZZJ-006E.description_en: Raising Cinnamon from three to five liang renames Guizhi Tang into Guizhi Jia Gui Tang for running-piglet qi—composition unchanged while the indication jumps: a formula is a parameterized system; tune before you switch.

C-ZZJ-007E.description_en: The preface names the systemic risk of single-channel diagnosis—prescribing after a few words of questioning alone; the four-examination fusion is the earliest protocol for multi-source information fusion, its absence a source of error.

C-ZZJ-008E.description_en: When mistreatment scrambles the presentation, Zhongjing gives no formula—only a method: from the wreckage back-infer both 'how the disease moved' and 'how the physician erred,' treating every error as the most information-dense controlled experiment.

C-ZZJ-009E.title_en: The Stable Interface of the Guizhi Family
C-ZZJ-009E.description_en: A dozen variants share one base-formula interface with documented modification clauses—the canonical formulas are medicine's earliest scale-verified function library, with the boundary clause 'death in yang excess' shipped alongside.

C-ZZJ-010E.description_en: The preface writes the system's failure domain and its critique of the guild ecology into the surviving text—the body stores protocols, the preface stores stance: true legacy is leaving others the protocol to re-derive the conclusions.

C-SK-001E.description_en: In Yanzhou Shen Kuo verified rock-oil firsthand, coined 'petroleum,' and wrote 'this substance will surely be widely used someday'—one observation yielding a new concept and a testable forecast, vindicated a millennium later.

C-SK-002E.description_en: A cut paper figure set on a qin string dances when its octave string is plucked—Shen Kuo turned sympathetic sound from hearsay into a publicly replicable experiment with the simplest apparatus.

C-SK-003E.title_en: The Twelve-Qi Calendar: Solar Time Without Moon Phases
C-SK-003E.description_en: Finding the synodic month irreconcilable with solar terms, Shen Kuo rebuilt the year on the onset of spring with solar terms as its spine—and predicted 'someday my scheme will be used'; eight centuries later, pure solar calendars arrived.

C-SK-004E.title_en: Circle Segmentation: A Table for the Bow-Shaped Field
C-SK-004E.description_en: Surveying a bow-shaped plot with no formula on file, Shen Kuo devised circle segmentation, unbending the arc into right triangles and a sector—need-driven mathematics later carried forward by the Shoushi Calendar school.

C-SK-005E.title_en: The Prefect-and-Magistrate Maps: Tiered Realm in Bird-Flight Lines
C-SK-005E.description_en: Twelve years of survey produced tiered-scale maps with route miles rectified to bird-flight lines and bearings fixed on twenty-four points—scale as a deliberate compression ratio, bearings stiffer than distances.

C-SK-006E.title_en: Shells in Taihang Cliffs: Reading Seas from Strata
C-SK-006E.description_en: Seeing shell fossils and pebble beds in Taihang cliffs, Shen Kuo inferred the land was once seashore—inferring landscape change from stratal evidence four centuries before Europe.

C-SK-007E.title_en: The Range-Finder on a Bronze Trigger: Artifact as Witness
C-SK-007E.description_en: Measuring the sight graduations of an ancient crossbow trigger and recomputing its range, Shen Kuo corrected the texts' 'six hundred paces'—artifacts are silent witnesses: texts miscopy, objects do not.

C-SK-008E.title_en: Four Compass Mountings and the First Declination Record
C-SK-008E.description_en: Comparing floating, fingernail, rim and suspended-thread compass mountings, he ranked the thread best—and honestly recorded 'it habitually inclines slightly east,' the first magnetic declination on record.

C-SK-009E.title_en: Bi Sheng's Movable Type: Archiving the Unnamed
C-SK-009E.description_en: Commoner Bi Sheng's clay movable type is absent from official history and survives through a single Brush Talks entry—the notebook genre builds files for those the state chronicles forget.

C-SK-010E.title_en: Dream Brook Park: Packing a Life into a Database
C-SK-010E.description_en: Retired in Runzhou, Shen Kuo packed thirty years into the 609-entry Brush Talks—thematic, self-contained, warranty-signed in its preface—upgrading personal notes into 'a landmark in the history of Chinese science.'

C-JSX-001E.description_en: Writing the Qimin Yaoshu, Jia Sixie ran four channels in parallel—classics, folk rhymes, experienced elders, and his own trials; over three hundred agricultural proverbs entered the canon alongside scholarly texts.

C-JSX-002E.description_en: Half his two-hundred-strong flock died for want of stored fodder; Jia recorded the failure verbatim and distilled from it a quantified fodder-storage protocol—failure as data.

C-JSX-003E.description_en: When elm samaras fall with spring rain, sow soybeans on the high fertile fields—living phenology replacing the rigid calendar, tiered into best and secondary windows.

C-JSX-004E.title_en: Two parameter sets for rich and poor fields
C-JSX-004E.description_en: Five sheng of seed per mu on good land, three on poor: one crop, two quantified regimes—technique written as a conditional function of the ground.

C-JSX-005E.title_en: Green beans as the best predecessor
C-JSX-005E.description_en: Comparing successor yields across predecessors, Jia ranked green beans best for millet; sown and plowed under in summer, one harvestless season buys years of fertility.

C-JSX-006E.description_en: The brewing chapters give exact ratios—one dou of starter to one dan of water—with seasonal coefficients: fermentation turned from hearsay into reproducible stoichiometry.

C-JSX-007E.description_en: Structure varieties by transport radius: perishable melons and mallows near the city, storable mulberries and hemp far from it—arguably the earliest agricultural location theory.

C-JSX-008E.description_en: Comparing batch scales, Jia ruled that fewer vats beat many because many vats cost—locating the optimum scale where fixed costs bite, and net profit over gross output.

C-JSX-009E.description_en: Hunger-relief crops like taro, beans, and mulberries enter the main register; cellaring and pickling systematized—the worst year as design condition, layered redundancy for survival.

C-JSX-010E.title_en: Naming the Qimin Yaoshu for posterity
C-JSX-010E.description_en: From tillage to sauces, every livelihood-sustaining craft written down complete and titled Essential Techniques for the Common People—a self-named literary machine built to outlive its author.

C-HFZ-001E.description_en: In 'Explicating Schools,' Han Fei audits the rhetoric of honoring worthies against actual state outcomes: scholars and knights-errant are honored while the state decays—moral prestige without cross-verification is empty talk, establishing the tradition of adjudicating claims by name-substance reconciliation.

C-HFZ-002E.description_en: Seeing the sleeping marquis cold, the crown-keeper draped a coat on him; waking, Marquis Zhao of Han punished both the coat-keeper and the crown-keeper—kindness outside one's office counts as breach. Unauthorized 'success' corrodes the name-substance system itself; zero tolerance for exceptions.

C-HFZ-003E.description_en: In 'Critiques I,' a Chu seller hawks a shield nothing can pierce and a spear that pierces everything: 'Pierce your shield with your spear—what then?' The man could not answer. A paired question lets an opponent's own sentences kill each other—the first mature application of the law of contradiction in Chinese logic.

C-HFZ-004E.description_en: Han Fei diagnoses two states' reforms line by line: Qin had 'law without technique,' so capable ministers usurped leverage; Han had 'technique without law,' so favorites judged rewards by private whim—seventy years without hegemony. From the autopsy he forges law, technique, and power into one interlocking machine.

C-HFZ-005E.description_en: In 'On Guarding the Inside': the carriage-maker wishes customers rich, the coffin-maker wishes them dead—'not from hate, but because his profit lies in that death.' Predict behavior from interest structures, not moral motives: the default baseline for institutional design.

C-HFZ-006E.description_en: 'Two Handles': the enlightened ruler steers ministers by penalty and favor alone. 'Reward generously and keep faith; punish heavily and without fail.' Fire looks fierce, so few are burned; water looks gentle, so many drown—deterrence comes from certainty, not cruelty.

C-HFZ-007E.title_en: Watching the stump: against ancestral law
C-HFZ-007E.description_en: 'Five Vermin': a farmer who once caught a hare against a stump waits forever for another—'those who would govern today's people by former kings' politics are all of the stump-watching kind.' When the age changes its affairs, preparations must change: 'the times have changed' becomes a complete argument for reform.

C-HFZ-008E.title_en: Cataloging the eight channels of deceit
C-HFZ-008E.description_en: 'Eight Deceits' compiles the complete list of channels eroding sovereign power—consorts, favorites, kin, renown-buying, largesse, lobbyists, retained fighters, foreign leverage—not specific plots but structural inlets, each mapped to a blocking design, threats ranked from inside outward.

C-HFZ-009E.title_en: Marquis Zhao asks about the ox tracks
C-HFZ-009E.description_en: 'Inner Store of Illustrations': knowing already of ox tracks outside the city gate, Marquis Zhao deliberately asked how they got there—the east gate clerk's false report collapsed on the spot. Known facts as a lie-detector baseline: 'if observation is not cross-checked, truth is never heard.'

C-HFZ-010E.title_en: Finalizing fifty-five chapters in a Qin prison
C-HFZ-010E.description_en: In 233 BCE Han Fei was imprisoned in Qin and forced to die by Li Si's poison—politically a total failure, but the fifty-five self-consistent chapters and millennial fables were already complete. The text is a distribution channel more reliable than any patron: his thought ruled the next two thousand years, outliving every contemporary power.

C-LSZ-001E.title_en: Vowing to remake the materia medica
C-LSZ-001E.description_en: Finding errors compounding across generations of bencao, the 35-year-old physician resolved to remake the canon from the Zhenglei bencao as base, laying down the program 'harvest the libraries, interview the four directions'—a vow that became a twenty-seven-year project.

C-LSZ-002E.description_en: Three full redactions in twenty-seven years: 1,892 drugs filed into sixteen sections and sixty classes—'like a net held by its headrope'—each drug opening with its corrected name as outline and entries as detail, turning a millennium of scattered drugs into a searchable system.

C-LSZ-003E.description_en: To verify the rumor that datura 'makes people dance,' Li took it himself and logged 'half-drunk, made to laugh or dance—it was verified'—the body as test bench, dose and remedy recorded, rumor upgraded to evidence.

C-LSZ-004E.description_en: Old books claimed the pangolin lured ants with its tongue; neither trusting nor dismissing, he caught one and dissected it—ants indeed in the stomach: rumor, interview, and dissection triangulated before the entry entered the canon.

C-LSZ-005E.description_en: Against the alchemists' mercury-elixir claims he tallied poisonings and named the claim false; the tangles of yuru with nilu and orchid with zelan were itemized in standing correction columns—errors archived, evidence adjudicating.

C-LSZ-006E.description_en: Years of expeditions to Wudang, Lu, She, and Niushou mountains collecting specimens, questioning herb farmers, itinerant doctors, hunters, woodcutters—frontline tacit knowledge structured into entries.

C-LSZ-007E.description_en: One field schema for all 1,892 drugs—nature, meridian entry, indications, elaboration, prescriptions: coptis to the heart, scutellaria to the lung, phellodendron to the kidney, gardenia through the triple burner—same-class comparison became possible for the first time.

C-LSZ-008E.description_en: Every drug ends with historical formulas—8,161 in all—with composition, dose, decoction, contraindications: 'changshan stops malaria' cashed out as a concrete regimen; a property that cannot say how to be used is not knowledge.

C-LSZ-009E.title_en: Cheap drugs, legislate for the poor
C-LSZ-009E.description_en: Grains, vegetables, fruits, waters, and soils entered at drug-grade rigor—ginger, jujube, rice, scallion in thousands of formulas; 'the rich buy from the market, the poor gather from the field'—paying power stripped out of the efficacy equation.

C-LSZ-010E.description_en: After completion Li carried the book to Taicang to seek Wang Shizhen's preface ('a comprehensive canon of investigating things'); after his death his son presented it to the throne; the Jinling edition printed in 1596, the Jiangxi reprint in 1603—the machine kept running after the author.

tags_en: The Great Depression and the New Deal
C-KEY-001E.title_en: The Great Depression and the New Deal
C-KEY-001E.description_en: US output halved, unemployment at 25% for years while prices failed to clear the market—Roosevelt injected aggregate demand through the WPA, Social Security, and public works, re-activating the below-full-employment equilibrium

tags_en: Pricing the Appliances-to-the-Countryside Subsidy by Multiplier
C-KEY-002E.title_en: Pricing the Appliances-to-the-Countryside Subsidy by Multiplier
C-KEY-002E.description_en: Rural households' high marginal propensity meant subsidies unlocked several times their face value in total consumption—'whom to spend on' decided by multiplier, not face value

C-KEY-003E.description_en: Rates at historic lows while the private sector still hoarded cash—a textbook liquidity trap forcing central banks into bond purchases and forward guidance

tags_en: The 1929 Crash and Keynes's Two Lessons

C-KEY-004E.description_en: Investors priced by the narrative that stocks only rise; when confidence flipped, investment and consumption collapsed together—Keynes, nearly ruined, distilled animal spirits and the beauty contest

C-KEY-007E.description_en: Reparations beyond Germany's capacity to pay—Keynes resigned and published The Economic Consequences of the Peace; his forecast matured in 1933

C-KEY-008E.description_en: Fund managers admitting on record 'we know valuations are absurd, but the music is playing'; the Nasdaq lost a quarter of its value in one week at the March 2000 confidence cliff

C-KEY-009E.description_en: States paid wages to preserve employment—sustaining aggregate demand without taking over firms, with sunset clauses pre-set: textbook discretionary intervention

C-KEY-010E.description_en: First settle 'what can we know,' then grow macro theory on the foundation of radical uncertainty—epistemology-first method; the Bloomsbury drawing room was the revolution's armory

C-WC-001E.description_en: 当时社会普遍认为雷电是天怒，是上天惩罚有罪之人的手段。王充在《论衡·雷虚》中首先运用常识经验法——若雷电是天怒，为何打人不分善恶？其次运用归谬法——若天意精确，何以无罪者常被击？最后提出机械因果解释：雷电是阴阳之气相搏产生的火，是自然现象而非意志行为。还以「冶炼之火同人无异」类比：同样的火，出自天地为雷，出自炉灶为冶火。

C-WC-002E.description_en: 王充在《论衡·问孔》中对孔子言论逐条质疑，指出其自相矛盾处。他不因孔子是圣人而接受其所有言论，而以事实检验每一主张。例如对「死生有命富贵在天」，他追问：若命定一切，为何还需修养与努力？这种质疑揭示了宿命论的内在矛盾，也确立了对最高权威文本的检验正当性。

C-WC-003E.description_en: 王充通过观察日常经验——水汽遇冷凝结成露水、冰霜——推断云雨也是水蒸气凝结的结果，提出「雨从地上出，复入于地」的循环模型。他运用常识经验法和机械因果法，将天象还原为物质过程，否定了天人感应的解释框架，展现出将宏观自然现象纳入统一物质解释体系的能力。

C-DAR-001E.title: The Galapagos mockingbirds: specimens differed markedly between islands, and Darwin bagged and labeled them by island with a note of puzzlement—it was this numbered batch (not the legendary finches) that pushed him from 'varieties' toward the mutability of species
C-DAR-001E.description:
The Galapagos mockingbirds: specimens differed markedly between islands, and Darwin bagged and labeled them by island with a note of puzzlement—it was this numbered batch (not the legendary finches) that pushed him from 'varieties' toward the mutability of species
Modern drill: User research: build a structured recording template first (interview IDs, verbatim quotes, context tags); postpone interpretive conclusions until the data is closed

C-DAR-002E.title: Origin chapter 9 systematically argues the incompleteness of the strata and the fossil record, converting 'why no intermediate forms?' into 'the record itself is a torn manuscript'—geology vouching for the vast time budget
C-DAR-002E.description:
Origin chapter 9 systematically argues the incompleteness of the strata and the fossil record, converting 'why no intermediate forms?' into 'the record itself is a torn manuscript'—geology vouching for the vast time budget
Modern drill: Technology forecasting: transplant Moore's-law arithmetic (tiny improvements × long time = huge performance) to software, energy costs, and other fields

C-DAR-003E.title: Origin chapter 1 opens with the making of pigeon breeds from the rock dove, with breeders' records and skeletal specimens as evidence—by its end the reader already 'believes in selection,' and from chapter 2 only persuasion remains
C-DAR-003E.description:
Origin chapter 1 opens with the making of pigeon breeds from the rock dove, with breeders' records and skeletal specimens as evidence—by its end the reader already 'believes in selection,' and from chapter 2 only persuasion remains
Modern drill: Explaining algorithms to non-technologists: start with an isomorphic everyday case (re-sorting a classroom queue), then extrapolate to distributed systems

C-DAR-004E.title: The raw entries of Notebook D (1838) show the skeleton of selection forming within two pages of the Malthus reading—inspiration as graft, not gradual accretion
C-DAR-004E.description:
The raw entries of Notebook D (1838) show the skeleton of selection forming within two pages of the Malthus reading—inspiration as graft, not gradual accretion
Modern drill: Algorithm design: graft biological sifting onto search spaces—genetic algorithms are this very graft engineered

C-DAR-005E.title: In the Origin Darwin lists creatures occupying every rung from pigment spot to perfect eye (starfish larvae, flatworm pits, Nautilus pinhole eyes, octopus camera eyes)—'every rung is in use' as the empirical pillar of the dissolution
C-DAR-005E.description:
In the Origin Darwin lists creatures occupying every rung from pigment spot to perfect eye (starfish larvae, flatworm pits, Nautilus pinhole eyes, octopus camera eyes)—'every rung is in use' as the empirical pillar of the dissolution
Modern drill: Technical review: against 'too complex to refactor incrementally,' decompose the target into a functional ladder with a user at every rung

C-DAR-006E.title: The Origin's sole illustration is the tree of descent—one diagram replacing the entire era's debates over the 'natural system': the hierarchy of taxa converted from artificial convention to genealogical fact
C-DAR-006E.description:
The Origin's sole illustration is the tree of descent—one diagram replacing the entire era's debates over the 'natural system': the hierarchy of taxa converted from artificial convention to genealogical fact
Modern drill: Technical architecture: converge subsystems' mutually foreign 'odd designs' onto one dependency/lineage graph, making legacy suddenly explainable

C-DAR-007E.title: The treatment of hybrid sterility in Origin chapter 8: Darwin conceded the problem gravely disfavored his theory yet still gave it a chapter and an explanatory route (sterility as a selected intermediate state of hybridity)—the opposition's strongest point absorbed into his own system
C-DAR-007E.description:
The treatment of hybrid sterility in Origin chapter 8: Darwin conceded the problem gravely disfavored his theory yet still gave it a chapter and an explanatory route (sterility as a selected intermediate state of hybridity)—the opposition's strongest point absorbed into his own system
Modern drill: Decision documents: include a section of the opposition's strongest arguments written as steel-men with frontal responses, not FAQ-style deflection

C-DAR-008E.title: Eight years of barnacles earned Darwin the standing of a serious taxonomist—in 1859 opponents could not dismiss him as an amateur; scholarly credit was banked before the theory arrived
C-DAR-008E.description:
Eight years of barnacles earned Darwin the standing of a serious taxonomist—in 1859 opponents could not dismiss him as an amateur; scholarly credit was banked before the theory arrived
Modern drill: Product launches: after the core algorithm/architecture is set, complete the evidence layers (security audit, load tests, docs) before going live—no wounded releases

C-DAR-009E.title: The seed-soaking experiment: measured germination of many seed types after 28 days in artificial seawater—kitchen-grade evidence for the assertion that plants can cross oceans
C-DAR-009E.description:
The seed-soaking experiment: measured germination of many seed types after 28 days in artificial seawater—kitchen-grade evidence for the assertion that plants can cross oceans
Modern drill: Hypothesis-testing training: decompose a project's big bets into minimal measurements executable this week (e.g., a walkthrough of 'users register within 3 steps')

C-DAR-010E.title: Peacock tails, stag antlers, bird-of-paradise plumage—one kindred class of survival-useless traits, uniformly explained by sexual selection rather than patched one by one
C-DAR-010E.description:
Peacock tails, stag antlers, bird-of-paradise plumage—one kindred class of survival-useless traits, uniformly explained by sexual selection rather than patched one by one
Modern drill: Product portfolios: when the main model (performance competition) fails on a class of wins (brand-emotion premium), judge the failures kindred and build a parallel mechanism (brand pathway) instead of stuffing them into the performance story

C-EIN-001E.title: Albert Einstein's 'Thought-Experiment Limit Method' applied today
C-EIN-001E.description:
The chasing-light experiment (1895-1905): chasing a light wave at speed c would show a standing field, which Maxwell's equations forbid—after ten years of digestion it became On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies, and special relativity landed as the direct product of a thought experiment
Modern drill: System design: run limit reasoning on axioms like 'the system must always be online' (a hundred million users, one datacenter down, clock drift)—the contradiction marks the architectural rework point

C-EIN-002E.title: Albert Einstein's 'Axiom-Critique Concept-Revolution Method' applied today
C-EIN-002E.description:
Special relativity 1905: the Lorentz-FitzGerald-Poincaré patch chain was absorbed wholesale by one definition, 'time = the clock reading'—contraction and transformation demoted from ad hoc hypotheses to deducible theorems
Modern drill: Organizational change: when procedural patches (exception approvals, temporary rules) pile up year over year, interrogate the charter's axiom-layer clauses instead of adding one more patch

C-EIN-003E.title: Albert Einstein's 'Unity-Axiom Assimilation Method' applied today
C-EIN-003E.description:
Electromagnetic unification (1905): a stationary observer sees a pure electric field, a moving one sees electric plus magnetic—field separation is a projection artifact of the frame, and the electromagnetic tensor unifies both
Modern drill: Platform engineering: unify logs/metrics/alerts of all business lines into one schema (a formal constraint); each line becomes a particular solution rather than another wheel

C-EIN-004E.title: Albert Einstein's 'Observability-Filter Method' applied today
C-EIN-004E.description:
The operational definition of simultaneity (1905): 'event at A simultaneous with event at B' = 'light signals from the midpoint arrive at both observers at the same moment'—one definition turns two thousand years of philosophical dispute into a computable problem
Modern drill: Metric systems: every 'strategic metric' must have a data path (which table, which caliber); metrics without a data path are expelled from assessment

C-EIN-005E.title: Albert Einstein's 'Idealized-Frame Framing Method' applied today
C-EIN-005E.description:
The equivalence principle (1907): a real gravitational field is inhomogeneous everywhere, yet inside local free fall gravity can be 'transformed away' entirely—contracting an intractably global force into a locally rigorous geometric starting point
Modern drill: Algorithm design: establish the method's optimal properties on ideal data (no noise, no missing values), then design the preprocessing contraction path from real data to the ideal assumptions

C-EIN-006E.title: Albert Einstein's 'Century-Debate Public-Adjudication Method' applied today
C-EIN-006E.description:
Solvay 1927: Bohr answered Einstein's single-slit objection on the spot with Einstein's own relativistic arguments (light signals and clock synchronization)—strongest-form restatement brought the debate to an adjudicable level the same day
Modern drill: Technical design review: write plan disagreements as public RFCs with counterarguments (an assigned 'devil's advocate' role), banning private vetoes

C-EIN-007E.title: Albert Einstein's 'Light-Quantum Boundary-Crossing Hypothesis Method' applied today
C-EIN-007E.description:
The light quantum, 1905: Planck's mathematical patch was transplanted as the nature of light, the photoelectric linear law (verified by Millikan 1916) serving as the verdict—within a decade wave and particle stood side by side in light itself
Modern drill: Cross-domain transfer: transplant a mechanism treated as an 'accounting convention' in industry A (auction pricing) and test it as a real mechanism in industry B (ad bidding)

C-EIN-008E.title: Albert Einstein's 'Miracle-Year Parallel-Pipeline Method' applied today
C-EIN-008E.description:
The miracle year 1905: four lines—light quantum, Brownian motion, special relativity, mass-energy—in parallel, all finished in patent-office spare time; the completion months of the five papers reveal a rhythm of line-switching, not a continuous sprint
Modern drill: Researcher's method: run 3-5 independent project lines in parallel, switching on stall; treat review/teaching work as judgment training rather than burden

C-EIN-009E.title: Albert Einstein's 'Reality-Interrogation Incompleteness-Localization Method' applied today
C-EIN-009E.description:
EPR 1935: juxtaposing the completeness and reality criteria forces a three-way choice (completeness / locality / quantum mechanics)—the debate upgraded from 'do you believe it' to a formalizable fork
Modern drill: Product-roadmap disputes: write each option's claims list (which metrics promised, to what degree, with what implicit worldview) and hunt for contradictions within the list rather than comparing volume

C-EIN-010E.title: Albert Einstein's 'Scientist's Public-Responsibility Audit Method' applied today
C-EIN-010E.description:
The 1914 'Manifesto to Europeans' gathered four signatures—Einstein's first demonstration of a ledger position: frontal opposition to mainstream luminaries' war manifesto at the price of isolation in the Berlin academy
Modern drill: AI research: register a model's misuse paths (deepfakes, social engineering, autonomous weapons) before release and publish your deployment conditions—release is a position

C-FRE-001E.title: Sigmund Freud's 'Unconscious-Inference-from-Gaps Method' applied today
C-FRE-001E.description:
In The Psychopathology of Everyday Life, a young man asking to borrow dice (brett) for a game misspoke it as 'borrowing knights' (Reis), betraying a repressed money anxiety about gambling
Modern drill: Structured clinical interviewing that treats topic avoidance and narrative breaks as diagnostic leads

C-FRE-002E.title: Sigmund Freud's 'Free-Association Tracing Method' applied today
C-FRE-002E.description:
The case of Emmy von N. in Studies on Hysteria: she explicitly asked Freud to stop interrupting her with hypnotic questioning; from her insistence grew the technique of letting the patient speak in her own continuous flow — the direct germ of free association
Modern drill: The couch setting and high-frequency framework of contemporary psychodynamic therapy

C-FRE-003E.title: Sigmund Freud's 'Dream-Work Deciphering Method' applied today
C-FRE-003E.description:
The 'Irma's injection' dream in The Interpretation of Dreams: Freud's exhaustive self-analysis of his own dream, demonstrating the full procedure from manifest narrative through associations to latent thoughts, concluding in wish-fulfilment
Modern drill: Contemporary sleep-laboratory content analysis of REM and NREM dreams (e.g., the Hall–Van de Castle coding system)

C-FRE-004E.title: Sigmund Freud's 'Talking-Cure Catharsis Method' applied today
C-FRE-004E.description:
The case of Anna O.: her alternating aphasia, paralyses, and eating disorders dissolved in 'onion-peeling' order as each symptom's first scene was narrated; the terms 'talking cure' and 'chimney-sweeping' are her own coinages
Modern drill: Narrative exposure therapy and the reproduce–discharge structure of EMDR in modern trauma treatment

C-FRE-005E.title: Sigmund Freud's 'Childhood-Etiology Tracing Method' applied today
C-FRE-005E.description:
The Dora case (1905): Freud traced her cough, aphonia, and attitude toward Herr K. to an interweaving of oral fixation (thumb-sucking, tic) with the Oedipal attachment to her father, showing how childhood structure organizes adult symptoms
Modern drill: Longitudinal research in developmental psychopathology predicting adult disorders from early attachment

C-FRE-006E.title: Sigmund Freud's 'Structural-Partitioning Method' applied today
C-FRE-006E.description:
The Wolf Man (Sergei Pankejeff): the infantile animal phobia following his witnessing of the 'primal scene' was explained as a transaction among id demand, fear of castration, and fantasies of religious salvation.
Modern drill: Foundational framework for structured assessment of personality organization (neurotic, borderline, psychotic) in psychodynamic therapy.

C-FRE-007E.title: Sigmund Freud's 'Defense-Mechanism Cataloguing Method' applied today
C-FRE-007E.description:
The Rat Man (1907/1909): the obsessive rituals of undoing and magical thinking were interpreted as a defensive organization against the ambivalent impulse of loving and hating his father.
Modern drill: The Defence Mechanism Rating Scales (DMRS), in use alongside DSM/ICD, apply the defensive spectrum to dimensional assessment of personality pathology.

C-FRE-008E.title: Sigmund Freud's 'Parapraxis Deciphering Method' applied today
C-FRE-008E.description:
The Signorelli case (1901): associations triggered by topics of death and inheritance blocked the retrieval of the Italian painter's name—the founding methodological case of the book.
Modern drill: Cognitive-psychological speech-error research (Fromkin) builds models of speech production on slip typologies, inheriting the thesis that 'slips are structured'.

C-FRE-009E.title: Sigmund Freud's 'Transference-Utilization Method' applied today
C-FRE-009E.description:
The Dora case (1905): Freud later admitted he failed to see that 'Dora was dealing with a new Herr K'; the unutilized transference ended the treatment—the failure that directly prompted 'The Dynamics of Transference'.
Modern drill: Contemporary psychodynamic therapies list transference focus (TFP, STPP) among their core evidence-based components.

C-FRE-010E.title: Sigmund Freud's 'Dual-Drive Hypothesis Method' applied today
C-FRE-010E.description:
War-trauma cases: opening Beyond the Pleasure Principle, veterans of traumatic neurosis repeatedly dreamed the scenes of explosion and injury, violating the pleasure principle—'repeating the painful' became the clinical starting point of the new hypothesis.
Modern drill: PTSD research on repetitive nightmares and re-exposure dynamics supplies a neuroscientific counterpart to the repetition compulsion.

C-HAR-001E.title: William Harvey's 'Living-Body Direct-Observation Method' applied today
C-HAR-001E.description:
Observing eel and fish hearts: small hearts beating slowly, the two stages of contraction (atria, ventricles) plainly visible—Galen's 'mystery of the heart's motion,' declared unobservable, dissolved by choosing the right species
Modern drill: User research: replace questionnaire answers about 'what users think' with direct screen-recording of what users do in real tasks—textual consistency is not behavior

C-HAR-002E.title: William Harvey's 'Quantitative Reductio Method' applied today
C-HAR-002E.description:
The blood-volume reckoning (1628): two ounces × one eighth per beat × seventy-two per minute = five hundred pounds an hour—the Galenic frame of 'liver makes, tissues absorb' executed by one multiplication, circulation the sole surviving structure
Modern drill: Architecture review: run a minimal-parameter multiplication on the narrative 'our log capacity suffices' (peak QPS × lines per request × retention days) and reductio the guesswork

C-HAR-003E.title: William Harvey's 'Structure-Function Mutual-Corroboration Method' applied today
C-HAR-003E.description:
The valves re-judged (1603-1628): Fabrizio's 'regulating valves' re-sentenced by Harvey as 'one-way valves'—the same structure, construction's testimony overriding the assigned function, becoming the circulation doctrine's most direct mechanical evidence
Modern drill: Code audit: a module's real permission set (what it can read, write, call) is more trustworthy than the function its comments declare—audit by construction, not by documentation

C-HAR-004E.title: William Harvey's 'Cross-Species Comparative-Framing Method' applied today
C-HAR-004E.description:
The eel heart as slow-motion model: beating two hours excised, slow enough to count beat by beat—the atrium-first, ventricle-after order read clearly in the eel and translated back to man and dog
Modern drill: Algorithm research: see the mechanism clearly at toy scale on synthetic data (adjustable, transparent parameters), then verify the invariant at real scale

C-HAR-005E.title: William Harvey's 'Suspended-Prediction Waiting Method' applied today
C-HAR-005E.description:
The capillary prediction (1628-1661): Harvey's 'tissue porosities' as a signed note of hand, honored by Malpighi's microscope—for thirty-three years the circulation doctrine was widely accepted carrying an open gap, because arithmetic necessity stood guarantor
Modern drill: Research management: allow papers to declare mechanisms that 'must exist but are yet unobserved,' provided the inference chain is closed and the detection path written—suspended prediction as standing practice

C-HAR-006E.title: William Harvey's 'Physician-in-Ordinary Trust-Lever Method' applied today
C-HAR-006E.description:
Vivisection before the king at Whitehall: Charles I watched more than once, on the public record—when the Galenists besieged the circulation doctrine, the royal post supplied the social credit of 'the king has seen it with his own eyes'
Modern drill: Corporate researchers: translate the organization's budget, data access, and executive time into research access, returning results as internal lectures and open source

C-HAR-007E.title: William Harvey's 'Monograph All-In Adjudication Method' applied today
C-HAR-007E.description:
De Motu Cordis, 1628: a seventy-two-page book going all-in at once, observation-arithmetic-rebuttal arranged as a whole—each Galenic attack (Primrose's anti-Harvey tract, Riolan's amended Galenism) had to face the entire book simultaneously
Modern drill: Open-source release: publish the core thesis's library as one integral release (docs, benchmarks, counterexample list complete), not one feature a day to be picked apart

C-HAR-008E.title: William Harvey's 'Embedded-Defense Method' applied today
C-HAR-008E.description:
The defense chapters (14-26) of De Motu Cordis: thirteen chapters of pre-written defense reduced most Galenic objections to 'questions already answered'—after Riolan's 1649 attack, Harvey's two public letters quoted the book almost throughout
Modern drill: Journal submission: pre-write every foreseeable reviewer objection in the discussion and answer each—the strongest objection answered first demotes the rest

C-HAR-009E.title: William Harvey's 'Imperfect-Harvest Cutoff Method' applied today
C-HAR-009E.description:
The field handover of 1628-1651: at the polemic's hottest Harvey fought less, letting followers like Schlegel and Walaeus carry the defense by replication—and the book, besieged, spread the wider
Modern drill: Open-source maintainers: when a project degrades to pure repetitive defense (no feature increment), hand over maintenance and start anew with the verified architectural experience

C-HAR-010E.title: William Harvey's 'Late-Renewal Question-Opening Method' applied today
C-HAR-010E.description:
De Generatione, 1651: a full-scale opening at seventy-three—direct observation (daily egg dissections), cross-species work (hen, doe, insects), mechanical questioning (is life pre-installed) reused without waste
Modern drill: Career transitions: after fifty, screen questions by 'zero waste of lifetime capability' rather than chasing hot topics or patching regrets

C-WJM-001E.title: William James's 'Stream-of-Consciousness Holistic Description Method' applied today
C-WJM-001E.description:
Chapter IX of the Principles breaks elementism with the 'sum of sensations' paradox: the same tune heard the second time is already different (carrying memory of the first)—adding sensation-atoms cannot yield this; mental compounding is a function, not an addition
Modern drill: UX research: describe user behavior holistically as task flows and journey maps; do not slice experience into click-atoms and re-assemble—see the stream before the funnel

C-WJM-002E.title: William James's 'James-Lange Bodily-Reversal Method' applied today
C-WJM-002E.description:
In 1884 'What Is an Emotion?' and in 1885 the Danish physiologist Lange independently proposed the same reversal—together becoming the James-Lange theory, two blind reversals converging
Modern drill: Behavior design: reverse 'motivation precedes action' into 'act first, motivation follows'—the five-minute start, behavioral activation therapy

C-WJM-003E.title: William James's 'Habit-as-Neural-Pathway Engineering Method' applied today
C-WJM-003E.description:
James quotes M. Léon Dumont's drunkard case: the drunkard who cannot change his milieu cannot reform; once the environment changes (leaving the old tavern), the vice dissolves—the engraving clings to environmental cues
Modern drill: Habit-app design: habit stacking plus cue re-engineering (running shoes at the door, uninstalling entry apps)—one-time arrangement replacing daily resolve

C-WJM-004E.title: William James's 'Pragmatist Cash-Value Verification Method' applied today
C-WJM-004E.description:
The credit-currency analogy: truth is like money, its value lying in being redeemed by experience—'truth's drafts' cashed by future experience, the web of ideas mutually endorsing (his most famous replacement for correspondence)
Modern drill: Product decisions: adjudicate design disputes by A/B-test conversion differences—log aesthetic disputes with no experiential difference as verbal, spending no test resources

C-WJM-005E.title: William James's 'Radical-Empiricist Relation-Internalization Method' applied today
C-WJM-005E.description:
The feeling of 'and': reading 'and' and reading 'or' leave different oral-utterance and conscious atmospheres—relations have experienceable texture; Hume cut them away only by admitting 'atomic impressions' alone
Modern drill: Qualitative research: admit connectives, pauses, and discourse markers into the codebook as first-class data, not just 'content words'

C-WJM-006E.title: William James's 'Naturalist Fieldwork on Religious Experience Method' applied today
C-WJM-006E.description:
The frontal reply to medical materialism (Lecture I): even if 'Saint Teresa was a hysteric' were entirely true as medicine, it still does not answer why her fruits were a holy life—root-explanation and fruit-evaluation are two different questions
Modern drill: Extreme-experience UX research: collect first-person narratives of extreme praise and extreme complaint into a spectrum; judge variants by behavioral fruits (retention, referral), not stance

C-WJM-007E.title: William James's 'Will-to-Believe Option-Partition Method' applied today
C-WJM-007E.description:
The social-trust case: 'should I trust my new partner' has no a priori evidence, and mistrustful suspension is already manufacturing hostility—James's paradigm of self-verifying belief (trust first → the partner catches it → trust becomes true)
Modern drill: Entrepreneurship: founders commit belief to vision claims no evidence can yet adjudicate (forced-living-momentous), mobilizing resources while setting milestone falsification points

C-WJM-008E.title: William James's 'Pluralistic Unfinished-Universe Method' applied today
C-WJM-008E.description:
The frontal battle with absolute idealism (the 1907-1909 public debate with Royce): 'all is arranged in the Absolute' and 'the world is being saved' are exactly equivalent in explanatory power, but the latter preserves the reality of responsibility
Modern drill: Organizational change: replace the myth of 'the grand strategy is settled' with 'the system is locally improvable'—pilots may fail alongside successes; refuse grand-narrative rationalization of failure

C-WJM-009E.title: William James's 'Second-Wind Energy-Release Method' applied today
C-WJM-009E.description:
The second-wind anthology: soldiers marching twenty more miles after 'exhaustion' at the bugle-call, mothers entering extraordinary endurance after extreme labor—energy re-available in larger measure beyond the threshold
Modern drill: Training science: polarized training and endurance-threshold re-estimation—controlled overload to mobilize reserves, with damage monitoring (HRV, creatine kinase) enforcing hard stops

C-WJM-010E.title: William James's 'Two-Layer Affective-Anchored Writing Method' applied today
C-WJM-010E.description:
The railway-platform and credit-currency analogies of Pragmatism: the entire truth-theory packed into everyday scenes of the traveler and the platform—hence the best-selling philosophical lectures in history
Modern drill: Technical writing: pair every abstract mechanism with an anchor from bodily experience (cache = desk sticky-notes), keeping the skeleton layer engineering-rigorous

C-GAL-001E.title: Galen's 'Doctrine-Sourcing and Self-Verification Method' applied today
C-GAL-001E.description:
Re-auditing Hippocrates: Galen wrote voluminous commentaries testing Hippocrates' doctrines item by item, enthroning whatever he could verify with his own hands—the Hippocrates he honored was the one 're-appearing in my own observation,' not the 'ancient sage'
Modern drill: Reading literature: before citing any classic finding, chase it to its original source and raw data; claims blank on both links are tagged 'hearsay-grade,' not 'evidence-grade'

C-GAL-002E.title: Galen's 'Public Anatomical Demonstration Method' applied today
C-GAL-002E.description:
The Roman live-pig laryngeal-nerve demonstration: cutting the pig's recurrent laryngeal nerves in public silenced it on the spot; severing or rejoining the other side restored or removed the squeal in step with the operation—a functional-localization question settled by one public act
Modern drill: Scientific reproducibility: major results ship with code and data others can rerun in one click (today's 'take up the knife'), guaranteed by replication rate rather than journal tier

C-GAL-003E.title: Galen's 'Section-and-Function-Attribution Method' applied today
C-GAL-003E.description:
Bilateral section of the recurrent laryngeals (2nd century): cutting one side weakened the squeal, cutting the other silenced it completely—a progressive two-sided control in one animal, pinning voice onto two nerves; a classic in surgical textbooks two millennia later
Modern drill: System debugging: bisect by disabling or commenting out components and watching the behavioral delta—'delete it and see what breaks' is the modern direct descendant of sectioning

C-GAL-004E.title: Galen's 'Teleological Structure-Interrogation Method' applied today
C-GAL-004E.description:
Functional anatomy of the hand: Galen devoted a full book to the thumb's opposition, the division of labor among five digits, and their fit with human tool use—form differences read as evidence of functional specialization, an analysis still referenced in reconstructive hand surgery
Modern drill: Evolutionary biology and ecology: cost-benefit analysis to explain trait differences (the rigorous modern version of 'why this shape'), with quantitative models and experiments guarding against 'just-so stories'

C-GAL-005E.title: Galen's 'Bedside Sign-Reading Method' applied today
C-GAL-005E.description:
Paralysis localization in On Affected Parts: back-inferring from the distribution of paralyzed muscles and preserved sensations whether the lesion lay in brain, cord, or peripheral nerves, and at which segment—the paradigm of localization without imaging
Modern drill: Observability engineering: logs, metrics, and traces are the system's 'pulse'—build the signal-to-fault correspondence table and backfill it with every incident, rather than merely piling up data

C-GAL-006E.title: Galen's 'Pulse Taxonomy Diagnostics' applied today
C-GAL-006E.description:
The four books On the Pulse (c. 175-180): the 27-attribute taxonomy governed pulse diagnosis past the Renaissance—the textbook 'observation upgraded to taxonomy'
Modern drill: Wearables catalogue heart-rate-variability signals into feature classes for clinical screening—"observation upgraded to taxonomy", modernized

C-GAL-007E.title: Galen's 'Philological Text Criticism' applied today
C-GAL-007E.description:
On the Spurious Books and the Hippocratic cleanup (c. 170s): philological authentication and commentary made his collation the 'true Hippocrates' standard for a millennium
Modern drill: Citation-chain verification in scholarship: chase broken transmission chains and misattributed quotes—an antidote to "Einstein said" apocrypha

C-GAL-008E.title: Galen's 'Self-Experimentation and Drug Trials' applied today
C-GAL-008E.description:
On the Powers of Simple Drugs (c. 170s): simples first, compounds second, across hundreds of drugs—the millennial template of testable pharmacology
Modern drill: Dose-escalation and combination trial design extends "simples first, compounds second": establish single-drug efficacy before combining

C-GAL-009E.title: Galen's 'Public Disputation Adjudication' applied today
C-GAL-009E.description:
Public anatomical demonstrations in Rome (c. 162-166): live severing of the pig's recurrent laryngeal nerve before skeptics won the medical establishment over and led to the imperial post
Modern drill: Public demonstration and live questioning at conferences: let claims face their strongest form, not just internal peer review

C-GAL-010E.title: Galen's 'Self-Annotating Canon Engineering' applied today
C-GAL-010E.description:
On My Own Books (c. 190s): the author's own catalogue and guide, later the first authority for distinguishing genuine from spurious Galen
Modern drill: Developers write READMEs and architecture decision records: a self-authored guide lets others take over the system—the engineering On My Own Books

C-AUG-001E.title: Augustine's 'Inward-Turn Introspection Method' applied today
C-AUG-001E.description:
Si fallor, sum (Against the Academicians III, c. 386): facing the Academic skeptics' universal doubt, Augustine does not rebut with a list of evidence—he points out that doubting presupposes a doubter; one eleven-word paradox seals the skeptics' exit
Modern drill: Product design: when surveys fail to surface real motives, have users replay their own actions and narrate the reasoning at decision moments—folding external inference into first-person self-audit

C-AUG-002E.title: Augustine's 'Evil-as-Privation Analysis Method' applied today
C-AUG-002E.description:
The privation reframing of evil (developed 386-400): exiting the Manichee convert's 'two-principles-at-war' worldview by turning 'why did God create evil' into 'how does good come to be absent'—one of theism's hardest puzzles dismantled by a single conceptual operation
Modern drill: Security engineering: restate 'vulnerability' as 'missing validation / missing boundary'—shifting from hunting vulnerability-entities to systematically closing missing surfaces; the design gulf between bounty hunting and defense-in-depth lives here

C-AUG-003E.title: Augustine's 'Psychological Reconstruction of Time Method' applied today
C-AUG-003E.description:
The threefold present (Book XI, c. 397-401): a tripartite ontology of time empty in past/future/present, reframed as threefold presence in memory-attention-expectation—no longer asking what time 'is' but how it is held in the mind
Modern drill: Perceived-latency design: a user's felt 'wait' is set by attention and expectation, not physical seconds—progress bars, skeleton screens, and expectation management are distentio animi engineering

C-AUG-004E.title: Augustine's 'Will-Primacy Diagnosis Method' applied today
C-AUG-004E.description:
The Milan garden conversion (summer 386): locked in the stalemate of two wills, Augustine hears a child's voice, tolle lege, and opens Romans—he came to read the moment as a re-ranking of will, not a victory of argument; his reason had long assented to Christianity, the change happened at the level of will
Modern drill: Behavior-change design: weight-loss/learning/cessation products stopped piling on knowledge (calorie tables, courses) and started re-ranking environments and rituals—defaults, commitment devices, community witness are the industrialized 'garden moment'

C-AUG-005E.title: Augustine's 'Autobiographical First-Person Argument Method' applied today
C-AUG-005E.description:
The pear theft of Book II: a trivial boyhood prank carrying the full theory of motiveless evil—the case's density (evil without motive is the scariest) gives the abstract claim irreplaceable persuasive force
Modern drill: Incident-review writing: a first-person 'here was my reasoning at the time' section teaches better than a bare timeline—case density is what makes organizations actually retain the lesson

C-AUG-006E.title: Augustine's 'Two-Cities Confrontational Narrative Method' applied today
C-AUG-006E.description:
The City of God's answer to the sack of 410 (413-426): the pagan 'we abandoned the gods and got ruin' argument dismantled by a frame operation—within the old frame Rome was the eternal sacred city and its fall a scandal; within the new, Rome is one earthly city and its fall business as usual; twenty-two books underwriting one narrative transfer
Modern drill: Crisis communication: after a major incident, itemized apology scatters—what is needed is a framework-level account ('we believed X; the world is Y'), a worldview revision that lets events be absorbed by organizational memory

C-AUG-007E.title: Augustine's 'Pagan-Bridge Method in Polemics' applied today
C-AUG-007E.description:
City of God VIII: the Platonists declared nearest to Christianity of all philosophers—then that concession leveraged: admitting an unchangeable creative source leaves no place for idols and many gods; the pagan elite readers could not defend by refusing to read, since the tribute was sincere
Modern drill: Cross-aisle technical advocacy: selling an architecture overhaul to management, derive it from their highest value (cost, risk, customer promises)—'the SLA you prize most is this refactor's biggest beneficiary' beats any list of technical merits

C-AUG-008E.title: Augustine's 'Epistolary-Network Governance Method' applied today
C-AUG-008E.description:
Hippo's monastic output (391-430): Alypius, Possidius, and fellow alumni taking key sees, North African church personnel and doctrine converging on the Hippo standard—the most successful translation of personal authority into institutional structure in antiquity
Modern drill: Distributed corporate governance: a founder replaces verbal instruction with archivable, citable written decision memos plus an internal training hub exporting the standard—Amazon's memo culture and Bezos's shareholder letters are this method's modern form

C-AUG-009E.title: Augustine's 'Open-Ended Layered Composition Method' applied today
C-AUG-009E.description:
The Confessions' genre overflow: an 'autobiography' growing ten books of philosophy and exegesis mid-stream—rather than rewriting Books I-IX to suit the later four, he lets the whole text be the site of thought's evolution, readers witnessing the structural transformation
Modern drill: Software engineering: semantic versioning, public changelogs, and deprecation notices—the Retractationes' direct descendants; authority from public revision history, not one-pass correctness

C-AUG-010E.title: Augustine's 'Deathbed Steadfastness and Legacy-Handover Method' applied today
C-AUG-010E.description:
The co-bishop appointment (426, four years before death): Heraclius declared successor before the whole congregation with reasons given—the see's continuation ranked above the prolongation of personal authority, and four years of transition sufficed for the network handover
Modern drill: Founder-exit design: announce the successor and reasons years ahead; document core assets so they are transferable rather than person-bound—the contrast studies around Zuckerberg/Bezos long-horizon announcements and founder-mode documentation

C-AQU-001E.title: Aquinas's 'Faith-Reason Integration Method' applied today
C-AQU-001E.description:
The Aristotle assimilation in Paris (1260s): amid an unresolved ban and colleagues' rejection, he took Aristotle's metaphysics, natural philosophy, and ethics wholesale into the skeleton of the Summa Theologiae—called the greatest assimilation project in the history of philosophy
Modern drill: Interdisciplinary integration: when absorbing a new field (say, behavioral economics into policy design), audit each claim's evidence type and real conflict points—refusing both wholesale tribal rejection and wholesale conversion

C-AQU-002E.title: Aquinas's 'Five-Ways Back-Inference to a First Cause' applied today
C-AQU-002E.description:
The first way (written c. 1265-1274): from 'everything is moved' to 'an unmoved mover'—attacked and rebuilt for over seven centuries, still the standard case in metaphysics courses
Modern drill: Product argument: rewrite 'we must adopt X' as a necessary inference from observational data the other side already grants, annotating the axiom each step relies on

C-AQU-003E.title: Aquinas's 'Two-Fold Truth Ledger Method' applied today
C-AQU-003E.description:
The eternity of the world (I q.46): he argues point by point that reason can neither prove the world began nor that it is eternal—registering a doctrinal claim explicitly in the 'revelation-only' ledger, the ledger's most famous application
Modern drill: Science-value boundary: manage empirical and normative questions in separate ledgers—data answers 'what is,' ethical frameworks answer 'what ought'—neither counterfeiting the other

C-AQU-004E.title: Aquinas's 'Sic-et-Non Quaestio Method' applied today
C-AQU-004E.description:
The Summa's five-thousand-plus quaestio units (1265-1274): every one runs the same structure—the textbook 'argument ethics written as typography,' annotated, imitated, and taken as the distant ancestor of the academic paper
Modern drill: Technical review (RFCs/design docs): mandate an 'objections' section—the strongest counterarguments listed before the proposal, the case not resting on rebuttal

C-AQU-005E.title: Aquinas's 'Conceptual Precision Engineering' applied today
C-AQU-005E.description:
The real distinction of existence and essence (De Ente et Essentia, c. 1256): 'essence can be thought without knowing whether it exists' cuts apart two concepts mixed since antiquity—the boundary became the standard starting point of later metaphysics
Modern drill: Requirements engineering: define each core noun ('user,' 'done,' 'available') by genus and difference with a counterexample list before the first requirement line

C-AQU-006E.title: Aquinas's 'Analogical Predication Control' applied today
C-AQU-006E.description:
The question of divine names (I q.13, c. 1265-1274): the univocal/equivocal/analogical trichotomy fixed the semantic status of religious language—the standard framework for seven centuries of theological philosophy of language
Modern drill: Cross-domain term transplant: when physics' 'entropy' or 'energy' migrates into social science, tag the relation type to the home use (metaphor/causal/proportional) to stop concept drift

C-AQU-007E.title: Aquinas's 'Authority-Citation Balancing' applied today
C-AQU-007E.description:
Summa I q.1 a.8 ad 2: while citing authorities voluminously for theology he states in plain words that 'the argument from authority is the weakest'—demoting authority inside the most authority-dense system, the method's most self-aware display
Modern drill: Evidence-based decision: tier evidence sources (RCTs > observational > expert opinion) and state in writing that no single citation settles anything

C-AQU-008E.title: Aquinas's 'Pagan-Rival Strongest-Form Method' applied today
C-AQU-008E.description:
The first four books of Summa Contra Gentiles (c. 1259-1265): a massive theological work with near-zero Scriptural citation—a 'public reason' text designed for interfaith disputation, seven centuries before Rawls's overlapping consensus
Modern drill: Cross-cultural dealmaking: build the case from the counterpart's internal KPIs and precedents rather than exporting your own standards

C-AQU-009E.title: Aquinas's 'Summa Curriculum-Architecture Method' applied today
C-AQU-009E.description:
The Summa's three-part architecture (1265-1274): the first modern-style textbook of a discipline, still the standard curriculum in Catholic seminaries in the twentieth century—the architecture has outlived every one of its arguments
Modern drill: Documentation engineering: rebuild a team wiki from time-stacked pages into recursive classification, self-sufficient units, cross-links—and write the general navigation preface

C-AQU-010E.title: Aquinas's 'Deathbed Silence and Legacy Handover' applied today
C-AQU-010E.description:
The Summa left unfinished (1273-1274): halted at question 90, completed by students from his notes—the unfinished part pre-digested by the architecture, the continuation transmitted as one with the original to this day
Modern drill: Founder exit design: once the system is 'takeover-ready,' the founder of a company or open-source project stops personal revision and turns to training maintainers and handover docs

C-LUT-001E.title: Luther's 'Sola-Scriptura Adjudication Method' applied today
C-LUT-001E.description:
The Leipzig Debate (1519): pressed by Eck, Luther admitted that even general councils (Constantinople's burning of Hus) could err—a move that transferred the power of judgment wholesale from 'councils' to Scripture, after which no dispute could be closed by endorsement of office
Modern drill: Organizational decisions: rewrite 'the leader decides' disputes as 'what do the data or the contract text say,' replacing endorsement of office with checkable source documents

C-LUT-002E.title: Luther's 'Root-Re-Diagnosis and Foundation-Swap Method' applied today
C-LUT-002E.description:
The Heidelberg Disputation (1518): before his fellow friars Luther laid out the 'theology of the cross' against the 'theology of glory'—ruling that the whole ladder of 'climbing to God by merits' is itself the lesion
Modern drill: Corporate transformation: when growth stalls, diagnose whether the business-model premise has expired before adding channels and budget to the old model

C-LUT-003E.title: Luther's 'Thesis-Form Public Debate Design Method' applied today
C-LUT-003E.description:
The format of the Ninety-five Theses: headed by a regular disputation letter under the Wittenberg dean—academic dress emboldened printers and copyists to spread it and left censors briefly without a charge of sedition
Modern drill: Technical standards competition: release a challenger design as a public white paper with open debate, letting industry discussion do the amplification instead of self-promotion

C-LUT-004E.title: Luther's 'Two-Party Confrontation Testimony Method' applied today
C-LUT-004E.description:
The Augsburg standoff (1518): Cajetan demanded 'recant and be silent'; Luther demanded 'show me where I am wrong'—each side kept its own record of the three interviews, and Luther rushed his version into print to seize the narrative
Modern drill: Workplace disputes: reduce every verbal arrangement to email confirmation, leaving a traceable mark on each procedural injustice

C-LUT-005E.title: Luther's 'Wartburg Productive-Retreat Method' applied today
C-LUT-005E.description:
Ten months at the Wartburg (1521-22): in hiding as 'Junker Jörg,' bearded, he translated the Greek New Testament into German—the imperial ban physically cut the loop of debate, and the German Bible was born at the most dangerous moment
Modern drill: Career crisis: when marginalized in an organization, convert the window into production time for skills or a portfolio, returning to market with finished work instead of fighting in place

C-LUT-006E.title: Luther's 'Vernacular-Translation Sovereignty Method' applied today
C-LUT-006E.description:
The September Testament (1522) as language engineering: forged written German on the chassis of Saxon chancery speech—'ask the mother, the child, the man at the market' became the translation ethic for all later vernacular writing
Modern drill: Technical writing: translate system documentation into the user's language ('ask the user, the support rep, the people in the forum'), building product discourse through documentation sovereignty

C-LUT-007E.title: Luther's 'Two-Kingdoms Ledger Governance Method' applied today
C-LUT-007E.description:
On Temporal Authority (1523): systematically separating what the temporal power governs—body and goods—from what the church governs—soul and conscience—written precisely as imperial courts began taking doctrinal cases
Modern drill: Platform governance: open separate ledgers for 'content rules' and 'community conscience'—algorithmic coercion and human judgment must not share one standard

C-LUT-008E.title: Luther's 'Fast Friend-Foe Sorting and Camp Management Method' applied today
C-LUT-008E.description:
The swift severance of Carlstadt (1522): back from retreat, he used the temporal power (the Elector) to expel a former comrade—kindred radicals were ruled a more urgent threat than the Curia, because they were contesting Wittenberg's interpretive authority
Modern drill: Multi-party negotiation: allocate effort by 'convertible vs non-convertible' instead of debating every opponent alike

C-LUT-009E.title: Luther's 'Small-Catechism Minimal-Delivery Method' applied today
C-LUT-009E.description:
The empirical starting point—the Saxon visitation (1528): Luther and Melanchthon toured rural parishes and recorded ignorance so deep (many pastors did not know the Lord's Prayer) that he abandoned the sermon form for Q&A
Modern drill: Product documentation: ship a two-layer delivery—'ten-minute quick start' plus 'complete manual'—letting non-experts become usable first and go deep later

C-LUT-010E.title: Luther's 'Psalm-Hymn Popular Voice Delivery Method' applied today
C-LUT-010E.description:
'Ein feste Burg' ('A Mighty Fortress'): likely composed around 1527 amid plague and death threats—it packs the two-kingdoms doctrine and justification by faith into singable stanzas, later called the Marseillaise of the Reformation
Modern drill: Brand communication: compress the product claim into a singable, repeatable short line, locking memory with melody or meter

C-ERA-001E.title: Erasmus's 'Textual-Emendation Restoration Method' applied today
C-ERA-001E.description:
The hundred-days publication of the Greek New Testament (1516): in under two years Erasmus collated manuscripts, emended, and translated with a new Latin version—the first printed Greek NT, letting every later biblical scholar bypass the Latin monopoly and face the original directly
Modern drill: Software engineering: audit a distribution's changes against upstream source commits, refusing to let 'the release build' stand for the truth

C-ERA-002E.title: Erasmus's 'Folly's-Irony Veiled-Critique Method' applied today
C-ERA-002E.description:
The frontal attack on the theologians: through Folly's mouth, the scholastics 'can explain everything and do no good'—written in days on the road to England (1509), published 1511, never condemned as heresy yet all over Europe
Modern drill: Organizational critique: in hierarchical settings, surface real problems through roast-style sketches or allegory, entering the agenda in deniable form

C-ERA-003E.title: Erasmus's 'Irenic Middle-Way Method' applied today
C-ERA-003E.description:
The stance of On Free Will (1524): named by Luther to declare himself, he wrote in the most restrained register not a compromise but a floor—granting man is not self-sufficient, yet insisting moral responsibility requires real choice; thereafter he stated, 'this is the whole distance I can go'
Modern drill: Organizational governance: stratify technical debates (core principles / implementation details / taste) and vote only at the core, leaving the rest to pilot data

C-ERA-004E.title: Erasmus's 'Colloquy Polyphonic-Dialogue Method' applied today
C-ERA-004E.description:
The Religious Pilgrimage of Convivium religiosum: at a humanist dinner, monastic and domestic piety each plead their case—no verdict is given, but the staged setting (library, garden, table prayer) makes plain which life the reader finds credible
Modern drill: Decision documents: recast a contested proposal as a multi-voice review dialogue (backer, opponent, user each at their strongest), so decision-makers read a play, not a deck

C-ERA-005E.title: Erasmus's 'Philosophia-Christi Ethical-Distillation Method' applied today
C-ERA-005E.description:
The Enchiridion's core declaration: the real battle is inward—outward rites (fasting, pilgrimage, candles) are auxiliary; contrition and love are the main front. The little book reoriented his own life and defined the humanist reform program for the next two decades
Modern drill: Organizational slimming: re-audit processes and ritual meetings by contribution to the core mission, letting demoted elements wither

C-ERA-006E.title: Erasmus's 'Print-Network Leverage Method' applied today
C-ERA-006E.description:
The Basel decade (1521-29): living beside Froben's press, he matched Luther's polemical tempo with publishing tempo—nine editions of the Greek NT, continuously enlarged Annotations, yearly expansions of the Colloquies, making Basel the capital of reformist publishing
Modern drill: Independent scholarship: run your own 'Basel'—build a content pipeline, a subscriber network, and multi-platform distribution rather than leaning on one institution

C-ERA-007E.title: Erasmus's 'Rhetoric-First Persuasion Method' applied today
C-ERA-007E.description:
The engineering of the Adagia: from 800 entries in 1500 to 4,000-plus later, each with classical citation and moral-political commentary—a corpus turned into a searchable magazine of thought that every European student owned
Modern drill: Content creation: keep a personal exempla library and variation drills, turning 'good writing' from talent into process

C-ERA-008E.title: Erasmus's 'Classical-Pagan Resource Requisition Method' applied today
C-ERA-008E.description:
The long note on Sileni Alcibiadis: from Aristophanes' little figurines he derives a universal test of surface versus core, then folds Christ, the saints, and good kings into one frame—classical allusion made the load-bearing structure of a theological essay
Modern drill: Interdisciplinary research: admit by 'does it work / does it lead to truth,' systematically absorbing a rival field's results (physics' causal idiom into sociology)

C-ERA-009E.title: Erasmus's 'Epistolary Community-Governance Method' applied today
C-ERA-009E.description:
The reconciliation sequence with Luther (1519-24): private mediation through Melanchthon and Elector Frederick first, public demarcation in On Free Will (1524) only when that failed—the sixteenth-century version of 'private message, then public statement' in community governance
Modern drill: Open source: govern a cross-timezone collaboration through mailing lists and issues, with layered channels for public, private, and review traffic

C-ERA-010E.title: Erasmus's 'Independence-Preservation Method' applied today
C-ERA-010E.description:
Declining the cardinalate (1535): Pope Paul III offered the red hat; he refused—not from humility but from arithmetic: a cardinal's pension would buy out his right to criticize for life, the one asset he could not sell
Modern drill: Career strategy: refuse binding offers (non-competes, exclusivity), staying multi-employer employable and ready to relocate

C-HAY-001E.title: F.A. Hayek's 'Spontaneous-Order Emergence Method' applied today
C-HAY-001E.description:
The 1945 tin example: when a tin mine is exhausted, nobody needs to know why; rising prices induce thousands of users to economize and substitutes to appear, all coordination carried by local knowledge
Modern drill: Platform economies: ride-hailing and delivery capacity self-organizes through real-time price signals; no centralized scheduler can handle ever-shifting local supply and demand

C-HAY-002E.title: F.A. Hayek's 'Dispersed-Knowledge Diagnosis Method' applied today
C-HAY-002E.description:
The socialist calculation debate of the 1930s: Mises and Hayek argued that without market prices the cost of combining millions of capital goods cannot be computed—the planning board is not unwilling to calculate but has no information to calculate with
Modern drill: Corporate dashboards: an executive cockpit aggregates only quantifiables; real customer experience and veterans' intuition remain at the front line—major decisions require field sampling, not report-reading

C-HAY-003E.title: F.A. Hayek's 'Price-as-Signal Communication Method' applied today
C-HAY-003E.description:
The 1945 tin example: one signal—a rising price—makes thousands of strangers economize on tin without anyone needing to know why the mine ran short
Modern drill: Internal corporate accounting: price internal services (data-API calls, compute) so departments self-provision like market participants, replacing administrative IT budget allocation

C-HAY-004E.title: F.A. Hayek's 'Competition-as-Discovery Method' applied today
C-HAY-004E.description:
US airline deregulation (1978): once the regulated era's 'known' fare and service structures were broken open, hub-and-spoke networks and low-cost models—unforeseen by anyone—were discovered by competition
Modern drill: Internal innovation racing: give the same problem to two or three teams; replace the assumption that the best solution is known with letting solutions discover each other, and add resources to winners

C-HAY-005E.title: F.A. Hayek's 'Division-of-Knowledge and Tradition-Evolution Test Method' applied today
C-HAY-005E.description:
Money as an evolved artifact: no government invented money; it emerged from millennia of exchange, and states merely took over an institution already there—leading Hayek to question the inevitability of monetary nationalism
Modern drill: Technology selection: before refactoring legacy systems, audit their survival history and incident record; require the new architecture to prove it can bear the same load and failure spectrum, not merely look trendier

C-HAY-006E.title: F.A. Hayek's 'Liberty-Based Institutional Baseline Method' applied today
C-HAY-006E.description:
The contrast of rule of law versus planning: a planning authority must treat particular persons and goals differently, clashing with law's generality; some welfare-state forms (uniform civil rights) are compatible with it, others (targeted favor) are not
Modern drill: Platform rule governance: for every new feature, draft a domain-of-action ledger—which user operations does it turn into platform approvals? Default to the option preserving user foreseeability

C-HAY-007E.title: F.A. Hayek's 'Fatal-Conceit Hypothesis Test Method' applied today
C-HAY-007E.description:
The bankruptcy of the 1970s inflation-unemployment trade-off: monetary authorities running Phillips-curve models promised inflation in exchange for jobs, and got stagflation—the model omitted expectations, which cannot be measured precisely
Modern drill: Strategic-planning audit: run an annual 'blind-spot inventory' of company KPIs—which critical realities (morale, brand damage, competitors' quiet moves) no metric covers

C-HAY-008E.title: F.A. Hayek's 'Competitive Currency Issuance Method' applied today
C-HAY-008E.description:
Denationalisation of Money (1976): Hayek traced chronic inflation to the undisciplined issuance monopoly—were HSBC and Lloyds each issuing money, over-issuers would be abandoned by users and money would face quality competition like any commodity
Modern drill: Internal tooling selection: for institution-goods monopolized by one vendor (identity, approval systems), design dual-supplier parallelism and data-portability clauses so switching cost disciplines the vendor

C-HAY-009E.title: F.A. Hayek's 'Scenario-Case Method from Situational Logic' applied today
C-HAY-009E.description:
Hayek's 1931 inaugural lecture on the Depression: the situation file—gold-standard constraint, central-bank knowledge (money stock controllable but mechanism unknown), political incentives (blame for deflation); his derivation 'loose money prolongs the slump' against Keynes's rival solution on the same file forms a textbook paired-derivation case
Modern drill: Business postmortem courses: turn major company decisions (market entry/exit, M&A) into situation-file cases; new managers derive inside the file before seeing outcomes

C-HAY-010E.title: F.A. Hayek's 'Late-System Layered Delivery Method' applied today
C-HAY-010E.description:
The spectral status of The Sensory Order: barely cited after 1952, yet Hayek said all his social theory was corollary of its theory of mind—kernel first, delivery may lag thirty years
Modern drill: Personal knowledge management: build a 'disciplinary projection map' for any 10-year-plus research question; before reading any field ask what it projects onto the question, to stop energy drift

C-SCH-001E.title: Joseph Schumpeter's 'Creative-Destruction Diagnosis Method' applied today
C-SCH-001E.description:
Railroads versus stagecoaches: the original 1942 case—the threat to a railroad company is not another railroad but the next transport innovation that makes 'railroad' as a combination itself obsolete
Modern drill: Corporate strategy: replace the 'twenty-year moat' narrative with a destruction-path inventory; audit each quarter which external new combination is most likely to make the core business obsolete

C-SCH-002E.title: Joseph Schumpeter's 'Entrepreneurial New-Combination Method' applied today
C-SCH-002E.description:
Xerox PARC and Apple: graphical interface, mouse, and Ethernet were all already present; Jobs's new combination re-arranged them into a sellable product—invention in the lab, innovation in the combination
Modern drill: Product innovation meetings: replace brainstorming with the five-type combination checklist, interrogating class by class what re-arrangements of existing factors are unrealized—seek new arrangements, not new ideas

C-SCH-003E.title: Joseph Schumpeter's 'Circular-Flow Breakthrough Method' applied today
C-SCH-003E.description:
The original 1911 contrast: a town economy producing and consuming in the same proportions year after year (circular flow), until one entrepreneur introduces the steam engine into weaving—profit is born in the breakthrough and evaporates back to zero as imitators flood in
Modern drill: Annual corporate audit: add a 'circular-flow test'—did core processes and product combinations undergo combinational change in the past three years; a run of noes is a red flag

C-SCH-004E.title: Joseph Schumpeter's 'Monopoly-Temporary-Rent Innovation Method' applied today
C-SCH-004E.description:
Bell Labs converting monopoly rent: AT&T's regulated monopoly profits funded the transistor, information theory, and satellite communication—the most famous instance of Schumpeter's 'big firms afford R&D' thesis
Modern drill: Antitrust reform debate: replace share thresholds with 'destroyability of position' as the core metric, distinguishing network-effect monopoly from exclusivity-agreement monopoly in platform economics

C-SCH-005E.title: Joseph Schumpeter's 'Three-Cycle Nesting Method' applied today
C-SCH-005E.description:
Schumpeter's 1939 synchronized reading: he interpreted the Great Depression as the superposed trough of three cycles—third long wave (steel/electricity) in decline, Juglar trough, and Kitchin trough arriving together, explaining the depression's abnormal depth
Modern drill: Portfolio construction: allocate assets in layers by long-wave exposure (technology-cluster themes), medium-wave exposure (capex sensitivity), and short-wave exposure (inventory sensitivity)

C-SCH-006E.title: Joseph Schumpeter's 'Capitalism-Legitimacy Audit Method' applied today
C-SCH-006E.description:
The original 1942 argument: after American corporations institutionalized R&D, 'progress' changed from personal achievement to brand narrative—Schumpeter predicted the separation of ownership and control would hollow out the system's political foundations
