Modern drill: Corporate reputation: upgrade the performance narrative ('jobs, taxes, technology we created') into a distribution narrative ('paths out for the losers and the transformed')

C-SCH-007E.title: Joseph Schumpeter's 'Elite-Competition Democracy Diagnosis Method' applied today
C-SCH-007E.description:
The counterpoint of the original 1942 definition: Schumpeter refuted the 'classical doctrine' (common good x popular will) point by point as inoperative in pluralist society—the common good is undefinable amid value disagreement, and the popular will unreliable because it can be manufactured
Modern drill: Regime risk assessment: replace binary democracy/autocracy labels with the four-condition checklist (entry/information/loser/term), producing structured democratic-deficit profiles

C-SCH-008E.title: Joseph Schumpeter's 'Innovation-Bureaucratization Threshold Method' applied today
C-SCH-008E.description:
DuPont and AT&T central labs: the historical verification of the 1942 thesis—institutionalized big-firm R&D did deliver nylon and the transistor (routinization's victory), yet also incubated creative flight (Xerox PARC enriched Apple, not Xerox)
Modern drill: Corporate innovation governance: map the innovation function annually and track the impact distribution, listing 'routinization threshold' as a board-level risk item

C-SCH-009E.title: Joseph Schumpeter's 'Civilizational-Stage Historiography Method' applied today
C-SCH-009E.description:
Schumpeter on classical economics: Ricardo's abstractive method explained as reflecting his era's social demand for certainty—a demonstration of stitching the history of analysis to social history
Modern drill: Academic introductions: begin any literature review with a 'social coordinates' section—what era-problem shaped the discipline's paradigm, and what its default premises are

C-SCH-010E.title: Joseph Schumpeter's 'Cross-Disciplinary Synthesis Delivery Method' applied today
C-SCH-010E.description:
The delivery structure of Capitalism, Socialism and Democracy: three parts (Marx's method / can capitalism survive / can socialism work / democracy and socialism) with a sociological thesis as spine, economic arguments as support, and the political-science definition as exit—one book as one polyhedron
Modern drill: Researchers' knowledge structure: compile a division-of-labor table for the core question and fill in each face's tools year by year (mathematics for the economics face, archives for the history face), following the table rather than drifting by interest

C-MON-001E.title: Montesquieu's 'Separation-of-Powers Checks Design Method' applied today
C-MON-001E.description:
The English constitution as exemplar: Montesquieu misread British practice (overestimating judicial independence and the degree of separation), yet his functional description of royal veto and parliamentary impeachment became the primal model of separation theory
Modern drill: Corporate governance: split board, management, and audit/supervision into three lines with cross-vetoes (independent-director nomination, audit reporting straight to the board) so a founder or CEO cannot occupy all three powers

C-MON-002E.title: Montesquieu's 'Typology-and-Principle Regime Method' applied today
C-MON-002E.description:
Montesquieu on Rome's fall: Considerations on the Romans attributed the Republic's expansion to the principle of virtue and diagnosed the collapse of civic equality through imperial growth as the first cause of its death—the principle was exhausted before the institutions collapsed
Modern drill: Organizational culture: distinguish the governance structure on paper (republic) from the actual driving force—founder's fear management or employees' mission; the target of culture audit is 'principle,' not 'structure'

C-MON-003E.title: Montesquieu's 'Spirit-of-the-Laws Situational Method' applied today
C-MON-003E.description:
His analysis of Roman land laws: the same statute had opposite effects in the early Republic and late Empire because the civic equality and smallholding structure sustaining it had vanished—the text unchanged, the relations changed
Modern drill: Cross-border institutional consulting: run a six-relation inventory on any 'successful foreign practice' before transplanting, to avoid copying an airport process into a Jakarta that breaks it

C-MON-004E.title: Montesquieu's 'Climate-and-Geography Variable Method' applied today
C-MON-004E.description:
His original 'servitude in the south, liberty in the north' claim: he partly attributed southern despotism to climate, yet in the same work argued China's institutional severity cannot all be charged to climate and that religion shapes India more than weather—he was himself bounding the variable
Modern drill: Location and industry analysis: when assessing regional economies, first list physical constraints (transport costs, endowments, climate hazards) and trace mechanisms, then weigh institutional variables—avoiding pure 'business-climate' narratives

C-MON-005E.title: Montesquieu's 'Defining-Liberty-by-Limits Method' applied today
C-MON-005E.description:
The definitional dispute of XI.3: Montesquieu directly rebuts Hobbes's definition of liberty as absence of impediments—if liberty were that, the subject stripped of legal protection would be most 'free,' which is plainly absurd
Modern drill: Platform rule design: open a community only after writing its boundaries (forbidden lists and appeal procedures); boundary changes without procedure destroy users' safety expectations more lethally than strictness

C-MON-006E.title: Montesquieu's 'Moderation-as-Measure Method' applied today
C-MON-006E.description:
His empirical argument on punishment: using cross-national experience he showed savage laws harden mores while mild and inevitable penalties deter better—an anticipation of the economics of crime forty years before Beccaria
Modern drill: Change management: for any reform, first draw the spectrum and measure the resistance interval, then design reversible staged rhythm—replace the 'direction debate' with a 'dosage audit'

C-MON-007E.title: Montesquieu's 'Doux-Commerce Method' applied today
C-MON-007E.description:
His account of the Goths ceasing to plunder Rome: he explained by commercial interest the barbarians' turn from raiding to settled rule—the yield of one plunder is below long-term taxation; calculation changed the conquerors themselves
Modern drill: International trade policy: treat 'interdependence lowers conflict' as a policy-evaluation variable while auditing its symmetry—asymmetric dependence becomes a coercive instrument

C-MON-008E.title: Montesquieu's 'Comparative-Historical Induction Method' applied today
C-MON-008E.description:
The methodological self-awareness of Considerations: he declares that it was not Roman virtue or vice that changed but civic equality—rewriting Rome's rise and fall from moral narrative into variable analysis, inaugurating the comparative method
Modern drill: Industry-decline research: decompose 'why an industry declined' into variables comparable across firms and countries (cost structure, regulatory exposure, technology dependence), never waving it away as 'corporate culture'

C-MON-009E.title: Montesquieu's 'Despotism Early-Warning Method' applied today
C-MON-009E.description:
His defense of the robe nobility and parlements: the parlements' registration right was a daily check on royal power; as president of the Bordeaux parlement he lived through Louis XV's repression of the courts—the dismantling began in his lifetime
Modern drill: Organizational early-warning dashboard: set 'buffer-structure health' metrics for firms and institutions (audit independence, employee representation, appeal channels) with event-timeline tracking

C-MON-010E.title: Montesquieu's 'Institution-Transplant Adaptation Test Method' applied today
C-MON-010E.description:
His restraint toward the English constitution: though The Spirit of the Laws takes England as the model of free government, he never urged France to copy it—France's principle is honor, not virtue, and its scale and stratification differ; copying means rejection
Modern drill: Multinational governance transplant: before moving headquarters systems into a new market, run requirements typing (local labor law, trust structures, execution costs) and land modules rather than switching wholesale

C-BEN-001E.title: Bentham's 'Felicific Calculus Method' applied today
C-BEN-001E.description:
The original 1789 application: Bentham audited the punishments of his day item by item—whether the incremental deterrence of hanging for theft outweighed its total pain—arithmetic foreshadowing the proportionality principle in criminal law
Modern drill: Policy evaluation: every proposal must carry a utility ledger—beneficiaries, losers, seven-dimension estimates, and weight assumptions; no principle-only submissions without accounts

C-BEN-002E.title: Bentham's 'Greatest-Happiness Principle Method' applied today
C-BEN-002E.description:
A Fragment on Government (1776): Bentham attacked Blackstone's 'antiquarian' defense of the English constitution with this principle—a constitution's legitimacy lies not in its age but in its net balance of happiness
Modern drill: Restructuring public debate: rewrite disputes from 'is this my right/tradition' to 'what happiness does it add or subtract, for whom'; parties refusing translation bear the burden of argument

C-BEN-003E.title: Bentham's 'Legislative-Utility Audit Method' applied today
C-BEN-003E.description:
Line-by-line audit of English criminal law: Bentham showed the deterrent yield of corporal punishment and transportation fell below their pain and opportunity cost, steering penal policy toward imprisonment and proportionality—a case of audit directly changing penal history
Modern drill: Regulatory impact assessment: new rules must carry the triple-cost settlement (enforcement, collateral, certainty); incomplete ones are returned to drafters

C-BEN-004E.title: Bentham's 'Four-Sanctions Diagnosis Method' applied today
C-BEN-004E.description:
The original 1789 analysis: Bentham explained why statutes against dueling failed—the political sanction was countervailed by the moral one (the refuser suffered reputational exile), so reform had to move the moral source first rather than pile on penalties
Modern drill: Policy instrument choice: for drunk-driving or anticorruption policy, attribute across four sources first—whether penalties alone suffice, and how reputation mechanisms pair with them

C-BEN-005E.title: Bentham's 'Panopticon Design Method' applied today
C-BEN-005E.description:
The original 1787 design: the circular prison Bentham proposed for London's Millbank—the building itself is the argument, 'the economy of inspection' written as a double yield, economic and moral
Modern drill: Organizational supervision: introduce visibility tooling in remote work together with an 'inspector visibility clause'—logs auditable by employee representatives

C-BEN-006E.title: Bentham's 'Pseudo-Concept Clearance and Question-Restatement Method' applied today
C-BEN-006E.description:
The 1791 critique of the French Declaration: clause-by-clause clearance of the inoperable formulations of 'rights,' arguing that absolutist rights language supplied the grammar of the Terror—an instance of conceptual clearance changing the mode of political critique
Modern drill: Audit of policy debate: run the translation test on 'national security,' 'public interest,' 'historical necessity'; those refusing translation bear the burden of argument

C-BEN-007E.title: Bentham's 'Fallacy-Exposure Method' applied today
C-BEN-007E.description:
The original 1824 campaign of The Book of Fallacies: naming one by one the antiquity-pleasing fallacies of parliamentary debate ('our ancestors did so,' 'this path is well trodden'), furnishing reformers with ready-made dissecting weapons
Modern drill: Team debate norms: maintain an internal fallacy catalogue (with cases and countermove formulas), allowing 'name-and-hold' interruptions in meetings to save discussion time

C-BEN-008E.title: Bentham's 'Pain-Minimization Penal Design Method' applied today
C-BEN-008E.description:
The original 1789 argument: the systematic clearance of capital punishment—unable to reform, replaceable by imprisonment for incapacitation, uncertain against violent crime yet costliest—hence to be abolished; Bentham's 1830s appeal to legislators everywhere institutionalized the method
Modern drill: Sentencing-guideline design: recompute sentencing bands by the full sequence—harm settlement, four-aim allocation, proportion rules—with deterrence evidence published per band

C-BEN-009E.title: Bentham's 'Panoptic Inventory and Reform-Map Method' applied today
C-BEN-009E.description:
The office inventory of the Constitutional Code: duties and accountability drafted post by post from supreme power down to junior clerks—the limit case of exhaustive institutional design
Modern drill: Organizational transformation: compile the all-element inventory (rules, processes, people, informal conventions) before scheduling reform, registering unlisted interest structures as explicit risks

C-BEN-010E.title: Bentham's 'Posthumous-Tracking Revision Method' applied today
C-BEN-010E.description:
The Constitutional Code published as written: volume one out in 1830 while volume two was still being revised—the original practice of publishing in expectation
Modern drill: Open-source and knowledge-base maintenance: run long-term projects with modular structure, maintainer mandates, and handover memos, never betting on a single maintainer

C-DAV-001E.title: Da Vinci's 'Cross-Domain Observation Transfer Method' applied today
C-DAV-001E.description:
Water vortices to air turbulence: in his flight studies he copied the observational format of his water research wholesale, drawing airflow around a bird's wing as flow around an obstruction in water—among the earliest systematic records of aerodynamic observation
Modern drill: Engineer to product manager, physician to data scientist: transfer not a skill checklist but the record format and question frame, run in three stages—common structure, boundary conditions, return verification

C-DAV-002E.title: Da Vinci's 'Anatomical Dissection and Layered-Exposition Method' applied today
C-DAV-002E.description:
The torso dissection sequence of the Windsor manuscripts: one trunk peeled from skin to spine, four views side by side—in his hand the grammar of the modern anatomical illustration takes shape
Modern drill: Technical writing: organize complex-system documents by decomposition axis + independent per-layer records + comparison figures; explanatory imagination pasted across layers is barred

C-DAV-003E.title: Da Vinci's 'Experience-as-Arbitress Verification Method' applied today
C-DAV-003E.description:
Beam-loading experiments: in his notebooks he tested beam strength by progressive loading and derived proportionality—an early foreshadowing of the mechanics of materials
Modern drill: Product decisions: every 'industry best practice' must first pass the test of your own data; authoritative case studies are not an evidence type

C-DAV-004E.title: Da Vinci's 'Nature-as-Master Bionic Design Method' applied today
C-DAV-004E.description:
The ornithopter: from watching crows and kites he extracted wing folding and beat rhythm, annotating the deformation requirements of wing membrane—bionic observation and mechanical drawing completed on one page
Modern drill: Robotics: extract force paths from octopus tentacles or primate fingers for grippers—the biological-prototype analysis page precedes the engineering page

C-DAV-005E.title: Da Vinci's 'Mirror-Written Experimental Notebook Method' applied today
C-DAV-005E.description:
Seven thousand pages of continuous record: from the 1490s to his death the same themes (water, flight, anatomy) recur across decades, deepening each time—the compound-interest sample of a long-term private system
Modern drill: Personal knowledge base: mixed image-text, frozen old pages, cross-references—a discipline against rewriting history for tidiness

C-DAV-006E.title: Da Vinci's 'Analogical-Bridge Inference Method' applied today
C-DAV-006E.description:
Systematic use of the water-air analogy: in the flight manuscripts he states 'the motion of air resembles the motion of water in like phenomena,' aligning density and velocity differences item by item—the model of analogical discipline
Modern drill: Cross-industry product innovation: map another industry's solution item by item through a correspondence table; verify isomorphism before launch

C-DAV-007E.title: Da Vinci's 'Quantified Observation of Light, Shadow and Perspective' applied today
C-DAV-007E.description:
The Last Supper and the Virgin of the Rocks: textbook application of the vanishing point and atmospheric perspective (the bluing of distant mountains)—quantified observation directly producing masterworks
Modern drill: Photography and film: exposure, color temperature, depth of field parameterized into checkable scales; aesthetic disputes become parameter discussions

C-DAV-008E.title: Da Vinci's 'Endless Curiosity Question-List Method' applied today
C-DAV-008E.description:
The question of the woodpecker's tongue: recorded and revisited decades later in the manuscripts—the true sample of a lifetime question list
Modern drill: Personal learning systems: maintain a question list rather than a book list, managing long-term questions on a revisit cadence

C-DAV-009E.title: Da Vinci's 'Unfinished-Work Continuous-Revision Method' applied today
C-DAV-009E.description:
The Adoration of the Magi: recomputation of the perspective scheme caused a long stall—the original sample of correctness at the price of the delivery date
Modern drill: Operating knowledge products: continuous revision after release with a public version history, refusing 'one-shot finality'

C-DAV-010E.title: Da Vinci's 'Art-Engineering Integrated Delivery Method' applied today
C-DAV-010E.description:
The Vitruvian Man: a geometric exposition of human proportion that is at once artistic image and metrological statement—the symbolic sample of integrated delivery
Modern drill: The design-engineer role: an organizational post holding aesthetic judgment and technical specification at once, with deliverables accepted on both faces

C-BAC-001E.title: Bach's 'Contrapuntal Constraint-Solving Method' applied today
C-BAC-001E.description:
The C-major fugue of WTC I (BWV 846): thirty-three measures in which every voice is independently singable and no rule is broken—the model of 'beauty of effortlessness' through total constraint satisfaction
Modern drill: Software design: make coding standards, performance budgets, and security boundaries explicit constraint lists; seek the most elegant implementation in solver mode rather than bypassing checks

C-BAC-002E.title: Bach's 'Single-Motive Generative Method' applied today
C-BAC-002E.description:
Musical Offering (BWV 1079): the six-note 'royal theme' given by Frederick the Great developed into a three-voice ricercar, a six-voice ricercar, ten canons, and a sonata—the historical limit case of single-material development
Modern drill: Product iteration: develop one core interaction (say, drag) exhaustively across all scenarios instead of piling on new features

C-BAC-003E.title: Bach's 'Tonal-Field Exhaustive Survey Method' applied today
C-BAC-003E.description:
The Well-Tempered Clavier's 48 pieces: complete enumeration of 24 keys × (prelude + fugue), hailed as the 'Old Testament' of music—the prototype of systematic creation
Modern drill: Knowledge-base building: template-based exhaustive coverage of the domain's parameter space (all scenarios, all edge cases), not just popular entries

C-BAC-004E.title: Bach's 'Chorale-Based Reconstructive Method' applied today
C-BAC-004E.description:
St Matthew Passion (BWV 244): the chorale 'O Haupt voll Blut und Wunden' appears five times with deepening harmonies—progressive re-illumination of one anchor
Modern drill: Brand refresh: keep the core identity (logo, slogan, values) fixed, redesign all surrounding context—old users recognize, new users find it new

C-BAC-005E.title: Bach's 'Works-as-Curriculum Method' applied today
C-BAC-005E.description:
The Inventions title page's complete pedagogy: from 'playing two parts cleanly' to 'a foretaste of composition'—a curriculum written in 1723 and still standard
Modern drill: Engineering onboarding: teach with real production code graded by complexity instead of toy examples—works as curriculum

C-BAC-006E.title: Bach's 'Liturgical-Cycle Pipeline Method' applied today
C-BAC-006E.description:
The first five Leipzig years: some two hundred cantatas, about one premiered per week—the historical sample of pipeline throughput
Modern drill: Content production: a fixed release cadence (weekly/biweekly) plus a material template library plus collaborative division of labor, replacing 'waiting for inspiration'

C-BAC-007E.title: Bach's 'Pilgrimage-and-Transcription Method' applied today
C-BAC-007E.description:
The Lübeck journey of 1705: 400 kilometers on foot to hear Buxtehude, four months overdue—the original sample of paying extreme cost for learning
Modern drill: Technical learning: transcribe core modules of excellent open-source projects by hand (not merely use them), forcing understanding of every design decision

C-BAC-008E.title: Bach's 'Answer-by-Work Dialogue Method' applied today
C-BAC-008E.description:
Potsdam, 1747: the royal theme improvised as a three-voice fugue on the spot, followed within two months by the complete Musical Offering (with a six-voice ricercar)—the historical sample of answering imperial challenge with work
Modern drill: Technical disputes: answer architecture criticism with a running open-source implementation instead of email-chain wars

C-BAC-009E.title: Bach's 'Proportional Pre-Design Method' applied today
C-BAC-009E.description:
The A-major fugue of WTC II: a basic 8+8 unit pattern individualized in two steps—a reconstructable case of proportional pre-design
Modern drill: Long-form writing: pre-assign paragraph budgets per section with reasoned offsets, auditing the length structure at the end

C-BAC-010E.title: Bach's 'Systematic Parody-Reuse Method' applied today
C-BAC-010E.description:
The B-minor Mass (BWV 232): cantata movements transplanted after text adaptation, most becoming the Mass's strongest pages—the settled verdict that parody can surpass its original
Modern drill: Software engineering: component and pattern inventories plus seam-customization rules—reuse the skeleton, customize the boundaries, audit the fit

C-PEI-001E.title: I.M. Pei's 'Geometric-Motif Unification Method' applied today
C-PEI-001E.description:
The East Building, National Gallery: one diagonal cut of a trapezoidal site, every element derived from the triangle—the most complete public specimen of the geometric-motif method
Modern drill: Product design: fix one scalable interaction motif (card, rounded rectangle) for a product family and reuse only its derivations across platforms

C-PEI-002E.title: I.M. Pei's 'Site-Constraint Translation Method' applied today
C-PEI-002E.description:
The Louvre underground: new above-ground construction forbidden by preservation, the main entrance and all services moved below, the pyramid the only permitted volume and the light well of the subterranean hall—the sample of a ban translated into form
Modern drill: Product development: treat platform limits (review rules, performance ceilings) as inputs for differentiated features, not as objects to circumvent

C-PEI-003E.title: I.M. Pei's 'Light-as-Space Method' applied today
C-PEI-003E.description:
The East Building atrium: full-length skylight over the triangular hall with Calder's suspended red metal leaves breaking the light again—the textbook site of light and geometry cooperating
Modern drill: Offices and retail: bring natural-light routing into the first round of layout (not the fit-out phase), using reflective surfaces to deepen experience

C-PEI-004E.title: I.M. Pei's 'Cultural-Genome Spatial Translation Method' applied today
C-PEI-004E.description:
The Suzhou Museum: geometric granite roofs, sliced-stone rockery, framed-view openings—the complete translation of garden grammar into modern materials, called by Pei 'my little daughter'
Modern drill: Brand localization: extract the target market's behavioral grammar (payment habits, social etiquette, information density) rather than pasting local symbols

C-PEI-005E.title: I.M. Pei's 'Evidence-First Client Persuasion Method' applied today
C-PEI-005E.description:
The Place de la Concorde model (1985): a full-scale mockup open to the public for weeks, 'smaller than imagined' becoming the headlines—one piece of evidence turning national opinion
Modern drill: Technical reviews: demo a running prototype to the fiercest opponent instead of debating slides

C-PEI-006E.title: I.M. Pei's 'Client-Problem Reframing Method' applied today
C-PEI-006E.description:
The Kennedy Library: 'build a library' reframed as 'house a national memory,' the scheme winning with a memorial sequence from dark to light—the most famous case of reframing winning the commission
Modern drill: Consulting and sales: work RFP requirements back to the true business question and win on a sharper problem definition

C-PEI-007E.title: I.M. Pei's 'Structural-Rationality Form Method' applied today
C-PEI-007E.description:
The Bank of China Tower: an X-braced system saving roughly forty percent of steel and becoming Asia's tallest landmark—structural rationality and landmark ambition in one body
Modern drill: Software architecture: design and expose the performance-critical path (caches, queues) rather than hiding it in a black box

C-PEI-008E.title: I.M. Pei's 'Sequenced-Narrative Circulation Method' applied today
C-PEI-008E.description:
The Miho Museum: the four-stage sequence of tunnel (170 m), bridge (120 m), gate, and sudden opening, each stage matching the Peach Blossom Spring—a historical-grade specimen of narrative circulation
Modern drill: Product onboarding: design the new-user journey as anticipation, first success, delight, review—controlling the rhythm of feature reveals

C-PEI-009E.title: I.M. Pei's 'Patient Controversy-Cultivation Method' applied today
C-PEI-009E.description:
The pyramid controversy (1983-1988): from ninety percent opposed to a national landmark in five years—the historical sample of running a value dispute on a yearly budget
Modern drill: Open source: for design disputes, answer not post by post but with an RFC document plus a long-available prototype cultivating consensus

C-PEI-010E.title: I.M. Pei's 'Cross-Continental Delivery Organization Method' applied today
C-PEI-010E.description:
The firm's 1960s peak: a dozen projects in Boston, New York, Dallas, Singapore, and Tehran at once—the throughput evidence of institutional delivery
Modern drill: Scaling design and consulting firms: gated phases plus local partner networks supporting cross-city parallel delivery, with the founder personally steering flagship projects

C-MIY-001E.title: Hayao Miyazaki's '['世界观先于情节法', 'Worldview-Before-Plot Method', '动画创作/叙事设计']' applied today
C-MIY-001E.description:
Nausicaa manga, vols. 1-2 (1982-1984): minimal plot density; every page builds the Sea of Corruption's ecology, the Valley's society, and the Ohmu's world rules—a self-consistent foundation for the epic plot of the later ten volumes
Modern drill: M-MIY-002

C-MIY-002E.title: Hayao Miyazaki's '['手绘滞空观察法', 'Hand-Drawn Sustained-Observation Method', '动画创作/观察方法']' applied today
C-MIY-002E.description:
My Neighbor Totoro (1988): crates of sketches of the mixed woods of Tokorozawa convert directly into the film's forest texture—camphor shrine and farm-path details all come from the field
Modern drill: UX research: replace report-reading with day-long on-site observation; encode findings by re-drawing/rebuilding the user journey by hand

C-MIY-003E.title: Hayao Miyazaki's '['飞行意象复用法', 'Recurring Flight-Imagery Method', '动画创作/母题设计']' applied today
C-MIY-003E.description:
Nausicaa (1984) glider: Nausicaa's flight is the will to engage and communicate—flying toward the Ohmu swarm is humble approach, not conquest
Modern drill: Brand metaphor systems: maintain a core image (e.g. 'tools for the mind') and vary its meaning across product generations rather than inventing new slogans

C-MIY-004E.title: Hayao Miyazaki's '['两难不加裁决法', 'Dilemma-Without-Adjudication Method', '动画创作/主题处理']' applied today
C-MIY-004E.description:
Princess Mononoke (1997): Tatara's compassion and the forest's victimhood both hold; Lady Eboshi is simultaneously destroyer of the forest and liberator of women and the sick—the audience is left inside the dilemma
Modern drill: Policy briefs: mandate steelmanned sections for each stakeholder; ban single-side recommendation language in deliberative documents

C-MIY-005E.title: Hayao Miyazaki's '['日常巨物并置法', 'Juxtaposition-of-the-Mundane-and-the-Colossal Method', '动画创作/场面调度']' applied today
C-MIY-005E.description:
Spirited Away (2001): the bathhouse is a real labor machine—shifts, rosters, bath tokens, the procedure for pulling a thorn from a river god; the spirit world gains all its credibility from the bathhouse's management logic
Modern drill: Worldbuilding for games and fiction: allocate explicit 'life systems' (meals, chores, routines) budgeted alongside plot content

C-MIY-006E.title: Hayao Miyazaki's '['配角生态厚描法', 'Thick-Portrait Ensemble Method', '动画创作/角色设计']' applied today
C-MIY-006E.description:
Spirited Away (2001): Kamaji's six arms and forty-year-old train tickets, Lin's tart tongue and soft heart, No-Face's devouring and quiet—every supporting character has a desire-history of their own
Modern drill: Game NPC design: give NPCs desires and schedules independent of the player, enabling a world that runs without the hero

C-MIY-007E.title: Hayao Miyazaki's '['手绘工期捍卫法', 'Hand-Crafted Schedule Defense Method', '动画创作/生产管理']' applied today
C-MIY-007E.description:
Princess Mononoke (1997): key sequences redrawn repeatedly to meet the quality bar; schedule and cost both overrun, making it the most expensive Japanese film of its time—the direct price of quality first
Modern drill: Software engineering: define-of-done includes quality gates; schedule back-planned around non-compressible review/test stages

C-MIY-008E.title: Hayao Miyazaki's '['儿童视角诚实法', 'Child-Perspective Honesty Method', '动画创作/受众设计']' applied today
C-MIY-008E.description:
My Neighbor Totoro (1988): the death-shade of the mother's long hospitalization is never stated, yet every child feels it—fear presented honestly without being consumed
Modern drill: Science communication for children: simplify without lying; keep uncertainty and mortality present at age-appropriate depth

C-MIY-009E.title: Hayao Miyazaki's '['退休宣言对赌法', 'Retirement-Threat as Driving Force Method', '动画创作/个人驱动']' applied today
C-MIY-009E.description:
After Princess Mononoke (1997): announced retirement; the epic was finished at 'last-work' density, and the return brought Spirited Away's peak
Modern drill: Career sprints: treat each project as possibly the last to force full-stake commitment, avoiding 'save it for later' dilution

C-MIY-010E.title: Hayao Miyazaki's '['工作坊空间共在法', 'Shared-Workshop Co-Location Method', '动画创作/团队组织']' applied today
C-MIY-010E.description:
Studio Ghibli: one big room, Miyazaki at the center, Suzuki at the entrance receiving guests and negotiating—the floor plan is the org chart
Modern drill: Startup war rooms: co-locate founders, engineers, and designers through critical build phases

C-LKY-001E.title: Lee Kuan Yew's '['行得通检验法', 'Does-It-Work Test Method', '政治治理/决策方法']' applied today
C-LKY-001E.description:
Jurong Industrial Estate (from 1961): no debate over whether foreign capital 'exploits' or 'feeds'; build the estate as a pilot, court the factories, and let employment and export data decide expansion—the hinge that turned an entrepot into a manufacturing and financial hub
Modern drill: Organizational strategy: pilot new businesses as minimum viable experiments with preset exit conditions; unit economics, not executive intuition, decides the scale-up

C-LKY-002E.title: Lee Kuan Yew's '['多元种族均势法', 'Plural-Race Equilibrium Method', '政治治理/社会整合']' applied today
C-LKY-002E.description:
After the 1964 race riots (four dead, dozens injured), Lee made 'race politics, never' the founding red line, written into constitutional and criminal practice
Modern drill: Plural organizations: replace inclusion slogans with structural mechanisms (cross-team rotation, mixed project pods) making cross-group contact the workflow default

C-LKY-003E.title: Lee Kuan Yew's '['超长期棋局法', 'Generational-Chessboard Method', '政治治理/战略规划']' applied today
C-LKY-003E.description:
The water chessboard: counting down the 1961/62 water agreements for decades, Singapore simultaneously built its reservoir system, NEWater (2003), and desalination—turning 'cut off the water' from a threat into a bargaining chip
Modern drill: Corporate strategy: separate slow variables (underlying demand, technology platforms) from fast ones (quarterly results); capital allocation protects the slow first

C-LKY-004E.title: Lee Kuan Yew's '['精英选拔养廉法', 'Meritocracy-with-Salary Method', '政治治理/人才制度']' applied today
C-LKY-004E.description:
The President's Scholarship system (from 1964): each year a handful of top students publicly enter the public-service track—Goh Chok Tong and Lee Hsien Loong both came through this funnel—binding 'politics' to 'destined talent' in public opinion
Modern drill: Corporate management-trainee design: a high-bar funnel plus cross-functional rotation plus dual-track promotion to grow whole-enterprise leaders, not department specialists

C-LKY-005E.title: Lee Kuan Yew's '['小国杠杆借力法', 'Small-State Leverage Method', '外交战略/地缘政治']' applied today
C-LKY-005E.description:
The 'poisonous shrimp' doctrine (1966): publicly concede inability to match neighbors, raise the cost of aggression with conscription and advanced equipment—while stating clearly this is only the deterrence floor
Modern drill: Startup survival: do not fight the big platform; become an irreplaceable node in its ecosystem (key component, data, compliance) so acquisition is worse than partnership

C-LKY-006E.title: Lee Kuan Yew's '['绝对条件坦白法', 'Hard-Truth Candor Method', 'Political Governance/Public Communication']' applied today
C-LKY-006E.description:
The separation broadcast of 9 August 1965: in tears, Lee announced expulsion from Malaysia and the next day explained to the nation 'we never asked for this independence' while laying bare the conditions of survival—founding the national narrative on truth, not myth
Modern drill: Crisis PR: disclose bad news and the response plan immediately and fully, making transparency itself a brand asset

C-LKY-007E.title: Lee Kuan Yew's '['先经济后政治法', 'Economics-Before-Politics Method', 'Political Governance/Reform Sequencing']' applied today
C-LKY-007E.description:
The 1960s-70s sequence: industrialization and universal housing first (employment and home-ownership soaring) while the space for opposition stayed low—the textbook execution of 'bread before ballots'
Modern drill: Transforming organizations: bank deliverable quick wins to earn the mandate for deep change; refuse radical restructuring on a trust deficit

C-LKY-008E.title: Lee Kuan Yew's '['制度信用工程法', 'Institutional-Credit Engineering Method', 'Political Governance/Institutional Design']' applied today
C-LKY-008E.description:
Judicial credit: decades of contract enforcement and investment protection made Singapore the world's preferred arbitration seat—international capital votes with its feet for the rule-of-law 'product'
Modern drill: Platform-developer relations: pledge multi-year API stability and deprecation notice periods, making predictability an ecosystem trust asset

C-LKY-009E.title: Lee Kuan Yew's '['对手意图读心法', 'Adversary-Intent Reading Method', 'Diplomacy/Game Analysis']' applied today
C-LKY-009E.description:
On China: Lee argued for decades that 'China wants to be a recognized great power again; it does not want war, but sovereignty and unification are non-negotiable'—derived from historical trauma rather than ideology, and borne out by events
Modern drill: Competitive intelligence: build rival dossiers of historical trauma plus organizational survival logic; predict behavior instead of paraphrasing PR

C-LKY-010E.title: Lee Kuan Yew's '['终身自我更新法', 'Lifelong-Self-Renewal Method', 'Cognition/Learning Method']' applied today
C-LKY-010E.description:
Decades of Mandarin: from the 1960s he kept studying Mandarin and Hokkien, still taking daily lessons in old age—modeling lifelong learning as a head of government and using the languages for constituency communication
Modern drill: Executive learning systems: calendarize weekly study blocks (papers, front-line visits) and keep a roster of younger experts to consult regularly

C-ATK-001E.title: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk's '['符号置换文明法', 'Symbol-Swap Civilization Method', '社会变革/文明转型']' applied today
C-ATK-001E.description:
The 1928 alphabet reform: Latin letters replaced Arabic script within months, literacy courses and night schools spread at scale, and Atatürk toured villages chalkboard in hand as 'head teacher'—one symbol swap rewrote the entire infrastructure of education and printing
Modern drill: Organizational change: land new values by starting with everyday symbols—badges, terminology, meeting rituals—so the new culture is rehearsed in daily acts

C-ATK-002E.title: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk's '['宗教去政治法', 'Religion-Out-of-Politics Method', '政治治理/政教关系']' applied today
C-ATK-002E.description:
Abolition of the caliphate, March 1924: the last caliph exiled, the centuries-old edifice of Ottoman church-state fusion demolished within weeks; religious courts and schools followed into the secular system
Modern drill: Organizational governance: separate personal faith from organizational decisions; handle value disputes with procedural justice, not position trials

C-ATK-003E.title: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk's '['军胜转政授权法', 'Victory-to-Mandate Method', '军事战略/政治转化']' applied today
C-ATK-003E.description:
The Erzurum Congress, July 1919: still an imperial general, Atatürk announced his resignation mid-congress and was elected chairman as 'representative of the nation'—the popular shell of the revolution took shape before the first bullet
Modern drill: Founders: convert each milestone at once into governance and board mandate rather than personal halo, banking institutional credit for the next round

C-ATK-004E.title: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk's '['残骸切分建国法', 'Nation-from-Wreckage Method', '政治治理/国家建构']' applied today
C-ATK-004E.description:
The National Pact, 1920: while the Ottoman parliament still sat, a six-point program openly declared that only land within its lines would be defended—imperial elites called it retreat, but it was the birth certificate of modern Turkey
Modern drill: Corporate strategy: admit the old business is dead, divest formally, and concentrate resources on the defensible core market

C-ATK-005E.title: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk's '['主权议会前置法', 'Assembly-First Sovereignty Method', '政治治理/建国程序']' applied today
C-ATK-005E.description:
Grand National Assembly opens, 23 April 1920: one month after the occupiers dissolved the Ottoman parliament, the Ankara Assembly declared itself the sole lawful power of the state—legitimacy transferred before weapons
Modern drill: Startup governance: charter the board and shareholder agreement before scaling outward, so later financing and decisions have a procedural vessel

C-ATK-006E.title: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk's '['Leverage-the-Pressure Negotiation Method', '外压内借谈判法', '外交战略/博弈谈判']' applied today
C-ATK-006E.description:
The Soviet-Turkish friendship treaty, 1921: mutual recognition and border settlement with Soviet Russia bankrupted the Anglo-French plan to isolate Ankara—one treaty serving simultaneously as military cover and bargaining chip
Modern drill: Deal negotiation: unbundle the contract into price, terms, duration, exclusivity, and give each side different consideration—preventing a buyer cartel

C-ATK-007E.title: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk's '['Head-Teacher Method', '教师元首法', '政治治理/公共沟通']' applied today
C-ATK-007E.description:
The alphabet tour, 1928-29: as 'head teacher' Atatürk taught at marketplaces in Seyhanır and Kastamonu chalkboard in hand; the photographs themselves mobilized the nation—the leader's teaching posture was the most powerful campaign
Modern drill: Founder preaching: for major transformations the CEO teaches the first class and closes the first demo deal—beyond the all-hands email

C-ATK-008E.title: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk's '['Six-Arrows Program Method', '六箭头纲领法', '政治治理/意识形态建构']' applied today
C-ATK-008E.description:
Six Arrows into the RPP program, 1931: republicanism, nationalism, populism, statism, secularism, reformism—one phrase each; the six-arrow emblem became the party's mark
Modern drill: Corporate values: compress operating philosophy into 3-6 recitable principles, stating the priority tensions among them instead of pretending no conflict

C-ATK-009E.title: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk's '['Off-Beat Reform Sequencing Method', '改革节奏错拍法', '政治治理/改革序列']' applied today
C-ATK-009E.description:
The dense phase 1924-26: caliphate, Hat Law, calendar, and civil code rolled out in sequence but at staggered peaks—after the 1925 order uprising was crushed, the civil code advanced immediately, keeping religious opposition facing two fronts
Modern drill: Organizational change: alternate high-conflict moves (layoffs, restructuring) with gain-giving ones (new benefits, new tools) so negative sentiment never compounds

C-ATK-010E.title: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk's '['Self-Spinning Institutions Method', '身后制度自转法', '政治治理/制度传承']' applied today
C-ATK-010E.description:
The Nutuk (1927): a thirty-six-hour speech completing the authoritative narrative of all decisions of 1919-27 and publishing it—the nation possessed its founding corpus while its founder lived
Modern drill: Founder exit design: write down key decisions and principles years ahead, rotate the number-two, and test the system's run without you

C-GUE-001E.title: Che Guevara's '['Foco Wildfire Method', 'Foco Wildfire Method', '军事战略/革命动员']' applied today
C-GUE-001E.description:
The Granma landing, 1956: 82 set out; barely a dozen held firm in the Sierra Maestra after landing—three years later that spark grew into an army of thousands that toppled Batista, the classic empirical vindication of foco theory
Modern drill: Lean startup: skip the three-year business plan; fight one ambush with a minimum viable product in the real market, and let user behavior—not survey reports—tell you whether conditions are ripe

C-GUE-002E.title: Che Guevara's '['New-Man Ethic Method', 'New-Man Ethic Method', '社会变革/价值塑造']' applied today
C-GUE-002E.description:
Institutionalizing voluntary labor (from 1961): Saturday cane-cutting and port loading made ministers and workers co-present in fixed practice—Guevara's proof that moral mobilization can run at national scale, though its efficiency debate never ended
Modern drill: Nonprofits and open source: sustain long-term volunteer contribution with attribution, honor tiers, and public thanks in place of money

C-GUE-003E.title: Che Guevara's '['Internationalist Expedition Method', 'Internationalist Expedition Method', '政治理念/跨境实践']' applied today
C-GUE-003E.description:
Guerrilla Warfare (1960) and Guerrilla Warfare: A Method (1963): publishing the Cuban experience as a manual with operational detail—open-sourcing the method—which directly seeded the birth (and death) of dozens of guerrilla fronts across Latin America and Africa
Modern drill: Open source software and open methodology: publish internal best practices with an 'applicability preconditions' and 'known failure modes' list

C-GUE-004E.title: Che Guevara's '['Medic-Revolutionary Fusion Method', 'Medic-Revolutionary Fusion Method', '个人品格/角色整合']' applied today
C-GUE-004E.description:
The 1952 motorcycle journey: crossing eight South American countries, serving patients with swimming therapy and care at San Pablo leprosarium—the travel diary became the factual dossier behind every later choice; by graduation in 1953 he was no longer the same doctor
Modern drill: Expert civic participation: physicians shaping health policy, teachers driving school reform, engineers in climate legislation—technical identity as the credit source of public argument

C-GUE-005E.title: Che Guevara's '['Elite Self-Liquidation Method', 'Elite Self-Liquidation Method', '个人品格/权力自律']' applied today
C-GUE-005E.description:
Refusing raises, freezing the family standard: as industries minister he took a civil-service-equal salary and kept household standards flat—self-audit via checkable pay slips, not moral slogans
Modern drill: Founders and executives: publish pay and interest registers, freeze personal treatment growth in office, make 'corporate interest apart from private interest' an auditable fact

C-GUE-006E.title: Che Guevara's '['Enemy-Leverage Method', 'Enemy-Leverage Method', '战略思维/以弱制强']' applied today
C-GUE-006E.description:
The Sierra Maestra pinning battle: a few hundred rebels dragged tens of thousands of government troops into mountain attrition; Batista's air raids on villages drove peasants up the mountain in batches—repression as mobilization demonstrated
Modern drill: Asymmetric business competition: the small firm avoids total war and strikes where the incumbent 'must defend everywhere' at cost—niche scenarios, compliance blind spots, service experience

C-GUE-007E.title: Che Guevara's '['Diary-as-Mirror Method', 'Diary-as-Mirror Method', '个人成长/自我审计']' applied today
C-GUE-007E.description:
The Motorcycle Diaries (1952): eight months rendered day by day, giving the young Guevara's transformation a fully traceable arc—the diary became the raw archive behind every later choice
Modern drill: Decision logs: record at decision time 'what we knew and why we chose this,' review six months later—keeping outcome bias from rewriting memory

C-GUE-008E.title: Che Guevara's '['Symbolic-Legacy Method', 'Symbolic-Legacy Method', '文化影响/符号政治']' applied today
C-GUE-008E.description:
The corpse-photo backfire (1967): the army's display meant to kill the myth instead manufactured a global martyr—the Passion-like visual structure doing the work—the landmark case of intent and effect diverging in communication history
Modern drill: Personal-brand endgame design: plan in advance the one photo, one sentence, one gesture you wish to be remembered by—and keep it visually minimal and replicable

C-GUE-009E.title: Che Guevara's '['Journey-Cognition Method', 'Journey-Cognition Method', '认知方法/经验获取']' applied today
C-GUE-009E.description:
The 1952 motorcycle journey: eight months from Buenos Aires toward Miami; Chilean miners, Peruvian leprosy patients, and Colombia's civil war along the way formed the experiential bedrock of his conviction that 'Latin America is one'
Modern drill: Product research: before entering a new market, live in the target region for weeks as an ordinary user (local income, local commute)—a small sample that hits structural reality directly

C-GUE-010E.title: Che Guevara's '['Ideal-to-Endgame Method', 'Ideal-to-Endgame Method', '个人品格/终局抉择']' applied today
C-GUE-010E.description:
The 1965 departure: resigning the industries ministry, renouncing Cuban citizenship, a farewell letter to Castro making the break public—choosing at the peak of prestige to become a nameless soldier again
Modern drill: Founder decisions: facing a rich acquisition against mission continuity, take 'will the mission be alive in ten years' as the sole standard and accept the short-term loss

C-NKR-001E.title: Kwame Nkrumah's '['Political-Kingdom-First Method', 'Political-Kingdom-First Method', '政治战略/独立时序']' applied today
C-NKR-001E.description:
Founding the CPP in 1949 and rejecting the Coussey constitution's consultative path: while the 'scholars' (UGCC) sought advisory constitutional reform, Nkrumah mobilized the masses directly under the slogan 'Self-Government Now'—the sequencing dispute was settled within two years
Modern drill: Organizational change: a new leadership first captures budget and hiring decision rights before rolling out plans, rather than lobbying endlessly inside the old power structure—leverage points over persuasion headcounts

C-NKR-002E.title: Kwame Nkrumah's '['Positive-Action Forging Method', 'Positive-Action Forging Method', '政治战略/非暴力动员']' applied today
C-NKR-002E.description:
The founding of the CPP and the organizational stockpile, 1949: within a year a nationwide branch network (youth wing, women's organizations, village committees) was built, so the 1950 call could ignite the major towns simultaneously—organization first as the precondition of Positive Action
Modern drill: Labor and collective bargaining: design warning strikes, rotating slowdowns, and general strikes as a graded ladder, each rung mapped to specific clauses at the bargaining table

C-NKR-003E.title: Kwame Nkrumah's '['Neocolonialism-Diagnosis Method', 'Neocolonialism-Diagnosis Method', '政治经济/结构分析']' applied today
C-NKR-003E.description:
Writing Neocolonialism (1965): systematically listing data on foreign aid, garrisons, and corporate concessions across forty-plus newly independent states—foreshadowing dependency theory and critiques of development economics—an audit of dependence conducted amid independence celebrations
Modern drill: National and regional industrial policy: run a neocolonialism-style audit of critical dependencies (chips, energy, payment systems), quantify 'supply-cutoff tolerance,' and invest in alternative pipelines

C-NKR-004E.title: Kwame Nkrumah's '['Consciencism-Synthesis Method', 'Consciencism-Synthesis Method', '哲学思想/文明综合']' applied today
C-NKR-004E.description:
Writing Consciencism (1964): arguing through the history of philosophy for an African materialist lineage (from ancient Egyptian thought to communal ethics) and proposing 'philosophy as society's compass'—a sitting head of state producing a systematic philosophical work, rare among twentieth-century politicians
Modern drill: Grounding organizational values: distill the axis from the founders' lived experience before absorbing industry best practice, rather than stitching together fashionable slogans

C-NKR-005E.title: Kwame Nkrumah's '['Political-Kingdom-First Method', 'Political-Kingdom-First Method', '政治战略/权力路径']' applied today
C-NKR-005E.description:
The split after the 1948 Accra riots: the older nationalists favored petitioning and constitutional gradualism; Nkrumah judged the riots as proof that the masses were ready and only organization was missing—the next year he founded the CPP, channeling street energy into a party
Modern drill: Latecomer competition: when market and technology are both weak, concentrate first on contesting rule-making power—standards, agendas, platform governance—and leave resource questions to the leverage that follows

C-NKR-006E.title: Kwame Nkrumah's '['Neo-Colonialism Diagnosis Method', 'Neo-Colonialism Diagnosis Method', '政治分析/结构批判']' applied today
C-NKR-006E.description:
The Akosombo Dam and the Volta Aluminium Company: Nkrumah pushed industrialization through an integrated bauxite-power scheme, yet power pricing, bauxite processing, and sales remained constrained by the international aluminium majors and external financing conditions—his own later exhibit for 'a national dam does not mean a national economy'
Modern drill: Corporate dependence audit: build a 'sovereignty misalignment map' for businesses acquired, platformized, or locked to a single customer, marking where channels, pricing, and standards remain in others' hands

C-NKR-007E.title: Kwame Nkrumah's '['Consciencist Synthesis Method', 'Consciencist Synthesis Method', '哲学方法/文明综合']' applied today
C-NKR-007E.description:
Writing and lecturing Consciencism (1964): he gave lectures in Ghana and refined the manuscript with young researchers, arguing from Egyptian intellectual history to contemporary ideology—building a head of state's program on the history of philosophy
Modern drill: Integrating organizational values: in mergers or cross-cultural teams, inventory each side's real traditions, then set one shared core value as arbiter—written as a teachable text, not a slogan wall

C-NKR-008E.title: Kwame Nkrumah's '['Consciencist Synthesis Method', 'Consciencist Synthesis Method', '哲学建构/文化整合']' applied today
C-NKR-008E.description:
Writing Consciencism (1964): chapter-by-chapter deduction from the maxims of ancient Egyptian Imhotep to Marx's materialism, with speeches on philosophy and liberation appended—the first systematic African philosophy built by a sitting head of state
Modern drill: Methodological autonomy for latecomer organizations: do not transplant Silicon Valley's or Huawei's system wholesale; rebuild the method's genealogy from your own industry and organizational history, then absorb external skeleton

C-NKR-009E.title: Kwame Nkrumah's '['Neo-Colonialism Diagnosis Method', 'Neo-Colonialism Diagnosis Method', '政治经济分析/结构透视']' applied today
C-NKR-009E.description:
Neo-Colonialism (1965) dissects dozens of cases country by country—the Congo (the Leopoldian legacy and Lumumba's murder), Ghana's cocoa trade, Rhodesia's constitutional fraud—turning 'structure' into a checkable chain of evidence; the book at once became the theoretical banner of his exile
Modern drill: Corporate supply-chain audit: draw an annual ledger of 'who can choke us at which link' (cloud, payments, chips, channels) and pre-build alternatives for the largest single points

C-NKR-010E.title: Kwame Nkrumah's '['Unbroken Voice-in-Exile Method', 'Unbroken Voice-in-Exile Method', '个人品格/逆境坚持']' applied today
C-NKR-010E.description:
The Conakry study (1966-72): in the villa granted by Guinea he wrote and received delegations daily, completing Consciencism: a reconstruction and multiple manuscripts—six years of exile were among his most productive
Modern drill: Ousted or departing leaders: within 48 hours publish a text of 'what I still believe and will keep doing,' sustaining credibility through continuous output, not silence

C-SC-001E.title: Schrödinger's 'Optico-Mechanical Analogy Transplant Method' applied today
C-SC-001E.description:
The core argument of the first wave-mechanics paper: the discrete energy levels of hydrogen are not postulated but eigenvalues of a boundary-value problem—integers 'appear naturally' like overtones of a vibrating string, and the old quantum conditions are wholly replaced by derivation
Modern drill: Algorithm engineering: when your field survives on ad hoc patches, find a mathematically isomorphic mature field (e.g., porting cybernetics into machine learning) and borrow the whole structure, not fragments

C-SC-002E.title: Schrödinger's 'Eigenvalue Reformulation of Quantization Method' applied today
C-SC-002E.description:
The hydrogen atom reframed: the same observed spectra, verification of a decree in the old theory, become solutions of a boundary-value problem in the wave equation—the data unchanged, the problem statement changed, the explanatory status inverted
Modern drill: Engineering decisions: reframe 'must-comply decrees' as the natural optimum of a cost function under constraints, turning rules from bolt-ons into derivables

C-SC-003E.title: Schrödinger's 'Continuous Wave-Description Commitment Method' applied today
C-SC-003E.description:
The Copenhagen debate: Bohr pressed him to accept 'jumps are unanalyzable'; Schrödinger parried with 'I can solve my equations and draw my pictures'—he lost the debate, but wave mechanics' usability was thereby established
Modern drill: Technology selection wars: argue from 'the team can understand and debug it' for the intuitive option even when the abstract one looks better on paper—winning the working language outlasts winning the paper

C-SC-004E.title: Schrödinger's 'Cat-Thought-Experiment Method' applied today
C-SC-004E.description:
The cat's immediate context is the 1935 EPR puzzle and his dissatisfaction with Copenhagen's 'wavefunction = knowledge' stance—it is the publicizing of his correspondence with Einstein, not an isolated whim
Modern drill: Algorithm ethics: design amplifier cases for the convention that 'probability outputs do not affect real people' (binding probabilities to real names), making the ethical vagueness unignorable

C-SC-005E.title: Schrödinger's 'Principled-Dissent-Against-Orthodoxy Method' applied today
C-SC-005E.description:
The 1935 'Present Situation' wrote his dissent from Copenhagen into four systematic papers—while Einstein's EPR attacked as a puzzle, Schrödinger inventoried as an engineer; the two were complementary
Modern drill: Technical standards wars: after consensus forms, keep maintaining the minority option through serialized technical documents, writing dissent as benchmarks and cases posterity can test—awaiting the next paradigm window

C-SC-006E.title: Schrödinger's 'Cross-Domain Predictive Question Method (What Is Life?)' applied today
C-SC-006E.description:
The 'aperiodic crystal' prediction: a decade before the double helix, he deduced that the hereditary carrier must be a non-periodic solid both stable and information-rich—the 1953 structure was the physical realization of this deduction
Modern drill: Entering a new field: don't start from zero with industry conventions; inventory the field's 'should not be so' list with your original discipline's tools, and write constraint-based predictive analyses

C-SC-007E.title: Schrödinger's 'Aesthetic-Criterion Theory-Choice Method' applied today
C-SC-007E.description:
He re-solved the Stark and Zeeman effects—cases the old quantum theory barely managed—with wave mechanics: the 'computability' criterion cashed out, not just declared
Modern drill: Tech-selection documents: when options are performance-indistinguishable, declare the criterion publicly (maintainability, teachability) and cash it out by solving a previously intractable real problem

C-SC-008E.title: Schrödinger's 'Equivalence-Proof Debate-Resolution Method' applied today
C-SC-008E.description:
The direct effect of the equivalence paper: Born confirmed in subsequent correspondence that the two mechanics were 'really one theory'—the schism of quantum mechanics was healed in the bud
Modern drill: Framework wars (frontend, databases, languages): run equivalence benchmarks first, prove operational equivalence, and compress the dispute to engineering preference

C-SC-009E.title: Schrödinger's 'East-West Convergence Method' applied today
C-SC-009E.description:
The core argument of Mind and Matter: from the physical fact that 'the world appears but once in consciousness' (observer uniqueness) to the singularity of consciousness, then the observation that Vedanta independently restated the same structure two millennia earlier as 'Atman is Brahman'
Modern drill: Methodology assessment: run a cross-industry search for independent restatements of a new methodology (has the isomorphic practice appeared separately in mutually unaware organizations?); convergence is confidence

C-SC-010E.title: Schrödinger's 'Public-Responsibility Science-Writing Method' applied today
C-SC-010E.description:
What Is Life?, in under a hundred thousand words, changed three careers (Watson, Crick, Wilkins all credited it)—the leverage of public writing exceeds the paper's: papers persuade peers, booklets change a discipline's demographics
Modern drill: Team public writing: turn major technical decisions (architecture, algorithm ethics) into jargon-free public documents delivered for external deliberation and peer review

C-LIB-001E.title: Li Bai's 'Roc Self-Positioning Method' applied today
C-LIB-001E.description:
'To Li Yong': cold-shouldered by the grandee on a courtesy call, the young Li Bai neither argued nor flattered but replied with the roc poem—raising the scale at the very site of rejection so the slighter looked small and he did not look abject
Modern drill: Personal brand: stop competing on resume keywords; define a category only you occupy ('the one who does X to the level of poetry'), leaving comparison without an object

C-LIB-002E.title: Li Bai's 'Genius-Narrative Behind Method' applied today
C-LIB-002E.description:
Ten years on Mount Kuang: ages fifteen to twenty-five of systematic study and sword practice in Shu—the inventory behind every later improvisation; he never showed those years to anyone, yet every poem carries them
Modern drill: Knowledge workers: show judgment and insight in public; keep a fixed daily slot of deliberate practice in private (tearing down exemplars, patching weak spots)—neither ledger lapses

C-LIB-003E.title: Li Bai's 'Wandering-as-Cognition Method' applied today
C-LIB-003E.description:
Leaving Shu (725): at twenty-five he 'left with his sword,' through the Three Gorges, Jiangling, Dongting to Jinling and Yangzhou, scattering three hundred thousand in gold within a year—roaming doubling as fame-investment and chivalric relief; the first network was woven here
Modern drill: Product and market research: before entering a new market, live in the target region for weeks as an ordinary user—a small sample that hits structural reality directly

C-LIB-004E.title: Li Bai's 'Paired-Wings Method' applied today
C-LIB-004E.description:
Three years as Hanlin attendant (742-744): the advancing wing fully deployed; yet at the first signs of lost favor he accepted dismissal with gold without futile clinging—the exit clause executed
Modern drill: Portfolio careers: advance in the main line while maintaining a second identity (advisory, writing, investing) as the landing point after exit, avoiding single-point dependence

C-LIB-005E.title: Li Bai's 'Drunkenness-as-Switch Method' applied today
C-LIB-005E.description:
'Bring in the Wine': the whole poem runs on drunk logic ('slaughter the lamb, butcher the ox, let us be merry' down to 'together we will melt the sorrow of ten thousand ages'), hyperbole and self-statement entirely free of ritual measure—the complete work-level sample of intoxicated amnesty
Modern drill: Creative process design: split 'generation' and 'critique' into explicit phases (diverge first, converge second) and give the generating phase a ritualized safe environment

C-LIB-006E.title: Li Bai's 'Moon-as-Fixed-Point Method' applied today
C-LIB-006E.description:
'Drinking Alone under the Moon': with no one to keep him company in Chang'an, he drafts moon and shadow into a drinking party of three—the anchor as full social substitute: loneliness converted into an aesthetic event instead of pain
Modern drill: Personal ritual: establish one daily constant requiring no institutional or other-person permission (morning run, meditation, writing) as the meaning floor of career turbulence

C-LIB-007E.title: Li Bai's 'Hyperbole-as-Epistemology Method' applied today
C-LIB-007E.description:
'Song of Qiupu': the absurd size of 'thirty thousand zhang of white hair' is anchored by the true cause 'because sorrow is just this long'—single-dimension hyperbole plus structural truth, the textbook move that makes absurdity credible
Modern drill: Public expression: in speeches and writing reserve the strongest language for the most important facts and stay restrained otherwise—the audience's 'hyperbole trust' sets how much weight your words carry at the key moment

C-LIB-008E.title: Li Bai's 'Chivalric-Generosity Networking Method' applied today
C-LIB-008E.description:
Scattering gold at Weiyang (726): over three hundred thousand within a year for ruined gentlemen, later cited in the letter to Pei as character credential—one act of generosity completing the three-stage conversion 'aided → story spread → job credential'
Modern drill: Early career: tilt disposable resources (time, money, skill) toward 'people worth helping who will grow'; a decade later those aided nodes form the deepest moat

C-LIB-009E.title: Li Bai's 'Banished-Immortal Persona Method' applied today
C-LIB-009E.description:
He Zhizhang trading his golden turtle for wine: the supreme endorsement of the right first meeting in Chang'an; he immortalized the moment at once in 'Remembering He the Supervisor over Wine'—the third-party title staked into the work without delay
Modern drill: Personal IP: seize the strongest third-party label (award, title, verdict), stake it immediately as self-positioning, and keep redeeming it with subsequent conduct

C-LIB-010E.title: Li Bai's 'Poeticizing-the-Endgame Method' applied today
C-LIB-010E.description:
'Setting Out Early from Baidi' (759): pardoned mid-exile, at fifty-nine he wrote the greatest turning of his life as one minute of a light boat—the sample of highest finish at the strait's exit; in twenty-eight characters not one says joy, yet all is ecstasy
Modern drill: Career straits: after being laid off, losing a suit, or failing, the first priority is not the appeal but finishing the narrative—write the experience into a postmortem, essay, or work, self-defining before others define you

C-DF-001E.title: Du Fu's 'Brooding-Cadence Method' applied today
C-DF-001E.description:
'Spring View': the nation's vast grief pressed into the personal detail 'white hairs, scratched shorter, scarce holding a hairpin'—state tragedy transmitted through the weight of one hairpin, heavier than any wailing
Modern drill: Public writing and speaking: put the strongest judgment in the calmest sentence—say with a declarative what others say with exclamation marks, and attention flows to the restrained

C-DF-002E.title: Du Fu's 'Poetry-as-History Method' applied today
C-DF-002E.description:
'Mourning Chentao' (756): the rout of government forces at Chentao; Du Fu, inside occupied territory, wrote the battle and the people's grief ('the city's people turn their faces north and weep') on the spot—where histories are thin, the poem stands as first-hand archive
Modern drill: Industry observation: keep weekly first-hand records (prices, policies, competitor moves) through an industry's upheaval; years later your notes are the era's most reliable market history

C-DF-003E.title: Du Fu's 'Small-Scale-Epic Method' applied today
C-DF-003E.description:
'The Officer at Shihao': not one authorial comment in the whole poem; the old woman's address forms its body—'the living steal a little life; the dead are gone for good'—the age's violence completing its whole indictment through one crone's testimony
Modern drill: Cause and policy communication: cite no percentages; tell the story of one person concretely changed by the institution, then assemble several into a cross-section—single stories penetrate, series prove

C-DF-004E.title: Du Fu's 'Freedom-Within-Form Method' applied today
C-DF-004E.description:
'Climbing High': every line parallel (self-parallelism within the opening couplet, craft throughout)—the strictest execution of the form and the strongest expression ('leaves without bound come sifting down') achieved together, proving constraint and freedom no opposites
Modern drill: Design systems: enforce the spec strictly (spacing, type scale, palette) and exhaust its combinations rather than route around it—the top designer's freedom comes from internalized spec

C-DF-005E.title: Du Fu's 'Ten-Thousand-Refinements Method' applied today
C-DF-005E.description:
The density of 'Climbing High': eight lines, four couplets, not one idle character, meter at maximum craft yet breath unimpeded—such finish can come only from repeated smelting, never from one bolt of inspiration
Modern drill: Writers: force a two-phase flow on everything public—capture in one pass without looking back; smelt at least three rounds (structure / sentence / read-aloud) with a round cap to ward off bitter-chanting

C-DF-006E.title: Du Fu's 'Never-Absent-Presence Method' applied today
C-DF-006E.description:
Occupation and flight (756-759): from 'Spring View' to the 'Three Officers' and 'Three Partings,' the three most perilous years of his life were the three densest of record—presence intensity inversely proportional to personal safety
Modern drill: Career: design presence in an industry on a decade scale (regular published observation, maintained relationships), not on raise-and-switch cadence—the presence premium peaks in year ten

C-DF-007E.title: Du Fu's 'Parallel-Structure Thinking Method' applied today
C-DF-007E.description:
The third couplet of 'Climbing High': 'ten thousand li of sorrowing autumn, ever a sojourner; a hundred years of illness, alone I climb the terrace'—Song critic Luo Dajing counted eight layers of grief (distance, season, exile, its permanence, a century, illness, the climb, its solitude); one parallel unit pressing five axes together, the limit sample of two-axis density
Modern drill: Decision analysis: force a counter-axis for every major judgment (benefit/cost, short/long, us/them); single-axis reports do not pass

C-DF-008E.title: Du Fu's 'Preworry-Positioning Method' applied today
C-DF-008E.description:
'Ballad of the Army Carts' (751): with expansionist war national policy and 'the desire to open the borders not yet sated' the nationwide mood, he wrote the cost of conscription—four years later the war drums of Yuyang shook the earth
Modern drill: Organizational risk: in good years, keep a fixed budget for red-team drills and bad-scenario exercises—switching off the risk function is itself the greatest risk

C-DF-009E.title: Du Fu's 'Synthesizer-of-Lineage Method' applied today
C-DF-009E.description:
The 'Six Quatrains': against the early-high Tang fashion of demeaning the Six Dynasties, he publicly defended Yu Xin and the four early-Tang masters ('Yu Xin's writing grows finer with age'; 'your sort perish with your names; the rivers flow on, ten thousand ages, none the less')—the lineage stance itself is the methodological manifesto
Modern drill: Technical research: on entering a field, first write a complete lineage review (who did what, where the limits lie) and explicitly position your work as a synthesis of which traditions

C-DF-010E.title: Du Fu's 'Undying-Resolve-Endgame Method' applied today
C-DF-010E.description:
'Climbing High' (767): fifty-six, poor and ill, newly off wine—yet the finest of all seven-character regulated verse; old-age sickness not avoided but written in ('a hundred years of illness, alone I climb the terrace'), decay incorporated as structure
Modern drill: Late career: design the retirement window by 'final season' standards (advisory, writing, transmission), adjudicating exit by output cadence rather than age

C-SU-001E.title: Su Shi's 'Form-Follows-the-Material Method' applied today
C-SU-001E.description:
One night's outing, three landings: the micro-essay 'Night Excursion to Chengtian Temple' closes at eighty-four characters, 'Water Melodeon: When Will the Moon Be Clear' becomes a lyric, 'Former Rhapsody on the Red Cliff' becomes an eofu—the material's momentum decides the genre, not the reverse
Modern drill: Product and content: format decided by information mass—an idea worth a tweet is not stretched into an essay; one worth an essay is not compressed into a tweet

C-SU-002E.title: Su Shi's 'Self-Deprecation-Dissolve Method' applied today
C-SU-002E.description:
'Arriving in Huangzhou': the first poem at the exile post after near-execution is no grievance but 'the River rings the walls—I know the fish are fine; good bamboo up the hills—I smell the shoots'—a brush with death rewritten as a gourmet's delight
Modern drill: Public postmortems: open the incident report with proactive self-mockery ('this was our dumbest moment'), converting critics into co-improvers

C-SU-003E.title: Su Shi's 'Peace-of-Mind-Is-Home Method' applied today
C-SU-003E.description:
Opening the Eastern Slope at Huangzhou (1081): salary gone, he petitioned for abandoned garrison land and farmed it himself—right of residence confiscated, productive capacity carried along
Modern drill: Relocation and expatriate posts: before departure compile a checklist of core life moves restorable within two weeks and execute in the first week on the ground—compressing 'settling-in' from months to a fortnight

C-SU-004E.title: Su Shi's 'Universalizing-Transposition Method' applied today
C-SU-004E.description:
'Water Melodeon' (1076): intimacy with a brother written into the thousand-year common text of 'such things have never been perfect'—after upscaling, the case becomes humanity's shared consolation resource
Modern drill: Consolation and psychosocial support: fully listen to the case (receive), then introduce 'many have passed through this' classing (upscale), then return to concrete companionship (close)—strictly in that order

C-SU-005E.title: Su Shi's 'Lushan-Angle-Shifting Method' applied today
C-SU-005E.description:
'Inscribed on the Wall of West Forest Temple' (1084): visiting Mount Lu he writes not scenery but epistemology—four lines completing the chain 'many angles - no privileged angle - inside distortion - attribution of distortion'
Modern drill: Product and user research: no requirement ships until two orthogonal pairs (engineer/user, new/old user) of perspective shifts are complete

C-SU-006E.title: Su Shi's 'Change-and-Changelessness Ledger Method' applied today
C-SU-006E.description:
'Former Rhapsody on the Red Cliff' (1082): the guest's (the author's) anxiety at impermanence liquidated item by item by the double ledger on an autumn night at the Huangzhou exile—the most famous double-entry bookkeeping at the existential layer in Chinese literature
Modern drill: Investing and finance: book 'volatility' and 'loss' separately—market swings of liquid assets enter the change ledger, long-held compounding the unchanging ledger; prevents emotional selling

C-SU-007E.title: Su Shi's 'Eight-Flank-Attack Reading Method' applied today
C-SU-007E.description:
Multi-round assault on the 'Book of Han': he advised Wang Xiang to read it 'coming again and again, each visit seeking one thing'—governance, figures, offices, artifacts each get their round; Song scholars canonized the method (Zhu Xi praised it often)
Modern drill: Professional depth: run round-by-round single-question close reading of your field's classics (textbooks, primary papers, case sets); reject check-in-style 'finished in one pass' reading

C-SU-008E.title: Su Shi's 'Cross-Domain-Generalist Method' applied today
C-SU-008E.description:
The Su Causeway (governor of Hangzhou, 1089-1091): a complete engineering loop—surveyed silt, fenced-field calculation, dredged mud used to build the causeway—the literatus controlling water, not merely commenting on it
Modern drill: Portfolio careers: beside the main line, pick two fields 'enterable as serious projects' (say writing + coding), accepting only finished works, not certificates

C-SU-009E.title: Su Shi's 'Joy-Forging-in-Bitterness Method' applied today
C-SU-009E.description:
The Huangzhou cuisine project (1080-1084): pork heat-control, brewing, fish soup—the golden age of Chinese culinary letters arrived exactly in his political trough
Modern drill: High-pressure career cycles: in the bitterest three months of a project, charter micro-joys proactively (a weekly team feast, one ritual milestone); the joy line runs parallel to the delivery line

C-SU-010E.title: Su Shi's 'Suspension-and-Cross-Verification Method' applied today
C-SU-010E.description:
'A Record of Stone Bell Mountain': mooring at night beneath the cliff to test the water-sound and stone apertures himself, obtaining a third explanation and declaring what he saw might still not be the whole—a complete scientific-experiment narrative rare in the history of Chinese letters
Modern drill: Research and investment due diligence: register all industry reports and expert views as hypotheses; before any pivotal decision complete at least one firsthand check (customer interviews, site visits, recomputation)

C-WW-001E.title: Wang Wei's 'Empty-Scene-Negative-Space Method' applied today
C-WW-001E.description:
'Deer Enclosure': the whole poem holds one positive datum (echoes of voices) and one negative (no one seen); twenty characters, and a thousand years of readers have each grown their own countless empty mountains
Modern drill: Product design: leave deliberately unfinished spaces (custom fields, open interfaces) and let users write themselves into the product

C-WW-002E.title: Wang Wei's 'Object-Self-Dissolution Contemplation Method' applied today
C-WW-002E.description:
'Magnolia Bank': the whole cycle of bloom and fall without one subjective line—later ages read it as the 'last word of Chan poetry'; the contemplation itself becomes practice
Modern drill: User research: when observing product use, suspend the 'they should use it this way' preset; record the user's actual rhythm, not the expected one

C-WW-003E.title: Wang Wei's 'Parallelism-as-Composition Method' applied today
C-WW-003E.description:
'On Mission to the Frontier': 'a lone smoke rises straight... the setting sun rounds'—generations of painting theory have called it 'an unrepeatable composition'; ten characters are at once a framing plan for a panoramic frontier scene
Modern drill: Slide design: fix each page's visual counterpoint first (one-image-one-text balance, one horizontal one vertical), then fill in words

C-WW-004E.title: Wang Wei's 'Dual-Track-of-Office-and-Reclusion Method' applied today
C-WW-004E.description:
Operating the Wangchuan estate: he bought Song Zhiwen's old property and converted it into a production base for poetry and painting—space bought with official salary directly became a creative asset
Modern drill: Career design: the main job supplies cash flow and network; the side practice supplies the core asset that cannot be annexed by an employer—complementary, not overlapping

C-WW-005E.title: Wang Wei's 'Musical-Synesthesia Method' applied today
C-WW-005E.description:
'Bird-Song Stream': 'the moon rises and startles the mountain birds'—a sudden visual event is registered by a bird's cry; the acoustic structure of a still night completed in one stroke
Modern drill: Sound design: give products and films cross-channel cues (a sound foreshadowing a visual event, a visual echo of a sound) to raise immersive resolution

C-WW-006E.title: Wang Wei's 'Writing-Heavy-With-Light Method' applied today
C-WW-006E.description:
'Seeing Yuan the Second Off': two landscape lines (rain, willows), then nothing but one act of urging wine—the de-saturation ceiling of Chinese parting poetry, immediately set to music as the parting song
Modern drill: Obituaries and eulogies: no adjectives, only concrete facts and small details of shared life; restraint lets sorrow arrive on its own

C-WW-007E.title: Wang Wei's 'Chan-Focus-on-Ordinary-Objects Method' applied today
C-WW-007E.description:
'Miscellaneous Quatrain': the whole motif of homesickness compressed into six characters, 'had the winter plum flowered?'—the extreme case of the small defeating the large in Chinese poetry
Modern drill: Brand semiotics: press brand value into one tiny portable sign (the bitten Apple, the Nike swoosh); the simpler the interface, the farther it travels

C-WW-008E.title: Wang Wei's 'Trace-Concealment-in-Adversity Method' applied today
C-WW-008E.description:
Forced into the puppet office after capture: he took medicine to fake severe dysentery and was still escorted to Luoyang—visible resistance conducted in the body, not in writing; the orally dictated 'Jade Pool' poem became the only effective self-testimony after the war
