Modern drill: Organizational survival: during reorganizations or purges, lower internal exposure (fewer bylines, fewer mass emails, fewer declared alignments) and keep professional output in neutral channels

C-WW-009E.title: Wang Wei's 'Poem-Painting Mutual-Translation Method' applied today
C-WW-009E.description:
The intertextual system of the 'Wangchuan Collection' poems and the 'Wangchuan Painting': one estate completed once in language and once on silk—the starting point of the Chinese literati tradition of 'one law for poem and painting'
Modern drill: Building interdisciplinary teams: deliberately staff double-major members (biology+code, law+design); boundary people are the source of translation and increment

C-WW-010E.title: Wang Wei's 'Structural-Mean-of-Half-Office-Half-Retreat Method' applied today
C-WW-010E.description:
Multiple hedges that spared his life in the captivity crisis: the 'Jade Pool' poem's self-testimony, his brother Wang Jin's surrender of office to redeem him, and the general amnesty after the war—all structures invisible in peacetime, all live at once in crisis
Modern drill: Personal finance: structural hedging across equities, bonds, and cash—never trade curve-smoothness for a single point of gain

C-MF-001E.title: Mi Fu's 'Swift-Brush Momentum Method' applied today
C-MF-001E.description:
Poems on Shu Silk (Shu Su Tie): writing fast on coarse silk, the drag of ink refused by the weave forces the eight-faced brush to its extreme—the faster the hand, the more the fabric's texture exposes every particle of speed
Modern drill: Speaking: deliver in one take without a verbatim script; let live momentum replace polished smoothness—audiences retain the momentum, not the sentences

C-MF-002E.title: Mi Fu's 'Assimilate-the-Ancients Method' applied today
C-MF-002E.description:
His mid-life account of his own sequence—Yan, Liu, Ou, Chu, the Two Wangs—each step carrying a specific diagnosis of the previous station's defect: a published case record of learning
Modern drill: Career planning: explicitly name your early career the 'collecting phase'; replace style-anxiety with a list of masters to be assimilated

C-MF-003E.title: Mi Fu's 'Monomania Deep-Dive Method' applied today
C-MF-003E.description:
The bow at Wuwei: full court dress, a bow to a stone, 'Elder Brother Stone'—public performance art entered into the official history, raising an aesthetic stance to a declaration of personhood
Modern drill: Personal branding: voluntarily contract one harmless eccentricity, let it fix in your circle, and collect the exemption from useless sociability

C-MF-004E.title: Mi Fu's 'Connoisseur Authentication Method' applied today
C-MF-004E.description:
The graded register of the Register of Sought Treasures: ranking the Jin model-books that passed through his hands—marvel, divine, fine—each with its holder named: an accountable ledger of authentication
Modern drill: Procurement and due diligence: convert every key judgment into a triple evidence base (site + documents + provenance chain), with a written trail

C-MF-005E.title: Mi Fu's 'No-Stroke-Unfinished Method' applied today
C-MF-005E.description:
The large-character Poems on Rainbow County: strokes thick as levers, yet every finish still shows the returning tip—large characters are the supreme test of full-length force; slacken once and you have an ink-bladder
Modern drill: Project management: write 'the finish is the quality' into process—every meeting and every sprint must end with a formal close and acknowledgment

C-MF-006E.title: Mi Fu's 'Shape-Follows-Momentum Method' applied today
C-MF-006E.description:
The stark contrast of huge characters like 'Crane' and 'Load' against small ones in the Poems on Shu Silk: sizes differing several-fold within one line, the momentum-curve legible at a glance
Modern drill: Speaking and teaching: fix only the opening; set the ensuing rhythm live by reading the audience—sense the momentum section by section rather than read a script

C-MF-007E.title: Mi Fu's 'Eye-Through-Models Method' applied today
C-MF-007E.description:
The lore of his Wang Xianzhi copies deceiving experts, and the surviving contested works: self-training measured against 'fooling the experts,' differences forced to the hair's breadth
Modern drill: Training professional vision: build the copy-recite-compare-doubt-verify loop in your field—back-translation for translators, pixel-faithful site reconstruction for designers

C-MF-008E.title: Mi Fu's 'True-Appreciation-Stands Method' applied today
C-MF-008E.description:
Throwing himself into the water for the Brief Outline: staking his life on a sheet of paper—the bound value of the object outweighing every market and power pricing
Modern drill: Institutional independence: pre-declared conflict-of-interest rules for audit, review and authentication posts—make independence process, not virtue

C-MF-009E.title: Mi Fu's 'High-Low Double-Track Method' applied today
C-MF-009E.description:
Every transaction recorded in the History of Calligraphy—price, holder, paper, mounting: street-track intelligence converted directly into primary sources of refined-track scholarship
Modern drill: Knowledge-worker double track: elite consulting (refined) + mass content (common), with an explicit conversion mechanism from content to consulting

C-MF-010E.title: Mi Fu's 'Self-Curating-Posterity Method' applied today
C-MF-010E.description:
The self-assured entries of the Famous Sayings: private insights written as quotable axioms, still foundational literature eight centuries on
Modern drill: Personal knowledge base: write your working process into a citable public archive (decision records, methodology, retrospectives)—the home field of narrative

C-BA-001E.title: Bada Shanren's 'White-Eye-Turned-to-Heaven Method' applied today
C-BA-001E.description:
'The Solitary Fowl': on a whole sheet of plain paper, one bird—standing on one leg, neck retracted, eyes rolled upward; the entire grief of a fallen dynasty borne by the position of one eye
Modern drill: Brand design: press the brand's attitude into one minimal visual hammer (a bite mark, a swoosh); the smaller the sign, the sharper the attitude it carries

C-BA-002E.title: Bada Shanren's 'Extreme-Sign Condensation Method' applied today
C-BA-002E.description:
'The Solitary Fowl': one bird owning an entire blank sheet—the limiting case of Chinese subtraction, repeatedly published, copied, and enlarged by later ages; proof that a condensed sign travels farther than an intricate masterpiece
Modern drill: Logo design: condense organizational identity into one critical sign (a letterform, a geometry); repeated deployment charges it with load

C-BA-003E.title: Bada Shanren's 'Signature-Cipher Method' applied today
C-BA-003E.description:
The late linked signature: the crying-or-laughing letterforms became the primary evidence for dating and authenticating his works—a cipher so successful it changed the workflow of connoisseurship
Modern drill: Personal branding: design core identity into a fixed slot of every output (signature opener, fixed sign-off style); recurrence is brand equity

C-BA-004E.title: Bada Shanren's 'Silent-Riddle Self-Protection Method' applied today
C-BA-004E.description:
Concealing his Ming-royal identity: under the Qing he moved through assumed names and sobriquets (Xuege, Geshan) instead of his genealogical name—zeroing the quotable at the identity layer before the work layer
Modern drill: Compliance writing: in regulated industries, prefer compliant media (diagrams, cases, third-party citations) to direct assertions

C-BA-005E.title: Bada Shanren's 'Deformation-For-Meaning Method' applied today
C-BA-005E.description:
The systematic square-eyed bird: square eyes exist in no species—they are pure geometric design; vigilance translated into a rectangle, the second signature of Bada's birds alongside the white eye
Modern drill: Character design: set a shape language for personality (square = stable, pointed = aggressive, round = friendly); fix deformation parameters before drawing

C-BA-006E.title: Bada Shanren's 'Fewest-Strokes Discipline Method' applied today
C-BA-006E.description:
The dozen-stroke birds and fish of the album leaves: later connoisseurs use 'no stroke can be added or removed' as an authenticity test—density as an anti-forgery feature
Modern drill: Code refactoring: prefer merging execution paths (one loop, several jobs) to deleting variables—action reuse over element deletion

C-BA-007E.title: Bada Shanren's 'Negative-Space Composition Method' applied today
C-BA-007E.description:
The suspension of 'The Solitary Fowl': the bird in the middle-upper sheet, nothing beneath—the directional choice of blank makes the viewer feel at first glance 'it has nowhere to stand'
Modern drill: Poster design: first decide the protagonist's relation to the viewer (besieged / looked up to / exiled), then allocate the blank's direction accordingly

C-BA-008E.title: Bada Shanren's 'Loyalist-Identity-Aestheticization Method' applied today
C-BA-008E.description:
The colophons on the 'Portrait of Geshan': friends like Rao Yupu wrote openly on the portrait that he was 'descended from the Prince of Ning of Nanchang'—the open record of identity placed in others' writing, not one word signed by himself; risk transfer and factual attestation in one stroke
Modern drill: Career positioning: translate unreplicable origins or experiences (unusual industries, unusual ordeals) into motifs or professional perspective—a differentiation moat

C-BA-009E.title: Bada Shanren's 'Calligraphy-Painting Mutual-Verification Method' applied today
C-BA-009E.description:
The unity of colophon and painting: his inscriptions are not captions but compositional participants—position, scale, and ink of characters breathing with the picture, reaching the completeness of 'calligraphy and painting as one thing'
Modern drill: Skill-pair investment: choose a second skill sharing your substrate (for a writer, structured expression over programming)

C-BA-010E.title: Bada Shanren's 'Madness-as-Performance Method' applied today
C-BA-010E.description:
The Linchuan madness: after a sojourn at the invitation of the county magistrate Hu Yitang, sudden derangement—tearing the monk's robe and walking back to Nanchang—one madness accomplishing three things at once: leaving the sangha, leaving the relation of dependence, and returning home
Modern drill: Career transition: where no procedure exists (as in closed institutions), design a public, unprosecutable farewell event (an open letter, a public pivot declaration)

C-WDZ-001E.title: Wu Daozi's 'Wu-Band-in-Wind Method' applied today
C-WDZ-001E.description:
The Eighty-Seven Celestials scroll (Wu-school tradition): the sashes of all eighty-seven divine figures stream toward one breath, thirty continuous meters without a break in the wind—the textbook specimen
Modern drill: Animation and game concept art: replace pose-copying with force analysis—write down 'what wind this cloth is under' for every panel before drawing

C-WDZ-002E.title: Wu Daozi's 'Eye-Capture Mind-Recall Method' applied today
C-WDZ-002E.description:
Three hundred li of the Jialing in one day: hung beside Li Sixun's months of labor on the same hall, both judged to reach the utmost—memory-painting and life-painting competing before the emperor without a loser
Modern drill: Meetings and interviews: take no notes; immediately afterwards, closed-book reconstruction of the structure—compression forces out what was truly understood

C-WDZ-003E.title: Wu Daozi's 'Borrowed-Momentum Method' applied today
C-WDZ-003E.description:
The Tiangong Temple spirit-wall: the sword-dance ends, the brush flashes, the wall stands in moments—contemporaries said of all Wu's works only this one 'had the aid of a spirit': the fullest record of borrowed momentum
Modern drill: Deep-work ignition: design a fixed opening ritual per task type—music, posture, a sprint—turning 'getting into state' from mysticism into procedure

C-WDZ-004E.title: Wu Daozi's 'Guard-the-Spirit Focus Method' applied today
C-WDZ-004E.description:
'Guard the spirit, unify the one' stands at the summit of Zhang Yanyuan's essay on the four masters' brush—not a technique but the precondition of all techniques running
Modern drill: Schedule for deep work: place the day's most creative task in one or two untouchable 'guard-the-spirit' blocks; fill the rest with clerical work

C-WDZ-005E.title: Wu Daozi's 'Wu-Style Underpainting Method' applied today
C-WDZ-005E.description:
'Wu finish' entering art history as a named term: a manner of coloring earns a name only when it is a complete methodology, not an omission
Modern drill: Brand and interface design: validate structure and hierarchy in monochrome first; introduce color only after it passes—color as reward, not dependency

C-WDZ-006E.title: Wu Daozi's 'Line-Only, Color-Delegated Method' applied today
C-WDZ-006E.description:
Three hundred-plus temple walls across the two capitals: physically impossible without stage-splitting—the division of labor is the real foundation of the 'Sage of Painting's' output
Modern drill: Creator economy: name your non-delegable stage (viewpoint, taste, the decisive stroke); hand editing, layout and operations to tools or teams

C-WDZ-007E.title: Wu Daozi's 'Manner-as-Generator Method' applied today
C-WDZ-007E.description:
Three hundred temple walls across the capitals alongside a crowd of simultaneously trained disciples: the Wu manner is art history's first true 'scaled style-production system'
Modern drill: Design systems: precipitate personal design decisions into tokens, components and usage spec, so scale never dilutes taste

C-WDZ-008E.title: Wu Daozi's 'Hell-Tableau Moral-Pressure Method' applied today
C-WDZ-008E.description:
The Transformation of Hell at Jinggong Temple moving the butchers and fishers of two capitals to quit their trades: the only event in Chinese art history recorded, in quasi-official style, as 'one painting changing a city's employment structure'
Modern drill: Public health: graphic warnings on packaging, visceral accident education—pair every behavioral risk with a visual-grade channel and a real exit

C-WDZ-009E.title: Wu Daozi's 'The Un-Signed Master Method' applied today
C-WDZ-009E.description:
The Huichang persecution destroyed most of the two capitals' murals, yet 'Wu Daozi' the name grew ever greater—his signature lodged in urban memory and literary transmission, more durable than pigment
Modern drill: Creator anonymity: replace face-branding with an instantly recognizable output style—'one glance and you know' as the moat

C-WDZ-010E.title: Wu Daozi's 'Entrust-the-Afterlife Method' applied today
C-WDZ-010E.description:
Zhai and Zhang carrying color, Lu and Yang carrying line: the Wu manner landed beyond the capitals too (Lu's work in Shu)—organs redundantly deployed across geography
Modern drill: Founder succession: split the company into organs—product, culture, relationships, cash—name a non-kin owner for each, and tolerate their variation in office

C-ST-001E.title: Shi Tao's 'One-Stroke Principle Method' applied today
C-ST-001E.description:
Chapter One of the Huayulu: eighteen chapters, thousands of words, all issuing from the single term 'one-stroke'—the theoretical system is itself a demonstration of the principle
Modern drill: Product design: reduce all product features to one minimal interaction unit (a click, a message stream) and test whether every feature is a combination of it

C-ST-002E.title: Shi Tao's 'Searched-Out-Peaks-Drafting Method' applied today
C-ST-002E.description:
The 'Sought-Out Peaks' handscroll (1691, Beijing period): not painting one particular mountain but fusing a lifetime of seen ranges into a scroll of mountains 'like none and like all'
Modern drill: Product research: interview to saturation (new interviews yield no new information) before designing; never substitute imagined users for real ones

C-ST-003E.title: Shi Tao's 'Ink-and-Brush-Must-Follow-the-Times Method' applied today
C-ST-003E.description:
The 'Autumn Purity of Huaiyang' scroll: the humid autumn air of the Yangzhou water-country, its peculiar level-distance composition—only someone living in Kangxi-era Yangzhou would see water this way
Modern drill: Brand design: renew brand language with each media generation (print to screen to short-video), keeping the recognition organs while replacing aphasic expression

C-ST-004E.title: Shi Tao's 'Method-of-No-Method Method' applied today
C-ST-004E.description:
Shitao's early exhaustive copying of Song-Yuan masters followed by a completely transformed middle-period style—his 'no-method' résumé first records a full history of method
Modern drill: Skill training: explicitly separate the 'obedience phase' from the 'transmutation phase'; forbid premature improvisation before obedience suffices

C-ST-005E.title: Shi Tao's 'I-Use-My-Own-Method Method' applied today
C-ST-005E.description:
A contrast in art history: tens of thousands of unsigned 'after Wang Meng' and 'after Huang Gongwang' scrolls versus the Huangshan handscrolls signed 'inscribed by Old Man Qingxiang,' which became top-tier symbols in the authentic market
Modern drill: Independent creation: publish on owned channels and build a personal signature system instead of mortgaging the whole copyright to platform certification

C-ST-006E.title: Shi Tao's 'Spirit-Meeting-Transmutation Method' applied today
C-ST-006E.description:
The decade of mutual shaping between Shitao and the Yellow Mountains: he wrote Huangshan's biography and Huangshan wrote his—the most recognizable landforms in surviving Shitao are transmutation, not plein-air transcription
Modern drill: User research: after interviews, publicly update one's priors; treat 'being changed by users' as evidence of effective research, not failure

C-ST-007E.title: Shi Tao's 'Segment-Capture Method' applied today
C-ST-007E.description:
Album leaves of the Huangshan series: each leaf takes one view, one corner; viewed together they assemble in the viewer's mind into a whole Huangshan completed by the audience
Modern drill: Feature journalism: refract the whole event through one concrete person's day, abandoning panoramic summary

C-ST-008E.title: Shi Tao's 'Ten-Thousand-Ink-Dots Method' applied today
C-ST-008E.description:
The 'Sought-Out Peaks' handscroll (1691): mountains built entirely by dot-work; connoisseurs of the Wu Hufan line rank it among the finest of Shitao's Beijing years—the density of dots itself became a criterion of authentication
Modern drill: Personal growth: choose one minimal daily executable (write 300 words, one commit) and rely on unbroken stacking, not bursts

C-ST-009E.title: Shi Tao's 'Wet-Brush-Atmosphere Method' applied today
C-ST-009E.description:
The vapor of 'Autumn Purity of Huaiyang': humid Yangzhou autumn translated directly by wet brush—the bleeding of not-yet-dry ink becomes part of the picture's language
Modern drill: Product design: outside the safe parameters every competitor occupies, choose one high-variance option (new material, new interaction) and go deep within a failure budget

C-ST-010E.title: Shi Tao's 'Monk-Subject-and-Loyalist-Dual-Track Method' applied today
C-ST-010E.description:
The 'Triumphant Seas and Clear Rivers' signature 'subject-monk Yuanji bows his head': one greeting, one inscription, separately accounting to three audiences (the new dynasty, the Buddhist order, the self)
Modern drill: Career planning: rebalance main job, side projects, and social identities by cycle; refuse to be defined by a single position, while scripting a narrative for each turn

C-TLS-001E.title: Leo Tolstoy's 'Panoramic-Microscopic Method' applied today
C-TLS-001E.description:
The Schöngrabern campaign: the novel's most important battle-writing is all low-angle—damp woods, the gunners' faces, the whisper-like terror of the charge—leaving the reader with a clearer sense of the whole campaign than any textbook gives
Modern drill: Strategy research: when analyzing an industry, force-pair the macro picture with first-hand material of 'one specific company's one specific day,' keeping strategy reports from becoming arrow diagrams

C-TLS-002E.title: Leo Tolstoy's 'Anti-Great-Man Method' applied today
C-TLS-002E.description:
The writing of Borodino: Napoleon 'watches' from a far hill a battle he cannot command—the rupture between order and outcome rendered as a landscape he cannot read
Modern drill: Organizational diagnosis: replace the 'one man turned the company around' narrative with a command-wear chain audit—what did cash flow, execution, and culture each contribute?

C-TLS-003E.title: Leo Tolstoy's 'Psychological-Dialectic Method' applied today
C-TLS-003E.description:
Anna's collapse at the races: the crowd's gaze and social rules press upon her, and her breakdown completes itself in a three-tier cascade of feeling-shame-deeper feeling—the dialectic's most famous public performance
Modern drill: Psychotherapy: after a client reports an emotion, immediately ask 'what do you do with this feeling,' advancing therapy from the emotion layer to the handling layer

C-TLS-004E.title: Leo Tolstoy's 'Moral-Limit-Probe Method' applied today
C-TLS-004E.description:
The Death of Ivan Ilyich: a complete record of a social self dissolving layer by layer—colleague, wife, daughter each leaving different residue in the solvent of death: an underwater photograph of respectable society
Modern drill: Talent vetting: before promoting to critical roles, set a high-density stress period (real crisis, real trade-offs) and judge by in-situ choice, not the promotion speech

C-TLS-005E.title: Leo Tolstoy's 'Defamiliarizing-Eye Method' applied today
C-TLS-005E.description:
Levin at the opera: a full passage of downgraded seeing—auditorium and stage ritual restored to a grotesque exhibition of bodies, immediately answered by his longing to be admitted, critique and longing in one frame
Modern drill: Product and experience design: run a quarterly novice-perspective walkthrough—someone who has never used it walks the whole flow, logging grotesque and confusion screen by screen

C-TLS-006E.title: Leo Tolstoy's 'Art-Ethics-Cointegration Method' applied today
C-TLS-006E.description:
What Is Art?: double-entry judgment passed on Shakespeare, Wagner, and all his own early novels—the most infectious works of the age ruled suspect in direction, convulsing European criticism
Modern drill: Content-platform governance: audit viral content on both force and direction (connection or hatred, understanding or addiction), writing both metrics into recommender systems

C-TLS-007E.title: Leo Tolstoy's 'Landlord-Concession-Experiment Method' applied today
C-TLS-007E.description:
The 1856 emancipation scheme: a first experiment with land and redemption clauses—failed through peasant distrust, the failure itself becoming input to the next design
Modern drill: Corporate and platform governance: firms at structural advantage make verifiable concessions first (data openness, take-rate caps, audit rights), writing values into contract clauses

C-TLS-008E.title: Leo Tolstoy's 'Proto-Nonviolence Method' applied today
C-TLS-008E.description:
The Kingdom of God Is Within You: a complete program from doctrine to a checklist of refusal—conscientious objectors across countries used it as an action manual
Modern drill: Civic action design: upgrade protest from emotional venting to cost-curve engineering—discipline, predictable suffering, and testimony purity written into the action code

C-TLS-009E.title: Leo Tolstoy's 'Law-of-Simplicity Method' applied today
C-TLS-009E.description:
The opening sentence of The Death of Ivan Ilyich: the whole work's verdict delivered in one plain sentence—juxtaposing the simple and the terrible at the extreme of syntactic minimalism

C-TLS-010E.title: Leo Tolstoy's 'Deathbed-Self-Audit Method' applied today
C-TLS-010E.description:
A Confession: the audit's working papers—at the summit of fame asking item by item 'what is this worth at my death,' until every achievement fell to the question

C-DSF-001E.title: Fyodor Dostoevsky's 'Psychological Realism Probe' applied today
C-DSF-001E.description:
Crime and Punishment: Raskolnikov returns to the murder scene and provokes Porfiry—the behavioral inversion born of superposed motives.

C-DSF-002E.title: Fyodor Dostoevsky's 'Thought-As-Living-Experiment' applied today
C-DSF-002E.description:
Crime and Punishment: the full infection-onset-immunity course of the extraordinary-man doctrine.

C-DSF-003E.title: Fyodor Dostoevsky's 'Suffering-Value Revaluation' applied today
C-DSF-003E.description:
Notes from a Dead House: the control pair of Alei-like tenderness and the beast-crushed convicts under the same fetters.

C-DSF-004E.title: Fyodor Dostoevsky's 'Freedom-Paradox Exposition' applied today
C-DSF-004E.description:
The Brothers Karamazov: the Inquisitor's full anti-freedom indictment and Christ's single kiss.

C-DSF-006E.description:

C-DSF-007E.title: Fyodor Dostoevsky's 'Self-Split Dialogue' applied today
C-DSF-007E.description:
The Brothers Karamazov: the trinity of Ivan-Smerdyakov-the devil as one self split three ways.

C-DSF-009E.title: Fyodor Dostoevsky's 'Tears-of-a-Child Tribunal' applied today
C-DSF-009E.description:

C-DSF-010E.title: Fyodor Dostoevsky's 'Press-Fire Publishing Method' applied today
C-DSF-010E.description:
The Gambler: 26 days of dictation to honor a punitive contract—the method's most complete single specimen.

C-MDL-001E.title: Dmitri Mendeleev's 'Periodic-Table Gap Prediction' applied today
C-MDL-001E.description:
In 1869 he left the eka-aluminium gap with a predicted density of 5.9; when Lecoq de Boisbaudran found gallium in 1875 and first measured 4.7, Mendeleev wrote arguing purity problems—the remeasurement gave 5.94, the prediction correcting the experiment.

C-MDL-002E.title: Dmitri Mendeleev's 'Card-Deck Reshuffle' applied today
C-MDL-002E.description:

C-MDL-003E.title: Dmitri Mendeleev's 'Atomic-Weight Dogma Breaking' applied today
C-MDL-003E.description:

C-MDL-004E.title: Dmitri Mendeleev's 'Correct-the-Experiment Rule' applied today

C-MDL-005E.title: Dmitri Mendeleev's 'Family-Column Extrapolation' applied today

C-MDL-006E.title: Dmitri Mendeleev's 'Deathbed-Developing Sprint' applied today

The Principles commission (1868) → the periodic table of February 1869: a textbook deadline forced science's greatest by-product.

C-MDL-007E.title: Dmitri Mendeleev's 'Triple-Duty Translation' applied today
C-MDL-007E.description:

C-MDL-008E.description:

C-MDL-009E.title: Dmitri Mendeleev's 'Textbook-Architecture Consistency' applied today
C-MDL-009E.description:

C-MDL-010E.title: Dmitri Mendeleev's 'Balloon-to-the-Clouds Observation' applied today
C-MDL-010E.description:

C-PGR-001E.title: Peter the Great's 'Incognito Apprenticeship' applied today
C-PGR-001E.description:

C-PGR-002E.title: Peter the Great's 'Hands-on Standard Setting' applied today
C-PGR-002E.description:
After Poltava (1709) he worked the dressing stations with his own hands, demonstrating that medicine was not servant's work—the army thenceforth built a formal medical corps.

C-PGR-003E.title: Peter the Great's 'Window-to-the-Sea Strategy' applied today
C-PGR-003E.description:

C-PGR-004E.description:

C-PGR-005E.title: Peter the Great's 'Master-Hire Localization' applied today
C-PGR-005E.description:

C-PGR-006E.title: Peter the Great's 'War-Driven Rapid Iteration' applied today
C-PGR-006E.description:

C-PGR-007E.description:
The Peter and Paul Fortress and dockyard came first, palaces later—defense and production ahead of splendor in the order of building.

C-PGR-008E.title: Peter the Great's 'Soul-Tax Census Logic' applied today
C-PGR-008E.description:

C-PGR-009E.description:
The Military Regulations (1716) and Naval Charter (1720) codified drill, military justice and fleet watches, so training ran on after foreign officers departed.

C-PGR-010E.title: Peter the Great's 'Mass-Questioning Accountability' applied today
C-PGR-010E.description:
After the Streltsy mutiny of 1698, whole formations were executed or exiled, the streltsy corps abolished for good, and interceding nobles punished with them.

C-EUC-001E.title: Euclid's 'Axiomatic Foundation' applied today

C-EUC-002E.description:

C-EUC-003E.description:
Book IX, Prop. 20: Euclid's classic proof of the infinitude of primes, barely improved in two millennia

C-EUC-004E.title: Euclid's 'Whole-from-Parts Construction' applied today
C-EUC-004E.description:

C-EUC-005E.description:

C-EUC-007E.description:

C-EUC-009E.description:
The Elements fusing two centuries of results, Thales to Eudoxus, into thirteen statutory volumes

C-EUC-010E.description:

C-GAU-001E.title: Gauss's 'Maximal Economy of Proof' applied today

C-GAU-002E.description:
Ceres 1801: orbit back-inferred from three observations; prediction preceded rediscovery

C-CAE-002E.title: Caesar's 'Battlefield Narrative' applied today
C-CAE-002E.description:
The Gallic War published year by year: each campaign season closed with a book, Roman readers following his exploits like installments while his enemies' attacks always ran an episode behind
Modern drill: Crisis PR: within the golden four hours, issue an adjective-free factual statement to seize interpretation and starve conspiracy theories

C-CAE-003E.title: Caesar's 'Asymmetry Lever' applied today
C-CAE-003E.description:
Alesia (52 BC): an inner wall to starve Vercingetorix and an outer wall to break the relief force—a 210,000-versus-50,000 showdown converted into two engineering exams each certain to pass
Modern drill: Startup competition: forgo the general market-share war and build tenfold absolute advantage on one niche feature

C-CAE-004E.title: Caesar's 'Absorb the Defeated' applied today
C-CAE-004E.description:
Gallic nobles into the Senate: descendants of the conquered entered Rome's power circle; satirists sneered about 'trousers in the Senate'—Caesar took it as a merit, not a disgrace
Modern drill: Post-merger integration: announce full retention and options for the acquired team first, turning the hostile organization's backbone into integration salespeople

C-CAE-005E.title: Caesar's 'Speed Against the News Gap' applied today
C-CAE-005E.description:
The opening of the civil war (49 BC): movements on both Italian shores completed before Pompey's mobilization paperwork—the 'lawful campaign' never truly launched
Modern drill: Business competition: out-tempo a larger rival—their kickoff meeting unfinished while your second release ships

C-CAE-006E.title: Caesar's 'Debt-Fueled Investment' applied today
C-CAE-006E.description:
The aedileship of 65 BC: 320 pairs of gladiators and citywide banquets at many multiples of his estate—popularity the highest-yield position in his portfolio
Modern drill: Startup finance: against asymmetric opportunity, raise at maximum speed for first-mover advantage, letting investors' loss functions lock in your resources

C-CAE-007E.title: Caesar's 'Infrastructure Rhetoric' applied today
C-CAE-007E.description:
The Julian calendar (46-45 BC): the 445-day last year of confusion unified the old reckoning; July bears his name—the direct ancestor of the modern Gregorian calendar, running two thousand years on
Modern drill: Standards strategy: turn a corporate protocol into the industry standard (USB-C, data formats) so rivals compete on your rails

C-CAE-008E.title: Caesar's 'Reconnaissance First' applied today
C-CAE-008E.description:
Opening the Helvetii war (58 BC): tribal councils, hostages, and grain-route intelligence fixed the migration route before the interception—the whole campaign as the execution of intelligence
Modern drill: Investment diligence: cross-verify management interviews, customer calls, and data audits before committing—decisiveness as the product of diligence

C-CAE-009E.title: Caesar's 'Crisis-Compressed Decision' applied today
C-CAE-009E.description:
The night at the Rubicon (49 BC): crossing the moment the ultimatum expired, converting a question of treason into a question of nerve
Modern drill: Negotiation: set a real deadline the other side can verify, removing 'let's wait' from the table

C-CAE-010E.title: Caesar's 'Clemency for Legitimacy' applied today
C-CAE-010E.description:
The amnesty of Pharsalus (48 BC): all captured senators and knights freed; not one Roman citizen executed in his triumphs—the direct contrast with Sulla's bloody lists
Modern drill: After organizational purges: publicly retain backbone staff who picked the wrong side, converting 'expectation of settlement' into 'loyalty performance'

C-BAK-001E.title: Bacon's 'Induction Ladder' applied today
C-BAK-001E.description:
Book II of the Novum Organum runs the full procedure on 'heat': 28 instances of presence, 41 of absence, a table of degrees—then excludes candidates such as 'heat is an element' or 'heat is opposed to motion,' leaving 'heat is an expansive motion within bodies'
Modern drill: Debugging: bisect and unit-test to exclude false hypotheses, locate the minimal reproducible case before debating root cause—Bacon's exclusion for engineers

C-BAK-002E.title: Bacon's 'Four-Idols Audit' applied today
C-BAK-002E.description:
Novum Organum I.46's balance metaphor for the idols of the tribe: only controlled experiment—placing sensory evidence on a regulated balance, not trusting the naked eye—offsets species-level distortion
Modern drill: Decision safety checklists: before a major investment, run the four questions—tribe (where does consensus come from?), cave (my own experience bias?), marketplace (are terms smuggling concepts?), theater (am I performing inside a fashionable framework?)

C-BAK-003E.title: Bacon's 'Three-Tables Exclusion' applied today
C-BAK-003E.description:
The heat study in full: the sun (heat without friction) eliminates the friction theory of heat; friction (heat without light) eliminates the light theory; the three tables converge on 'expansive motion'—history vindicated the direction
Modern drill: Churn analysis: contrast churned against retained users in presence/absence/degree tables; the minimal difference-pair (both used feature A, only the former saw the popup) usually hides the truth

C-BAK-004E.title: Bacon's 'Obey-to-Command' applied today
C-BAK-004E.description:
Novum Organum I.81-82 names the three great inventions—printing, gunpowder, the lodestone—that changed the face of the world, asserting these 'fruits' surpass all the victories of speculation: anchoring the ranking of scientific value
Modern drill: Engineering practice: any architectural argument must land as a deployable path—obedience (to physics and economics) and command (system design) are one document

C-BAK-005E.title: Bacon's 'Salomon's-House Institution' applied today
C-BAK-005E.description:
The twelve classes of Salomon's House: 'divers' gathering deep-sea specimens, observers charting comets, mechanics building finer instruments, 'Merchants of Light' collecting knowledge abroad—a complete organizational chart
Modern drill: Corporate research labs: write a mission statement outliving product cycles for the basic-research team, splitting 'exploration' and 'delivery' into different staff lines

C-BAK-006E.title: Bacon's 'Natural-History Cataloguing' applied today
C-BAK-006E.description:
The thousand entries of the Sylva Sylvarum: from 'the pattern of frost-bite on apples' to 'the passage of sound through an iron pipe,' gathered under a uniform numbered scheme—one of the Royal Society's earliest databases after his death
Modern drill: Data engineering: fix the schema before collecting; field design caps the future callability of hypotheses—Bacon's uniform questionnaire, engineered

C-BAK-007E.title: Bacon's 'Crucial-Instance Experiment' applied today
C-BAK-007E.description:
In his heat study Bacon staged crucial instances: if heat is expansive motion, an anvil under hammering should heat while water under the same blows should not—he used such contrasts to eliminate 'heat is an element' step by step
Modern drill: Product experiments: when two growth hypotheses both 'explain' the retention data, fork a single-variable test that forces them apart

C-BAK-008E.title: Bacon's 'Semantic Audit of Language' applied today
C-BAK-008E.description:
Bacon's audit of the word 'element': scholastics debated the world's constitution over 'elements,' but he demanded first, what observable property does 'element' denote—until the word is settled, the question cannot stand
Modern drill: Software collaboration: domain-driven design mandates a ubiquitous language—every new concept enters the glossary before the code, killing interface accidents where one word means three things

C-BAK-009E.title: Bacon's 'Gradual Approximation' applied today
C-BAK-009E.description:
The designed incompleteness of the Great Instauration: a six-part plan published openly, the first two parts issued as they stood, Bacon's preface handing 'the unfinished parts to posterity to proceed by the same method'—making incompleteness itself part of the method
Modern drill: Engineering practice: version numbers, changelogs, and open code make every conclusion rerunnable and refutable by the same procedure—Bacon's trusteeship, softwareized

C-BAK-010E.title: Bacon's 'Great-Instauration Planning' applied today
C-BAK-010E.description:
The six-part plan of the Great Instauration: 'division—method—natural history—labyrinth—beginnings—second philosophy' as a structured master map, the gaps after part three filled by two generations of scientists working to his chart
Modern drill: Technology strategy: write architecture decision records and the roadmap before teams build—'constitution before statutes,' engineered

C-LOC-001E.title: Locke's 'Idea-Source Audit' applied today
C-LOC-001E.description:
Against innate ideas: 'no idea can be innate that children and idiots do not know'—the dullest counterexample auditing the loftiest claim
Modern drill: Decision review: decompose 'our judgment' into an inventory of concrete beliefs, interrogate each for evidential source, demote the murky to hypothesis and retest

C-LOC-002E.title: Locke's 'Tabula-Rasa Scripting' applied today
C-LOC-002E.description:
Some Thoughts opens: 'nine parts of ten of what we are, good or bad, useful or useless, is from education'—the blank slate applied to schooling
Modern drill: Organizational design: never assume 'people are just like this'; audit which behaviors are the institution's writing before you write anew

C-LOC-003E.title: Locke's 'Primary-Secondary Split' applied today
C-LOC-003E.description:
Fire and pain: the fire holds corpuscular motion (primary), pain lives only in us—rewriting 'fire is painful' as 'fire causes pain' clears the ledger
Modern drill: Product metrics: book 'system latency' (object property) and 'feels laggy' (observer-added) in separate columns—monitoring for one, experience design for the other

C-LOC-004E.title: Locke's 'Consent-Warrant Check' applied today
C-LOC-004E.description:
Against Filmer: the first Treatise dissects 'kingship from Adam' line by line—the warrant shows no such entry
Modern drill: Corporate governance: a superior's authority runs to the job's delegation letter; overreaching orders may be refused, with the refusal on record

C-LOC-005E.title: Locke's 'Fiduciary-Trust Recall' applied today
C-LOC-005E.description:
The Glorious Revolution: Parliament invites William and Mary under a Bill of Rights—not a dynasty change but a trustee replaced and the terms rewritten
Modern drill: Corporate charters: boards' fiduciary duties to shareholders written into the charter; performance and compliance audits are the performance audit, persistent failure triggering re-election

C-LOC-006E.title: Locke's 'Quantity-of-Money Method' applied today
C-LOC-006E.description:
The 1695 recoinage: Locke urged recoinage at the old full standard (5.7 million pounds melted and reminted)—'better a sharp pang than a debased penny'; Parliament followed
Modern drill: Inflation analysis: for 'why are prices rising,' set up the three accounts first (money stock, goods in circulation, turnover) before emotional attribution

C-LOC-007E.title: Locke's 'Education-Order Method' applied today
C-LOC-007E.description:
Cold baths and thin shoes: 'to inure the feet to cold and wet'—the founding case of training written as prescription
Modern drill: Parenting: write an explicit family order (sleep and exercise→character and habits→grades) and let no grade pressure invade the first two tiers

C-LOC-008E.title: Locke's 'Consciousness-Identity Method' applied today
C-LOC-008E.description:
Prince and cobbler: the consciousness-swap cleaves 'man' from 'person'—identity follows consciousness, not the body
Modern drill: Narrative identity: rewrite 'who am I' as 'how far back does my consciousness reach'—an autobiography is a renewable asset, not a verdict

C-LOC-009E.title: Locke's 'Under-Labourer Discipline' applied today
C-LOC-009E.description:
The under-labourer epistle: Newton 'has sailed so far into the sea of knowledge'; Locke only 'clears the ground a little'—two centuries on, the epistle is quoted more often than many edifices
Modern drill: Teamwork: claim the unglamorous work everyone depends on—docs, tests, issue triage—and let outcome, not title, carry credit

C-LOC-010E.title: Locke's 'Physician's Field Method' applied today
C-LOC-010E.description:
Saving Shaftesbury: the 1668 drainage of a liver abscess, in an age of no anesthesia and near-zero success—philosophy's road bent through the surgeon's art
Modern drill: Product research: demote 'users all want X' to ten real cases, tabulate context and outcome, hunt the counterexamples

C-UM-001E.title: Hume's 'Impression-Copy Reduction' applied today
C-UM-001E.description:
The pineapple test: one who has never tasted a pineapple has no idea of its taste—Hume's demonstration that complex ideas are impossible without original impressions, the first experiment of empiricism textbooks
Modern drill: Metric design in products: 'user loyalty' is not directly observable—operationalize it into proxies (repurchase rate, NPS, retention curves) before it enters the dashboard: the analyst's impression-copy

C-UM-002E.title: Hume's 'Causation Skepticism' applied today
C-UM-002E.description:
The billiard-ball anatomy (Treatise I.3.2): one ball strikes another; we observe contact and motion—the 'transferred force' never appears; the primal teaching case of causal skepticism
Modern drill: Data analysis: any 'feature X lifted retention' conclusion must pass three gates—confounders excluded, precedence demonstrable, mechanism independently evidenced; failing these, demote to correlation

C-UM-003E.title: Hume's 'Induction Boundary' applied today
C-UM-003E.description:
The sunrise question (1748): 'the sun will rise tomorrow' is as intelligible and contradiction-free as its denial—the primal statement of induction's unprovability, still the first examination question of philosophy
Modern drill: Quantitative finance: backtest reports must state 'no guarantee out of sample' with failure conditions (policy shifts, liquidity regime changes)—the compliance form of the induction boundary

C-UM-004E.title: Hume's 'Custom-as-Guide' applied today
C-UM-004E.description:
Hume's working timetable: 'I spend three hours every morning writing, afternoons with friends, dinner at six'—habit institutionalized into a schedule that steadied the moods producing six volumes of history
Modern drill: Personal productivity: bind writing or training to fixed time, place, and initiation ritual—let environment, not willpower, carry the cost of persistence

C-UM-005E.title: Hume's 'Reason-as-Slave-of-Passion' applied today
C-UM-005E.description:
The tree-house case in the Treatise: a man who wants to fell a tree and build a hut is not stopped by reason declaring the hut useless—reason can only point out facts such as 'this tree falls faster'
Modern drill: Product and marketing: mine desire in user research (the passion layer) before designing features and copy (the reason layer)—Hume's order of pain-point before solution

C-UM-006E.title: Hume's 'Is-Ought Gap' applied today
C-UM-006E.description:
Dismantling the naturalness of slavery: the age's favorite premise 'some are born fit to be enslaved'—the Humean question is whether the toll was ever paid between 'natural difference' (is) and 'so slavery is just' (ought); in the essay Of the Populousness of Ancient Nations he attacks with historical facts: the inefficiency and atrocities of slave labor
Modern drill: AI governance: 'the model is 95% accurate' (is) does not entail 'deploy it' (ought)—deployment arguments must add value premises: the price of error, fairness, consent

C-UM-007E.title: Hume's 'Sympathy Resonance' applied today
C-UM-007E.description:
The strings metaphor of Treatise II.1.11: the expression of another's sorrow raises in me a weaker copy of sorrow—the physics-style statement of sympathy from which Smith's whole Theory of Moral Sentiments departs
Modern drill: User research: interviews must rebuild the situation rather than collect stated preferences—field engineering of resonance bandwidth

C-UM-008E.title: Hume's 'Artificial-Virtue Convention' applied today
C-UM-008E.description:
The three rules of property—present possession, occupancy, long possession—none has 'natural right'; they were chosen for stability and convenience (the lowest adjudication cost): a cost accounting of convention choice
Modern drill: Platform governance: community norms grow from user interaction, not legal drafting—governance should identify emergent conventions and reinforce them, not parachute rules

C-UM-009E.title: Hume's 'Miracle-Testimony Balance' applied today
C-UM-009E.description:
The audit of the resurrection (Enquiry X): four anonymous gospel transmitters, decades apart, driven by martyrdom ardor—Hume runs the discount checklist item by item, arguing the testimony's falsehood is anything but miracle-improbable
Modern drill: Information literacy: for a viral 'on-site video,' audit the first-hand source and the transmission chain—a letter forwarded a billion times is still one letter

C-UM-010E.title: Hume's 'Quantity-of-Money Mechanism' applied today
C-UM-010E.description:
The anatomy of American bullion: the Political Discourses traces how New World gold enriched particular hands first, raised prices industry by industry, and lifted wages last—'during the transition, industry and commerce may flourish'—the temporal structure of transmission written whole for the first time
Modern drill: Reading monetary policy: central-bank chapters on transmission (policy rate to credit to investment to prices, with lags at each link) are Humean tracking—read the lag, not the single rate hike

C-CHU-001E.title: Churchill's 'Rhetoric-as-Mobilization' applied today
C-CHU-001E.description:
The resignation ultimatum of 28 May 1940: at the war-cabinet meeting where Halifax pushed a Mussolini back-channel and Chamberlain wavered, Churchill declared 'better we should all resign'—the decision-core of mobilization: physically deleting 'negotiation' from the agenda with the threat of resignation
Modern drill: Crisis leadership: the CEO or commander completes the contest of definition (transformation or failure?) within 48 hours of the bad news—each day of delay solidifies the default narrative

C-CHU-002E.title: Churchill's 'Wilderness-Dissent Machine' applied today
C-CHU-002E.description:
Quarterly reconciliation of Luftwaffe figures: through Foreign Office intelligence officer Ralph Wigram (later silenced by superiors) and the 'Focus' network, Churchill's German squadron counts in the Commons ran above the official White Papers—and proved near-true afterward; the evidentiary basis of his being 'the only man available' in 1940
Modern drill: Risk research and short-selling: a short report's value lies in reconciliation (line-item citations, traceable publication), not vehemence—wilderness cries with unverifiable sources trade at a discount

C-CHU-003E.title: Churchill's 'History-Self-Forging' applied today
C-CHU-003E.description:
The Gallipoli rehabilitation project: six volumes of The World Crisis arguing the campaign 'would have shortened the war by two years if properly executed,' with wartime telegrams printed line by line—despite later scholarship's demonstration of failures in intelligence and execution, the 'brilliant plan failed' frame still holds the mainstream textbook and screen interpretations
Modern drill: Founder succession: complete the self-account (memoir, internal history, board post-mortem) before leaving—the interpretive vacuum is short; a year late, rival versions gain a step

C-CHU-004E.title: Churchill's 'Black-Dog Metabolism' applied today
C-CHU-004E.description:
Painting begins, 1915: the weekend he lost the Admiralty over the Dardanelles—'forty, politically dead'—he took up the brush at a friend's Surrey house; four hundred oils followed, painted even on weekends as wartime PM—the formal founding of his unjudged territory
Modern drill: Self-engineering for high-intensity careers: rewrite 'mood management' from 'eliminating bad states' to 'pre-installing outlets for them'—the trough task-list, the unjudged side pursuit, and the humorized writing, in threes

C-CHU-005E.title: Churchill's 'Alliance-Knotting' applied today
C-CHU-005E.description:
The divine service on HMS Prince of Wales (10 August 1941): Churchill arranged British and American crews and both leaders to sing Onward, Christian Soldiers—the Atlantic Charter signed first in 'shared experience' before treaty text; that deposit of goodwill was drawn on repeatedly in Lend-Lease bargaining
Modern drill: M&A and startups: treat founder-to-founder intimacy as a structural part of the deal (shared experiences beforehand, high-frequency correspondence with a temperature differential), not emotional decoration—breakdown risk drops sharply

C-CHU-006E.title: Churchill's 'Intelligence-Primacy' applied today
C-CHU-006E.description:
The ULTRA courier regime: Hut 6's Enigma solutions couriered weekly to Churchill's residence or the War Rooms—files he called 'my golden eggs' and insisted on reading personally—intelligence advantage institutionalized as 'the PM reads the product' into a strategic asset
Modern drill: Corporate decisions: the CEO keeps the right to raw user feedback and raw incident logs; dashboards navigate but do not conclude—summary-level management is intelligence depreciation in business dress

C-CHU-007E.title: Churchill's 'Technology-Catalysis' applied today
C-CHU-007E.description:
The Landships Committee (February 1915): a patchwork of Admiralty, War Office, and industry, from the vague concept of 'a tracked machine to cross trenches' to the 'Little Willie' prototype and production in sixteen months—the tank went from idea to its Somme debut in nineteen, far faster than any regular armament process
Modern drill: Government innovation governance: regulatory sandboxes for disruptive technology (autonomous vehicles, biotech, crypto assets)—the sandbox is political immunosuppression: let the heterogeneous project grow acceptance capability before the system clears it

C-CHU-008E.title: Churchill's 'Paradox-Humor Armor' applied today
C-CHU-008E.description:
The Astor exchange (1920s, oft-cited): 'If you were my husband I'd poison your tea'—'Madam, if you were my wife, I'd drink it'—the textbook of accepting the premise and reversing it; the kill power lies in precision, not volume
Modern drill: Negotiation and meetings: the accept-the-premise-and-reverse reply rebuilds psychological parity better than defense or silence

C-CHU-009E.title: Churchill's 'Rhythm-Endurance' applied today
C-CHU-009E.description:
The wartime slope, five years and a day: from 10 May 1940 to 23 May 1945 without a day off—rising mid-afternoon, dictation in the bath, war meetings at dusk, files until two or three, then a nap—the secretariat rostered in two shifts across the 24 hours, the tempo institutionalized into every post
Modern drill: Long-cycle creators: replace 'waiting for inspiration' with a fixed daily quota (words or canvases)—output equals rhythm times years; inspiration is interest

C-CHU-010E.title: Churchill's 'Iron-Curtain Line-Drawing' applied today
C-CHU-010E.description:
The Fulton address (5 March 1946): Missouri chosen with Truman's tacit consent (he appeared to introduce him, then disowned the content); 'iron curtain' was in global headlines within a day—and the Soviet ambassador Novikov, ordered to rebut it point by point, unwittingly performed the city-by-city 'map verification' the line needed
Modern drill: Cybersecurity: naming APT groups (the Bear, the Panda families) is where industry-wide collaborative defense begins—before the name, vendors fight alone; after, indicators are shared

C-QXS-001E.title: Qian Xuesen's 'Level-Climbing Solution' applied today
C-QXS-001E.description:
The Kármán-Tsien rule (1939): the subsonic compressible pressure correction for airfoils—not by cracking the nonlinear equations but by linearizing in the hodograph plane, one order more accurate than the Prandtl-Glauert approximation and standard in American aeronautics for twenty years; the textbook case of straightening equations by changing coordinates
Modern drill: Algorithm engineering: before performance tuning, run a level audit—does the problem yield at the database, cache, or architecture level? Tuning parameters on the wrong floor is the classic resource black hole

C-QXS-002E.title: Qian Xuesen's 'Overall-Design-Department' applied today
C-QXS-002E.description:
DF-2's crash and rebirth (1962-64): the maiden flight fell at 69 seconds—the department attributed it to the coupling of airframe elastic vibration with the control system, not to a single part, and led the 'ground-tests-first' reorganization (an eighteen-item ground-test program including a full-rocket vibration tower), succeeding with the improved model in 1964; the textbook case of interface attribution
Modern drill: Software engineering: make the architect and the architecture-governance board an entity with veto power, not an honorary title—microservices shatter the system; only the overall function can stitch it back

C-QXS-003E.title: Qian Xuesen's 'Reliability-from-Organization' applied today
C-QXS-003E.description:
The eighteen ground tests (1962-64): after DF-2's crash, a full-rocket vibration tower, full-duration engine hot-fires, control-system joint tests and the rest of an eighteen-item ground program, all passed before a second flight—reliability rewritten from 'trial and error in flight' to 'exhaustion on the ground'; the 1964 success as the exemplar of organizational discipline substituting for component advantage
Modern drill: Internet reliability engineering: SRE error budgets, chaos engineering, canary releases—five nines on unreliable cloud components by organizational means, the contemporary literal translation of the method

C-QXS-004E.title: Qian Xuesen's 'Imitate-then-Originate Relay' applied today
C-QXS-004E.description:
DF-1, copied whole (1958-60): Soviet R-2 drawings plus physical prototypes, the Fifth Academy learning as it copied—every 'why' behind a drawing tolerance compiled into internal teaching materials; the copy completed in 1960, the very year of the withdrawal—a race between the learning dividend and the supply cutoff, the former winning by a nose
Modern drill: Chips and semiconductors: planning the foundry-to-own-IP-to-own-architecture relay, with handover criteria written into strategy (nature of the problem list, own verification facilities, supply-cutoff contingency)

C-QXS-005E.title: Qian Xuesen's 'Cybernetic-Feedback Governance' applied today
C-QXS-005E.description:
Engineering Cybernetics as manual-making (1954): turning Wiener's philosophical frame into criteria and algorithms any engineer could look up—its stability chapter cited across American and Soviet engineering; 'manualizing a discipline' as feedback applied at the level of knowledge organization
Modern drill: Management: before any KPI system, audit the controlled variable—can it be measured truthfully? Will it be optimized into itself? How long is the lag to reality?

C-QXS-006E.title: Qian Xuesen's 'Book-as-Legislation' applied today
C-QXS-006E.description:
Engineering Cybernetics as defense and legislation (1954): written after his clearance was revoked, published in English by McGraw-Hill—the book proved to American peers he 'had no secrets left' while fixing cybernetics' teaching structure for the next twenty years; the classic one-book-two-uses
Modern drill: Engineering teams: new architecture starts with the RFC and the architecture handbook, not the code—TOC review is boundary review; newcomers onboard from the manual, not from folklore

C-QXS-007E.title: Qian Xuesen's 'Intelligence-Roadmap' applied today
C-QXS-007E.description:
Taking evidence in Europe (1945): touring Germany with the group—the Braunschweig research complexes, Peenemuende's remains, the von Braun interrogation record flowing straight into the report; every conclusion on 'aviation's next decade' traceable to a field item; the series became the US Air Force's technological constitution for a decade
Modern drill: Corporate strategy: before entering a market or technology, the due-diligence report plus dependency graph—at roadmap review every step must hang on evidence; 'vision-based scheduling' is barred

C-QXS-008E.title: Qian Xuesen's 'Grand-Collaboration Orchestration' applied today
C-QXS-008E.description:
Orchestrating three systems for the two-bomb-combined test (October 1966): the warhead (Second Ministry), the missile (Seventh Ministry), the range (military bases)—the tables meshed all three timelines into one network chart; from charter to success took two years; the engineering summit of cross-system collaboration
Modern drill: Large software-hardware programs: cross-team dependencies in interface-contract tables with joint milestone reviews—standup consensus is not delivery; the table is

C-QXS-009E.title: Qian Xuesen's 'Rhythm-of-Scholarship' applied today
C-QXS-009E.description:
Engineering Cybernetics under house arrest (1950-54): stripped of lab and clearance, he converted 'time with nowhere to go' into a discipline's founding text by fixed writing blocks—rhythm as the counter-technology of environmental deprivation
Modern drill: Researchers and writers: a two-slot system—fixed answering/mail hours plus fixed writing hours—the network and deep work never trespass on each other

C-QXS-010E.title: Qian Xuesen's 'Meta-Synthesis Integration' applied today
C-QXS-010E.description:
The 1990 paper as manifesto: 'open complex giant systems' uniting society, geography, the human body, and the brain in one research program—four classes sharing one methodology (meta-synthesis); the classification itself the last piece of systems science's puzzle
Modern drill: AI research design: engineering human-in-the-loop and 'expert structural priors'—encoding domain experts' causal hypotheses into model structure rather than post-hoc correction

C-HLG-001E.title: Hua Luogeng's 'Thin-Thick-Thin Reading' applied today
C-HLG-001E.description:
The five Tsinghua years (1931-1936): a junior-school graduate clerk finished the entire mathematics curriculum and three languages by 'thickening'—as Hua put it, others worked eight hours while he worked twelve, doing by hand the labor that classmates got in lectures; clerk to instructor in four years
Modern drill: A programmer learning a framework: refuse to stop at the official tutorial—pick one core module and 'thicken' it (rebuild the internals and design motives), then 'thin' it into a note on the framework's three structural decisions; more transferable than ten tutorials

C-HLG-002E.title: Hua Luogeng's 'Bringing the Axe to Lu Ban's Door' applied today
C-HLG-002E.description:
The refutation of Su Jiaju's quintic (1930): a nineteen-year-old Jintan clerk's first showing of the axe, before a Tsinghua professor; the error-catching paper became his life's springboard—proof that even a first performance at the master's door, as mere correction, suffices to be seen by the strongest
Modern drill: Open source: send the pull request to the project's strictest maintainer, not the laxest; a PR rejected three times builds architectural judgment faster than ten mediocre merges

C-HLG-003E.title: Hua Luogeng's 'Exception-as-Springboard' applied today
C-HLG-003E.description:
The Su Jiaju affair (1930-31): the Jintan clerk mailed his anomaly—correcting a Tsinghua professor—to Science; Xiong Qinglai, reading it, asked 'which country did this Hua Luogeng study in,' learned he was a shop clerk, and at once sent for him; the complete specimen of an in-language anomaly plus a discerning gatekeeper
Modern drill: Job-hopping without credentials: don't storm the resume screen—manufacture an anomaly the role cannot refuse: a verifiable solution to the position's real pain point, submitted as work, not CV

C-HLG-004E.title: Hua Luogeng's 'Number-Shape Union' applied today
C-HLG-004E.description:
The jump from number theory to several complex variables (1940s-50s): seeing that the structure of bounded symmetric domains shared a silhouette with group representation theory, he applied the cross-representation vision trained in number theory and opened a new direction—the harmonic analysis of classical domains became foundational
Modern drill: Data science: no statistical conclusion enters a report without its 'shape' (distribution, residual plots)—all-number conclusions are unaudited ledgers; ledger mismatch signals data-quality trouble

C-HLG-005E.title: Hua Luogeng's 'Induction as Ladder' applied today
C-HLG-005E.description:
Mathematical Induction (1963): the method monographized—from 'handshakes among six people' to chessboard covering to program flowcharts, the core demonstration being: stand a minimal case, then seize the growth law; the book enlightened generations of Chinese secondary students
Modern drill: Software: before writing recursion or DP, hand-solve the minimal input and ask whether the transition equation captures all growth; ninety percent of off-by-one bugs come from skipping the minimal rung

C-HLG-006E.title: Hua Luogeng's 'Golden-Section Search' applied today
C-HLG-006E.description:
Catalyst-ratio optimization in chemical plants (Two Methods, 1970s): two tests at 0.618 and mirror, the yield up within a few rounds—the small teams' typical result, single-factory savings often 'hundreds of thousands of yuan a year' in then-money, across thousands of plants
Modern drill: Tuning: for single-parameter performance curves (cache size, timeout, batch size), coarse-scan with 0.618 then refine locally—half the experiment budget of grid enumeration

C-HLG-007E.title: Hua Luogeng's 'Overall-Planning Network' applied today
C-HLG-007E.description:
Tea-making (opening of the 1965 Plain Guide): washing the pot, boiling water, rinsing cups, fetching leaves, each with dependencies—the optimum boils water while doing the rest; a one-minute parable that made overall planning common sense for generations—the text design of popularization is itself a methodological achievement
Modern drill: Personal workflow: draw a five-minute 'today network' each morning and mark the critical path (rarely more than 2-3 items); squeeze only those, let the rest slip—busyness is unrelated to the critical path, the daily reminder

C-HLG-008E.title: Hua Luogeng's 'Dimension-Down Translation' applied today
C-HLG-008E.description:
The folded paper strip (field version of the optimization method): golden-section search as 'tear the strip, find the middle band, keep good drop bad'—millions of workers self-taught; a perfect semantics-inventory execution: not one executable item lost, only the calculus garment shed
Modern drill: Docs engineering: before writing the quick-start, run a semantics-inventory—verify every executable item a new user needs in fifteen minutes against the original method; each miss is a doc defect

C-HLG-009E.title: Hua Luogeng's 'Talent-Funnel Design' applied today
C-HLG-009E.description:
Bringing Chen Jingrun to Beijing (1950s): the Xiamen lecturer, squeezed out while attacking the Goldbach conjecture, was read by Hua and, against resistance, transferred to the Institute with research support; '1+2' appeared in 1966—the funnel design's best dividend; Hua in later years called it one of the two things he was proudest of
Modern drill: Open-source governance: a work-based promotion channel for anonymous contributors (PR quality and design review as the sole basis) plus a mentor-and-resubmit path for first-time rejecters—the maintainer funnel of major GitHub projects is exactly this

C-HLG-010E.title: Hua Luogeng's 'Burning at the Lectern' applied today
C-HLG-010E.description:
The Tokyo lectern (June 12, 1985): mid-lecture on 'theory, application, and popularization' in Japan, heart attack, collapse at the lectern, death that day; he began his public working life at a Tsinghua lectern and left it from a lectern—the isomorphism of first and last makes the closed loop the final signature of his 'identity defined by action' philosophy
Modern drill: Professional identity: choose a core action you can keep doing rather than a title you top out—'researcher' (researching) resists retirement and reorganization better than 'professor' (a post)

C-ZKZ-001E.title: Zhu Kezhen's 'Observation-Before-Theory Method' applied today
C-ZKZ-001E.description:
Ten years at Beijige spreading a nationwide observing network, turning 'Chinese forecasting Chinese weather' from slogan into daily operations
Modern drill: Software observability: lay logs, metrics, and traces before optimizing anything

C-ZKZ-002E.title: Zhu Kezhen's 'Proxy-Record Method' applied today
C-ZKZ-002E.description:
Locating the warm/cold boundary by 'plum trees flourishing in Tang Chang'an, barely surviving by the Southern Song'
Modern drill: Business proxy metrics: retention as a revenue leading indicator—calibrated against actual revenue first

C-ZKZ-003E.title: Zhu Kezhen's 'Long-Series Curve Method' applied today
C-ZKZ-003E.description:
The periodization of four warm and four cold periods, bounded by phenological breaks rather than dynasties
Modern drill: SRE long-window SLO curves: single incidents decide nothing; the quarterly curve decides architecture

C-ZKZ-004E.title: Zhu Kezhen's 'Phenological Dating Method' applied today
C-ZKZ-004E.description:
During the exodus, students and staff logged blooms and bird arrivals along the route—two thousand kilometers, the phenology table never missing a day
Modern drill: Climate-change monitoring: national phenology networks use 'how many days spring came early' as the most legible warming dashboard

C-ZKZ-005E.title: Zhu Kezhen's 'The-Diary-as-Instrument Method' applied today
C-ZKZ-005E.description:
Paper exhausted on the march, he continued on matchboxes and cigarette cartons—the diary never broke
Modern drill: Developer worklogs and ADRs: decisions written same-day, traceable later

C-ZKZ-006E.title: Zhu Kezhen's 'Elements-of-a-University Method' applied today
C-ZKZ-006E.description:
Four relocations over two thousand kilometers with roster and chairs intact; the university reopened in halls and temples and tripled in size
Modern drill: Remote-first organizations: the office lease is discardable; key people, code, and decision records are not

C-ZKZ-007E.title: Zhu Kezhen's 'Night-Watchman-For-Truth Method' applied today
C-ZKZ-007E.description:
Refusing to sign Yu Zisan's 'suicide' verdict; examining the body's wounds himself and testifying to reporters
Modern drill: Corporate compliance: a CFO or auditor refusing to sign false statements—the refusal itself archived as future evidence

C-ZKZ-008E.title: Zhu Kezhen's 'Go-Player's-Layout Method' applied today
C-ZKZ-008E.description:
The 1956 Survey Commission growing into the national scientific vanguard spanning deserts, water transfer, and the plateau
Modern drill: Corporate research arms: pre-place observation posts and talent for the industry's inevitable ten-year questions

C-ZKZ-009E.title: Zhu Kezhen's 'Ledger-Self-Governance Method' applied today
C-ZKZ-009E.description:
After the Yishan bombing, full casualty and property counts posted within forty-eight hours, compensation paid within a week
Modern drill: Open-source governance: public RFCs/ADRs and numbered issues—the community audits by default

C-ZKZ-010E.title: Zhu Kezhen's 'Reading-History-as-Curve Method' applied today
C-ZKZ-010E.description:
Compiling the Book of Songs, the Lüshi Chunqiu, the Qimin Yaoshu, and the Qing court's daily weather logs into one five-thousand-year temperature curve
Modern drill: Digital humanities: quantifying literature and archives via word frequencies, toponyms, and price series

C-MYS-001E.title: Mao Yisheng's 'Failure-as-Master Method' applied today
C-MYS-001E.description:
Designing the Qiantang bridge (1933-35): failure list first—silt (water-jet caissons), bore (cofferdams timed off spring tides), scour (riprap protection), ship strike (stiffer piers), typhoon (girder erection in wind windows); five deaths, five defenses; zero natural failures from opening to wartime destruction
Modern drill: Software architecture review: before launch write the list of 'all the ways this system dies' (data loss, traffic spikes, dependency outages, accidental deletion); map each death to a defense (backup, rate limiting, circuit breaker, permissions); blank lines block launch

C-MYS-002E.title: Mao Yisheng's 'Constraint-Conversion Method' applied today
C-MYS-002E.description:
Birth of the water-jet (1934-35): against forty meters of quicksand, physical translation first—'saturated sand liquefies under disturbance and loses bearing'—then pairing: existing caissons failed (the sand would grip a sinking caisson), so high-pressure jets were invented to scour and assist sinking—the constraint converted into the starting point of Chinese deep-foundation practice
Modern drill: Startup resource constraints: translate 'no marketing budget' into 'what is the physics of customer-acquisition cost,' forcing invention of growth mechanisms (content-led acquisition, viral loops) rather than surrender or burn—the obstacle list rewritten as an invention list

C-MYS-003E.title: Mao Yisheng's 'Parallel-Erection Method' applied today
C-MYS-003E.description:
Three parallel lines at the Qiantang (1935-37): pier, girder, and erection lines interlocking—caissons sinking while girders fabricated while finished spans erected—total schedule halved; the complete execution sample
Modern drill: Software releases: turn the serial dev-test-ops pipeline into CI/CD parallelism (testing interlocked with development, canary and ops readiness in parallel)—release cycles from months to days; waiting is software's costliest material

C-MYS-004E.title: Mao Yisheng's 'Practice-Before-Theory Method' applied today
C-MYS-004E.description:
Tangshan Jiaotong's curriculum reform (1920s-30s): freshmen surveying and testing on site from year one, 'examinations paired with workshop' written into the rules; graduates famed for site judgment, becoming the cradle of engineers for the Qiantang and Wuhan Yangtze bridges
Modern drill: Programming education: build a real small product with real users before studying computer science systematically—problem system before symbol system, with an anchor for every concept in theory class

C-MYS-005E.title: Mao Yisheng's 'Design-for-Destruction Method' applied today
C-MYS-005E.description:
Demolition points reserved at the Qiantang (1937): blast-position drawings made during construction—eighty-nine days after opening, the bridge blown by its own drawings to halt the Japanese; the direct product of putting war on the failure list
Modern drill: Data-system design: deletability as a first-class requirement—physical deletion paths, synchronized purge of backups, auditable deletion records; GDPR's right to erasure is design-for-destruction legislated

C-MYS-006E.title: Mao Yisheng's 'Water-Jet Foundation Method' applied today
C-MYS-006E.description:
The water jet (1934-35): high-pressure jets scouring the sand while caissons sank by their own weight—'making liquefaction work for you' engineered; the starting point of Chinese deep-foundation practice
Modern drill: AI R&D: translate 'the model is unusable' into mechanisms (data quality, evaluation blind spots, alignment failure) and design an intervention per item—refusing analogy-style escapes like 'use a bigger model'

C-MYS-007E.title: Mao Yisheng's 'Bridge-Talks Popularization Method' applied today
C-MYS-007E.description:
China's Stone Arches (1962): from the thesis 'stone arches are an innovation of world bridge history' down to the concrete image of 'two small arches on each shoulder of the great arch' at Zhaozhou—hundreds of millions of students anchored their first engineering cognition to a bridge they might have walked; half a century in textbooks
Modern drill: Product launches: open not with spec tables but from scenes users already live ('the moment your phone dies'), mapping the product's principle onto it—experiential anchoring converts better than spec lists

C-MYS-008E.title: Mao Yisheng's 'Demolish-to-Rebuild Method' applied today
C-MYS-008E.description:
The demolition (23 December 1937): eighty-nine days after opening, the bridge destroyed by its reserved blast plan—clean, timely, to the drawing; the moment of 'building it was patriotism; blowing it is patriotism too'
Modern drill: Strategic pivot: when the star product conflicts with the new strategy, cut by the aid-the-enemy inflection; pre-ordering (mission priority written in peacetime) plus trade accounting (resources, focus, reputation gained by cutting) spares the pivot internal strife

C-MYS-009E.title: Mao Yisheng's 'Reading-Roots-from-History Method' applied today
C-MYS-009E.description:
The mechanics of Zhaozhou (1950s-60s): the spandrel arch translated as 'reduced main-arch thrust plus added flood discharge' with load recomputation—a Sui-dynasty bridge becoming a case study in modern structural mechanics
Modern drill: Software engineering: read principles from the literature of mainframe-era system design (fault tolerance, batch processing, caching)—architecture decisions in 'ancient code' answer mechanism problems cloud-native still faces

C-MYS-010E.title: Mao Yisheng's 'One-Life-Three-Crafts Method' applied today
C-MYS-010E.description:
Eleven years at the Qiantang (1933-46): the peak of the building post—build, destroy, rebuild, an experience that at once became the core case library of his later teaching and writing (the building→transmission/recording pipe opened immediately)
Modern drill: Technical careers: the senior engineer unfolds as build systems→lead teams and teach→write books and keep the knowledge base—one technical core, three survival forms; the post-forty career anxiety is essentially a post-timing problem

C-P23F-001E.title: Phase23Final's 'Pure-Increment Merge Method' applied today
C-P23F-001E.description:
Entering Mao Yisheng (t_845f9f75, commit 1f08fe0): the five-piece payload merged as pure increment—10 modes, 10+10 scenarios, 40 tags, one code_maps entry, library 1112→1122, zero alteration of prior entries, 162-item independent spot check all PASS
Modern drill: Team code review: a PR may only add files or functions; edits to existing code open a separate refactor PR—reviewers read only additions, and changes roll back independently

C-P23F-002E.title: Phase23Final's 'Dual-Mirror Isomorphism Method' applied today
C-P23F-002E.description:
Mao Yisheng's dual mirrors (t_83774645→t_845f9f75): one render by build_mys.py produced three identical copies; at entry the data/figures and docs/figures sha256 (96bdd4c4) matched the working draft word for word—generated mirrors, zero drift
Modern drill: Technical documentation: READMEs and API docs generated from code comments or OpenAPI specs—doc and code updates merge in one PR, drift intercepted at CI

C-P23F-003E.title: Phase23Final's 'Dangling-Reference Zeroing Method' applied today
C-P23F-003E.description:
Zeroing Zhu Kezhen's fused ids (commit 4a89ae4): three fusions like 'M-ZKZ-010M-ZKZ-006' split into legal id pairs, synced across main library, embedded copy, and both mirrors—after repair, dangling references stood at 0 library-wide
Modern drill: Team wiki governance: CI runs dead-link patrols; a new page citing a nonexistent one blocks the merge—'create the target before citing' becomes the default order

C-P23F-004E.title: Phase23Final's 'Range-Reservation Method' applied today
C-P23F-004E.description:
The triple occupancy check of verify_mys.py (T35/T36/T37): no H-MYS in code_maps, no M-MYS in the main library, no C-MYS in the scenario banks—Mao Yisheng's full namespace security check before entry
Modern drill: Microservice teams: services/topics/queues allocated by 'team-prefix + resource-name' registry—two teams wanting the same name resolve on the registry, not in production

C-P23F-005E.title: Phase23Final's 'Verification-First Method' applied today
C-P23F-005E.description:
Mao Yisheng's 162 assertions (verify_mys.py plus independent spot check): schema key-set equality with the template, bilingual triples, list lengths, related_modes validity, triple occupancy checks, scenario id pairing, hash reconciliation—all PASS before entry
Modern drill: TDD: write tests before implementation—red, green, refactor; 'tests as spec' locks the acceptance standard before the first line of code

C-P23F-006E.title: Phase23Final's 'Scenario-Mapping Method' applied today
C-P23F-006E.description:
Mao Yisheng's full scenario set (t_845f9f75): C-MYS-001~010 and 001E~010E paired from one source—C-MYS-001 running from the Qiantang failure list straight to a software-architecture drill performable this afternoon
Modern drill: Corporate training design: every methodology course must ship an action card doable Monday morning—points without action cards are not scheduled

C-P23F-007E.title: Phase23Final's 'Cross-Reference Weaving Method' applied today
C-P23F-007E.description:
Mao Yisheng's three-thread weave (figure cross_references): Qian Xuesen (pole-contrast), Hua Luogeng (popularization kin), Zhu Kezhen (recording kin)—every thread with a full relational note, all targets in-library
Modern drill: Team knowledge-base norms: a new doc must link at least three existing ones with stated relations—'written but unfindable' becomes institutionally impossible

C-P23F-008E.title: Phase23Final's 'Hash-Anchoring Method' applied today
C-P23F-008E.description:
Mao Yisheng's hash reconciliation (t_83774645→t_845f9f75): figure json sha256 04a15217 matching upstream, md dual mirror 96bdd4c4 identical across three copies—the entry report testifying by hash
Modern drill: Software releases: publish a checksum per artifact and ask users to verify—'did the download complete' moves from prayer to one command

C-P23F-009E.title: Phase23Final's 'Baseline-Accounting Method' applied today
C-P23F-009E.description:
Mao Yisheng's four-account entry (commit 1f08fe0): '1112->1122 modes, 1183->1193 scenarios, 1690->1730 tags, figures 126->127'—one merge's complete scale ledger
Modern drill: Warehouse operations: record per-table row counts before and after every ETL—counts off means alarms; data loss exposes at the pipeline

C-P23F-010E.title: Phase23Final's 'Final-Retrospective Method' applied today
C-P23F-010E.description:
The Phase 21 FINAL sync (commit e35bf6a): the boards→workspace full mirror—four final-check assertions ('792 IDs unique, related_modes zero dangling, dual-mirror sha256 identical, QA 15/15 PASS') as the sealing declaration
