C-RFR-010E.text: A core open-source maintainer is diagnosed with a serious illness; panic spreads through the project. He applies unfinished-closure and accelerates the handover: within two weeks documentation, permissions and in-flight funding (sponsor contracts) are packaged as a 'successor kit', two co-maintainers designated, and the final public release ships on schedule. A year later he has stepped back and the release cadence has not broken — a career's completeness lies not in how far he ran but in whether someone stood where he stopped.

C-WAT-001E.civilization: 苏格兰启蒙运动：格拉斯哥大学'以教养养工匠'的独特生态（布莱克、亚当·斯密、罗比森的同廊而过）、长老会商人家庭的动手传统与实用精神、月社（Lunar Society）的科学家-制造商联盟、专利制度与议会游说所代表的英国产权政治、苏格兰-英格兰之间的工程师劳动力市场
C-WAT-001E.text: A marketplace's return rate jumped eight points quarter over quarter, and the ops meeting sprouted theories: slow logistics, a redesigned product page, competitor discounting. The new head of data borrowed the loss-audit method: before entertaining any hypothesis, turn 'returns' into a metered account — a four-way cross of category, warehouse, carrier and page-version showed that 'eight points' was really 6.1 points of damage returns on bulky furniture from one East-coast warehouse via one carrier. The fix two weeks later was not 'overhaul logistics' but renegotiating packaging standards with one carrier and adding a cushioning line at one warehouse. 'Settle the per-stroke account before touching a screw' became line one of the team's retrospective template.

C-WAT-002E.civilization: 苏格兰启蒙运动：格拉斯哥大学'以教养养工匠'的独特生态（布莱克、亚当·斯密、罗比森的同廊而过）、长老会商人家庭的动手传统与实用精神、月社（Lunar Society）的科学家-制造商联盟、专利制度与议会游说所代表的英国产权政治、苏格兰-英格兰之间的工程师劳动力市场
C-WAT-002E.text: A content platform's moderation team was stuck in a dilemma: loose standards raised liability, tight ones drove creators away, and every predecessor had hunted the same golden middle, making things worse each time. The new lead borrowed the decoupling method: stop turning one knob; give 'creator experience' and 'compliance floor' separate houses — light review at publish with instant visibility (the hot cylinder), asynchronous deep review deciding only demotion and removal (the cold condenser), one status field as the connecting pipe. The looseness debate dissolved: creators wanted immediacy, regulators wanted accountability, and each demand was met the same day instead of cancelling the other.

C-WAT-003E.civilization: 苏格兰启蒙运动：格拉斯哥大学'以教养养工匠'的独特生态（布莱克、亚当·斯密、罗比森的同廊而过）、长老会商人家庭的动手传统与实用精神、月社（Lunar Society）的科学家-制造商联盟、专利制度与议会游说所代表的英国产权政治、苏格兰-英格兰之间的工程师劳动力市场
C-WAT-003E.text: A quant fund's risk chief was told to adopt an 'academically proven' tail-risk model. Borrowing the independent-verification method, he did not plug the paper in — he redid its core experiment on his cleanest year of tick data and found the key assumption failed under his market's microstructure (a fatter tail in price-jump distributions). He did not debunk the paper; he took his own reproduction to the authors over video and reconciled line by line; the authors confirmed the applicability boundary and supplied a correction. Only reproduced models go to production, and the team's rule became: 'every cited model in production must have had its core experiment re-done by someone inside.'

C-WAT-004E.civilization: 苏格兰启蒙运动：格拉斯哥大学'以教养养工匠'的独特生态（布莱克、亚当·斯密、罗比森的同廊而过）、长老会商人家庭的动手传统与实用精神、月社（Lunar Society）的科学家-制造商联盟、专利制度与议会游说所代表的英国产权政治、苏格兰-英格兰之间的工程师劳动力市场
C-WAT-004E.text: A payments company's core path threw intermittent timeouts while every dashboard stayed green; on-call engineers gambled on restarts. The new architect borrowed the revealing-instrument method: first the glass vessel — sampling 1% of production into full request/response time pairs (qualitative watching) confirmed the delay sat in lock waits on the downstream risk service; then the indicator — automatically plotting lock-wait against concurrency into a daily chart (quantitative record). The chart's unmistakable staircase exposed an hourly concurrency pulse from a marketing campaign. Three weeks later timeouts fell from 0.4% to 0.03% — and the team kept not just the fix but a work-loop diagram to reconcile against for years.

C-WAT-005E.civilization: 苏格兰启蒙运动：格拉斯哥大学'以教养养工匠'的独特生态（布莱克、亚当·斯密、罗比森的同廊而过）、长老会商人家庭的动手传统与实用精神、月社（Lunar Society）的科学家-制造商联盟、专利制度与议会游说所代表的英国产权政治、苏格兰-英格兰之间的工程师劳动力市场
C-WAT-005E.text: An industrial energy-services firm kept getting squeezed at the negotiating table: 'you claim you save power — why should we believe it?' The new CEO borrowed the standard-unit method: with a third-party lab he first defined a standard measurement for 'kWh saved per tonne of product' and published it in an industry white paper, then priced the contract on it — a base fee plus a share of metered savings. Average negotiation fell from five weeks to two, because the argument shifted from 'how much do you really save' to 'how to split the number the white-paper method produces'. Three years on, the metric his firm defined was written into the provincial subsidy's application standard — the author of the yardstick had become the market's price-setter.

C-WAT-006E.civilization: 苏格兰启蒙运动：格拉斯哥大学'以教养养工匠'的独特生态（布莱克、亚当·斯密、罗比森的同廊而过）、长老会商人家庭的动手传统与实用精神、月社（Lunar Society）的科学家-制造商联盟、专利制度与议会游说所代表的英国产权政治、苏格兰-英格兰之间的工程师劳动力市场
C-WAT-006E.text: A surgical-robotics startup had stalled for two years: the prototype was superb in the lab, but production yield sat under 40% while the team ground its own gears. The new VP of engineering borrowed the bottleneck-outsourcing method: triage the blocker first — the control algorithms (principle) were world-class in-house; what was stuck was harmonic-gear machining precision (process). He shut the internal gear shop, wrote 'how precise' into a tolerance spec, toured the country's precision shops and found an old telescope-mount factory, bound by an exclusive supply contract with acceptance on the startup's side. Six months later: 92% yield. The retrospective line: 'our bottleneck lives in someone else's domain — the shortest path is asking the owner to open the door, not climbing the wall.'

C-WAT-007E.civilization: 苏格兰启蒙运动：格拉斯哥大学'以教养养工匠'的独特生态（布莱克、亚当·斯密、罗比森的同廊而过）、长老会商人家庭的动手传统与实用精神、月社（Lunar Society）的科学家-制造商联盟、专利制度与议会游说所代表的英国产权政治、苏格兰-英格兰之间的工程师劳动力市场
C-WAT-007E.text: A medical exoskeleton company found its core transmission sat inside a competitor's patent claim — shipping would mean injunction. The engineering lead borrowed the constraint-substitution method: write the goal as a function ('carry motor torque to the joint with backlash under three degrees'), not a construction; then map the claims line by line — the patent covered the specific construction of a series harmonic drive, not the function. A two-stage belt drive with clutch met the same backlash spec outside the claims, with an exit clause pre-written: switch back on day two after expiry. The design-around cleared FTO counsel and shipped four months late, not never.

C-WAT-008E.civilization: 苏格兰启蒙运动：格拉斯哥大学'以教养养工匠'的独特生态（布莱克、亚当·斯密、罗比森的同廊而过）、长老会商人家庭的动手传统与实用精神、月社（Lunar Society）的科学家-制造商联盟、专利制度与议会游说所代表的英国产权政治、苏格兰-英格兰之间的工程师劳动力市场
C-WAT-008E.text: A materials firm invented a new battery-separator coating, and its CEO wavered between selling product and collecting royalties. The board asked for a review of the Watt case: principle-level patent plus renewal plus litigation maximises monetisation but freezes downstream innovation and invites backlash — high-pressure steam stalled sixteen years inside Watt's patent and rivals charged in at fivefold speed once it lapsed, while Boulton & Watt kept share on first-mover premium. The company chose a hybrid: core-formula patents held and actively licensed (the rent), process equipment and customer service done in-house (the product), licences granted to two competitors to keep the ecosystem alive — collecting rent without freezing, taking Watt's cash flow and refusing his blockade.

C-WAT-009E.civilization: 苏格兰启蒙运动：格拉斯哥大学'以教养养工匠'的独特生态（布莱克、亚当·斯密、罗比森的同廊而过）、长老会商人家庭的动手传统与实用精神、月社（Lunar Society）的科学家-制造商联盟、专利制度与议会游说所代表的英国产权政治、苏格兰-英格兰之间的工程师劳动力市场
C-WAT-009E.text: Two PhDs' synthetic-biology startup failed three raises: the science dazzled, but every investor asked the same question — 'who sells this?' After reviewing the Watt-Roebuck-Boulton cascade, they did three things: drew a list of fatal gaps (money, scale-up, channel, regulatory) and admitted they covered one and a half; recruited a former pharma executive with FDA filing scars and gave him founder-level equity; wrote the division into the charter — founders own the science, the newcomer owns registration and commercialisation. The fourth pitch used the same technical slide plus a gap-and-cover table, and closed oversubscribed. The investor's words: 'you finally know what you are missing.'

C-WAT-010E.civilization: 苏格兰启蒙运动：格拉斯哥大学'以教养养工匠'的独特生态（布莱克、亚当·斯密、罗比森的同廊而过）、长老会商人家庭的动手传统与实用精神、月社（Lunar Society）的科学家-制造商联盟、专利制度与议会游说所代表的英国产权政治、苏格兰-英格兰之间的工程师劳动力市场
C-WAT-010E.text: A 58-year-old database-kernel expert, after his company's acquisition, faced the standard menu: manage people or fade to emeritus. He borrowed the late-career lateral method: inventory the transferable crafts of his peak — reasoning about locks and transactions, intuition for memory layout, instrumented reproduction of failure scenarios; then pick the field densest in need of exactly those crafts — storage engines for genomic sequencing data. A garret start: one open-source columnar compression library as the single work proving the method travels, incorporated two years later. His note to younger colleagues: 'do not look for a second spring inside your old product — your crafts belong to no product; they belong to you.'

C-FOR-001E.civilization: 美国镀金时代与进步时代：中西部农场的实用机械文化、底特律的作坊-工厂生态、爱迪生门洛帕克的发明共同体、大规模移民劳动力的到来、反垄断诉讼与谢尔曼法的产权政治、消费社会与分期付款文化的兴起
C-FOR-001E.text: A chain of health-check clinics took five days to issue reports and was bleeding customers. Every past director had tried to make doctors write faster. The new operations head borrowed the moving-line method: she traced one sample's five-day journey and found seventy percent of it was 'queuing for a person', not 'waiting for a process'. She inverted the view: let the sample move and the people hold stations — blood draw, centrifuge, assay, review and release arranged as a scheduled internal shuttle, each hop time-boxed, overdue samples auto-escalating. Reporting fell to 36 hours. Her retrospective line: 'we kept hurrying the people — it was the sample we should have hurried.'

C-FOR-002E.civilization: 美国镀金时代与进步时代：中西部农场的实用机械文化、底特律的作坊-工厂生态、爱迪生门洛帕克的发明共同体、大规模移民劳动力的到来、反垄断诉讼与谢尔曼法的产权政治、消费社会与分期付款文化的兴起
C-FOR-002E.text: A collaboration product had swollen to 217 settings; customer success exhausted itself explaining, and bug fixes crawled. The new CPO borrowed the radical-simplification method with one rule — 'ask whether it can be deleted before asking whether it can be changed'. In six months, 89 settings went, 61 replaced by defaults; the configuration space shrank from astronomical to testable, and the defect rate fell with it. The fiercest resistance came from sales — until two enterprise deals came back with 'your software finally feels designed'. The product meeting now opens with one question: 'what exactly do we lose if this feature never existed?'

C-FOR-003E.civilization: 美国镀金时代与进步时代：中西部农场的实用机械文化、底特律的作坊-工厂生态、爱迪生门洛帕克的发明共同体、大规模移民劳动力的到来、反垄断诉讼与谢尔曼法的产权政治、消费社会与分期付款文化的兴起
C-FOR-003E.text: A coffee chain wanted to enter the value segment, and procurement and finance said: 'the cost is the cost — a low price is not possible.' The CEO borrowed price-back: pin the target first — a nine-yuan Americano — then back-solve: a blend instead of single-origin, standardised cup sizes, a re-flowed store doubling labour productivity, packaging from seven print layers to two. Fourteen months later the nine-yuan tier turned a profit per store, and because the price was a promise rather than a promotion, repeat purchases climbed. His line to the team: 'cost is history; price is a vow — set the vow and the history must change.'

C-FOR-004E.civilization: 美国镀金时代与进步时代：中西部农场的实用机械文化、底特律的作坊-工厂生态、爱迪生门洛帕克的发明共同体、大规模移民劳动力的到来、反垄断诉讼与谢尔曼法的产权政治、消费社会与分期付款文化的兴起
C-FOR-004E.text: A warehouse-automation firm kept missing deliveries because its assembly technicians kept leaving — rivals poached them at twenty percent above market. The new GM, having costed the churn, borrowed the wage-cycle method: top-of-market pay for the assembly floor, tiered by certified skill. On the payroll sheet it looked like cost; but shorter delivery cycles pulled advance payments in earlier and cash flow improved — and departed technicians began recommending their old employer in trade groups. Renewals hit a record. At the board he showed one sheet: 'what low wages save' against 'what delays burn' — and the argument ended.

C-FOR-005E.civilization: 美国镀金时代与进步时代：中西部农场的实用机械文化、底特律的作坊-工厂生态、爱迪生门洛帕克的发明共同体、大规模移民劳动力的到来、反垄断诉讼与谢尔曼法的产权政治、消费社会与分期付款文化的兴起
C-FOR-005E.text: A prepared-meal company's margin was eaten by three layers of distributors and outsourced cold chain, with peak-season capacity spikes and late deliveries on top. The founder borrowed vertical integration — not all of it, ranked by volatility: first self-built regional cold-chain hubs (the worst seasonal choke), then consolidated the two core product plants; upstream farming and downstream retail stayed on the market. Eighteen months on, peak fulfilment rose from 71% to 97% and costs fell — booked entirely as profit since prices never moved. His post-mortem: 'integration is not a faith; it is a diagnosis of which link is least reliable — misdiagnosed, integration is a liability.'

C-FOR-006E.civilization: 美国镀金时代与进步时代：中西部农场的实用机械文化、底特律的作坊-工厂生态、爱迪生门洛帕克的发明共同体、大规模移民劳动力的到来、反垄断诉讼与谢尔曼法的产权政治、消费社会与分期付款文化的兴起
C-FOR-006E.text: A EV maker faced a wave of retired batteries it paid to dispose of as hazardous waste. The new circular-assets director borrowed the waste-monetisation method: build the waste ledger first — graded testing sent eighty percent of iron-phosphate packs into second-life storage cabinets; the rest dismantled for lithium, copper and aluminium; even the wooden packing frames became returnable pallets billed per use. Within two years a 'disposal budget' had become a 'circular-assets profit centre', and the storage division now buys retired batteries from the car side — the waste stream turned procurement channel.

C-FOR-007E.civilization: 美国镀金时代与进步时代：中西部农场的实用机械文化、底特律的作坊-工厂生态、爱迪生门洛帕克的发明共同体、大规模移民劳动力的到来、反垄断诉讼与谢尔曼法的产权政治、消费社会与分期付款文化的兴起
C-FOR-007E.text: A robotics firm found its whole category shadowed by an umbrella patent: the holder manufactured nothing and lived on licences, suing whoever refused. The CEO borrowed the patent-breaking method: three independent claim dissections by patent counsel confirmed coverage of only one specific transmission layout; a public, streamed technical forum made the difference legible to the industry; and an open pledge — 'even if we win, we charge no royalties' — rallied dealers across the trade. Eighteen months later the patent was partly invalidated and the licensing ring dissolved. His word to peers: 'the wall-breaker's true prize is not his own rent-free status, but bringing the whole industry from the courtroom back to the lab.'

C-FOR-008E.civilization: 美国镀金时代与进步时代：中西部农场的实用机械文化、底特律的作坊-工厂生态、爱迪生门洛帕克的发明共同体、大规模移民劳动力的到来、反垄断诉讼与谢尔曼法的产权政治、消费社会与分期付款文化的兴起
C-FOR-008E.text: An agri-IoT firm launched smart water pumps in Southeast Asia; the city team designed an app, cloud subscription and professional installation. The regional lead borrowed the farm-craft method, writing the user into physical constraints: 'in the field, in the monsoon, one pair of hands, no stable power' — a pump maintainable by hand, solar-driven, tunable by a local dial with no network, the app demoted to an option; sales points in township farm-supply stores, not city showrooms. Year one rural volume was triple the urban version's. Printed on the manual's flyleaf: 'ask first whether a farmer can repair it, not whether it dazzles.'

C-FOR-009E.civilization: 美国镀金时代与进步时代：中西部农场的实用机械文化、底特律的作坊-工厂生态、爱迪生门洛帕克的发明共同体、大规模移民劳动力的到来、反垄断诉讼与谢尔曼法的产权政治、消费社会与分期付款文化的兴起
C-FOR-009E.text: A battery-cell maker was losing the price war; the CFO wanted to 'cut to cash cost and survive'. The new strategy head borrowed the scale-cost method: fit the firm's own learning curve — a 12% unit-cost drop per doubling of capacity — then publicly announce 'five percent off every quarter, eight quarters running', turning the cut into a marching order for the plant; expansion back-scheduled from the price targets, orders flooding in at the low price to feed the curve. Eight quarters later costs were down 33%, the rival that had cut 40% was dead, and gross margin was back to pre-war levels.

C-FOR-010E.civilization: 美国镀金时代与进步时代：中西部农场的实用机械文化、底特律的作坊-工厂生态、爱迪生门洛帕克的发明共同体、大规模移民劳动力的到来、反垄断诉讼与谢尔曼法的产权政治、消费社会与分期付款文化的兴起
C-FOR-010E.text: A national social app had ridden 'simple plus free' to the top, then five years of increasingly timid iteration — every change vetoed with 'the old users will mind'. The new product lead put the formula-expiry method on the table: write down the four assumptions of 'why we win', then build a soft-signal dashboard — complaint keywords, rival downloads, churn reasons — to monitor the formula's decay before DAU falls. In month three the alarm lit: Gen-Z users named a rival's group-chat stickers as their switching reason. The team launched a second product line while daily actives still sat at their peak; two years on, as the old app plateaued, the new line took the baton. The CEO at the retrospective: 'the best time to change over is the moment you least want to.'

C-MAT-001E.civilization: 明治-昭和日本：纪州藩士没落之后的大阪学徒传统、关西'服务至上'的商人伦理（石田梅岩'石门心学'的市井余脉）、大正-昭和电气化大众消费的黎明、战后财阀解体与金库（系列）企业群的崛起、儒家'教养主义'与神道'产业报国'精神在公司伦理中的合流
C-MAT-001E.text: An industrial-grade air-quality instrument company had stalled: top-tier accuracy, six-figure unit prices, customers limited to environmental bureaus and big-factory labs. The new CEO applied the tap-water test as an ordering rule: ask first where air quality ranks among ordinary life's necessities — the answer was schools, property managers, chain restaurants, mass scenes that could never afford six figures. The firm chartered a hundred-yuan-class home detector: target price set at 'one takeout meal', sensor and cloud-calibration architecture derived backwards, penetration rate rather than gross margin as the north-star metric. Three years later the home line carried 70% of revenue, and the industrial line's premium rose on the back of the brand's ubiquity — 'fix the price everyone can pay, then go build it' sat on page one of the project brief.

C-MAT-002E.civilization: 明治-昭和日本：纪州藩士没落之后的大阪学徒传统、关西'服务至上'的商人伦理（石田梅岩'石门心学'的市井余脉）、大正-昭和电气化大众消费的黎明、战后财阀解体与金库（系列）企业群的崛起、儒家'教养主义'与神道'产业报国'精神在公司伦理中的合流
C-MAT-002E.text: A SaaS product VP caught himself defending the product in every customer interview; his notes read more and more like briefs for the defence. He forced the unbiased-mind discipline: freeze the roadmap before the interview and declare 'today, listening only'; when the urge to rebut rose, mark a 'defence' glyph in the margin instead of speaking; after each session, restate the problem in the customer's own words for confirmation. In the first strictly kept interview he found that the 'slow reports' customers cursed were really 'three manual edits before the report can face the boss' — the requirements list was rewritten. His rule for the team became Atami in one line: 'until you have restated and been confirmed, you heard only your own version.'

C-MAT-004E.text: A cross-border e-commerce firm ran three years of 100% growth, shareholders pressing every profit into warehouse expansion. Two years on, a sudden platform-rule change plus a currency crash hit together; peers fire-sold inventory, while this firm released the dam by plan — reserve cash buying the fire-sale stock, elastic compute absorbing sellers defecting from rivals. C-MAT-005E.text: Rumours ran through a 200-person design studio: 'the boss landed a big job and withheld bonuses', 'we are being acquired'. Within three months, 'information anxiety' as a stated reason in exit interviews fell from 60% to 12%; the surprise was employees flagging cost waste on their own — the 'the ledger is mine' effect. C-MAT-006E.text: At a trillion-scale internet company a homepage redesign crossed nine approval layers; innovation died in the process. Six months later those accounts renewed at 95%. Sales summed it up: 'in those three days we never once pitched the product — and closed the biggest deal of the year.'

The final plan shipped two icons by user segment — the icon quarrel turned into a convention census. 'Icons have no natural meaning' written as chapter one of the design spec.

C-LZH-001E.civilization: The scene of intellectual history from the 1950s to the new century: a poor and solitary boyhood in Changsha, Hunan — father dead early, mother a primary-school teacher supporting the family; as he said of himself, 'I grew up in loneliness, and toward life I have always carried a deep suspicion and sadness'; study at Peking University's philosophy department in the 1950s and youthful fame with the study of Kang Youwei and Tan Sitong — entering the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences before thirty, founding his own position in the aesthetics debates with the 'unity of objectivity and sociality'; the years of the cadre school, secretly reading Kant and Marx in English editions — writing on those lamp-lit nights the Critique of Critical Philosophy that would later shake the intellectual world; the decade 1979-1988, when The Path of Beauty, Chinese Aesthetics, Four Essays on Aesthetics and the three histories of ancient, modern and contemporary Chinese thought appeared in succession, making him the preacher of the new aesthetics and the 'spiritual guide' of the 1980s — young people queuing at Peking University for his lectures, the 'aesthetics fever' and 'culture fever' rising at his call; the drifting life after moving abroad in 1988, the estrangement from a 1990s turn when 'scholarship came on stage and thought exited', the refusals in old age — including refusals of the title 'master of national learning' — and a solitude of the kind 'I love you, but it is none of your business'; in his mountain retreat in Colorado writing the Anthropological-Historical Ontology and 'seeking one who knows the tune on high mountains and flowing water' — one of the last men in late twentieth-century Chinese thought who thought with his own head

C-LZH-008E.text: A deadlock in the executive debate over 'should algorithms share revenue with creators': growth proves revenue-sharing kills the growth model, creator-relations proves refusing it kills the ecosystem; the CEO puts it not to a vote but declares a dual-constraint format: every quarter henceforth publishes growth metrics and creator retention together, neither ledger permitted to offset the other; half a year later the solution the team finds is no one's victory but a 'stepped revenue share' grown out of practice — synthesis, he says, is not argued out; it is tried out.

The answer is an internal legend of the support team once 'staying two hours overtime for an elderly customer living alone'; the new version drops the four characters and instead writes the story, the recording of the call, and an annual 'two-extra-hours prize' into the institution — the year the values landed, the support team's voluntary overtime fell for the first time, because 'worth it' had replaced 'must'.

Which partner's sudden absence altered the judgement of the founder? The counterfactual test shows that with another partner at that meeting the project would most likely not have been missed; the team rewrites its rules: no unplanned absence at decisive meetings, and every 'pass decision' must record 'who turned, after which sentence, at which link' — the account kept to the handwriting, not only to the grammar.

C-P25F-001E.text: A consultancy split each client engagement into a research squad and a solution squad, one baton pass between them. The research squad used to paste every hedged interview remark into its handover memo, and the solution squad read 'the client may not be thrilled' as a finding—so every proposal came out defensively bland. The new partner changed the rite: the handover accepts exactly two items, a verified data table and a one-page boundary note stating what is proven and what is still open; interview verbatims and the research squad's internal debates never leave the room. On the next engagement, every judgement the solution squad voiced at the final review traced back to the table, and the client's spot-checks all landed.

C-P25F-002E.text: A game studio shipped build packages to an overseas publisher, declaring 'complete build' in the email body—until the publisher unzipped a package whose resource table had been clipped 200 KB by a mail gateway, and two weeks of finger-pointing followed. The new rite: delivery mails carry only the package's sha256 and byte count, and the publisher's ingest script recomputes the hash as its very first line—mismatch means automatic rejection with the actual value returned. Six months later a CDN sync glitch was caught on the spot by the fingerprint check; nobody had to argue 'I swear I sent the full thing'—the hash testified for everyone.

C-P25F-003E.text: A pharmacy chain merged a newly acquired brand's product catalogue. While importing the new SKUs, an operator helpfully 'corrected' the category codes of three old SKUs, fusing the merge diff into an unreadable blob; at month-end, finance found old-store sales booked under wrong categories and spent two weeks tracing the 'helpful fix'. New rule: import jobs may only append rows; any change to existing data opens its own ticket with separate approval. At the next quarterly import the diff read cleanly—new rows were additions, the ticket was the repair—and the month-end reconciliation took ten minutes.

C-P25F-004E.text: An e-commerce warehouse QC team noticed that their most common loss incident was a 'label applied upside-down'—human eyes caught it every time they looked, yet someone always missed one. Instead of another 'please be careful', the supervisor wrote the shape into the outbound scan as a hard assertion: any mismatch between parcel weight and label dimensions forces a rescan. Three months later that loss class hit zero, freeing the team to chase the newly emerging 'wrong-variant shipment' shape—and to add one more assertion for it. The checklist kept growing, but the misses kept shrinking—the list had become the warehouse's case record.

C-P25F-005E.text: A SaaS firm's pricing appeared in three places—the website, the sales deck template and the support knowledge base—each maintained by hand, until one price change touched only the website: sales quoted the old number, support answered with the old number, three complaints landed in a week. Engineering extracted pricing into a single tokens file, all three surfaces generated from it in one build; the release script hashes all three and asserts identity. C-P25F-006E.text: Before launching a 'next-day across the delta region' service, a logistics company's ops team went straight to writing the landing page and price table. C-P25F-007E.text: A corporate trainer taught the 80/20 rule and examined it with 'give an example of the 80/20 rule'—every learner recited the textbook case (20% of customers yield 80% of revenue), everyone scored full marks. Next year she changed the exam: learners received a wholly alien dataset (a kitchen's food-waste inventory) and had to produce an action plan with the rule. The first cohort could not move; after the redesign, they ranked the waste items, spotted that three dish families drove seventy percent of the loss, and cut prep volume instead of trimming everything—a plan in which the rule visibly runs even with its name covered.

C-P25F-008E.text: Six regional offices of a group filed weekly reports to HQ. East China found the field name 'qoq_growth_rate' awkward and quietly renamed it 'weekly_growth' one day—HQ's aggregation script died that week, and the other five regions lost half a day to the fallout. The group then signed a contract: the report schema frozen for a year, new metrics added as columns without renaming, renames requiring all six regions' co-signature. Over the next two years East China added three metrics without touching a single field name, and HQ's script never changed—the dividend of a constant interface is that everyone forgets it exists.

C-P25F-009E.text: A wiki community's new admin, seeing thousands of red links, moved to bulk-delete them 'for tidiness'. A veteran editor stopped him and ran a typing pass: about a third were mistitled (corrections), two-fifths pointed to topics since split (migrations), and nearly half pointed to articles genuinely worth writing but unwritten (waiting). Deletion would wipe out the last category forever. The community switched to a ledger: red links booked by type, writers claiming the waiting ones, a bot revisiting weekly. Six months later the red-link count had barely dropped, but zero good topics had been destroyed—and the survival rate of newly created articles had doubled.

C-P25F-010E.text: A design studio's quarterly retrospective used to produce sixty slides of inspiration and then dissolve. The new rule: the retro discusses only methods proven effective this quarter, and each is cast on the spot into a method card—number, four-step process, the project that first validated it, its failure conditions—reviewed against the same QA bar the studio applies to client deliverables. The design director's own card failed its first pass (missing failure conditions) and was sent back for recasting. Six months later, new hires read thirty-seven method cards instead of slides, each card pointing back to a real project.

C-ZSS-001E.civilization: The scholar's scene of the Ming-Qing transition and the guest-master's scene of Tokugawa Japan: born 1600 into a family of office in Yuyao, Zhejiang — he watched the factional strife and the Liaodong collapse under Wanli and Tianqi; twice summoned under Chongzhen and three times within a year under Hongguang he declined — he had long ceased to trust a court 'full of lecturers and empty of doers'; after 1645 he ran between Zhoushan and Japan seeking aid, and twice to Annam to rescue loyalist forces; in 1659 (jihaì) he followed Zheng Chenggong into the Yangtze, and after the defeat crossed the sea to Nagasaki at fifty-nine — his bottom line of 'never shaving' nearly stranded him at Nagasaki, until the Yanagawa physician-scholar Andō supported him at the ruin of his family: 'keeping integrity' itself became the credential of transmission; in 1665 Mitsukuni sent for him as guest-master, honoured at Edo and Mito alike: he fixed the Shidian rubrics, drew the academy plans, guided bridges and ritual vessels, taught agronomy and crafts, instructed the heir and the inner circle — the Mito academy, the Yushima Seidō and the great-duty historiography of the Dai Nihonshi all carry his methodic blood; he died at Edo in 1682, Mitsukuni gave the title 'Wengō', and he lies at Mount Zuiryū, the stele reading 'Tomb of Zhu Zhiyu, Zhengjun of Ming' — an old man who lived 'the fallen state' as 'the transmitted lamp': while this body remained, the dress remained, and where the dress remained, rites and music remained
C-ZSS-001E.text: A newly appointed technology VP finds that decisions ride on an 'architecture guru's' eloquence: quietly he abolishes every speculative review, keeping only one gateway — a runnable demo; within three months the slide-deckers fall silent on their own and running systems speak for themselves — the organisation for the first time owns a criterion of knowledge settled by artefacts, not rhetoric.

C-ZSS-010E.text: A twice-failed founder does not write a self-criticism but an attribution ledger: each failure decomposed into institutions (partner mechanics), people (key-role mismatches) and process (scaling tempo), each entry with evidence and counterfactuals — while the value scale ('what kind of company is worth building') stays constant; before his third venture he hands the ledger to every co-founder: a ledger can be taught, and what is taught can be continued.

C-ISA-001E.civilization: The Iberian scene of the later fifteenth century: born in 1451 at Madrigal de las Altas Torres in the heart of Castile — her father John II dead early, her half-brother Henry IV reigning, the court torn to shreds by noble factions; a girlhood spent under cold, guardianship-style custody at Arevalo and Segovia, ringed by nobles coveting the throne and wavering courtiers; the Concord of Toros in 1468 recognized her as Princess of Asturias, and in 1469, at eighteen, she defied every counsel to marry Ferdinand of Aragon in secret — a forged papal bull, a disguised journey, a wedding without royal blessing, traded for the union of the crowns of Castile and Aragon; in 1474, at her brother's death, she was crowned at Segovia's Plaza de San Miguel amid civil war — Portuguese invasion, noble rebellion and a debased coinage pressing in at once; in 1476 she founded the Santa Hermandad, a town militia restoring public order, and the reform Cortes of Toledo and Burgos (1476-78) rebuilt the kingdom's credit in coin, finance and justice; in 1478 a papal bull established the Castilian Inquisition, whose organization was fixed at the Cortes of Toledo in 1480; from 1482 to 1492 the ten-year Granada war — she went to the front in person and commanded through logistics and camp-building; in 1492 Granada fell, the Jews were expelled, and Columbus sailed — three world-history-changing acts completed in a single year; her later years were eaten by grief — Prince John and Princess Isabella died one after the other, mad Juana became heir — and she died at Medina del Campo in 1504. Her life is a complete specimen of 'sovereignty negotiated through marriage, institution built through war, and political cleansing enacted through faith.'
C-ISA-001E.text: An open-source foundation crushed by a large corporation waited two years for a governance seat that never came: the board published 'Foundation Charter 1.0' on its own and began operating under it — creating the fact of 'already self-governing' first; the corporation found that bypassing the foundation cost more than recognizing it, and after six months signed a ratification agreement of its own accord. The crux of the accomplished fact is managing the ratification window: the three successful projects run under the charter were the entire stake at the ratifying table.

C-ISA-010E.text: A founder's will was not an inventory but a governance contract: who acts if the successor proves unfit, the acting party's forbidden zones (core patents from the founding era not to be sold), the buy-back fallback order — three interlocking clauses forming a closed loop; a binding-coverage check followed (family, partners, option pool) and notarization fixed the text. Eight years later the successor proved unfit as foreseen; the company fell back per the clauses without litigation — turning the worst case from a bargaining problem into an execution problem.

C-ECL-001E.civilization: The frontier scene of eleventh-century Iberia: born around 1043 near Vivar, the son of a minor gentry family — his father a knight fallen on hard times, his boyhood passed as a squire between the court of Castile and the palace of Zaragoza; under Fernando I Castile wrestled with the Moorish taifa states to the south — the young Rodrigo distinguished himself in the border wars, and in the battle of Graus in 1063, avenging his slain prince Sancho's heir Urraca's cause, cut down the enemy champion, earning the byname 'El Cid' (from Arabic sayyidi, 'my lord') — and for his feats the name 'Campeador', 'the master of the battlefield'; twice banished after quarrels with the great magnate Garcia Ordonez and King Alfonso VI — on the first banishment (1081) he simply took his followers into the service of the Muslim taifa of Zaragoza, nine years drawing Moorish pay, fighting Christian neighbours, learning Arabic and its arts of state; the campaign of Valencia was the masterpiece of his life: a five-year siege (1092-1094) took the great Mediterranean port, and for five years after he ruled it in his own name and no king's — a Christian monarch without a title, trading and allied with Muslim neighbours, employing Moorish officials, his court hearing at once the suits of Christians and Muslims; after his death in 1099 his wife Jimena held Valencia three years against the Almoravid hosts; his bones were laid beside his horse Babieca — and the Poema de mio Cid, written around 1200, made him the founding epic of the Spanish nation: the knight exiled by court slander who won everything back by his own sword, his own loyalty and his own measure — 'Spain's first national hero', half history, half the casting of a people's heart
C-ECL-001E.text: A senior engineer laid off by a large firm gets a head-hunter's approach: the poacher is the rival company, and his non-compete has four months left; instead of joining quietly he sends the clause's original text to the head-hunter, proposes 'start on the expiry date', and spends the waiting period turning non-covered technical reports into public blog posts; on the day he joins four months later, the new employer writes in an internal letter: the four months we waited bought the four words 'he does as he says' — two years on he is engineering director, with the performance appraisals of both former employers as his letters of credit.

C-ECL-002E.text: A cross-border payments company's compliance officer faces two regulators at once: headquarters demanding 'zero risk in data export', the Chinese regulator demanding 'local data never leaves'; taking neither side, she keeps two ledgers — for headquarters an audit record of 'zero compliance defects'; for the Chinese regulator a published annual list of 'localisation upgrades'; both sides know she works for the other, but neither file holds a single punishable breach — three years on she is the one compliance head in her industry invited to advise by both regulators.

C-ECL-005E.text: In a protracted patent suit the defence changes strategy: no longer seeking to crush the plaintiff, but computing precisely 'the fear water-level at which the other side will settle' — every filing keeps a step for the plaintiff's 'honourable settlement' (no punitive damages sought, public respect for the opposing engineers); meanwhile inside the defendant's company they publish a 'settlement condition list', letting the plaintiff's counsel pick their own steps down; the case settles in month four, at thirty percent of the original claim — and two years later the two firms are cross-licensing partners.

C-ECL-007E.text: A SaaS startup caught between two cloud giants: the 'joint solution' partnerships of both carry exclusivity clauses; the founder restructures the company into the shape 'neither can afford to lose' — the core engine adapted natively to both clouds, a 'neutral layer' published on the public roadmap; BDs from both press for exclusivity, but each side's internal assessment reads 'losing them gives the rival fifteen points of share'; two rounds of exclusivity pressure fail over three years, and the company closes its Series C on the positioning of 'dual-cloud neutral'.

C-ECL-008E.text: The fourth company of a serial founder starts work before the licence: through the fourteen months of the sandbox application, he makes the 'four hard currencies' real — funds in custody with open books (the analogue of fair taxation), published arbitration rules (predictable justice), zero major data-security incidents (reliable defence), a complete performance record with three banks (credible diplomacy); the day the licence is granted, the regulator's approval contains a rare line: 'the entity's compliance during the unlicensed period constitutes a basis of trust' — the title came to ratify the function, not the function to await the title.

C-ECL-009E.text: A documentary director films the biography of a late scientist: relying not on archives alone, she draws a 'two-asset list' — factual assets (original notes, lab records) and narrative assets (colleagues' remembered 'stories', the old watch he always wore, the tale of skipping an award ceremony to teach); she deliberately makes every 'good story' in the narrative assets match the archives, keeping one unverifiable legend (revising a student's paper from his sickbed) but marked 'unverified'; after release, the academy credits the film as 'credible' while the public remembers 'that watch' — archives govern the academy, story governs the heart.

C-ECL-010E.text: A founder's core team has followed him through three pivots: the secret of cross-project recruitment is the 'partnership charter' he has run since the first venture — sharing rules written into every company's shareholders' agreement, no clawbacks or pursuit of leavers, his own share fixed and unprivileged; for the third venture he posts no recruitment notice, only circulating the bound share-ledgers of the first two companies — within two weeks seven veterans are at their desks, two having quit plum jobs at a giant; he says: a recruitment ad can only deceive strangers; a ledger can summon partners.

C-ZHH-001E.civilization: The scientific and official life of the Eastern Han court: born in 78 at Xi'e in Nanyang commandery (today's Nanyang, Henan) into a gentry family in decline — his grandfather Zhang Kan had been governor of Shu but died early, the family fell on hard times, and the young Zhang Heng wrote of himself that he 'worried not about rank's lack of honour but about virtue's lack of grandeur; was ashamed not that emolument was small but that knowledge was not broad' ('Yingjian'); from sixteen he travelled the Three Adjuncts, viewing mountains and rivers, composing the 'Rhapsody on the Hot Springs' around 95; he entered the Imperial Academy at Luoyang, 'thorough in the Five Classics, versed in the Six Arts'; around 100 he served nine years as registrar to Bao De, governor of Nanyang, writing there the 'Eastern Capital' and 'Western Capital' rhapsodies satirising extravagance; summoned by Emperor An in 112 as a palace gentleman, in 115 he was promoted Grand Historian-Astrologer (taishi ling) — an office he held twice (115-120, 126-133) over the heavenly signs, the calendar, divination and the records of the Lingtai observatory; in 117 he cast the water-driven armillary sphere, powered by a water-clock and matching the sky; in 132 he built the seismoscope ('the instrument for feeling the winds and earth-movements') — a bronze vessel with eight dragons holding bronze balls in the eight directions, each dropping into a toad's mouth at an earthquake, the sound announcing the bearing; in 138 a quake struck Longxi, unfelt at the capital, yet the western dragon dropped its ball and 'the scholars in the capital all wondered at its lack of evidence' until days later the courier report arrived proving the Longxi earthquake, 'and all acknowledged its marvel'; he also wrote the 'Ling Xian' on the heavens — proposing an infinite universe ('the bounds of space have no edge; the ends of time no beginning') and the hypothesis that moonlight is reflected sunlight and eclipses the earth's shadow; his computations gave the celestial circumference as 1,036,880.5 (pi about 3.1466); he argued in the calendar controversies that one follows heaven, not human preference, built south-pointing-type vehicles and the odometer drum-cart in the woodwork tradition, and drew geographical maps; late in life as chancellor of Hejian (136-139) he awed the powerful clans and cleansed the kingdom in a year; he died in 139 in office as one of the Imperial Secretariat, aged sixty-two; Cui Yuan's epitaph summed him as one who 'exhausted heaven and earth with numbers and matched creation itself with his devices' — a rare four-in-one specimen in Chinese science history: poet, astronomer, instrument-maker, local governor.
C-ZHH-001E.text: At a quarterly strategy review a quant lead gives a falsifiable milestone in public: 'this factor's win rate will fall below 52% within forty trading days, or I admit the error and retire it.' For twenty days the factor wins and colleagues begin betting on it again, but he does not touch the milestone; on day thirty-seven the drawdown arrives and the milestone expires precisely inside its window — at the review no one debates whether the model is good any more; the debate becomes 'how should the next batch of milestones be written': prediction published before outcome, no revision inside the interval, settlement by events — three steps done, the team's trust in the milestone system exceeds, for the first time, its trust in any single person.

C-ZHH-002E.text: Two data vendors had argued for two years over whose forecasts were more accurate; the CTO stopped listening to meetings and instead gave each a continuously running prototype sandbox, the same live data feed, one acceptance metric: rolling 90-day forecast-error curves posted on the intranet, visible to all, auto-refreshed daily; three months on, the argument closed of itself — the flatter curve won the contract, the loser received an itemised list of where the gap lay in its input chain; ever after, all algorithm-vendor disputes had one door at the CTO's office: 'plug into the sandbox first, and let the curve speak for you.'

C-ZHH-003E.text: An engineer drafted off to write the group's annual achievements report lays the accomplishments past reproach: revenue, patents, market position, each written to the full; then in the chapter on international strategy, he lets the data's own logic lay out the overseas business end to end — gross margin year by year, retention year by year, return rates year by year, all lawful content of an achievements report, yet together they surface what 'scale bought more than glory' means; the report carries not one critical sentence, but at next year's strategy meeting 'overseas business health' appears for the first time as a standalone agenda item — the genre took the risk for him, and he stands safely in the byline.

C-ZHH-010E.text: A founder's third company reaches, in an industry winter, the day every outer method is spent: financing closed, pivot fruitless, holding on a loss; instead of trying yet another move he shuts the door and writes — first the list of exhausted methods (seven items), then a real measurement of three pairs: motives (do I persist in this thing or in the identity 'I am the founder'), samples (how three predecessors lived this same dead end: one pivoted, one liquidated, one outlasted), coordinates (what cannot change: the industry cycle; what can: team size and my own role); the conclusion of the four-thousand-word review is 'accept the outer post' — he merges the company into a competitor and takes charge of one of its divisions, and two years later relaunches the same product inside the larger firm; he keeps the review to this day: 'that was a real measurement I made of myself, in the place where seeing failed.'

C-SYX-001E.civilization: The farming-scholar world of Fengxin, Jiangxi, and the instructor's post at Fenyi in the late Ming: born 1587 into a gentry family in Fengxin, Jiangxi — provincial juren under Wanli, five failures at the metropolitan examination ended his pursuit of rank; from 1634 a school instructor in Fenyi, Jiangxi, spending his hours outside teaching among the fields, workshops, kilns and foundries nearby; in 1637 the Tiangong Kaiwu printed at Nanchang — the same year brought the Essays on the Times, on Qi, on Heaven and the Poems, five works in one year; later assistant judge at Tingzhou, Fujian and prefect at Bozhou, Anhui, living through the Southern Ming collapse; after the fall of the Ming he retired to his home district, dying around 1666 — a book 'having nothing to do with official fame' became the permanent record of an empire's productive capacity

C-QJS-001E.civilization: The troubled world of late Southern Song mathematics: born in Anyue, Puzhou (Sichuan) in 1208, his father a Song official in the capital — 'in my early years I attended my parents in the capital, where I learned from the Grand Astrologers and received mathematics from hidden gentlemen'; the Mongol invasion of Sichuan in 1235 — 'amid the calamity of invasion, through years of blockade, I did not expect to survive between arrows and stones' — a decade and more as a minor provincial official through the wars; his mother's death brought him to Huzhou for mourning (1244), and there, 'having accumulated much and loath to discard it,' he completed the Shushu Jiuzhang (Mathematical Treatise in Nine Sections) in 1247 — eighteen juans, nine categories, eighty-one problems; the next year he was recommended to the court for calendar studies; later posts in Jiankang, Qiongzhou and Meizhou; died at his Meizhou post in 1268 — contemporaries Liu Kezhuang and Zhou Mi left calumnies of his character, modern scholars such as Guo Shuchun retrace them to political rivalry, and 'separate the learning from the man' remains the frame of his historical image
C-QJS-001E.text: A telecom firm maintained a global roaming billing network: billing cycles differed per region, deduction rules mutually exclusive, and no single 'correct moment' existed. The team dropped the unified-clock plan and applied the dayan move — concede that each system's cycle stands on its own, then find the one day on which all align: write the constraints as a system of congruences, solve for the minimal common solution clause by clause. Within two weeks one feasible alignment window emerged for the whole network. The retrospective title: 'do not unify the things; seek their concurrence.'

C-MDLN-001E.civilization: The world of historiography amid the Song-Yuan transition: born in Leping, Raozhou (Jiangxi) in the mid-1220s, his father Ma Tingluan rising to chief councilor of the Southern Song — Duanlin 'received his father's teaching from childhood,' steeped in the family library and its historical learning; in 1273 his father, at odds with the grand councilor Jia Sidao, resigned and returned home; in 1276 the Yuan army entered Lin'an and the Song fell — Duanlin henceforth lived 'in retirement, refusing office'; the new dynasty repeatedly summoned him to head the Cihu and Keshan academies, and late in life he served as Confucian school instructor of Taizhou — a loyalist of the fallen dynasty teaching within the new; from about 1285 he spent more than twenty years composing the Wenxian Tongkao (Comprehensive Examination of Literature) in 348 juans, completing it around 1307, with presentation to the throne in 1318; among his other works the Jingji Kao (Examination of the Classics and Texts) and commentaries on the Great Learning; he died around 1324 — a life spanning the half century of the dynasty's fall, the historical system completed in retirement after the collapse
C-MDLN-001E.text: A company auditing a ten-year knowledge base found two systems holding contradictory 'facts' that no one dared delete. The archives team rebuilt it on the dual-track of wen and hsien — written records and living testimony credited separately, tagged separately, cross-checked — first establishing a source-hierarchy table for every claim, then collating item by item; contradictions were not deleted but stored side by side with a note 'two accounts coexist.' Three months on, the knowledge base had its first credibility rating. To trace the stream to its source is not to pick a story; it is to lay out where every story came from.

C-MDLN-002E.text: A new CTO inherited a 400,000-line legacy rules system whose categories overlapped and left great blanks. C-LB-001E.civilization: The world of Zhedong strategists at the Yuan-Ming transition: born in Wuyang village, Qingtian, Chuzhou (1311), courtesy name Bowen; jinshi of 1333 under the Yuan, serving as assistant magistrate in Gao'an and vice-intendant of schools in Jiangzhe, until disagreement over the Fang Guozhen affair drove him into retirement; in 1360 Zhu Yuanzhang sent envoys with gold and silk to summon him to Yingtian, where he presented the Eighteen Policies on the Times, was lodged in the Hall for Honoring the Worthy, and conferred nightly behind closed doors; he championed the sequence 'Chen first, Zhang second' and directed the battles of Longwan and Lake Poyang; in early Hongwu he served as censor-in-chief and director of astronomy, helping draft the Great Ming Code and fix the Great Concord calendar; stern by nature and hating evil, at odds with Li Shanchang and Hu Weiyong, he retired to Qingtian in 1371 upon his wife's death, 'drinking wine and playing go, never speaking of merit'; he died in 1375 in grief (by tradition poisoned by a physician sent by Hu Weiyong), posthumously enfeoffed as Earl Wencheng; in late Yuan he wrote the Yulizi's two hundred allegories, and the Baked-Cake Song circulated after his death under his name, one of the 'Four Worthies of Zhedong' with Song Lian, Ye Chen and Zhang Yi
C-LB-001E.text: A startup faces three rivals: the deep-pocketed incumbent, the fastest-growing challenger, and a niche player. A new captain chose his weather window from the archive on his first command and skirted a detour — private experience counts only once written as a public lane.

Within six months such tickets hit zero — the hardness of the translation buys consistency of understanding.

'Version disputes' never recurred — with two texts standing together, each checks and backs up the other.

C-QCJ-001E.civilization: The world of Daoist schools amid the Jin-Mongol transition: Qiu Chuji (1148-1227), courtesy name Tongmi, style Changchunzi, a native of Qixia in Dengzhou, one of the Seven Perfected of Quanzhen and founder of the Dragon Gate lineage; he entered the way at nineteen under Wang Zhongyang and practiced six years of austerity at Panxi and Dragon Gate; summoned repeatedly by Jin and Southern Song, he declined them all, but at the winter of 1219, past seventy, set out on the Great Khan's single summons with eighteen disciples from Laizhou, westward ten thousand li across the Mongolian steppe, over the Altai, through the desert, reaching the Hindu Kush in 1222 for three audiences with Genghis Khan, counseling 'revere heaven and love the people as the root, purify the heart and few desires as the essential' — history's 'one word that stayed the slaughter'; returning east he dwelt at the Taiji Palace in Yanjing (renamed Changchun Palace), charged with all Daoism under heaven, winning remission of clergy taxes, building abbeys widely and sheltering refugees; he died in 1227, buried at Chushun Hall in the White Cloud Temple; his disciple Li Zhichang recorded the journey and audiences as the Journey to the West of the Perfected Changchun, a firsthand source for Yuan-era Central Asian geography and early Mongol religious policy
C-QCJ-001E.text: A startup learned a giant was scouting acquisitions and the window might close in a blink. The CEO set aside the fundraising calendar, flew with his core team to the acquirer's headquarters within three days to pitch in person — the journey itself persuaded them of his seriousness. Two weeks on, exclusive talks were secured: some chances wait not for readiness but for presence.

C-WCY-001E.civilization: 金初的关陇与胶东道门：王重阳（1113-1170），原名中孚，字允卿，后改名德威，字世雄，入道后名喆，字知明，号重阳子，京兆咸阳人。幼业儒，曾中金熙宗天眷年间武举（甲科），任终南县酒监，因怀才不遇、愤然辞官。正隆四年（1159）于甘河镇遇异人授以真诀（'甘河证道'），金大定元年（1161）弃家入道，于终南刘蒋村筑墓自居其中，榜曰'活死人墓'，独居两年余，以死喻生、以墓证道。大定七年（1167）焚庵东行，赴山东宁海州传道，先后度化马钰（丹阳）、谭处端（长真）、丘处机（长春）、刘处玄（长生）、王处一（玉阳）、郝大通（广宁）、孙不二（清静散人）七人，史称'全真七子'；于宁海、福山、登州、莱州、掖县建三教七宝会、三教金莲会、三教三光会、三教玉华会、三教平等会五会，主张儒释道三教合一、以《道德经》《般若心经》《孝经》为门人日诵之经，倡'全真'之名——保全真性、不假外物。大定九年（1169）携马、谭、刘、丘四弟子西归关中，次年正月初四卒于开封，年五十八；葬终南刘蒋村故庵（后成重阳宫，元代为天下祖庭）。生前以马钰嗣教；其《重阳全真集》《重阳教化集》《重阳立教十五论》与弟子所记《重阳真人金关玉锁诀》，奠定全真道先性后命、识心见性、真行功行的教义骨架，身后十余年间七真各开一派，全真道蔚为北方大宗。
C-WCY-001E.text: A engineer deciding to start a company first resigns publicly from his big-tech post and posts his savings as a 'failure bond' to his feed — not reclaimed without success. Three months later the first clients sign; one says: 'A man who stakes everything won't be learning on our project.'

C-WCY-002E.civilization: 金初的关陇与胶东道门：王重阳（1113-1170），原名中孚，字允卿，后改名德威，字世雄，入道后名喆，字知明，号重阳子，京兆咸阳人。幼业儒，曾中金熙宗天眷年间武举（甲科），任终南县酒监，因怀才不遇、愤然辞官。正隆四年（1159）于甘河镇遇异人授以真诀（'甘河证道'），金大定元年（1161）弃家入道，于终南刘蒋村筑墓自居其中，榜曰'活死人墓'，独居两年余，以死喻生、以墓证道。大定七年（1167）焚庵东行，赴山东宁海州传道，先后度化马钰（丹阳）、谭处端（长真）、丘处机（长春）、刘处玄（长生）、王处一（玉阳）、郝大通（广宁）、孙不二（清静散人）七人，史称'全真七子'；于宁海、福山、登州、莱州、掖县建三教七宝会、三教金莲会、三教三光会、三教玉华会、三教平等会五会，主张儒释道三教合一、以《道德经》《般若心经》《孝经》为门人日诵之经，倡'全真'之名——保全真性、不假外物。大定九年（1169）携马、谭、刘、丘四弟子西归关中，次年正月初四卒于开封，年五十八；葬终南刘蒋村故庵（后成重阳宫，元代为天下祖庭）。生前以马钰嗣教；其《重阳全真集》《重阳教化集》《重阳立教十五论》与弟子所记《重阳真人金关玉锁诀》，奠定全真道先性后命、识心见性、真行功行的教义骨架，身后十余年间七真各开一派，全真道蔚为北方大宗。
C-WCY-002E.text: A consultant entering a new market first wins the biggest local lighthouse client, then within two years stands up local teams in five cities under one uniform name and sign, lingering in none. Before headquarters expands, the service network already stands.

C-WCY-008E.text: An executive keeps a weekly hour to review his motives, not his results: did I push this week because the project was urgent, or because I feared looking incapable? Within half a year the team notices he vetoes himself more often than he vetoes others.
